rows.original: "You just wish to speak?" Hretha snorts, a smirk spreading on her black lips. "Now that's a rare thing indeed. I'm not sure half this tribe knows how to string twenty words together... or count that high. Alright. What's on your mind, [pc.name]?"
rows.translation: “你就只想说几句话而已？”赫蕾莎嗤笑道，她黑色的嘴唇上浮现出一丝讥讽的笑容，“这可真是件难得的事啊。我敢说，这个部落里有一半的人恐怕连二十个词都串不起来……更别提数到那么大了。好吧，你想说什么，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: '\n    "You just wish to speak?" Hretha snorts, a smirk spreading on her black lips. "Now that\'s a rare thing indeed. I\'m not sure half this tribe knows how to string twenty words together... or count that high. Alright. What\'s on your mind, [pc.name]?"'

rows.original: "So, the Kervus tribe. Where are you all from exactly?" Hretha shrugs. "Islands east of here. Most of my life I heard them called the 'northern islands,' but we're even more north here, so I guess now they're the eastern islands? The Kervus tribe's territory spread over nine small islands and one larger one, big enough for most of the tribe to live on with all our thralls. There's a big hillfort in the middle of the island — that's where me and my siblings were brought up, with the rest of the tribe in cabins and huts sprawling out for the better part of a mile. It's a mountainous island, heavily forested. Good resources for us to build boats and carve spears and arrow-heads, and the rock shields us from the worst of the wind and cold. That's how we get away with the bare skin under our hides; if we weren't living in valleys between the mountains half the tribe would probably all freeze to death before they sucked in their pride and wore more clothing. The other half would solve the problem by fucking more, sharing their body heat cocks-first." She laughs again with a wry grin. "Eh, I make the whole tribe sound like idiots. They aren't... just the gaggle of warriors Argoth brought with us. Like the gods have to flip a coin between giving an orc brains or brawn, and there's no in between. Most of our craftsmen, priests, and mages stayed behind on the islands, so we're stuck here with the meatiest of meatheads all aching for a fight. I don't envy Arona trying to wrangle them into following her, whatever she decides to do." "Can you tell me some of your tribe's history?" "What history?" Hretha snorts. "We're raiders. One tribe among a hundred in the islands. Most years we raid the coastlands for food and slaves; when things get lean, we turn our hammers towards the other tribes. It's been that way longer than I've been alive. As far back as our skalds' stories go, too. Some legends about our coming to the islands at the dawn of time, of Velun raising them from the sea and sprinkling orcs across them." So her tribe just has... no history? That can't be right. She just shrugs. "Far as I'm concerned, the only history that matters is our heroes. Rathgar son of Rathor; Hillebrand the Conqueror; Fannock the Founder. That matters more to us than remembering what year some shitheel knocked over a tree and made a fort from it. They deserve the skaldic songs." That's one way to look at it, you suppose.
rows.translation: “那么，克尔维斯部落。你们到底是从哪里来的？” 赫蕾莎耸了耸肩。“就在这里的东边，一些岛屿。我大半辈子都听人管它们叫‘北方岛屿’，可我们这里还要更靠北，所以现在它们大概该叫东方岛屿了吧？克尔维斯部落的领地分布在九座小岛和一座大岛上，那座大岛足够让大部分族人连同我们所有的奴隶一起住下。岛的中央有一座大型山寨——我和我的兄弟姐妹就是在那里长大的，其余族人则住在绵延近一英里的小屋和棚屋里。那是座多山的岛，森林茂密。那里有丰富的资源，让我们能造船、削长矛和箭头，而山岩则替我们挡住最猛烈的风寒。正因为这样，我们才能在兽皮底下光着身子；要不是住在山间的谷地里，半个部落大概都会在放下自尊多穿点衣服之前就冻死。另一半则会靠多操逼来解决问题，用鸡巴对鸡巴分享体温。” 她又带着一丝苦笑。“唉，我这么一说，好像整个部落都是白痴。他们不是……只是阿戈斯带来的那帮战士罢了。就像神明在给兽人分配脑子和肌肉时只能抛硬币决定，中间没有别的选项。我们的大多数工匠、祭司和法师都留在了群岛上，所以我们只能跟这群最肥的莽汉困在这里，一个个都痒着要打架。不管阿罗娜决定怎么做，要驯服他们听她的话，我可一点都不羡慕她。” “你能给我讲讲你们部落的一些历史吗？” “什么历史？”赫蕾莎嗤了一声。“我们是掠夺者。是这些岛屿上百来个部落中的一个。大多数年头我们劫掠海岸地带，抢食物和奴隶；年景不好时，我们就把锤子转向其他部落。这规矩比我活着的年头还长。我们的吟游诗人的故事能追溯到多久，它就是多久。有些传说讲我们是在时间之初来到这些岛屿的，讲维伦把兽人从海里托起、撒遍这些岛屿。” 所以她的部落就只有……没有历史？这不可能。 她只是耸了耸肩。“在我看来，唯一重要的历史就是我们的英雄。拉索尔之子拉思加尔；征服者希勒布兰德；奠基者范诺克。记住他们，比记住某个混蛋哪一年砍倒一棵树、用它搭了个堡垒要重要得多。他们才配得上吟游诗人的歌谣。” 你想，这也是一种看待历史的方式。

rows.original:
"So, your brother..."

    "Argoth," Hretha sighs, leaning back against the tentpole. "The big stupid idiot. I told him this would happen — if it wasn't Arona, it would be one of his thanes. He thought he could keep a horde of restless berzerkers on a chain here in the camp forever, that they were loyal to him like some kind of god instead of as the man responsible for filling their chests with booty and their ships with slaves."
    
    She shakes her head, balling her fists. "I should never have told him what I dreamed..."
    
    "Is that how you all ended up here? A dream?" you ask.
    
    "Aye, a dream of dragonfire and hoarfrost," Hretha answers. "The goddess shared with me a prophecy, that the Frost Marches would be host to the greatest battle our world has seen since the Godswar; that a fell beast from beyond our world would come heralding destruction and desolation. My dreams always bear truth to them, [pc.name]. That is my curse and blessing, the gift Lumia gave me in exchange for my sight. It would be a sin not to use it, and yet..."
    
    [pc.bg scholar acolyte|You've heard that story before: the gods give prophecy, but it is always vague and veiled in riddles and misdirection. They may be true, but interpreting them in a way that avoids human suffering is a tall order indeed.
    
    Hretha nods slowly. "Too right."|Having the gift of prophecy sounds like a real boon for a tribe. What's the catch?
    
    Hretha laughs. "The catch is that you have to interpret them. Half the time my dreams are so vague or veiled that I can't make sense of them before it's too late. The other half of the time, acting on them to avoid tragedy only ends up causing what I'd hoped to avoid. The gods are fickle and perverse, and they enjoy watching us writhe in their cages of torment."]
    
    She leans back and sighs. "Normally Argoth treated my dreams with healthy skepticism. He'd help me work through what I'd dreamed, make sense of the gods' riddles. This time, though, was different. Like I lit a fire under his ass. Within a week of my dream, he had us sailing for the Marches at full speed. And yet, he ordered me to not say a word of the reason to anyone, even Arona. When I pushed him, he raged and howled, said that this was to be his destiny — that he was here to meet a great enemy. That'd he'd secure his place in the skalds' songs forever."
    
    When Hretha's knuckles go white with anger and her words trail away, you finish for her: "And now he's exiled."
    
    "Exiled, never to see home again. Exiled, never to see his daughter again. Exiled for what good damn reason but his own fat-headed hubris? Every gods-damned time Lumia gives me these dreams, what good does it do? Nothing! All they bring is suffering..."
    
    "He was a brave warrior. Strong. A fair and just leader, too," Hretha finally says, returning back to the topic of her brother. "Before this, the tribe followed him without question — not because he was a god, or had some great destiny, but because he'd never given them even half a reason to question him. He won the battles he picked, defended our lands fiercely, and handed out gifts of gold and thralls with an even hand. Now I can only hope our little sister lives up to that legacy; hope that she's mature enough to fill the void he'll have left when we return home. I know Arona can lead a warband, but can she lead a village full of pregnant girls and craftsmen? I don't know..."
    
    Neither do you.
rows.translation:
“那么，你哥哥……”

    “阿戈斯，”赫蕾莎叹了口气，背靠着帐篷支柱。“那个又蠢又笨的大块头。我跟他说过会这样——就算不是阿罗娜，也会是他手下的某个领主。他以为他能把一群躁动不安的狂战士永远用链子拴在营地里，以为他们忠于他就像忠于某种神明，而不是把他当成那个负责往他们箱子里装满战利品、往他们船上装满奴隶的人。”
    
    她摇着头，攥紧拳头。“我当初真不该告诉他我梦见了什么……”
    
    “你们就是因为这个才来到这里的？一个梦？”你问道。
    
    “没错，一个关于龙火与霜华的梦，”赫蕾莎回答道。“女神与我分享了一个预言：霜冻边境将迎来自神战以来我们这个世界所见过的最大一场战役；一头来自我们世界之外的凶兽将会降临，带来毁灭与荒芜。我的梦总是应验的，[pc.name]。这就是我的诅咒与祝福——卢米娅以我的视力为代价赐给我的礼物。不用它才是罪过，可是……”
    
    [pc.bg scholar acolyte|你以前听过这样的故事：神明会赐下预言，但预言总是含糊其辞，藏在谜语和误导之中。它们可能是真的，可要把它解读得能避免人间苦难，实在是难上加难。
    
    赫蕾莎缓缓点了点头。“说得太对了。”|拥有预言的天赋对一个部落来说听起来是真正的好事。可代价是什么？
    
    赫蕾莎笑了。“代价就是你必须自己去解读它们。有一半时候，我的梦模糊或隐晦得让我在一切太迟之前都弄不明白。另一半时候，照着梦去行动以避免悲剧，结果偏偏造成了我本想避免的事。神明反复无常又爱捉弄人，他们就喜欢看着我们在他们设下的痛苦牢笼里挣扎。”]
    
    她向后靠着，叹了口气。“平常阿戈斯对我的梦抱持着健康的怀疑态度。他会帮我梳理我梦见的东西，弄懂神明的谜语。可这一次不一样。就像我在他屁股底下点了把火。我做梦后不到一周，他就命令我们全速驶向边境地区。可他却又命令我对任何人都不许提原因，连阿罗娜也不行。我逼问他时，他暴跳如雷地吼叫，说这就是他的宿命——他来此就是为了迎战一个强大的敌人。这样他就能永远在吟游诗人的歌谣中占有一席之地。”
    
    当赫蕾莎愤怒得指节发白、话音渐弱时，你替她把话说完：“而现在他被流放了。”
    
    “被流放，再也见不到家乡。被流放，再也见不到他的女儿。除了他自己那颗肥脑袋的狂妄自大，还能有什么他妈的好理由？每次卢米娅给我这些梦，到底有什么用？一点用都没有！它们带来的只有痛苦……”
    
    “他曾是个勇敢的战士。强壮。也是个公正无私的领袖，”赫蕾莎终于开口，把话题转回她哥哥身上。“在此之前，部落毫无异议地追随他——不是因为他是什么神明，也不是因为他有什么伟大的宿命，而是因为他从未给过他们哪怕半个质疑他的理由。他打赢自己挑起的每一场战斗，凶猛地保卫我们的土地，慷慨而公平地分发黄金和奴隶。如今我只能希望我们的小妹妹不负这份传承；希望她足够成熟，能在我们回家后填补他留下的空缺。我知道阿罗娜能带领一支战团，但她能带领一个满是怀孕女孩和工匠的村庄吗？我不知道……”
    
    你也不知道。

rows.original:
"So, about Arona..."

    Hretha rolls her head back and chuckles. "Ah, yes, the little firebrand of the family. Argoth and I, we're our mother's children, but Arona? She's the spitting image of our father... at least to me. The way she talks, the way she throws herself headfirst at problems without a care for the reasons why... yeah, she's the old man's little girl."
    
    "What happened to your father?"
    
    "Died in battle when he was twenty-five. Way Arona will probably die, I figure. Mother raised us in the great fort, took over when pop bought his farm fighting some up-jumped Sorran crusaders, thought they owned the waves cuz their goddess commanded the storms. He broke them, though. Never heard of their order again. Skalds always think they can impress me with retellings that make him seem larger than life, like a hero from the sagas. What I really remember about him though was bouncing on his knee while he told me those stories. Arona loved them, of course. She'd always sit with me when he sang the sagas, while Argoth was out training to swing the axe under a thane like a proper young lord."
    
    "Of course, where I saw allegory and metaphor in the sagas, all Arona heard was tales of glory and adventure. She wanted to follow Argoth to war, even when she was too small and scrawny to swing a short sword."
    
    It's hard to imagine the muscular titan you know today as ever being scrawny. 
    
    Hretha gives you a conspiratorial smirk at that. "Oh, yeah, she was a little thing. Figured she was gonna grow up littler than me, even; that I'd have to find some big hunk of a thane to marry her off to or she'd end up getting carted off by some other tribe's raiders. But when our mother died, and Argoth became the new chief... something changed in that girl. Started getting into fights, coming home covered in bruises... then she started putting on muscle, more and more every damn day it felt like, until she was as thick around the arms as Argoth was. By then she was ending the fights; sending trained warriors home with broken arms."
    
    "And then she started with the girls," Hretha sighs. "I was proud the first time I heard her sneaking some shieldmaiden in... thought she was really growing up. That she was becoming a true warrior. But a different girl the next night was less charming. When she broke her bed a few weeks later riding some shipwright's daughter's face like a bucking aurochs, I knew something was off with that girl. Horny as an orc boy in rut, and damn near as big as one too."
    
    "Is that how she ended up with the dick?" you ask. It's practically Arona's favorite asset, and she loves nothing more than waving it around threatening to mount people on it. 
    
    Hretha nods and raps her fist on the flat of her bronze staff. "Yeah, I'm responsible for that. She had a few boys here and there, but nine out of ten times I'd hear her across the fort with someone, it'd be another woman. When Arona won the grand melee at the tribe's year-end festival, earning herself the right to ask anything of the chief, I already had done the research to give her what she'd inevitably ask for. Only boon she ever asked of me and Argoth both, as far as I recall. Even when she was little, she wanted to do everything for herself. Cook, stitch, build... and when she realized what would make her complete was a throbbing big cock 'tween her legs, she went and won the biggest fight on the island for the right to claim it as her due."
    
    "I respect her skill at arms," Hretha says after a moment. "But she's immature. Barely twenty, and already overthrowing the chief — her own brother, too. Growing too big for her britches. But I'm still her sister, and damned but I love the girl even if she is a handful. Here's hoping I can guide her down a path of wisdom before she ends up like the old man."
rows.translation:
那么，关于阿罗娜……”

    赫蕾莎仰头轻笑起来：“啊，没错，我们家那个小‘火苗’。阿戈斯和我都是我们母亲的子女，但阿罗娜呢？她简直就是我们父亲的翻版……至少在我看来是这样。她的说话方式，她那种不顾后果、直接迎难而上的人生态度……没错，她就是那位老先生的‘小女儿’。
    
    你的父亲发生了什么事？”
    
    “他二十五岁时在战斗中牺牲了。我想，Way 阿罗娜很可能也会死吧。母亲在那个大堡垒里把我们抚养长大，当父亲为了争夺那片农场与那些自以为是的索拉n十字军战士战斗时，母亲接过了抚养我们的责任。那些人以为他们的女神能够控制风暴，所以他们觉得自己可以随心所欲地支配一切。不过，他确实把它们弄坏了，之后就再也没人听说过它们的下落。那些吟游诗人总以为，通过那些把他的形象描绘得如同传奇英雄般的讲述，就能给我留下深刻的印象。不过，我真正记得的，是他在给我讲这些故事时，总是坐在膝盖上讲。阿罗娜当然很喜欢它们。每当他吟唱那些传说故事时，她总会陪在我身边；而阿戈斯则在外面接受训练，像一个真正的年轻贵族一样，学习如何使用斧头。

rows.original:
You enter the orc tent to the overwhelming scent of onion. As the tentflap flutters shut behind you, you have to stagger for a moment and shield your eyes from the sheer aura of it in the air. Though the scent itself isn't entirely unpleasant, the sting of it in the air from them burns unpleasantly. When you've had enough time to adjust, you can see that there is a pile of chopped onion detritus beside a small pot simmering with what looks like hearty stew.
    
    Hretha guffaws when she senses your struggle, stirring the pot and squeezing the juice of half a lemon over the mixture. Infrith sits on the bedside, looking about as enthusiastic as you are. She does, however, toss you a smile.
    
    "[pc.name]! Just the [pc.manWoman] I was hoping to see. My apprentice here managed to gather enough ursus bulb for a batch of six-bear tonic! Would you care to test it out?" she asks, eyes glinting as much from the devious grin she's giving as the residual onion essence.
    
    "What does that entail?" you ask, managing not to cough. "What's a six-bear tonic?"
    
    "Only the strongest virility tonic I'm capable of making in this shithole!" Hretha laughs again. "There are bigger bulbs in the Sailgraves that do the job better, but these will do fine for now. A good quaff of this will have you ready and able to breed for as long as you need to. Cures infertility, too. Of course, it can also drive you mad with the sudden surge of pent-up desire, and beefs up your pheromones such that you'll be irresistible to any orc woman in the same room. You won't need to worry about a side effect like that, though. Not with two perfectly fertile orc women ready to intercept those desires."
    
    Infrith doesn't voice her agreement right away, but she does squirm and rub her thighs together at the mention of intercepting your desires. From here at least, the stuff doesn't smell awful, and it's certainly an enticing proposition. Is that something you're looking for right now, though? Judging by what she said, there's no way either of them are leaving this place unimpregnated if you drink the tonic...

你走进兽人帐篷，立刻被浓重得令人窒息的洋葱味包围。身后的帐篷门帘飘落合拢时，你踉跄了片刻，不得不遮住眼睛，抵挡弥漫在空气里的强烈刺激。气味本身倒不完全难闻，可其中的辛辣依然灼得人十分难受。等你花了足够时间适应，终于看清一只小锅正在咕嘟炖煮着看似丰盛的浓汤，旁边还堆着一堆切碎后留下的洋葱残渣。
    
    赫蕾莎察觉到你的窘境，哈哈大笑起来；她搅拌着锅里的东西，又将半颗柠檬的汁水挤入其中。因弗丽丝坐在床边，看起来和你一样提不起兴趣。不过，她还是向你投来一抹微笑。
    
    “[pc.name]！正是我希望见到的[pc.manWoman]。我这位学徒设法收集到了足够的熊葱，可以做一批六熊补剂了！你愿意试试效果吗？”她问道。眼中闪烁的光芒，既来自脸上那副狡猾的笑容，也来自残留的洋葱精华。
    
    “要怎么试？”你强忍着没有咳嗽，开口问道。“六熊补剂又是什么？”
    
    “这是我在这个鬼地方能做出的最强壮阳补剂！”赫蕾莎再次放声大笑。“帆葬海岸有更大的球茎，效果也更好，不过眼下这些就够用了。好好喝上一大口，无论需要繁衍多久，你都能随时做好准备、保持能力。它还能治好不育。当然，积压的欲望骤然爆发也可能把你逼疯；而且它会增强信息素，让同一间屋里的每个兽人女人都无法抗拒你。不过你不必担心这样的副作用。这里正好有两个生育能力完美的兽人女人，随时准备承接那些欲望。”
    
    因弗丽丝没有立刻出声表示赞同，不过听到要承接你的欲望，她确实不安地扭动起来，双腿相互摩擦。至少隔着这段距离，锅里的东西闻起来并不糟糕；而这个提议也确实相当诱人。不过，这真是你眼下想要的吗？按赫蕾莎的说法，只要喝下补剂，她们两个就绝不可能没怀上孩子便离开这里……

That elicits a moan from her and a chuckle from Hretha, and then the two of them get to work. It doesn't take long to get the onions diced, and then mashed and scooped into the pot with water and several ingredients that are blocked from your view by the orcish bodies that draw your gaze.     "There. It's ready. Come, then, and drink! While it's still warm."

You brush him off and straighten your back; you're not going to fuck anyone.

        The trio surrounding you immediately steps back, whilst their leader frowns... and then scowls. Yet you stand firm; if their chieftain submits to you, then that means they'll do the same. You're not going to tolerate them making moves on you. There's no joking — you're not fucking them and they're going to have to accept it. You wait and watch, daring the orc with your stance to try it.
        
        But he never does; instead, the warrior turns and sets his mug on the nearby table before facing you with a resigned grumble.
        
        "Come on boys, we're going out. We'll find a harpy or something to fuck with."
        
        The trio all agree silently, watching the drunk step past you before ultimately following him out. Though they're going to still be around, you doubt they'll be waiting to talk to you after this. But at least now, you're free to drink and visit the hall in peace.

        The orc cups her hands together, giving you a foot up towards the exit. "I'll head straight there, start the challenge as soon as I see you again. And listen, [pc.ra orc|even if you're an orc, try not to draw too much attention. The warband's big, but we're like family. Unless you're dealing with a drunk or a fool, anybody will recognize that you don't belong.|try not to draw too much attention. [arona.isVictor|I know the temptation to bend over for every orc dick you see is gonna be real, but try|Try] to stay out of trouble. Things get too loud and the whole camp will come down on you like a hammer, and I can't save you then.]"
        
        Sounds like good advice. You put your foot in Arona's hand and let her heft you up the well. You grab the stone rim at the top and pull yourself up the rest of the way. A hand down brings up [party.som||your companion and |your companions and ]Arona, giving you a moment to look around while the brawny orc clambers up. You're standing next to a well, a rough circle in the rocky ground of the hillside, surrounded by tent flaps and crates of supplies stacked hap-hazardly around. A simple bucket and wheel provides the water to the camp, though the immediate area seems vacant for now. 
        
        "Looks like we're clear," Arona says, a hint of relief in her voice. "Won't stay that way for long, though. Get moving, and I'll meet you in the chief's tent."
        
        She gives you a parting slap on the back and slips out between two of the tents, out into a main thoroughfare. You hear voices from that way a moment later, and shadows moving against the tents — looks like there are plenty of orcs around.
        
        Time to move before one of them gets thirsty. 
        
        [party.oneComp kiyoko etheryn berwyn cait brint
            |"Let us follow Arona's advice and make haste," Kiyoko advises.
            |"I've got a bad feeling about this," Ryn sighs, holding her [etheryn.weapon] close. "L-Let's make this quick, please?"
            |Berwyn covers his nose. "This place reeks."
            |"Wow, you really take me to the nicest places," your kitty complains. "Ugh, the smell... like an unwashed gym!"
            |Brint rolls his shoulders as the amazon leaves. 
        ]

阿罗娜朝岩石上方以及那道照下来的圆形光柱扬了扬头。“水井。就在我们萨满驻扎处的后面。出去后，悄悄摸到酋长的帐篷……它最大，在北端，不可能认错。来。”
        
        女兽人双手交握，托住你的脚，把你推向出口。“我会直接过去；等再次见到你，我立刻发起挑战。还有，听着，[pc.ra orc|即使你是兽人，也尽量别引起太多注意。战团人数众多，但我们亲如家人。除非碰上醉鬼或蠢货，否则任何人都能认出你不属于这里。|尽量别引起太多注意。[arona.isVictor|我知道你看到每根兽人肉棒都想弯腰迎接，诱惑肯定很大，但还是尽量|尽量]别惹麻烦。动静一旦太大，整个营地都会像锤子一样砸向你，到时我可救不了你。]”
        
        听起来是个好建议。你把脚踩进阿罗娜手中，让她将你托上水井。你抓住顶部的石制井沿，靠自己的力量爬完剩余距离。你伸手将[party.som||你的同伴与|你的同伴们与]阿罗娜拉上来；肌肉健硕的兽人攀上井口时，你得以观察四周。你正站在一口水井旁——山坡岩石地面上一个粗糙的圆形开口，四周围着帐篷门帘以及胡乱堆叠的补给箱。一个简单的水桶与转轮为营地提供用水，不过眼下附近似乎空无一人。
        
        “看来周围没人，”阿罗娜说道，声音里带着一丝宽慰。“不过不会一直这样。赶快行动，我在酋长帐篷里跟你会合。”
        
        她告别般拍了一下你的后背，从两顶帐篷之间溜出去，进入一条主要通道。片刻后，那边传来人声，帐篷上也映出移动的阴影——看来周围有很多兽人。
        
        趁还没有人感到口渴，赶紧行动。
        
        [party.oneComp kiyoko etheryn berwyn cait brint
            |“我们听从阿罗娜的建议，赶快行动吧，”清子建议道。
            |“我有种不好的预感，”小琳叹道，将[etheryn.weapon]紧紧抱在身旁。“我、我们快点办完，好吗？”
            |温妮捂住鼻子。“这里臭死了。”
            |“哇，你带我来的地方可真是越来越棒了，”你的猫女抱怨道。“呃，这股味道……像一座从来没人洗澡的训练馆！”
            |亚马逊战士离开时，布林特活动了一下肩膀。
        ]

You push your way through the back flap of the tent. It's your only real way forward that doesn't bring you straight into the open, and there's a subtle scent of incense on the air coming from it that is strangely alluring.[pc.bg acolyte| It reminds you of the temple you once called home.] The interior is dark, illuminated only by embers in a central firepit and a number of scented beeswax candles surrounding it. As your eyes adjust, you see that there are a great many animal skulls and furry tribal fetishes dangling from the tentpole, and between you and the firepit lies a thick bearskin stretched out with its mouth snarling at you.

    [party.has etheryn|"Eep!" Ryn gasps, recoiling from the skin. You quickly assure her it's just a rug. Nothing to be frightened of... until she says that's not what she's looking at.]
    
    Suddenly, you hear a growling from the darkness. You turn sideways, and see something shifting in the shadows... and a pair of large, red eyes stalking towards you. The shape resolves into that of a great black-furred wolf, its pearly fangs bared.
    
    [pc.bg hunter barbarian|"Easy, boy," you whisper, holding up your hands. "Easy..."]
    
    A voice cuts through the darkness, gruff even for an orc but still distinctly feminine. "Gerik? What do you see, old wolf? Who's wandered into my tent now?"
    
    An orc stands up, towering and full-figured despite her musculature. You can just make out dark green skin, largely without scars, and a loose plait of fiery red hair that falls around one shoulder, down to a furred hide bra that struggles to contain a bust that would put even the buxom muscle-babe Arona to shame. The woman strides forward, taking up a staff that had lain against one of the tentpoles, it's head adorned with a radiant sun of bronze.
    
    "I don't recognize your scent... and Gerik doesn't, either," the woman growls. "You have balls, my little lost lamb, invading a priestess's sanctum without her invitation."
    
    [dayNight|The far side of the tent erupts in light, making you recoil with the sudden shift as|The flap on the far side of the tent sweeps open, bathing you in moonlight as] another orcess steps in. While she might be as tall as any other orc, this one is softer than any you've ever seen before: her body is all smooth gray skin and voluptuous curves, with barely a hint of muscle. [pc.corruptionRange 50|She's got a body made for fucking, not fighting, that's for sure.]
    
    "Mistress Hretha!" the young woman gasps, eyes fixing on you[party.sizeRange 1 2 3|| and [companion.name]| and your party]. "Invader[party.hasCompanions|s|]!"
    
    The older orc forms her lips into a tight line. "Yes, Infrith. Your keen powers of observation serve you well." When she returns her attention to you, you notice for the first time that the red-maned priestess's eyes are milky gray and unfocused, seemingly staring off in the middle distance even as she advances on you with her bladed staff in hand. "Now help me subdue [party.som|[pc.himHer]|them|them]."

rows.original:
"Wait!" Hretha growls, putting her hands up in a peaceable gesture. Her bladed sun-staff falls to the wayside, digging into the dirt floor of her tent. "That's enough, Marcher. We yield."

    Infrith gasps. "Mistress? We can't-"
    
    The older orc puts up a hand, silencing her curvaceous counterpart. Hretha's chest heaves, straining against the furred hides barely holding her back. She stares blindly in your direction, grabbing one of the nearby tentpoles to support herself. "I don't know who you are, but I can guess why you've come. My idiot sister's planning her duel with our brother... too soon for your invasion to be a coincidence. If you mean to do my tribe harm, take out whatever vengeance you need on me. Let my young apprentice go. She's just a child."
    
    The other she-orc bites her lip, staring up at you with fearful eyes. Her weapons, too, are on the ground, and her hands are wrapped around the great wolf's neck. Infrith's certainly no child, though... her tits are so huge that they can barely be restrained, and she has a goddess-like fertile figure prime for breeding.
    
    [pc.dcb|You kick their weapons away as you decide what you want to do with them. No sense hurting them — you're the invader after all — but you can think of a few things that a pair of extremely buxom priestesses could do to make up for their aggression.|You tell them to relax, that you're not here to kill anybody.|"Oh I wouldn't hurt a fly!" you giggle.]

rows.original:
"I need weapons," you tell Pavo. "A lot of them."

        One of the ridges over the lizan's eyes raises like a brow. "Got some for sale. Extra things I make between orders..."
        
        You shake your head. "Enough for all the slaves in the pens."
        
        Pavo stares at you for a long moment. "You... planning a revolt? Keep ya voice down then. Kervus men everywhere, drinking or fighting or fucking, but not deaf. Always watching us slaves. But I havta say, I'd love to see them taken down a notch. Got no love for 'em, just don't want any trouble coming back on me. So. Weapons, yeah? I might be able to help, but what I've got was meant for the next scouting party going towards the minotaur gates. If I lose 'em, I get punished. If they find out I gave 'em to slaves that started a rebellion... well, the chief says my hide would make good armor for him."
        
        "So what would it take to get them?" you ask.[flags.PAVO_FOUGHT 2| "Another ass-kicking?"]
        
        "Freedom would be nice," Pavo grunts. "But I run, and the orcs chase me down. Seen it happen plenty. Ain't pretty, what happens after: every man in the clan gets his turn with you. Chief's sister, too, with her mutant cock she's so proud of. Tell ya what, though: the bastards my weapons go to, they're outside the gates. Guarding it, see? You rough 'em up, shame 'em so they won't show their face till I can make new ones... yeah, that can work."

        帕沃久久凝视着你。“你……在策划叛乱？那就小声点。凯尔维斯的人到处都是，不是在喝酒，就是打架、做爱，可他们并不聋。他们一直盯着我们这些奴隶。不过我得说，我很想看他们吃点苦头。我不喜欢他们，只是不想让麻烦回头找上自己。所以，你要武器？我也许能帮忙，但手头那些是给下一支前往弥诺陶洛斯大门的侦察队准备的。弄丢了，我会受罚。要是他们发现我把武器交给发动叛乱的奴隶……哼，首领说我的皮很适合给他做护甲。”

        “能获得自由当然好。”帕沃哼道，“但我一跑，兽人就会追来。这种事我见得多了，之后发生的事可不好看：部落里的每个男人都会轮流上你。首领的妹妹也不例外，她还长着那根引以为傲的变异阴茎。不过这样吧：本来要拿我武器的混蛋就在大门外。他们负责守门，明白吗？你们揍他们一顿，羞辱得他们不敢露面，直到我造出新武器……对，这办法可行。”

"Already done," you tell him. "Gate's open."

rows.original:
Nobody's guarding the slave pen, so you feel fairly confident in approaching it and peeking through the slatted wooden rails keeping the camp's thralls enclosed. There's maybe twenty people inside the pen, mostly dirty humans mixed with a handful of bronze-skinned slender catfolk. They all look weary from overwork, clothes tattered and filthy. Tribe Kervus doesn't seem to take such good care of their labor slaves...

    "You there!" a hoarse voice croaks out as you approach. A human man, maybe thirty years of age and sporting a wild beard and dark curls, pushes himself up against the bars. [pc.ra orc|"You're no Kervus! Are you here to buy us?"|"You're no orc! I can smell them a mile away now... are you here to free us?"]
    
    You can hear the hope in his voice... the desperation. "Please... we've been stuck here for months!"
    
    [party.oneComp etheryn cait
        |Ryn chews on a lip, looking among the slaves. "I thought I had it bad..."
        |Cait sucks in a sharp breath. "Oh, god. You poor people..."
    ]
    
    The pen is secured only by a plank of wood barring the door from the outside. It's probably more the threat of orcish brutality than the walls of their cage keeping these slaves in. [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|Perhaps Arona would be amenable to freeing these people...|Well, a slave uprising would sure help your odds of getting inside, [flags.ORC_SLAVES_ARMED|and now that you've armed them they may be able to fend for themselves.|but as it is, you'd be doing them more harm than good letting them loose.]]
rows.translation:
没有人在看守那个奴隶围栏，所以你毫不犹豫地走了过去，透过那些用来将营地里的奴隶们关起来的栅栏往里面看。围栏里大概有二十个人，大多是肮脏的人类，还有少数皮肤呈青铜色、身材修长的猫族。他们全都因为过度劳累而显得疲惫不堪，衣服破旧不堪、污秽不堪。看来克尔维斯部落并没有好好照顾这些劳工……

    “你！过来！”当你靠近时，一个沙哑的声音传来。那是一个大约三十岁的人类男子，留着杂乱的胡须，一头深色的卷发，他正靠在栅栏上。 [pc.ra orc|你可不是克尔维斯！你是来买我们的东西的吗？|你根本不是兽人！我现在就能闻到他们的味道……你是来救我们的吗？]
    
    你能从他的声音中听出希望……还有绝望。“求你了……我们已经被困在这里好几个月了！
    
    [party.oneComp etheryn cait
        |小琳咬着嘴唇，目光在那些奴隶们身上扫过。“我还以为自己的处境已经很糟糕了……
        |凯特猛地吸了一口凉气，说道：“哦，天哪……你们这些可怜的人……
    ]
    
    这把锁仅仅是用一块木板从外部挡住门而已。其实，将这些奴隶束缚在这里的，恐怕更多的是兽人那种残忍的威胁，而不是他们笼子的墙壁本身。 [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|或许阿罗娜会同意释放这些人……|嗯，如果发生奴隶起义的话，肯定能增加你成功潜入内部的几率。 [flags.ORC_SLAVES_ARMED|现在你们已经为他们提供了武器，他们或许能够自力更生了。|但事实上，如果放任它们自由活动，反而会带来更多的危害而非好处。]]

rows.original:
"Here!" you shout, hucking the basket of javelins and bronze axes over the pen's wall. "Get ready for when I let you out."

        There's a buzz of activity from amongst the slaves as they descend like vultures on the basket, grabbing weapons and passing them out to every slave still able to stand. The middle-aged man that first spoke to you grabs one of the axes and swings it up onto his shoulder, filled with a second wind. "Alright. We're with you, [pc.mf|sir|miss]. Just give us the word and we'll wreak hell upon those Kervus bastards!"
rows.translation:

        奴隶们立刻骚动起来，像秃鹫一样扑向那个篮子，抓起武器分发给每一个还能站得住的奴隶。那个最先跟你说话的中年男子抓起一把斧头，重新振作起来，把它扛到肩上。“好了，我们跟你一起干，[pc.mf|先生|小姐]。只要你一声令下，我们就把那些该死的克尔维斯混蛋打得落花流水！”

rows.original:
You push the lockbar out of position, letting the pen's gate swing open under its own weight.

        "FREEDOM!" one of the catgirl slaves cries out, rushing past you with an exaltant howl. The others are slower to move, gathering themselves up and slowly poking their heads out of their cage.
        
        "Well, come on, you fools!" the old man says, waving his fellow slaves forward. "We aren't ever going to get a better chance. To freedom!"
        
        "FREEDOM!" the other slaves echo, following their de facto leader out of the pens. You turn to follow them, just in time to see the first howling catgirl get clotheslined by an orc amazon walking out of the warrior's lodge. The catgirl flops onto her ass, bawling from the impact as the orcess saunters past her.
        
        [flags.ORC_SLAVES_ARMED
            |The old man rushes forward, cracking her upside the head before she can call out for help. The other slaves rush forward, trampelling the orc on their way towards the gates. There's a faint commotion thataway, but soon the noise dies down again... guess they made it!
            |The freed slaves charge with a collection of roars and battlecries, dogpiling the orc amazon as she yells for help. More orcs come running out of the lodge to see what's going on, only to get dragged into the growling melee outside. There's a lot of screaming and yelling and punches landing, which only draws more attention from the battle-lusty greenskins. 
        
            Uh-oh. Pretty soon, the fight starts moving; unconscious bodies are left behind as a running brawl makes its way deeper into the camp. Most of the fallen are slaves, who are quickly carted off by younger orcs for their own pleasures.
            
            Well, at least you gave them a chance, right? And the orcs have been somewhat cleared out of the lodge, chasing their runaways as they are.
        ]
rows.translation:
你把锁杆推离原位，畜栏的门便借着自身的重量缓缓打开。

        “自由！”其中一名猫女奴隶放声高喊，兴高采烈地嚎叫着从你身边冲过去。其他奴隶动作则慢得多，它们纷纷站起身来，慢慢把头探出笼子。
        
        “喂，快点啊，你们这群傻瓜！”老人说着，挥手示意其他奴隶跟上。“我们再也不会碰上比这更好的机会了。为了自由！”
        
        “自由！”其他奴隶齐声呼应，跟着这位事实上的领袖走出了围栏。你转身跟上去，正好看见最先嚎叫的那个猫女被一个从战士小屋走出来的兽人亚马逊一记横臂撞翻在地。那猫女一屁股摔在地上，痛得哇哇大哭，而那个兽人女则慢悠悠地从她身边走过。
        
        [flags.ORC_SLAVES_ARMED
            |老人冲上前去，在她来得及呼救之前狠狠敲了她的脑袋。其他奴隶也一拥而上，在冲向大门的路上从那个兽人身上踩了过去。那边传来一阵模糊的骚动，但很快声音又平息下去……看来他们成功了！
            |被解放的奴隶们发出一阵怒吼与战吼，蜂拥而上扑向那个正在呼救的兽人亚马逊。更多的兽人从屋里跑出来查看情况，结果也被卷进了外面那场低吼的混战。到处都是尖叫、怒吼和拳头落下的声音，这只会招来更多好战的绿皮的注意。 
        
            哦不。没过多久，这场斗殴就开始移动；失去意识的人被留在原地，混战一路向营地更深处蔓延。倒下的大多是奴隶，他们很快被年轻的兽人拖走，供自己取乐。
            
            不过，至少你给了他们一个机会，对吧？而且兽人也算从那个小屋里清出去了，毕竟他们都去追那些逃跑的奴隶了。
        ]

rows.original: As you draw close to the midst of the merrymaking, an orcish voice bellows out. "Ho, slave!" While the voice was aimed was in your general direction, maybe it wasn't beckoning you in particular. Maybe - "Are you fucking deaf, slave?" No, you're definitely the target of the orc's ire. [pc.isDK|Though it frustrates you to no end, you have to remember not to blow your cover here. Lashing out isn't going to help you any|So much for studying the situation before engaging; a few steps in and you've already drawn attention to yourself]. Doing your best impression of servile meekness, you turn and are faced with a young orc woman, one of the tribe's greener warriors. She's carrying a crude wooden tray with a couple of empty mugs balanced on it, and looks very, very aggrieved at having to serve her elders instead of joining in the cavorting herself. "I'm so sorry," you say. "What did you need of me?" A scowl. "Finally, a slave that isn't either out serving or otherwise occupied. The mead casks are almost empty, [pc.race]. What with the current mood of the lodge, gods know what'll happen when one of the veterans' mugs run dry and there isn't a refill on hand. If you value your ass tonight, you'll make sure that doesn't happen. Understood?" "Of course." The orc snorts and looks like she's got more to say, but a roar for more mead rings out from the head of the table and she hurries over, disappearing into the throng of revelers. Well. Like it or not, this presents you with another potential course of action. If you had something appropriate on you, you could attempt to tamper with the mead being served. Otherwise, the mood in the lodge is running high with sex and pent-up violence alike; it wouldn't take much to provoke the orcs' revelry into a particularly rowdy crescendo, to make an understatement. Then again, all of the above are probably better options than trying to beat down the entire lodge on your own, an almost certainly suicidal course of action — but one nevertheless. Finally, discretion is the better part of valour — if you don't feel up to the task, simply getting the mead from the camp cooks and serving it up is probably your best bet for slipping away without rousing suspicion. What's it going to be?
rows.translation: 当你渐渐接近这场狂欢的中心时，一个兽人的嗓音大吼起来。“喂，奴隶！” 虽然那声音是朝着你所在的大致方向发出的，但也许它并不是专门在叫你。也许—— “你他妈是聋了吗，奴隶？” 不，你绝对是那个兽人怒火的目标。[pc.isDK|尽管这会让你无比恼火，但你必须记住，不能在这里暴露自己的真实身份。大发雷霆对你没有任何好处|说什么先观察情况再动手；结果才走几步，你就已经引起了别人的注意]。你竭力装出一副奴仆般温顺的样子，转过身，面前是一个年轻的兽人女性——部落中那些比较年轻的战士之一。她端着一个粗糙的木托盘，上面放着几个空杯子，看上去非常、非常委屈，因为她得伺候长辈，而不能自己去寻欢作乐。 “非常抱歉，”你说。“你需要我做什么？” 她皱起眉。“总算有个奴隶既没在外面伺候人，也没忙着别的事。那些装蜂蜜酒的桶几乎都空了，[pc.race]。就凭这间小屋现在这股气氛，天知道等哪个老兵的杯子喝干了、手边又没有酒续上时会出什么事。要是你今晚还想保住自己的屁股，就务必别让这种事发生。明白了吗？” “当然。” 那个兽人哼了一声，看起来还想再说些什么，但桌首传来一声要求再来点蜂蜜酒的吼叫，她便匆匆赶过去，消失在欢腾的人群里了。 好吧。不管你喜欢与否，这为你提供了另一个可行的行动方案。如果你身上带着合适的东西，你可以试着在端上桌的蜂蜜酒里动手脚。否则，这间小屋里的气氛已经充满了性欲和压抑的暴力；说得保守一点，只要稍微一激，兽人们的狂欢就能被推向一场格外喧闹的高潮。不过话说回来，以上这些大概都比你独自一人打翻整个小屋要好——那几乎必然是自杀式的举动——但那也是一种选择。 最后，谨慎是勇气中更好的那部分——如果你觉得自己胜任不了这个任务，最简单的办法大概就是去营地厨师那儿取来蜂蜜酒端上去，这样你就能悄悄溜走而不引起怀疑。 会是什么结果呢？

rows.original: Deciding that spiking the mead is probably the safest course of action, you slip out of the warriors' lodge in search of the camp cooks. By the time the inebriated and addled merrymakers gather enough of their wits together to figure out something's amiss, you'll be well and away... or at least, that's the plan. Finding the cooks isn't hard, all you have to do is follow your nose. They're situated just off to the side — it makes perfect sense for them to be so close by the lodge, after all. Under the close supervision of half a dozen heavyset cooks, slaves butcher game, turn spits, and season sauces in the gigantic open-air kitchen; the smell of sizzling fat and meat cooking in its own juices fills the air and joins the rising smoke to be blown away on the wind. As far as the Kervus tribe is concerned, vegetables are something you slice into thin slivers and use to decorate your roast boar. "Hey, what're you doing here?" Striding towards you is a particularly thick cook, waving his ladle menacingly as he closes the distance between you with surprising alacrity, considering his wooden pegleg that's in place of his right leg from the knee down. "You're not here to filch any food, are you, slave?" "No, of course not." Your reassurance doesn't seem to mollify the cook any, and with good reason — it soon becomes painfully obvious that the orcish cooks are spending more time making sure the slaves don't sneak bites out of the meals they're preparing than they are cooking themselves. "I'm here to get more mead for the lodge, they're nearly out." There's a subtle shift in the cook's face, just the tiniest hint of outright naked fear, then his overbearing stature reasserts itself. "Damn right you are. We've got the casks loaded up since forever by the storage tent. If you know what's good for your ass, you'll bring it back to them before they run dry and start thinking sober thoughts." "That's what I was told." "Damn right. Follow me, slave." You bow your head and follow meekly behind the cook, doing your best to ignore the growling of your stomach as you pass through the rows of spits and tables. While you've seen all kinds of slaves while passing through the orcish war camp, those assigned to the kitchens might just be the most miserable-looking of the bunch. Food, food all around them, and nary a bite to eat — or at least, not at a hefty price few of them are willing to pay. "Here we are." He's led you to the front of a gigantic storage tent, in front of which a hand cart has been piled with several upright casks of mead. As you watch, the cook breaks open the casks' bungholes one by one, then draws off equal portions from each to fill a full mug. It soon becomes evident where he got that big belly of his — after a glance to make sure the kitchen slaves are watching, he empties the mug in a matter of seconds before smacking his lips with relish and wiping his mouth with the hairy back of his hand. "Gotta make sure the mead's still good, you know. Just in case. Although I'll say that even though I'm not fit for fighting any more, feeding all these bastards is a battle worthy of any warrior." He gives you a toothy grin. "Okay, [pc.race], off you go now. [party.solo|Don't keep them waiting if you know what's good for you.|You over there —" the cook points a meaty finger at [party.compNames] — "I'll need some help getting some other stuff to the lodge as well.]" So it turns out that you're wheeling five or six casks of mead back to the lodge, [party.solo|struggling by your lonesome even with the hand cart to ease your burden|[party.compNames] trailing behind you laden with several kinds of roasted meat and sweetbreads to boot]. As you turn a corner, you find a nice narrow spot between two large tents that'll take you out of sight — not for long, but long enough for you to do the deed. What're you going to spike the mead with?
rows.translation: 你觉得往蜂蜜酒里掺东西大概是最稳妥的做法，于是溜出战士们的木屋，去找营地的厨子。等那些醉醺醺、脑子发昏的寻欢客攒够清醒的脑子意识到出了问题时，你早就远走高飞了……至少计划是这样的。 找到厨子并不难，你只要跟着鼻子走就行。他们就在旁边不远处——毕竟，他们离那间木屋这么近是再合理不过的。在六个壮硕厨子的严密监督下，奴隶们在那座巨大的露天厨房里宰杀猎物、转动烤叉、给酱汁调味；油脂滋滋作响、肉在自己汁水里烹煮的香味弥漫在空气中，混着升腾的烟被风带走。对克尔维斯部落来说，蔬菜就是把什么东西切成细丝、用来装点烤野猪的玩意儿。 “嘿，你在这儿干什么？”一个格外粗壮的厨子大步朝你走来，一边威吓般地挥着汤勺，一边以出奇麻利的速度拉近与你的距离——考虑到他右腿从膝盖以下都换成了木假腿，这速度实在令人意外。“你不是来偷吃的吧，奴隶？” “不，当然不是。”你的保证似乎没能让那厨子安心多少，而且理由充分——很快你就痛苦地发现，这些兽人厨子花在盯着奴隶、不让他们从正在准备的饭菜里偷嘴上的时间，比他们自己下厨的时间还多。“我是来给木屋再取些蜂蜜酒的，他们快喝完了。” 厨子的脸上掠过一丝微妙的变化，露骨恐惧的痕迹只有那么一丁点，随即他那副盛气凌人的架势又回来了。“说得没错。酒桶早就装好放在储藏帐篷边上了。要是你想让自己屁股好过，就趁他们还没喝干、还没开始清醒地思考之前把酒送回去。” “我被告知的就是这样。” “没错。跟我来，奴隶。” 你低下头，温顺地跟在厨子身后，尽量不去理会肚子的咕咕声，一路穿过一排排烤叉和桌子。你经过兽人军营时见过各种各样的奴隶，但被分到厨房的那些，或许才是这群人里看起来最惨的。食物，食物就在他们四周，却一口也吃不上——或者说，至少得付出他们中很少有人愿意付的高昂代价。 “我们到了。” 他把你领到一座巨大的储藏帐篷前，帐篷前停着一辆手推车，上面堆着几只竖立的蜂蜜酒桶。你看着那厨子逐一打开桶塞，从每只桶里取出等量的酒，装满一大杯。他那个大肚子是怎么来的，很快就一目了然了——他先瞥一眼，确认厨房的奴隶们都在看着，然后几秒钟内就把那杯酒一饮而尽，意犹未尽地咂咂嘴，用手背上毛茸茸的部分擦了擦嘴。 “得确认这蜂蜜酒还没坏，你懂的。以防万一嘛。不过我得说，虽然我已经不适合打仗了，但喂饱这帮混蛋也算是一场配得上任何战士的战斗。”他冲你咧嘴一笑，露出满口牙。“好了， [pc.race]，现在你走吧。 [party.solo|要是你知道什么对自己好，就别让他们等着。|你那边那位——”厨子用肥厚的手指指向[party.compNames] —— “我还需要几个人帮忙，把别的一些东西也送到木屋去。]” 结果就是你得推着五六桶蜂蜜酒回木屋去， [party.solo|就算有手推车减轻负担，也只能独自一人吃力地推着|[party.compNames]跟在你身后，还背着好几种烤肉和甜面包]。拐过一个弯时，你发现两顶大帐篷之间有个不错的小缝隙，能让你避开视线——时间不长，但足够你动手了。你打算往蜂蜜酒里掺些什么呢？
rows.raw: " Deciding that spiking the mead is probably the safest course of action, you slip out of the warriors' lodge in search of the camp cooks. By the time the inebriated and addled merrymakers gather enough of their wits together to figure out something's amiss, you'll be well and away... or at least, that's the plan. Finding the cooks isn't hard, all you have to do is follow your nose. They're situated just off to the side — it makes perfect sense for them to be so close by the lodge, after all. Under the close supervision of half a dozen heavyset cooks, slaves butcher game, turn spits, and season sauces in the gigantic open-air kitchen; the smell of sizzling fat and meat cooking in its own juices fills the air and joins the rising smoke to be blown away on the wind. As far as the Kervus tribe is concerned, vegetables are something you slice into thin slivers and use to decorate your roast boar. "Hey, what're you doing here?" Striding towards you is a particularly thick cook, waving his ladle menacingly as he closes the distance between you with surprising alacrity, considering his wooden pegleg that's in place of his right leg from the knee down. "You're not here to filch any food, are you, slave?" "No, of course not." Your reassurance doesn't seem to mollify the cook any, and with good reason — it soon becomes painfully obvious that the orcish cooks are spending more time making sure the slaves don't sneak bites out of the meals they're preparing than they are cooking themselves. "I'm here to get more mead for the lodge, they're nearly out." There's a subtle shift in the cook's face, just the tiniest hint of outright naked fear, then his overbearing stature reasserts itself. "Damn right you are. We've got the casks loaded up since forever by the storage tent. If you know what's good for your ass, you'll bring it back to them before they run dry and start thinking sober thoughts." "That's what I was told." "Damn right. Follow me, slave." You bow your head and follow meekly behind the cook, doing your best to ignore the growling of your stomach as you pass through the rows of spits and tables. While you've seen all kinds of slaves while passing through the orcish war camp, those assigned to the kitchens might just be the most miserable-looking of the bunch. Food, food all around them, and nary a bite to eat — or at least, not at a hefty price few of them are willing to pay. "Here we are." He's led you to the front of a gigantic storage tent, in front of which a hand cart has been piled with several upright casks of mead. As you watch, the cook breaks open the casks' bungholes one by one, then draws off equal portions from each to fill a full mug. It soon becomes evident where he got that big belly of his — after a glance to make sure the kitchen slaves are watching, he empties the mug in a matter of seconds before smacking his lips with relish and wiping his mouth with the hairy back of his hand. "Gotta make sure the mead's still good, you know. Just in case. Although I'll say that even though I'm not fit for fighting any more, feeding all these bastards is a battle worthy of any warrior." He gives you a toothy grin. "Okay, [pc.race], off you go now. [party.solo|Don't keep them waiting if you know what's good for you.|You over there —" the cook points a meaty finger at [party.compNames] — "I'll need some help getting some other stuff to the lodge as well.]" So it turns out that you're wheeling five or six casks of mead back to the lodge, [party.solo|struggling by your lonesome even with the hand cart to ease your burden|[party.compNames] trailing behind you laden with several kinds of roasted meat and sweetbreads to boot]. As you turn a corner, you find a nice narrow spot between two large tents that'll take you out of sight — not for long, but long enough for you to do the deed. rows.original: With grim determination and purpose, you draw the small vial of berry juice out of your pockets. Knowing full well its deadliness, you take extra care as you pull out the stopper, then move towards the uncorked bungholes on the casks. [party.has cait| Cait's big blue eyes widen as she realizes what you're about to do. "You're going to kill them! The entire lodge!" "Not at this dosage," you reply, although try as you might, your own words sound unconvincing even to you. "One small vial in six entire casks — besides, they're robust creatures. All I want to do is to send them into a very deep sleep." Cait bites her lip. The berries' poisonous qualities are legendary in the Marches, and for good reason; she's clearly wrestling with her conscience for several moments before slumping her shoulders. "I know they're here to raid, burn and pillage. I know that they'd show no more mercy than you are, [pc.name]. I'm not going to stop you... but given how easily this could go wrong, I'm going to say this doesn't sit well with me." She wouldn't be Cait if she were perfectly fine with mass poisoning. Now, to work... ] [party.has etheryn| Ryn eyes you morosely as you lift the vial to the casks. "Oh. Blood Iris." You eye her up and down. "You're familiar with it?" "You could say that." Given Ryn's tone of voice, you're not inclined to press any further, but she continues of her own accord. "I never saw it for myself, but Grandmother was said to favor it as a method of execution. The remaining druids who held onto their faith after she declared the Seven as the pale elves' new religion, yet wouldn't exile themselves... according to the stories, they had one last night of devout merriment and then committed suicide by imbibing blood iris. "My sister favored my grandmother's methods, at least in that regard — and those I saw enough of. A merciful, painless death, Alissa called it, and much less messy than calling for the headsman." Well, you don't intend on killing the orcs, only taking them out of commission for long enough that Arona doesn't meet with any unexpected surprises. Ryn looks askance, but nods. ] [party.has viviane|"Blood Iris? [viv.isDemon|You'll need more than that to kill them. Though I suppose that amount would work for knocking them out. Probably better that way, now that I think about it. More warriors for Arona to command.|Hmmm... I'd normally object, but in this dosage, it should just knock them out. Good thinking, [pc.name].]] Biting your lip, you measure out an equal dose of blood iris into each of the mead casks, taking great care not to let the tiniest smidgen get onto your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Eventually, the vial is emptied — the motion of the cart as you push it the remaining distance to the lodge should ensure it mixes well before it's served. Looks like mead. Smells like mead. Hopefully, tastes like mead, although you're not going to find out first-hand. With how fast-acting the poison is, hopefully all the orcs will be out of commission before someone figures out what's wrong. The rowdy romping of the orcs' merrymaking soon draws near once again; by the looks of it, there're now even more hot bodies pressed into the lodge than when you left. Despite the general chill of the Marches, the interior is practically sweltering with the fire stoked to its limits, and several faces turn at your arrival — and more importantly, that of the cart behind you. "About damn time! Hurry up, slaves — our mugs, they be a'-running dry! You don't want us sober!" They don't indeed. A couple catfolk slaves come running up and to the door, quickly relieving you of your burden[party.hasCompanions|; others receive the still-steaming meats and glazed sweetbreads from [party.compNames]], ferrying them away with the plodding efficiency of defeated spirits. Shouts and laughter rise from the trestle table as mead is poured and mugs are filled once more — the handful of decorated veterans at the head of the table claiming the lion's share of the fresh offerings, of course. Under the pretext of fixing the hand cart's wheel, you linger in the doorway while the remainder of the casks are brought into the lodge, barely daring to breathe as you wait for the poison to take hold. You don't have long to wait — perhaps as little as ten minutes, fifteen tops. The poison permeates flesh, seeping directly into the blood, the heavy dilution rendering it merely virulent instead of outright lethal. One of the younger warriors yawns, shakes her head, and lasts another half-minute before slumping over on the table, tipping over her mug and spilling it all over her dish. The other orcs react with amusement and mockery — that is, until more of them start dropping where they sit, falling off the benches and crashing onto the floor like felled trees. Upset food and spilled mead drip onto the straw-covered floor, and it's at this point the air of the lodge palpably changes, merriment turning to fear-fueled anger as the raiders look around for an enemy to fight, a cause to blame, but find none. "Sorcery!" "Treachery!" "Someone run and get Hretha!" [party.has cait|Cait has her face covered, yet peeps through her fingers at the chaos you've caused — she can't look on, but nor can she look away. ][party.has etheryn|Ryn just sits quietly on the cart, arms folded, slowly shaking her head as an all-too-familiar scene plays out once more. ]Several of the orc warriors try to vomit, to purge themselves of the poison they suspect they've ingested, but it's far too late for them at this point. Something long-absent in the faces of the lodge slaves glimmers once more in their gazes, hope — and it's a brave, mangy-looking catfolk who grabs a mace off an unconscious warrior and finishes the job the poison started. The result is short and brutal. Unable to put up much of a resistance, the orcish warriors in the lodge quickly fall in the melee that ensues, beaten down with their own weapons. Argoth's cronies alone manage to put up a bit of a fight, debilitated by the blood iris as they are, but even they succumb at last to the sheer weight of the slave rabble and are beaten down handily. There's not a moment to lose. Armed with a surfeit of some of the finest weapons to be had in the orc camp, the slaves push past you on their way out, making a beeline for the pens, clearly intent on acquiring reinforcements for themselves. [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|What a surprise they're going to be in for when they get there and find them empty. ] A couple of them nod at you on the way out, clearly suspecting you having something to do with the sudden turn of fate, but none waste precious time lingering to speak. [party.has etheryn|Ryn sighs, clearly upset by all this. "Looks like it's over."] One more thing remains. A heavy beam lies to one side of the door, allowing the door to be barred from both sides; you set it in place with a grunt of effort, then push the hand cart against the door, locking the beam in place. That should inconvenience the warriors some when they finally come to, and buy you more time. A job well done — it's time to move on, either to cause more havoc in the warcamp, or to the chieftain's tent if you're ready to put an end to this.
rows.translation: 你带着坚定的决心和目的，从口袋里掏出了那小瓶浆果汁。明知这种液体具有致命性，你在拔开瓶塞时格外小心，随后便将瓶子对准那些已经打开的酒桶接口。 [party.has cait| 当凯特意识到你即将要做什么时，她那双大大的蓝眼睛顿时睁得更加大了。你会把他们全部杀死的！整个部落都会遭殃的！ 以这种剂量的话，不行。你试图回复，但无论怎么努力，你自己的话听起来甚至连你自己都不觉得有说服力。六整桶酒里只有一小瓶这种药剂——而且，它们本身就是强壮的生物。我所要做的，只是让它们进入深度睡眠状态而已。 凯特咬住了嘴唇。在边境地区，这些浆果的毒性是出了名的，而且这种名声确实是有根据的；显然，她内心正在激烈地挣扎了好一会儿，最终才耸了耸肩。 我知道他们来这里是为了劫掠、焚烧和破坏一切。我也知道，他们会像你们一样，毫无怜悯之心。 [pc.name]我不会阻止你……但考虑到这件事很容易出错，我必须说，我对此感到很不放心。 如果她不是这样的话，她就不会是凯特了。是大规模中毒也完全没问题。现在，开始工作吧…… ] [party.has etheryn| 当你将小瓶举向那些酒桶时，小琳沮丧地注视着你。哦，血之鸢尾。 你上下打量了她一番。你熟悉这个吗？ 也可以这么说。从小琳的语气来看，你本来并不想继续追问下去，但她却主动继续说了下去。我从未亲眼见过这一幕，但据说祖母偏爱这种处决方式。在她宣布将‘七圣’作为苍白精灵的新宗教之后，那些依然坚守信仰却不愿流亡的德鲁伊们……据传说，他们在那个夜晚举行了最后的虔诚仪式，随后便饮下血鸢尾花汁自杀了。 至少在这一点上，我姐姐更赞同我祖母的做法——至少就我看到的那些情况而言。她称之为‘一种仁慈的、无痛的死亡方式’，而且这种方式比请刽子手来执行处决要省事得多。 嗯，你并不是真的想杀死那些兽人，只是想让他们暂时无法行动，这样阿罗娜就不会遇到任何意外的麻烦。 小琳有些疑惑地看了你一眼，但还是点了点头。 ] [party.has viviane|血之鸢尾花？ [viv.isDemon|仅仅依靠那些是远远不够杀死它们的。不过，我想那样的数量应该还是可以的会这样反而能把他们彻底击败。现在想来，这样做或许更好。这样阿罗娜就能拥有更多战士来指挥了。|嗯……通常我会反对这种做法，但以这种剂量的话，应该能把他们弄晕吧。想得不错，[pc.name]。]] 你咬着嘴唇，小心翼翼地将等量的血虹草汁倒入每一个蜂蜜酒桶中，生怕有一点点汁液溅到自己身上。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]最终，小瓶里的内容物会被完全倒出来——当你将推车推到小屋那里时，推车的运动过程应该能够确保这些成分在被端上桌之前充分混合。 看起来像蜂蜜酒，闻起来也像蜂蜜酒。希望真是这样吧味道就像蜂蜜一样，不过你恐怕永远无法亲身体会这一点。由于这种毒药的见效速度如此之快，希望在有人弄清楚到底发生了什么之前，所有那些兽人就已经无法行动了。 不久之后，那些兽人喧闹的狂欢声又再次传来；看样子，现在挤在小屋里的那些“火热的身躯”比你离开时还要多。尽管边境地区普遍气候寒冷，但这里由于火堆被烧得旺旺燃烧，室内温度简直高得令人难以忍受。当你到达时，有好几双眼睛转向了你——更重要的是，你身后那辆马车的主人也注意到了你的到来。 终于等到这一刻了！快点，这些奴隶们——我们的杯子都快喝空了！你们肯定不希望我们保持清醒吧！ 他们确实没有。几个猫族奴隶跑过来，迅速帮你们卸下了负担。[party.hasCompanions|而其他人则能吃到那些还热气腾腾的肉类以及糖衣甜面包。 [party.compNames]]那些被击败的灵魂，以一种缓慢而乏力的方式，将人们带离了那里。当蜂蜜酒被倒入杯中，人们再次举杯欢笑时，桌旁那几位装饰华丽的老兵们自然抢走了大部分新鲜的食物。你以修理手推车车轮为借口，在门口徘徊，而其他那些桶已经被搬进了小屋。你紧张得几乎不敢呼吸，就在等待毒药开始发挥作用的那一刻。 你等待的时间并不长——也许只需要十分钟，最多十五分钟而已。这种毒素会渗透到肌肉组织中，直接进入血液。由于被大量稀释，它的毒性虽然依然存在，但已经不足以致人死亡。其中一位年轻的战士打了个哈欠，摇了摇头，又坚持了半分钟左右，最终瘫倒在桌子上，杯子从手中掉落，里面的液体洒了一地。其他兽人们纷纷露出戏谑和嘲弄的神情——直到更多兽人开始在他们坐的地方突然倒下，从长凳上摔落到地面，就像被砍倒的树木一样。洒落的食物和溢出的蜂蜜酒滴在铺着稻草的地板上，就在这一刻，小屋里的气氛发生了明显的变化，原本的欢乐瞬间被恐惧引发的愤怒所取代。那些袭击者四处张望，想要找到敌人来攻击，想要找到可以责备的对象，但却一无所获。 魔法！ 背叛！ 快去把赫蕾莎找来！ [party.has cait|凯特将脸遮住，却还是从指缝间窥视着你所引发的这场混乱——她既不忍直视，又无法移开视线。 ][party.has etheryn|小琳只是静静地坐在手推车上，双臂交叠，当这一幕再次上演时，她缓缓地摇了摇头。 ]几名兽人战士试图呕吐，试图将他们怀疑自己摄入的毒素排出体外，但此时已经为时过晚。那些长期消失在营地里奴隶们的眼中，再次闪烁着希望的光芒——而正是那只外表瘦弱、满身污垢的猫族，从一名昏迷的战士手中夺过一根钉头锤，完成了毒素未能完成的任务。 结果简洁而残酷。那些躲在营舍里的兽人战士几乎无法进行任何抗性，在随之而来的近战中，他们纷纷被自己的武器击倒。唯有阿戈斯的亲信们勉强进行了些抗性——尽管他们已经受到了“血之鸢尾”的影响而实力大减，但最终还是在这股奴隶暴民的压倒性力量面前屈服了，被轻易地击败。 一刻也不能耽误。这些奴隶手中拿着兽人营地里最精良的武器，他们从你身边挤过去，径直朝着那些畜栏方向走去，显然是为了为自己争取援兵。 [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|当他们到达那里却发现里面空无一物时，该会多么惊讶啊…… ]有几个人在离开时朝你点了点头，显然怀疑你与这一突如其来的变故有关，但没有人浪费宝贵的时间停下来与你交谈。 [party.has etheryn|小琳叹了口气，显然对这一切感到非常不安。看来一切都结束了。] 还有一件事需要处理。门的一侧有一根重型的横梁，可以将门从两侧都锁住；你费了些力气才把它固定到位，然后把手推车抵在门上，让横梁真正锁住。等那些战士最终赶来的时候，这肯定会给他们带来麻烦，从而为你争取更多时间。 干得不错——是时候继续行动了。要么继续在军营里制造混乱，要么如果你已经决定结束这一切，就前往首领的帐篷吧。
rows.raw: " With grim determination and purpose, you draw the small vial of berry juice out of your pockets. Knowing full well its deadliness, you take extra care as you pull out the stopper, then move towards the uncorked bungholes on the casks. [party.has cait| Cait's big blue eyes widen as she realizes what you're about to do. "You're going to kill them! The entire lodge!" "Not at this dosage," you reply, although try as you might, your own words sound unconvincing even to you. "One small vial in six entire casks — besides, they're robust creatures. All I want to do is to send them into a very deep sleep." Cait bites her lip. The berries' poisonous qualities are legendary in the Marches, and for good reason; she's clearly wrestling with her conscience for several moments before slumping her shoulders. "I know they're here to raid, burn and pillage. I know that they'd show no more mercy than you are, [pc.name]. I'm not going to stop you... but given how easily this could go wrong, I'm going to say this doesn't sit well with me." She wouldn't be Cait if she were perfectly fine with mass poisoning. Now, to work... ] [party.has etheryn| Ryn eyes you morosely as you lift the vial to the casks. "Oh. Blood Iris." You eye her up and down. "You're familiar with it?" "You could say that." Given Ryn's tone of voice, you're not inclined to press any further, but she continues of her own accord. "I never saw it for myself, but Grandmother was said to favor it as a method of execution. The remaining druids who held onto their faith after she declared the Seven as the pale elves' new religion, yet wouldn't exile themselves... according to the stories, they had one last night of devout merriment and then committed suicide by imbibing blood iris. "My sister favored my grandmother's methods, at least in that regard — and those I saw enough of. A merciful, painless death, Alissa called it, and much less messy than calling for the headsman." Well, you don't intend on killing the orcs, only taking them out of commission for long enough that Arona doesn't meet with any unexpected surprises. Ryn looks askance, but nods. ] [party.has viviane|"Blood Iris? [viv.isDemon|You'll need more than that to kill them. Though I suppose that amount would work for knocking them out. Probably better that way, now that I think about it. More warriors for Arona to command.|Hmmm... I'd normally object, but in this dosage, it should just knock them out. Good thinking, [pc.name].]] Biting your lip, you measure out an equal dose of blood iris into each of the mead casks, taking great care not to let the tiniest smidgen get onto your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. Eventually, the vial is emptied — the motion of the cart as you push it the remaining distance to the lodge should ensure it mixes well before it's served. Looks like mead. Smells like mead. Hopefully, tastes like mead, although you're not going to find out first-hand. With how fast-acting the poison is, hopefully all the orcs will be out of commission before someone figures out what's wrong. The rowdy romping of the orcs' merrymaking soon draws near once again; by the looks of it, there're now even more hot bodies pressed into the lodge than when you left. Despite the general chill of the Marches, the interior is practically sweltering with the fire stoked to its limits, and several faces turn at your arrival — and more importantly, that of the cart behind you. "About damn time! Hurry up, slaves — our mugs, they be a'-running dry! You don't want us sober!" They don't indeed. A couple catfolk slaves come running up and to the door, quickly relieving you of your burden[party.hasCompanions|; others receive the still-steaming meats and glazed sweetbreads from [party.compNames]], ferrying them away with the plodding efficiency of defeated spirits. Shouts and laughter rise from the trestle table as mead is poured and mugs are filled once more — the handful of decorated veterans at the head of the table claiming the lion's share of the fresh offerings, of course. Under the pretext of fixing the hand cart's wheel, you linger in the doorway while the remainder of the casks are brought into the lodge, barely daring to breathe as you wait for the poison to take hold. You don't have long to wait — perhaps as little as ten minutes, fifteen tops. The poison permeates flesh, seeping directly into the blood, the heavy dilution rendering it merely virulent instead of outright lethal. One of the younger warriors yawns, shakes her head, and lasts another half-minute before slumping over on the table, tipping over her mug and spilling it all over her dish. The other orcs react with amusement and mockery — that is, until more of them start dropping where they sit, falling off the benches and crashing onto the floor like felled trees. Upset food and spilled mead drip onto the straw-covered floor, and it's at this point the air of the lodge palpably changes, merriment turning to fear-fueled anger as the raiders look around for an enemy to fight, a cause to blame, but find none. "Sorcery!" "Treachery!" "Someone run and get Hretha!" [party.has cait|Cait has her face covered, yet peeps through her fingers at the chaos you've caused — she can't look on, but nor can she look away. ][party.has etheryn|Ryn just sits quietly on the cart, arms folded, slowly shaking her head as an all-too-familiar scene plays out once more. ]Several of the orc warriors try to vomit, to purge themselves of the poison they suspect they've ingested, but it's far too late for them at this point. Something long-absent in the faces of the lodge slaves glimmers once more in their gazes, hope — and it's a brave, mangy-looking catfolk who grabs a mace off an unconscious warrior and finishes the job the poison started. The result is short and brutal. Unable to put up much of a resistance, the orcish warriors in the lodge quickly fall in the melee that ensues, beaten down with their own weapons. Argoth's cronies alone manage to put up a bit of a fight, debilitated by the blood iris as they are, but even they succumb at last to the sheer weight of the slave rabble and are beaten down handily. There's not a moment to lose. Armed with a surfeit of some of the finest weapons to be had in the orc camp, the slaves push past you on their way out, making a beeline for the pens, clearly intent on acquiring reinforcements for themselves. [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|What a surprise they're going to be in for when they get there and find them empty. ] A couple of them nod at you on the way out, clearly suspecting you having something to do with the sudden turn of fate, but none waste precious time lingering to speak. [party.has etheryn|Ryn sighs, clearly upset by all this. "Looks like it's over."] One more thing remains. A heavy beam lies to one side of the door, allowing the door to be barred from both sides; you set it in place with a grunt of effort, then push the hand cart against the door, locking the beam in place. That should inconvenience the warriors some when they finally come to, and buy you more time. A job well done — it's time to move on, either to cause more havoc in the warcamp, or to the chieftain's tent if you're ready to put an end to this."

rows.original: You don't have any Blood Iris on hand.
rows.translation: 你手头上没有任何“血鸢尾”。
rows.raw: "You don't have any Blood Iris on hand."

rows.original: Remembering how potent the venom of the Foothills' wyverns is, you suppress a shudder — or perhaps a shiver — as you pull it out of your belongings. The moment you uncork the flask, the sweet smell that rushes to meet you is heady and intoxicating, a perfect fit for the casks of dark mead sitting in the cart. Just looking at it and smelling the fumes that rise into the air makes your mind wander places... diluted as it'll be, there'll still probably be enough to get the entire lodge into a more amorous state of mind. It might not be outright poison, but at least spiking the mead this way is far less likely to arouse suspicion — an orgy taken a bit too far is much less alarming than orcs dropping in their seats. No time to waste daydreaming, then. Taking advantage of the cook's gluttony, you pour an equal amount of pink venom into the open bungholes, the rich, viscous fluid seemingly taking forever to ooze into the drink. Once you've got as much as you can into the casks, you seal the empty flask and prepare to make for the lodge — the cart's motions should ensure the casks are well-mixed by the time you get there. [party.has brint| "[pc.name], I'm not feeling so good," Brint mutters. "A little dizzy." You turn to Brint and find the minotaur rubbing his temples with a hand — and massively tenting his loincloth in the bargain. Looks like the fumes got to him somewhat harder than one would have expected, but then again, the denizens of Khor'minos aren't known for their chastity. "Are you all right?" you ask. "The smell was pretty heavy, even for me. I need you thinking with the right head until we're out of here." Brint waves off your concern. "I just need... a little while." So be it. Half a minute of tense silence passes in the narrow space between the tents, you half-expecting some passing orc to call you out for slacking off any moment. Thankfully, your fears aren't realized, and Brint heaves a big sigh as his erection diminishes somewhat now that the scent's dissipated. "All right, [pc.name], we can move on. They're no doubt wondering where the mead went." ] [party.has berwyn| As you prepare to move off, you notice Berwyn fidgeting behind you uncomfortably — the poor trappy dogboy is sporting a massive doggy boner in his robes, his cheeks flushed as he tries to hide his embarrassment. Seems like the aphrodisiac venom's scent got to the poor boy. "Do I have to go out like this?" he whimpers, although it's clear that the question is merely a formality. "Well, look at it this way," you reply. "With a hard-on line that, maybe one of the orcish warrior women will fancy a fuckboy, instead of their menfolk deciding the same." Berwyn swallows hard and falls in line behind you. ] It doesn't take long for you to make your way back to the warriors' lodge, the rickety handcart wobbling under its sloshing load. The rowdy romping of the orcs' merrymaking soon draws near once again; by the looks of it, there're now even more hot bodies pressed into the lodge than when you left. Despite the general chill of the Marches, the interior is practically sweltering with the fire stoked to its limits, and several faces turn at your arrival — and more importantly, that of the cart behind you. "About damn time! Hurry up, slaves — our mugs, they be a'-running dry! You don't want us sober!" They don't indeed. A couple catfolk slaves come running up and to the door, quickly relieving you of your burden[party.hasCompanions|; others receive the still-steaming meats and glazed sweetbreads from [party.compNames]], ferrying them away with the plodding efficiency of defeated spirits. Shouts and laughter rise from the trestle table as the drink you brought is served and mugs are filled once more — the handful of decorated veterans at the head of the table claiming the lion's share of the fresh offerings, of course. Under the pretext of fixing the hand cart's wheel, you linger in the doorway while the remainder of the casks are brought into the lodge, wondering when the aphrodisiac venom's effects are going to take hold. As it happens, you don't have long to wait. Before long, the general rowdiness of the lodge erupts into a true raucous caucus, the orcs shouting for the slaves to bring them more of this amazingly fine mead that's being served. By degrees, the general atmosphere of the warrior's lodge passes through mere disorder into true unhinged territory. Trembling slaves bring food as ordered, but the meats remain untouched as the orcs all participate in some unspoken contest as to who can guzzle down the most drink in an equally undignified fashion. Mead spills down chins and seeps into furs and hide; it spills onto the table and drips down to the floor. "Living gods, this is some fine stuff, not the swill we've been having for a while." "Where'd we get it? Did someone go raiding without us noticing? It damn well isn't the stuff we brought over." "Nah, Arona and her girls are the only ones who've been out, and she isn't raiding nothing. Not on her own." That raises a number of guffaws from Argoth's goons at the head of the table. You're starting to wonder if the venom's going to ever kick in when one of the decorated veterans pulls over not one of the slaves as might be expected, but a younger warrior who's at serving her elders. The tray in her hands tumbles out of her grasp, splashing the both of them with copious amounts of freshly-tapped mead. She squirms in his grasp, inadvertently grinding against the massive erection he's sporting, although whether she's resisting or encouraging him is hard to tell. "Now what's a strong young thing like you doing serving drink when there're slaves aplenty to do the job? Come on, sit down, don't be shy. You can serve your elders much better this way." More rapacious laughter. For a moment, the young warrior looks like she might slap the old bastard, then pulls him into a voracious kiss while her hands pull at his leathers, ripping out a massive erection for all to see. That gets things going. Given the go-ahead by their betters, the orcs are quick to release their pent-up frustrations and be rid of their ennui; a palpable wave of lust sweeps through the entirety of the warriors' lodge as an orgy rapidly foments within its confines. Slaves scurry for cover, but the pretext of serving food is hardly enough to save them from the privations of their masters; even so, there're hardly enough slaves to go around, and the orc quickly turn to each other to slake their lusts. In the blink of an eye, there's an enormous orgy going on in the lodge, a writhing mass of furtive flesh quickly shedding clothing and propriety alike under the aphrodisiac venom's spell. [party.has cait|"Oh my," Cait murmurs as she surveys the ongoing orgy playing out in front of her eyes. "You know, [pc.name], when this is all over and done, I wonder if I could get some of that venom to take home. I'm sure the temple would find it very interesting."] Seems like your work here is done — with the overpowering stench of sex mixing in with that of fire and food alike, none of the orcs in the lodge are going to be in any shape to do very much for a good long while. To seal the deal, a heavy beam lies to one side of the door, allowing the door to be barred from both sides; you set it in place with a grunt of effort, then push the hand cart against the door, locking the beam in place. That should buy you more time when the orgy participants finally get to wanting to leave. With that, it's time to move on, either to cause more havoc in the warcamp, or to the chieftain's tent if you're ready to put an end to this.
rows.translation: 想到山脚地区那些翼龙的毒液有多么致命，你在从物品中取出那瓶毒液时不禁打了个寒颤。当你打开瓶盖的那一刻，扑面而来的甜腻香气令人陶醉，这种气味与马车里那些装着黑麦酒的桶子简直再合适不过了。仅仅看着它，闻着那些升腾到空气中的香气，就会让人的思绪飘向远方……虽然这些香气的浓度已经被稀释了，但应该还是足以让整个小屋里的氛围变得更加浪漫。这或许不算真正的毒药，但用这种方式为蜂蜜酒增添香味，肯定不会引起别人的怀疑——毕竟，一场过于热烈的狂欢，远没有兽人突然瘫坐在地上那么令人惊慌。 那就没有时间再做白日梦了。利用厨子贪吃的习惯，你把等量的粉红色毒液倒入那些敞开的容器中，这种浓稠的液体似乎需要很长时间才能渗入饮料中。当你把尽可能多的毒液倒入桶里后，就把空瓶子封好，然后准备前往小屋——路途中马车的颠簸应该会让这些桶里的液体充分混合起来。 [party.has brint| "[pc.name]，我最近感觉不太舒服。布林特低声嘟囔着。有点头晕。 你转向布林特，发现那个弥诺陶洛斯正用一只手揉着太阳穴——与此同时，他的缠腰布也被严重地拉得变形了。看来那些有毒烟雾对他的影响比人们预想的要严重得多，不过话说回来，科尔米诺斯的居民们向来以不检点著称。 你没事吧？你说呢。这种气味实在很浓烈，就连我也觉得难以忍受。在我们离开这里之前，你必须保持清醒的头脑，认真思考每一件事。 布林特对你的关心不以为意，只是摆了摆手表示不必担心。我只需要……一点时间而已。 就这样吧。在帐篷之间的狭窄空间里，半分钟的紧张沉默悄然流逝，你甚至有点担心会遇到某个路过的兽人，指责你偷懒。幸运的是，你的担忧并没有成为现实。当那股气味逐渐消散后，布林特终于长舒了一口气，他的紧张情绪也有所缓解。 好吧， [pc.name]，那么，我们可以继续下去了。他们肯定在疑惑那些蜂蜜酒去哪儿了。 ] [party.has berwyn| 就在你准备离开的时候，你注意到贝尔温在你身后坐立不安——这个可怜的家伙穿着长袍，却因为兴奋而难以控制自己的身体，他的脸颊涨得通红，拼命想要掩饰自己的尴尬。看来那种催情毒液的气味确实对他产生了影响。 我真得这样出门吗？他呜咽着，尽管很明显，这个问题只不过是走个形式而已。 嗯，这样想吧。你回复吧。采用这种直接了当的方式，或许会让一些兽人女战士们更愿意选择那些花花公子，而不是让她们的男性伴侣来决定这种事情。 贝尔温艰难地咽了口唾沫，然后跟在了你的身后。 ] 你没花太长时间就回到了战士们的小屋，那辆摇摇晃晃的手部推车在装载着重型的货物时显得格外不稳。不久之后，兽人们喧闹的嬉戏声又传了过来；看起来，现在小屋里的挤满的人比你离开时还要多。尽管边境地区的气温普遍较低，但小屋里的火已经被烧得旺旺的，室内简直热得让人难以忍受。当你走进小屋时，有好几双眼睛转向了你——更重要的是，你身后那辆手部推车也引起了他们的注意。 终于等到这个时候了！快点，这些奴隶们——我们的杯子都快喝空了！你们肯定不希望我们保持清醒吧！ 他们确实没有。几个猫族奴隶跑过来，迅速帮你们卸下了负担。[party.hasCompanions|而其他人则能吃到那些还热气腾腾的肉类以及糖衣甜面包。 [party.compNames]]那些被击败的灵魂，以一种缓慢而机械的方式，将人们送离了那里。当你端来的饮料被端上桌，杯子再次被倒满时，桥牌桌上响起了人们的欢呼声和笑声——当然，那些坐在桌前的几位装饰华丽的老兵们，抢走了大部分新鲜上来的食物。你以修理手部推车车轮为借口，在门口徘徊，而其他那些桶已经被搬进了小屋。你心里在想：这种催情毒液的效果究竟什么时候才会显现出来呢？ 事实上，你并没有等太久。不久之后，营地的喧闹气氛逐渐演变成了一场真正的混乱场面——那些兽人们大声呼喊，让奴隶们再给他们拿来一些这种美味无比的蜂蜜酒。渐渐地，战士营地的整体氛围从单纯的混乱状态彻底陷入了彻底失控的境地。颤抖的奴隶们按照命令端来了食物，但那些肉类却无人问津——因为所有兽人都在参加一场无声的竞赛，看谁能够以同样粗俗的方式喝下最多的酒。麦酒从他们的下巴上流淌下来，渗进毛皮和皮革中；它洒在桌子上，又滴落到地板上。 活生生的神明啊，这可真是美味极了，和我们这些天吃到的那些东西完全不一样。 我们这是从哪儿弄来的？难道有人在我们不知情的情况下去偷拿了这些东西吗？这肯定不是我们之前带过来的东西。 不，只有阿罗娜和她的朋友们出去过了，其他人都没有。她并不是在独自进行袭击行动。 这引得坐在桌前的阿戈斯那些手下们爆发出一阵阵哄笑。你不禁开始怀疑：当那些身负荣誉的资深战士们没有选择那些奴隶，而是选择了一位正在为长辈们服务的年轻战士时，这种“毒药”究竟还会不会产生效果呢？她手中的托盘突然从手中滑落，大量的新鲜蜂蜜溅在了他们两人身上。她在他的怀抱中扭动身体，不自觉地蹭到了他那坚硬的勃起部位，不过很难分辨她是在抗拒还是在鼓励他。 像你这样一个强壮的年轻人，为什么要在有那么多奴隶可以来做这份工作的时候去端酒呢？来吧，坐下来，别害羞。这样你才能更好地为长辈们服务。 更多贪婪的笑声。有那么一瞬间，这位年轻的女战士看起来似乎想要扇那个老混蛋一耳光，但随后她却将他拉进一个热烈的吻中，同时用手扯扯他的皮衣，结果将他的阴茎扯了出来，让在场的所有人都看到了。 这样一来，事情就开始了。在得到了上级的许可后，兽人们立刻释放了他们压抑已久的愤怒与烦躁，彻底摆脱了那种无聊与倦怠的感觉；一股强烈的欲望浪潮迅速在全体战士们的驻地中蔓延开来，一场疯狂的狂欢活动很快就在那里爆发了。奴隶们慌忙寻找掩护，但以“端菜”为借口，实在不足以让他们免受主人的欺压与剥削；即便如此，奴隶的数量也远远不够，于是那些兽人便开始互相残杀，以满足自己的欲望。转瞬间，小屋里便陷入了一场疯狂的狂欢之中——一群人急切地脱掉衣服，完全抛弃了所有的矜持与礼貌，在这种催情毒药的作用下，他们的身体开始疯狂扭动、交织在一起。 It might not be outright poison, but at least spiking the mead this way is far less likely to arouse suspicion — an orgy taken a bit too far is much less alarming than orcs dropping in their seats. Despite the general chill of the Marches, the interior is practically sweltering with the fire stoked to its limits, and several faces turn at your arrival — and more importantly, that of the cart behind you. "About damn time! Hurry up, slaves — our mugs, they be a'-running dry! You don't want us sober!" They don't indeed. A couple catfolk slaves come running up and to the door, quickly relieving you of your burden[party.hasCompanions|; others receive the still-steaming meats and glazed sweetbreads from [party.compNames]], ferrying them away with the plodding efficiency of defeated spirits. Shouts and laughter rise from the trestle table as the drink you brought is served and mugs are filled once more — the handful of decorated veterans at the head of the table claiming the lion's share of the fresh offerings, of course. Under the pretext of fixing the hand cart's wheel, you linger in the doorway while the remainder of the casks are brought into the lodge, wondering when the aphrodisiac venom's effects are going to take hold. As it happens, you don't have long to wait. Before long, the general rowdiness of the lodge erupts into a true raucous caucus, the orcs shouting for the slaves to bring them more of this amazingly fine mead that's being served. By degrees, the general atmosphere of the warrior's lodge passes through mere disorder into true unhinged territory. Mead spills down chins and seeps into furs and hide; it spills onto the table and drips down to the floor. "Living gods, this is some fine stuff, not the swill we've been having for a while." "Where'd we get it? Did someone go raiding without us noticing? It damn well isn't the stuff we brought over." "Nah, Arona and her girls are the only ones who've been out, and she isn't raiding nothing. Not on her own." That raises a number of guffaws from Argoth's goons at the head of the table. You're starting to wonder if the venom's going to ever kick in when one of the decorated veterans pulls over not one of the slaves as might be expected, but a younger warrior who's at serving her elders. Slaves scurry for cover, but the pretext of serving food is hardly enough to save them from the privations of their masters; even so, there're hardly enough slaves to go around, and the orc quickly turn to each other to slake their lusts. rows.original: When one's going off stereotypes, there's only one thing that orcs like to do more than feasting and fucking — and that's fighting. The primal energy that the island tribesfolk are exhibiting in their brawl puts anything that might ever conceivably happen in the Frost Hound to shame; while no steel is actually drawn, chairs, wooden plates, mugs and steins are all fair game as makeshift weapons. Out of the corner of your eye, you spot one of the decorated veterans wielding a large leg of ham as if it were a sword or a particularly large mace, viciously clubbing the fellow whom which he'd been drinking and laughing with mere minutes ago. Most of the slaves who were serving food have long since fled, seeking refuge along the walls of the lodge while the brawl coalesces along the length of the table. You haven't been idle, either. Nipping off the stage, you seek to make like a tree and leave — you're smart enough not to announce your intentions by making a beeline for the door, but instead swerve towards the sides, as if you were a slave seeking to take cover amidst the freshly roasted game. Several huge ham-hands reach for you in passing, perhaps mistaking you for a combatant[pc.ra orc| — you are an orc, after all —] but their owners are too inebriated to move with any modicum of alacrity. It's only when you're sure you're clear that you edge over to the huge door and push it open, eliciting several gasps from the handful of slaves who've managed to escape the melee. [pc.isDK|If they prefer their chains, so be it — you know what's good for you, and that's getting out of here.|You can't help but feel a bit sorry for them. That people might get used to slavery is one thing, but for them to choose it against self-preservation is another.] Looks like you've got to set the example here; straight-backed and unabashedly, you step out of the lodge and away from the raucous caucus, looking back over your shoulder at the slaves. Finally, they get the hint and make for the door in one united surge, clearly deciding that whatever punishment their masters might visit upon them later on is worth avoiding risking being dragged into the brawl. Once the last slave is out, there's still one more thing you have to do. A hefty, metal-reinforced beam lies to one side of the entrance, allowing the door to be barred from within or without, and it's this that you slide across the hooks that hold it in place, earning you more gasps for your audacity. When the orcs finally have had enough of beating the stuffing out of each other, they're going to have a jolly fun time trying to leave — hopefully they'll have spent enough of their strength that the door'll slow them down some. With that, it's time to move on, either to cause more havoc in the warcamp, or to the chieftain's tent if you're ready to put an end to this. As for the slaves... well, it's probably time for them to start re-learning to think for themselves. There's nothing much you can do for them as they are.
