rows.translation:
环顾这个小屋，很明显，这里的兽人们都非常渴望战斗。阿罗娜不是说过吗？他们是从那些岛屿被运到这里来的，结果却整天无所事事、闲坐着而已。 [pc.bg minstrel|在你作为吟游诗人的职业生涯中，你已经多次揣摩过潜在听众的情绪。当他们的情绪如此恶劣时，其实只需要一点点刺激，就很容易引发一场斗殴——如果你真的想要这样的话。只需要轻轻一推，那块石头就会滚下山坡，然后事情就会像滚雪球一样越闹越大……|即使你并不是什么擅长解读人群情绪的人，也能明显感受到那些聚集在小屋里的兽人们身上积压着的愤怒——那种愤怒正在不断酝酿、不断升温，只要稍加刺激，就会立刻爆发出来。]

    当然，你不会真的动手打人——否则你的奴隶身份就会暴露无遗。而且，任何“意外”也不太可能达到你预期的效果，因为你希望他们把怒火发泄在彼此身上，而不是奴隶们身上。但是，如果配上几首情绪恰当的歌曲，再营造出一种热烈的氛围，再加上合适的歌词…… [party.hasCompanions|最好告诉[party.compNames]，在你施展魔法时在外面等你。]
    
    嗯，现在……
rows.raw:
"
    Looking around the lodge, it's quite obvious that the orcs here are itching for a fight. Didn't Arona say something about them being shipped all the way here from the islands, only to sit around on their asses all day? [pc.bg minstrel|You've read the mood of a potential audience many a time in your career as a minstrel, and with them so surly it shouldn't take very much to provoke them into a melee, if that's what you wanted. All it'd take would be a small push to get the stone rolling down the hill, and it'd snowball from there...|Even if you aren't any kind of professional crowd-reader, the pent-up aggression in each and every orc clustered in the lodge is practically palpable. Simmering, steaming, ready to be brought to a boil with just the slightest turning up of the heat.]

    Of course, you wouldn't be throwing any punches — not without breaking your tenuous cover as a slave. Nor are any "accidents" likely to produce the result you want, as you want them to turn their ire upon each other and not the slaves. But a song or two with the right mood, combined with the steamy atmosphere, the right lyrics... [party.hasCompanions|better tell [party.compNames] to wait for you outside while you're working your magic.]
    
    Hmm. Now..."

rows.original: Of course, you've been paid in the past by all manner of establishments to keep the peace within their walls — from rural watering spots to mid-city holes in the wall, a bit of appropriate music always helps the muscle to keep the peace. It's often forgotten that true mastery over something also means the power to take it away. Through the ruckus and revelry, your eyes are drawn to a crude stage in a back corner of the lodge; barely more than a raised platform of wood, but it'll do. On it lies a rawhide drum, and on that a set of ram-bone pipes, a cowhorn bugle, a bone flute... [pc.ora orc|deceptively simple instruments, but having grown up around these you know full well how effective they can be in the right hands. Sometimes, going back to basics isn't so bad, and orcish music is raw and primal, speaking to the soul|simple instruments fitted to the tusked mouths of their intended players, and fitting for their culture, perhaps. Not ideal, but they'll probably speak the most to the islander orcs, and that's what you need right now]. The right tool for the right task — you don't use a scalpel to butcher an animal, after all. Several of the orcs cast you suspicious glances as you pick up a stride towards the stage, but while you keep your head bowed and shoulders downcast in a passable slave fashion, your steps are firm, as if you know you have every right to be there. Indeed, they relax and turn back to their mugs as you pick up the pipes and begin, picking up a swift marching tune. Something innocuous, something that won't draw suspicion, yet resonates with the orcs and gets their blood pumping, drawing their minds to the possibility of imminent conflict. It works. Your performance even earns a few cheers from the orcs at the table — it'd have been better if you'd accompaniment on the rawhide drum, but you can't blame any of the slaves for not wanting to stick their necks out and draw attention to themselves. Slowly, you shift the mood of the lodge, you manipulation becoming less and less subtle as the rousing tune sweeps up more and more orcs in its wake. The more sober of the revelers hammer out a beat to your music with their mugs; the others try to, with much less success. The revelry is much more animated at this point — for a moment there, it felt like it might have exploded into an orgy, aggression and sexual tension being not so different in such a culture. You quickly nip that particular problem in the bud and continue, fingers dancing across the pipes in a blur as you lead the orcs down this deceptive path. The blood pumps! The limbs stir! Intentional or not, the warriors' lodge is built with excellent acoustics — something you instinctively recognize, and don't hesitate to utilise to its fullest extent. Your notes ring out into the wooden rafters, echo into the hall; at this point, you've got even the slaves enthralled, their tired, overworked bodies nevertheless inspired enough to move to the beat of your tune. But the lines dividing emotions are thin, if they exist at all; a stray note here, a discordant chord there, and one's thoughts turn from exhilaration to irritability. You're drawing upon everything you've learned in your time as a minstrel, pushing this simple set of carved-bone pipes to the limit of everything they're worth. The table becomes as a pile of dry tinder, waiting for the appropriate spark to catch; given their nature, their culture and the atmosphere of aggression you're provoking, all the orcs need is the slightest bit of provocation to set things going... ...And it does, in short order. Absorbed in your own playing, you're not exactly sure what sparks the brawl — probably something disgustingly petty like a stepped toe, a spilt drink, an overlong look at one's favored slave — but the first punch is thrown, a roar goes up from the table, and soon enough more and more orcs eagerly leap into the mire of the melee, desperate for something, anything to fight. Another job well done, another satisfied audience. Smiling, you set down the pipes and exit stage left.
rows.translation: 当然，过去有很多机构都曾付钱给你，让你在他们的场所里维持秩序——无论是乡村的小酒馆，还是城市里的那些不起眼的酒吧，合适的音乐总能帮助工作人员维持秩序。 人们常常忘记，真正掌握某样东西，同时也意味着拥有将其夺走的能力。 在喧闹与欢庆之中，你的目光被 lodge 后角那个简陋的舞台吸引了——那不过是一个用木头搭建起来的高台而已，但已经足够用了。上面放着一个生皮鼓，而那个一套羊骨笛管、一只牛角号、一支骨制笛子…… [pc.ora orc|这些乐器看起来简单得令人惊讶，但因为在这样的环境中长大，你很清楚：在合适的人手中，它们可以发挥出多么强大的效果。有时候，回归基础其实并不是坏事。而兽人音乐就是那种原始而直接的音乐，它能够直击人的灵魂。|这些简单的装置被安装在那些拥有长牙的生物的口中，或许也符合他们的文化习惯。虽然并不完美，但它们很可能会被岛上的兽人们接受和使用，而这正是你现在所需要的。]用对了工具才能完成正确的工作——毕竟，你不会用手术刀来宰杀动物吧。” 当你朝舞台走去时，有几个兽人向你投来了怀疑的目光。但你低着头，肩膀耷拉着，摆出一副奴隶该有的姿态，脚步却十分坚定，仿佛你完全有权利出现在那里。的确，当你拿起烟斗开始演奏那段轻快有力的旋律时，他们便放松下来，重新专注于自己的杯子。这段旋律看似无害，不会引起任何怀疑，但却能让兽人们热血沸腾，让他们开始思考即将发生的冲突。 效果还不错。你的表演甚至让桌旁的兽人们发出了一些欢呼声——如果你能用生皮鼓来伴奏的话，效果会更好，但也不能怪那些奴隶们不愿意冒险招来注意吧。 渐渐地，你改变了整个酒馆的氛围，你的操控手段也越来越明显了，因为那激昂的旋律吸引着越来越多的兽人加入其中。那些比较清醒的狂欢者们，开始用他们的杯子敲打出与你音乐相匹配的节奏；而其他的人尝试一下吧。结果却远没有那么成功。此时的狂欢场面变得更加热烈了——有那么一刻，甚至感觉场面可能会演变成一场疯狂的混乱，因为在这样的文化中，攻击性与性冲动其实并没有太大的区别。你迅速扼杀了这个潜在的麻烦，继续演奏着，手指在管子上飞快地移动，引领着那些兽人沿着这条充满欺骗性的道路前进。 血液开始流动！四肢也开始有了反应！无论有意还是无意，这些战士们的营舍确实拥有极佳的声学效果——你会立刻意识到这一点，并毫不犹豫地充分利用它。你的歌声在木制的屋梁间回荡，传遍整个大厅；甚至那些奴隶们也被吸引住了，他们那些疲惫不堪、劳累过度的身体，也因此受到了鼓舞，开始随着你的节奏跳动起来。 但是，划分各种情绪的界限其实非常模糊，甚至可以说几乎不存在；某个不经意的音符，某个不和谐的音调，就足以让人的情绪从兴奋瞬间转变为烦躁。你正在运用自己作为吟游诗人期间所学到的一切，将这套简单的骨制笛子发挥到它们所能达到的极致。这张桌子就像一堆干枯的引火物，只等着合适的火花来点燃它；考虑到它们的本性、他们的文化，以及你所引发的那种敌对氛围，所有这些兽人所需要的，仅仅是一点点的刺激，就能让事情闹翻天了…… 果然，事情在很短的时间内就发生了。当你全神贯注地参与游戏时，其实并不清楚究竟是什么引发了这场争斗——很可能是一些琐碎的事情，比如被踩到脚趾、饮料洒了、或者多看了自己喜欢的“奴隶”一眼……但第一拳很快就被挥出了，桌子上顿时响起一片怒吼，不久之后，越来越多的兽人迫不及待地加入了这场混战，他们都迫切地想要得到些什么任何东西又一项出色的工作，又一批满意的观众。你微笑着放下道具，然后从舞台左侧离开。

rows.original: Through the ruckus and revelry, your eyes are drawn to a crude stage in a back corner of the lodge; barely more than a raised platform of wood, but it'll do. On it lies a rawhide drum, and on that a set of ram-bone pipes, a cowhorn bugle, a bone flute... You may not have been formally trained in music, but you've been steeped enough in orcish oral traditions growing up that something's seeped through that thick skull of yours. [pc.ra orc||You might have gotten it changed since then, but it sure doesn't seem to have helped that much, heh. ]Ah, memories of nights spent huddled around a roaring fire in the middle of the longhouse, a beacon of sanity against the cold winter dark pressing in from outside in all directions. Hours spent too cold to sleep yet too dark to do much of anything, listening to the tribe elders recount old tales and chants handed down from generation to generation... Ha, you've got it. You're not sure if the Kervus Tribe shares the exact same sentiments towards this particular tale as yours did, but supposedly it's significant to all orckind to some degree; you'd be surprised if not even so much as a punch gets thrown, remembering the vigorous disputes it sparked amongst your own tribe. Feeling a multitude of expectant stares starting to turn in your direction, you quickly pick up the ram-bone pipes and do your best to recall how to work them as if your life depended on it — because it very well might. Desperation is the mother of inspiration, or something along those lines, anyway, but the memories do come flooding back unbidden as you raise the pipes to your lips and start playing. It's disquieting. Haunting, even. Much like how you remember it, and completely at odds with the atmosphere of revelry that's supposed to occupy the warriors' lodge. But supposedly, every orc knows of the battle between the armies of the two brothers Khargol and Torgan, a great and tragic battle that's gone down generations of orc history across Savarra. Every time you set aside the pipes from your lips to recount more of the legend, you can see the Kervus orcs grow more thoughtful and angry, although with them there really isn't much difference between the two, is there? The Battle of Kuom Valley, in which both armies somehow managed to surprise each other. And to this day, no one — even within the same clan — can really agree on who it was who emerged the victor. Now this should get people moving. You've heard it said that music comes out better when the player is really able to get into the mood of the melody, but you're simply not feeling it today. Your fingers feel fat and clumsy as you work the pipes, you're sure you missed a note where your memory couldn't supply it, these ram-bone pipes really could have been better carved. Your performance doesn't have to be good, though, it just has to be good enough — and judging by the mutterings going on along the entire length of the trestle table, you're doing pretty well. The latent aggression of the Kervus orcs is brimming over, what with being penned up in a warcamp for weeks with nothing to do; all you need to do is give it a little push for the mug to tip over and make a complete mess of things. It really brings back memories, the glorious fistfights that would happen between those who claimed one brother or the other was the rightful victor of Kuom Valley. Brother against sister, parent against child, elder against young, all brawling in the longhouse while the cold dark rages outside — it was practically a time-honored tradition. As the last few notes of the dolorous melody emerge from the ram-bone panpipes, as the last verses of the legend are sung, the melee is already fully underway. Cheerful revelry's given way to even more cheerful head-bashing and face-punching as the orcs go at each other with great gusto. Looks like your work's done here — your performance might not have been the best, but Kuom Valley's sure to get orcs embroiled in a glorious fistfight, let alone those already on edge. Setting the pipes back down on the rawhide drum, you quickly make to slip out before the fray expands to engulf you.
rows.translation: 在喧闹与欢庆之中，你的目光被小屋角落里那个简陋的舞台吸引了——那不过是一个用木头搭建起来的高台而已，但已经足够用了。舞台上放着一只生皮鼓，而那个一套羊骨笛管、一只牛角号、一支骨制笛子…… 你可能没有接受过正规的音乐训练，但在成长过程中，你充分接触了兽人的口头传统，因此这些音乐元素肯定已经渗透进了你的脑海之中。 [pc.ra orc||从那以后你可能已经把它改掉了，但看起来效果并不是很显著，呵呵。 ]啊，那些在长屋中央围着熊熊燃烧的火堆度过的夜晚，那些在寒冷的冬夜里抵御外界暗影的时光……那些因为天气太冷而无法入睡，却又因为天太黑而无所事事的日子里，我们听着部落的长者们讲述那些代代相传的古老故事和吟唱…… 哈，你猜对了。你不确定凯尔维斯部落对于这个故事是否和你们的部落有着完全相同的感受，但据说这个故事在某种程度上对所有兽人种族来说都具有重要意义；如果连一场争斗都没有发生，那你可要大吃一惊了——毕竟这个故事曾经在你们的部落里引发了激烈的争论。 感觉到周围许多充满期待的目光正朝你投来，你迅速拿起了那些长笛，竭力回忆起如何使用它们——因为这确实关系到你的生死。总之，绝望往往是灵感的源泉吧。就在你将长笛送到嘴边开始演奏时，那些记忆突然如潮水般涌了回来。 这确实令人不安，甚至有一种萦绕心头的感觉。这种记忆与人们所想象的战士们欢聚一堂、热闹非凡的场景截然相反。但据说，每一个兽人都应该知道卡戈尔与托尔根这两位兄弟的军队之间那场伟大而悲惨的战役——这场战役在萨瓦拉的兽人历史上流传了无数代人。每次你停下讲述，让嘴唇暂时休息片刻，那些凯尔维斯兽人就会显得更加深思熟虑、更加愤怒起来。不过，对他们来说，这两种情绪其实并没有什么区别，对吧？ 库奥姆山谷之战，双方在战斗中都成功地对对方实施了突然袭击。直到今天，甚至在同一阵营内部，也没有人能够真正确定究竟是谁取得了胜利。这个这种音乐确实能够激发人们的热情，让人们为之动容。 你肯定也听说过，当演奏者真正能够融入旋律所表达的情绪时，演奏效果会更好。但今天，你却完全感觉不到这种效果。当你拨动这些管子时，手指显得笨拙而无力，你甚至觉得自己漏掉了一些音符——因为你的记忆无法帮助你准确地回忆起这些音符。这些管子其实本可以雕刻得更好一些。不过，你的表演并不一定要非常出色，只要达到一定的水平就可以了。足够了 ——从沿着整张长桌传来的窃窃私语来看，你们做得相当不错。那些被关在军营里好几周、无所事事的克尔维斯兽人，他们内心压抑的敌意已经快要爆发了；你们只需要再稍微加把劲，就能让局势彻底失控，陷入一片混乱。 这真的让人回忆起那些美好的时光——那些为争夺“谁才是阔姆山谷的真正胜利者”而展开的激烈斗殴。兄弟与姐妹争斗，父母与子女对峙，长辈与晚辈互相冲突，所有人都在长屋里厮打闹腾，而外面则是寒冷的暗影在肆虐……这几乎已经成为一种由来已久的传统了。当那些凄凉的旋律的最后一音符从骨笛中传出，当那个传说的最后几句诗句被唱完时，近战已经全面爆发了。欢乐的庆祝活动早已被更加激烈的搏斗所取代——兽人们正满怀热情地互相厮杀着，头撞、脸打，一片混乱。 看来你在这里已经完成了任务——虽然你的表现可能不是最好的，但至少让库奥姆山谷里的兽人们陷入了一场激烈的斗殴之中，更不用说那些本来就已经处于紧张状态的人了。你迅速把管子重新放回生皮鼓上，然后赶紧溜走了，以免这场争斗进一步扩大，把你也卷入其中。

But supposedly, every orc knows of the battle between the armies of the two brothers Khargol and Torgan, a great and tragic battle that's gone down generations of orc history across Savarra. Every time you set aside the pipes from your lips to recount more of the legend, you can see the Kervus orcs grow more thoughtful and angry, although with them there really isn't much difference between the two, is there? The Battle of Kuom Valley, in which both armies somehow managed to surprise each other. And to this day, no one — even within the same clan — can really agree on who it was who emerged the victor. Now this should get people moving. You've heard it said that music comes out better when the player is really able to get into the mood of the melody, but you're simply not feeling it today. Your fingers feel fat and clumsy as you work the pipes, you're sure you missed a note where your memory couldn't supply it, these ram-bone pipes really could have been better carved. Your performance doesn't have to be good, though, it just has to be good enough — and judging by the mutterings going on along the entire length of the trestle table, you're doing pretty well. The latent aggression of the Kervus orcs is brimming over, what with being penned up in a warcamp for weeks with nothing to do; all you need to do is give it a little push for the mug to tip over and make a complete mess of things. It really brings back memories, the glorious fistfights that would happen between those who claimed one brother or the other was the rightful victor of Kuom Valley. Brother against sister, parent against child, elder against young, all brawling in the longhouse while the cold dark rages outside — it was practically a time-honored tradition. As the last few notes of the dolorous melody emerge from the ram-bone panpipes, as the last verses of the legend are sung, the melee is already fully underway. Cheerful revelry's given way to even more cheerful head-bashing and face-punching as the orcs go at each other with great gusto. Looks like your work's done here — your performance might not have been the best, but Kuom Valley's sure to get orcs embroiled in a glorious fistfight, let alone those already on edge. Setting the pipes back down on the rawhide drum, you quickly make to slip out before the fray expands to engulf you."

rows.original: For a moment, you think you'd have to sing — until you spy a makeshift stage in the rear end of the lodge, crudely cobbled together by a myriad of wooden planks. To be perfectly frank, it's little more than a raised platform, but it'll do. There're even a handful of traditional orcish instruments set atop it, gathering dust; looks like they've been untouched for some time. A bugle fashioned from a hollowed-out cow's horn, a set of ram-bone panpipes, a long and thin bone flute, and a rawhide drum. Definitely very suiting for islander tribe culture, given what you've seen of them so far. Several suspicious pairs of eyes fall on you as you approach the stage, but soon turn away as you quickly pick up what looks like the best instrument of the lot — the ram-bone pipes. To be honest, it's not surprising the orcs don't bother much with the instruments themselves, not when there's feasting, drinking and flirting to be done, but you can't help but feel a knot form in your stomach at the sight of the morbid music-maker. Still, you raise it to your lips, try to summon up what little you know of playing pipes, and have a go at it. To say it's hard would be an understatement — though the pipes aren't any bigger than your palms put together, playing them feels like you're struggling with a monster many times your size, and one intent on devouring you at that. The strange, keening notes the bones make when blown, the way your fingers are forced to move, the fact that you have absolutely no accompaniment whatsoever to cover for your mistakes — an ugly little voice rears in the back of your mind, pointedly asking what in the name of the Seven you're doing here in the first place and how did you even imagine this was a good idea in the first place. To be fair, you're not sure what you're playing yourself — a hodgepodge of pieces you've heard in your past, angry, rousing, vivid. As your fingers dance across the pipes, your mind takes a back seat to whatever mysterious force that's taken possession of you. "I don't know what that is the slave's playing," one of the orc up front mutters as she nurses a mug of mead. "But it's got soul. Maybe someone should get Hretha? She might be interested in this one." There's no mistake about it, you're certain your playing isn't up to swaying a lodge full ornery orcs. Good thing, then, that the music's just the vehicle — the sheer force of your raw presence is what's driving the mood shift in the room, the forcefulness and intensity with which you're making up your lack of skill and training. It helps that these islander orcs aren't exactly the most discerning audience, their mugs pounding out a beat on the trestle table as the more sober amongst them try to follow along with the music. The off-key melody, the strained, discordant notes — they might all be unintentional, but they work anyway. Poking away at the deep undercurrents of the orcish psyche, the table becomes as a pile of dry tinder, waiting for the appropriate spark to catch. Given their nature, their culture and the atmosphere of aggression you're provoking, all the orcs need is the slightest bit of provocation to set things going... ...And it does, in short order. Absorbed in your own playing, you're not exactly sure what sparks the brawl — probably something disgustingly petty like a stepped toe, a spilt drink, an overlong look at one's favored slave — but the first punch is thrown, a roar goes up from the table, and soon enough more and more orcs eagerly leap into the mire of the melee, desperate for something, anything to fight. Be it by luck, by force of presence, or by the orcs' own ornery nature, your job is done here. Best to be off before you too get embroiled in the melee.
rows.translation: 有那么一瞬间，你以为自己非得唱不可——直到你瞥见木屋后方那座临时搭起的舞台，那是用无数木板粗劣拼凑起来的。说实话，它不过是个垫高的台子，但也够用了。上面甚至还摆着几件传统的兽人乐器，都积着灰；看来已经很久没人碰过了。一只用掏空的牛角做成的号角，一套羊骨排箫，一支细长的骨笛，还有一面生皮鼓。就你目前对岛民部落文化的了解来看，这确实非常契合他们。 你走向舞台时，好几双狐疑的眼睛落在你身上，但当你迅速拿起那堆乐器里看起来最好的一件——那套羊骨排箫——之后，他们很快就移开了目光。说实话，兽人自己不太在意这些乐器并不奇怪，毕竟还有吃喝和调情要做，但看到这件阴森的乐器，你还是忍不住觉得胃里打了个结。尽管如此，你还是把它举到唇边，努力搜刮出自己那点可怜的吹奏知识，试着吹了起来。 说它难都算是轻描淡写了——尽管这排箫还没你两只手掌合起来大，吹起来却像是你在和一个体型比你大许多倍的怪物搏斗，而且那怪物还一心想把你吞掉。骨头被吹响时发出的那种怪异尖鸣，你的手指被迫做出的动作，以及你完全没有伴奏来遮掩自己的错误——一个丑陋的小声音在你脑海深处冒了出来，毫不客气地质问：你究竟以七神之名在这里干什么，你当初又怎么会觉得这是个好主意。 公平地说，你自己也不清楚自己在吹什么——一堆你过去听过的曲子的杂烩，愤怒、激昂、鲜活。当你的手指在排箫上跳动时，你的头脑退居其次，任由那股占据了你身体的神秘力量摆布。 “我不知道那个奴隶在吹的是什么，”前面一个兽人一边小口喝着蜂蜜酒，一边嘟囔道。“但它确实有灵魂。也许该找个人去叫赫蕾莎？她可能会对这个感兴趣。” 毫无疑问，你确信自己的演奏打动不了满屋子的暴躁兽人。幸好，音乐只是个载体——真正推动屋里气氛转变的，是你纯粹气场的力量，那种强横与强度，让你足以弥补技巧和训练的不足。这些岛民兽人也不是什么挑剔的听众，这也有帮助：他们用酒杯在架板桌上敲出节拍，其中还算清醒的那些人试着跟上音乐。 走调的旋律，紧绷而不和谐的音符——这些或许都是无心的，但它们照样奏效了。它们戳动着兽人心理深处的暗流，让整个场面变成一堆干柴，只等合适的火星落下。以他们的天性、文化，以及你所挑起的这股暴戾气氛来看，兽人们只需要最轻微的一点刺激就会炸开…… ……而事情很快就发生了。你沉浸在自己的演奏里，并不清楚究竟是什么点燃了这场斗殴——大概是些恶心的小事，比如踩了谁的脚、洒了杯酒，或者多看了别人看中的奴隶一眼——但第一拳挥了出去，桌边响起一声怒吼，很快越来越多的兽人急切地扑进混战的泥潭，迫切地想找点东西，任何东西来打一架。 无论是靠运气、靠气场的力量，还是靠兽人自己那股暴躁天性，你在这里的任务都完成了。最好在你也被卷进混战之前赶紧离开。

rows.original: Glancing around the lodge, you spy a stage in one of the rear corners — little more than a simple raised platform of planks thrown on top of each other, easily disassembled in a hurry. Crude and basic like your musical talents, but hopefully it'll do. Various orcish instruments of rudimentary make lie atop it, clearly having seen better days; a bone flute, a bugle carved from a cow's horn, a set of ram-bone pipes and a simple rawhide drum. The bugle in particular looks as if someone had used it to stove an unlucky bastard's head in for an unsatisfactory performance, judging by the massive dent in its exterior; hopefully the orcs won't do the same to you. Hopefully. Alas, your hope quickly falls short. The ram-bone pipes look the most promising of the lot with regards to actually being able to carry a tune, and you pick them up. No sooner have you put them to your lips and begun to play, though, that it becomes a struggle — right from the outset, you're not so much playing a song as you're wrestling a beast a hundred times your size. Perhaps matters would have gone more smoothly had you a concrete idea of what you were going to play instead of something generally provocative, or if your fingers didn't seem to disobey you at every turn, spitting on your efforts to wrangle some kind of passable tune out of the pipes. Numerous times the song eludes you, slipping out of your reach only to fall into a cacophonous pit of noise. Eventually, even the slaves have had enough. Growling, two lupine slaves storm up to the stage, grab you by one shoulder each, and march you off to the jeers and catcalls of the inebriated orcs. "Out, out, out," one of them growls not quite under her breath. "I don't care what the orcs will think when they find another slave wandering around the camp, but considering how difficult you've just made things for us here in the lodge I don't think I can bring myself to be bothered. Gods be thanked that this lot isn't in an even worse mood than they are already." She's not wrong. The atmosphere has definitely soured, but not in the way you'd envisioned it — a slow, simmering sullenness directed at the slaves, rather than at each other. When you reach the door, the lupines yank it open and toss you outside unceremonously[party.hasCompanions|, right in front of [party.compNames]]. "And stay out." With those parting words, the door to the lodge slams shut, and you hear a bar being drawn over the stout wood. Yeah, you're not getting back in anytime soon. [party.has cait| "Well, at least you tried," Cait says, clearly trying more than a little too hard to be cheery after your rather dismal failure. "Nothing ventured, nothing gained, right? Besides, much worse could've happened than you just being thrown out." "Yeah, much worse," you agree. "Several of them cast me murderous glances on my way out." "It's all right if you're not the musically inclined type, but don't ever try that in the Frost Hound. I think Garth would be less merciful than the orcs in that regard." ] [party.has berwyn| "That was absolutely awful," Berwyn says as he picks you up and helps you to your feet. "It might be the worst thing I've ever heard, and I've had the misfortune of being subjected to my mistress' singing." "[pc.isDK|Oh, so you think you can do better?|Can't deny that,]" you reply. "If it's any consolation, you might just have made the orcs too ill to do very much of anything. I don't imagine that'd have gone down very well with the swill they're drinking." ]
rows.translation: 环顾小屋四周，你会在其中一个后角看到一个舞台——不过只是一个用木板简单搭建起来的高台，可以随时快速拆卸。虽然它很简陋，但希望足够使用吧。上面摆放着各种制作粗糙的兽人乐器，显然它们都已经不再处于最佳状态了：一支骨制笛子、一支用牛角雕刻而成的号角、一套羊骨制成的管乐器，以及一个简单的生皮鼓。尤其是那支号角，从它外壳上那道巨大的凹痕来看，似乎有人曾用它来敲碎某个表现不佳的倒霉家伙的脑袋——希望兽人们不会对你也做出同样的事。 但愿如此。 然而，你的希望很快便破灭了。在这些乐器中，那些看起来最有可能发出悦耳音色的号角，你选择了它们。但当你把它们放在嘴唇边开始吹奏时，才发现这实在是一件极其困难的事情——从一开始，你演奏的就不像是一首歌，而更像是在与一只体型比你大上百倍的野兽搏斗。如果你能清楚地知道自己到底想演奏什么，而不是总是选择一些具有挑战性的曲目，或许事情会进行得更加顺利；另外，如果你的手指不会在每一个关键时刻都不听使唤，阻碍你尝试从这些乐器中演奏出还算像样的旋律，或许也会好很多。很多时候，这首歌总会从你手中溜走，消失得无影无踪，最终却落入一片混乱的噪音之中。 最终，就连那些奴隶们也受够了。两只体型像狼的奴隶咆哮着冲上舞台，各自抓住你的一个肩膀，然后在那些喝得醉醺醺的兽人的嘲笑声中，将你拖了下去。 出去，出去，出局，"他们中有一个人低声咆哮着。我不在乎兽人发现又有奴隶在营地里闲逛时会怎么想，但考虑到你刚刚给我们在这里带来的麻烦，我实在没精力再去理会这些事了。幸好这些兽人的脾气还没有变得更糟。 她并没有错。气氛确实变得糟糕了，但并不是你想象中的那种方式——那种缓慢积累、逐渐加剧的怨恨是针对奴隶们，而不是针对彼此。当你走到门口时，那些狼族会猛地拉开门，毫不客气地将你扔到外面去。[party.hasCompanions|就在正前方[party.compNames]]。 然后留下出去。随着那些告别的话语，小屋的门被猛地关上了，你还能听到有人用铁条把门锁上了。没错，短时间内你是再进不去那里了。 [party.has cait| 嗯，至少你尝试过了。凯特明显是在刻意努力表现得开心起来，毕竟你之前的失败实在令人沮丧。不冒风险，就得不到回报，对吧？而且，其实本可能发生更糟糕的事情，而不是你只是被赶出去而已。 是的，情况要糟糕得多。你同意了。在我离开的时候，有几个人向我投来了充满杀意的目光。 如果你不是那种对音乐有天赋的人，那也没关系，但千万不要在‘霜冻猎犬’号上尝试这样做。我觉得在这方面，加斯会比兽人还要严厉。 ] [party.has berwyn| 那简直太糟糕了。贝尔温一边扶你站起来，一边说道。这可能是我听过最糟糕的事情了……而我，不幸地，还得听我女主的歌声。 “[pc.isDK|哦，所以你认为自己能做得更好？|不得不承认，]”你回复吧。 如果这能让你好受些的话，你刚才的做法可能让那些兽人病得根本无法动弹了。我想，对于他们现在喝的那些劣质酒来说，这种后果恐怕也不会让他们高兴吧。 ]

rows.original: As you consider this particular option, a tiny voice speaks up in the back of your mind. There're at least a couple dozen orcs in the lodge at the moment, maybe more; even if you could get some of them to fight each other in the confusion, you'd still be facing vastly overwhelming numbers. Unless you are significantly stronger than they are — and significantly can't be stressed enough — then trying to take on the entire lodge at once would be a very bad idea and not go down well for you. That being said, are you foolhardy enough to try and do this?
rows.translation: 当你考虑这个特定的选择时，你脑海中会突然响起一个微小的声音：目前那个小屋里至少有几十只兽人，甚至可能更多；即使你能设法让其中一些兽人在混乱中互相争斗，你仍然会面临压倒性的数量优势。除非你比他们强得多——这个强得多再怎么强调都不为过——否则试图一次对付整个小屋的兽人，会是个非常糟糕的主意，对你也不会有什么好下场。 话虽如此，但你真的有足够的勇气去尝试这样做吗？

rows.original: Well, looks like you're insane enough to try and take on an entire lodge packed full of ornery orcs. Can't say that you lack the guts — if you actually manage to pull this off, it'll be one heck of a fight to remember. As you draw your [pc.weapon], the orc nearest to you notices it and roars a warning, tossing his stein of cheap mead at you. It doesn't hit, but the commotion does rouse the other orcs to action, eager for something to fight after having been cooped up in their warcamp for so long. Your cover as a slave blown, you ready yourself as the assembled orcs practically fall over each other in their eagerness to get to you, a mad dash to take a piece out of the intruder; slaves drop platters and trays as they flee for the relative safety of the spits, cowering and hoping not to be dragged into the melee. Your only saving grace is that if you back yourself into a corner, only so many of the orcs can get to you at once — but there are always more willing to fill in the spaces left by any of their comrades that might fall. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 嗯，看来你确实有足够的勇气去挑战那个满是脾气暴躁的兽人的小屋了。不得不说，你的胆量确实不小——如果你真的成功做到了，那将会是一场令人难忘的激战。 就在你拔出武器的那一刻[pc.weapon]离你最近的那个兽人注意到了这一情况，发出一声警告性的咆哮，同时将一瓶廉价的麦酒朝你扔来。虽然没有击中你，但这一阵骚动确实惊动了其他兽人，它们在战营里被关了这么久，早就迫不及待想要找点东西来打架了。你伪装成奴隶的身份已经暴露，此刻聚集在一起的兽人们争先恐后地朝你冲来，他们急于抓住这个入侵者，甚至不惜互相推挤。那些奴隶们在逃往相对安全的区域时，连盘子和托盘都扔掉了，他们蜷缩着，只希望不要被卷入这场混战之中。 你唯一的优势在于：当你被逼入绝境时，同时有那么多兽人能够攻击你；不过，总会有更多的兽人愿意填补那些可能阵亡的同伴留下的空缺，继续向你发起攻击。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " Well, looks like you're insane enough to try and take on an entire lodge packed full of ornery orcs. Can't say that you lack the guts — if you actually manage to pull this off, it'll be one heck of a fight to remember. As you draw your [pc.weapon], the orc nearest to you notices it and roars a warning, tossing his stein of cheap mead at you. It doesn't hit, but the commotion does rouse the other orcs to action, eager for something to fight after having been cooped up in their warcamp for so long. Your cover as a slave blown, you ready yourself as the assembled orcs practically fall over each other in their eagerness to get to you, a mad dash to take a piece out of the intruder; slaves drop platters and trays as they flee for the relative safety of the spits, cowering and hoping not to be dragged into the melee. Your only saving grace is that if you back yourself into a corner, only so many of the orcs can get to you at once — but there are always more willing to fill in the spaces left by any of their comrades that might fall. It's a fight!"

rows.original: As you consider the motley, mottled mob before you, sanity and self-preservation win out over desires of murderhobo and glory hounding. Maybe trying another tack might suit the situation better... one that isn't that likely to end up with your head stoved in or worse.
rows.translation: 当你看着眼前这群五颜六色、杂乱无章的人群时，理智与自我保护的欲望最终战胜了那些想要杀戮或追求荣耀的冲动。或许，尝试另一种方法会更适合当前的情况……那种不太可能让你丢掉性命或遭遇更糟后果的方法。
rows.raw: "\n        As you consider the motley, mottled mob before you, sanity and self-preservation win out over desires of murderhobo and glory hounding. Maybe trying another tack might suit the situation better... one that isn't that likely to end up with your head stoved in or worse."

rows.original: You've been surrounded by the orcish revelers in the lodge, each and every one of them intent on working out their pent-up aggressions on you. A sea of mean green crashes against you, pushing you into your corner and preventing any kind of retreat should you have second thoughts about this frankly suicidal endeavor. Hopefully, you still have enough faith in your sword arm as you did when you started out!
rows.translation: 你现在被小屋里的那些兽人狂欢者包围了，他们每一个都一心想要把积压已久的怒火发泄在你身上。一道道恶意的攻击如海浪般向你袭来，将你逼入绝境，让你根本没有任何退路——如果你还在犹豫是否要继续这项简直就是自寻死路的举动的话。希望你仍然像刚开始时那样，对自己的剑术充满信心吧！
rows.raw: "\n    You've been surrounded by the orcish revelers in the lodge, each and every one of them intent on working out their pent-up aggressions on you. A sea of mean green crashes against you, pushing you into your corner and preventing any kind of retreat should you have second thoughts about this frankly suicidal endeavor. Hopefully, you still have enough faith in your sword arm as you did when you started out!"

rows.original: With a grunt, the last of the orcs topples over like a felled tree, fall cushioned by the sheer number of twitching, groaning bodies already heaped up on the straw-covered floor of the lodge. You spin around, [pc.weapon] in hand, but there simply aren't any more orcs left to give battle — by great fortune or great prowess, you've managed to best the entirety of the warrior's lodge. Several orcs lie a little ways away from your corner, apparently having beaten each other silly when they realized they weren't getting a go at you anytime soon. All's the better, you suppose. [party.has cait|"Mallach's balls," Cait mumbles, a most uncharacteristic expletive leaving the catgirl's lips as she leans back against the nearest wall, out of breath. "If only we'd been able to put up such a showing that day, [pc.name]. We could've saved Calla, and none of this would've happened." "We're not the people we were then," you point out. "And we definitely wouldn't be the people we are now, either. It's not like you to second-guess yourself, Cait." "I know. I just wish..." Cait pauses, then shakes her head. "No, you're right. There's no point dwelling on what could've been — let's move on. I must say, though, that I feel a lot more comfortable with the prospect of meeting that Master Tollus creep again." ] [party.has brint|Brint looks back and forth across the carnage he's caused, a mass of twitching, groaning orcs piled up upon one another. He looks thoughtful for a moment, then scratches his craggy brow. "You know, if I were to tell everyone back in the village what happened here, they'd never believe me. Too unbelievable." "Well. Clearly the answer here's to do even more ludicrous things that can't be denied, so much that beating an entire lodge full of orcs single-handedly's going to pale in comparison. By that point, they won't even dare to question you." Brint considers that a moment, then grins and nods, kicking one of the groaning orcs in the side. "Yeah, I see what you're getting at. I get the feeling that we're going to have plenty of chances to do just that before this is all over." ] [party.has etheryn|Trembling a little, Etheryn sinks back into the corner, heaving and gasping for breath. It's less a physical debilitation than it is a mental one as she looks back and forth across the entire spread of unconscious orcs, a sea of fur-clad green that was until recently, considerably mean. "I... oh. Wow." You come up and give her a pat on the head. "Hard to believe, isn't it?" "I mean... I... give me a moment, please. I just need to convince myself of what we just did." "Take as long as you need — within reason, of course. These orcs aren't going to be getting up anytime soon." ] [party.has atugia|"Damn," Atugia lets out a low whistle as she surveys her handiwork. "If only Carmen could see me now. Bet she'd be havin' second thoughts about passin' me over t' you, eh?" "Well, that's her loss, and my gain." "Times like these, can't say that I totally miss being back up at the castle. Weeks upon weeks of fighting nothin' but a trainin' dummy full o' straw puts rust into your joints an' wool in your 'ead. It's nice to know that I haven't totally lost it, y'know?" ] [party.has viv|"Well, I have to say, that was [viv.isDemon|exhilarating|terrifying]," Viviane says[viv.isDemon|, voice filled with glee| between exhausted pants]. "I never imagined when I joined you that I'd be facing down dozens of orcs, let alone succeeding. [viv.isDemon|We should do something like that again sometime!|Please never do that again.]"] Even the slaves are staring dumbfounded at you, cautiously creeping out of their hiding places now that the melee's died down. Most just gawk, a few point, others stand open-mouthed as they try to process what's just happened here. You put away your [pc.weapon], give a little shrug as if nothing of note happened, and plant the heel of a foot right onto one of the orc's tusked faces. "Maybe you'll think about what happened today, and consider if your situation really was that hopeless that you really had no other choice than to accept your station in this warcamp. If I hadn't come along, what would've happened to you lot?" Silence. "Go grab the weapons off these bastards, I'm sure there's plenty to go around. Dole them out, and see what you can do with them, yes? Or has your time here wiped your minds completely clean of your ability to think for yourselves?" That spurs them into action. Surging forward, the slaves quickly divest their masters of their weapons — swords, axes, maces, all — and start heading for the door. It seems like the realization of what you've just done is beginning to sink into their minds, so long touched by fear of the proverbial lash; they definitely look a little more confident now that they're armed to the teeth, practically bristling with more sharp edges than they can safely carry. As you watch in silence, the armed slaves slip out into the camp, making a beeline for the slave pens. Oh boy, this is going to be good. There's one last thing, though. Lying to one side of the lodge door is a heavy bar, holders on doorway and door alike allowing the entrance to be barred from both within and without. With a grunt, you heave the metal-reinforced wood into position, giving it a few shakes to ensure it isn't loose. That should slow down the orcs a little once they start coming round... With that, it's time to move on, either to cause more havoc in the warcamp, or to the chieftain's tent if you're ready to put an end to this. If you've beaten the stuffing out of a good chunk of Argoth's warriors, the cheftain himself can't be that much of a threat, can he?
rows.translation: 随着一声闷哼，最后一个兽人像一棵被砍倒的树一样倒下了，它的身体落在了那些已经堆在小屋稻草覆盖的地面上的、正在抽搐、呻吟的兽人尸体上。你迅速转过身来[pc.weapon]这些兽人其实还在你手中，但现在已经没有更多的兽人了，它们再也无法与你交战了——多亏了你的运气或者出色的战斗技巧，你成功地击败了整个战士协会的成员。在离你所在的位置不远处，有几只兽人倒在地上，显然是在意识到短时间内无法与你交战之后，它们互相厮杀了起来。你想，这样反而更好。 [party.has cait|马拉赫的胆量啊……凯特嘟囔着，这个完全不符合她性格的咒骂语从这位猫女子的口中脱口而出，此时她正靠在最近的墙上，气喘吁吁地喘着气。要是那天我们能有这样的表现该多好[pc.name]我们本可以救下卡拉的，这样这一切就不会发生了。 我们已经不再是过去的自己了。你指出了这一点。而且，我们现在也不可能成为现在的自己。凯特，你从来不会怀疑自己的决定。 我知道。我只是希望……凯特停顿了一下，然后摇了摇头。不，你说得对。纠结于那些可能发生的事情并没有意义——让我们继续前进吧。不过我必须承认，一想到还能再次遇到那个叫托卢斯的家伙，我就觉得安心多了。 ] [party.has brint|布林特回头望着自己所造成的这场惨状：一堆蠕动着、发出呻吟声的兽人堆叠在了一起。他沉思了一会儿，然后挠了挠自己布满皱纹的额头。 你知道吗，如果我把这里发生的事情告诉村里的所有人，他们绝对不会相信我的。这太离奇了，简直难以置信。 嗯，显然，解决办法就是做出更多那些无可否认的荒谬举动，以至于单枪匹马击败一整个兽人小队这种事，相比之下就显得微不足道了。到那时，他们甚至都不会再敢来质问你。 布林特思考了片刻，然后咧嘴一笑，点了点头，同时用脚踢了踢那个正在呻吟的兽人。是的，我明白你的意思。我感觉在这一切结束之前，我们会有很多机会去做这件事。 ] [party.has etheryn|伊瑟琳微微颤抖着，又退回到角落里，不停地喘着气。这种疲惫更多是精神上的，而不是身体上的。她来回望着那些昏迷不醒的兽人——那一片片覆盖着毛皮的绿色身影，直到刚才还显得如此凶恶可怖。 我……哦，哇。 你走上前去，轻拍她的头。真难以相信，不是吗？ 我是说……我……请给我一点时间。我需要先让自己相信我们刚才所做的那些事。 你可以花你需要的时间——当然，前提是要合理。这些兽人短期内是不会醒过来的。 ] [party.has atugia|该死。阿图吉娅看着自己的“杰作”，轻声吹了个口哨。要是卡门现在能看到我该多好。我打赌，她肯定会重新考虑是否应该把我让给你吧？ 嗯，那是她的损失，也是我的收获。 在这种时候，我确实会怀念重新回到城堡里的日子。连续数周不断地与那些只是装满稻草的训练假人战斗，真的会让人的关节变得僵硬，头脑也变得迟钝。不过，好在我还没有完全失去能力，你知道的吧？ ] [party.has viv|嗯，我得说，那真是[viv.isDemon|令人兴奋的|可怕极了]维薇安说道。[viv.isDemon|带着无比喜悦的声音| 累得不行了]当我加入你们的时候，我从未想过自己会面对几十只兽人，更不用说还能取得胜利了。 [viv.isDemon|我们以后应该再找个机会做这样的事情吧！|请千万不要再那样做了。]"] 就连那些奴隶们也都惊呆了，当近战战斗逐渐平息后，他们小心翼翼地从藏身之处探了出来。大多数人只是呆呆地望着你，少数人指指点点，还有些人张大嘴巴，试图理解刚刚发生的一切。你把你的[pc.weapon]收了起来。他微微耸了耸肩，仿佛什么值得注意的事情都没有发生，然后用脚后跟狠狠地踩在了那个兽人长着獠牙的脸上。 也许你会仔细思考今天发生的事情，认真想想自己的处境是否真的那么绝望，以至于除了接受在这个战营中的命运之外别无选择。如果我没有出现，你们会遭遇什么？ 寂静。 去把那些混蛋身上的武器抢过来，肯定有足够的武器供大家使用。把它们分发下去，然后看看你们能用这些武器做些什么，明白吗？还是说，在这里待得太久，让你们完全忘记了自己思考的能力？ 这一举动激励了他们采取行动。奴隶们迅速冲了上去，从主人手中夺走了所有的武器——剑、斧头、钉头锤，无一遗漏——然后朝着门口方向跑去。看来，他们终于开始意识到自己刚刚做了什么；长期以来，他们对那些可怕的鞭子一直充满了恐惧，而现在，既然他们武装到了牙齿，手中握着的锋利武器多到几乎无法安全携带，他们的神情确实显得自信了许多。当你默默地注视着时，那些武装的奴隶们悄悄地溜出了营地，径直朝着奴隶围栏的方向走去。 哦，天哪，这次肯定会有好戏上演。 不过，还有一件事需要注意。在小屋的门边放着一根重型的铁条，门框和门上都有固定的装置，这样就可以从内部和外部都将入口封闭起来。你发出一声哼声，将那根经过金属加固的木棍摆放到指定位置，然后轻轻摇晃了几下，以确保它没有松动。那个一旦那些兽人开始围过来，这种策略应该能够让他们的速度有所减缓…… 既然如此，是时候继续行动了——要么继续在军营里制造更多的混乱，要么如果你们准备结束这场冲突的话，就前往首领的帐篷。既然你们已经击败了阿戈斯大量战士，那么首领本人应该也不会构成太大的威胁吧？

rows.original: The stupidity of your decision is driven home by the ringing in your ears as you lie sprawled on the straw-strewn floor. Above you, the tusked faces of the massed orcs leer down, mocking, taunting; a few hands reach for you, but are quickly pushed aside as the quintet of grizzled, decorated veterans you saw at the table's head come into view. The foremost amongst their number grins an extremely toothy grin as he sweeps down and grabs you by the scruff of your neck. "Not bad, not bad at all in making it this far into the camp. I'll have to ensure the patrols spend a day or two in the stocks for sleeping on the job. Argoth told us his little sister might try something, but we weren't expecting her to pull it off so soon. Still, looks like she found a bunch of outsiders with plenty of guts, enough to try and take all of us on. "Too bad you don't have the muscle to back it up, though. More's the pity. [pc.ra orc|With that bloody-mindedness of yours, we could've used you in the Kervus Tribe|You'd have made a good orc with that bloody-mindedness of yours]." He whistles, and [party.hasCompanions|more hands reach down from the seething green mass to pick up [party.compNames]|one of the orcs hands him a half-full mug of mead, which he downs before continuing]. "Now then, what we usually do with intruders is put them in the stocks before moving them into the slave pens, but I think for someone as feisty as you [party.hasCompanions|lot ], we're going to have to make an exception. "And Arona?" The leer widens. "[pc.ra orc|Weakling|[pc.Race]], I think Arona is the least of your worries right now." With that, the orcs close in, Argoth's goons at their head. [party.has cait|"I'm so sorry," you whisper to Cait as she's carried off into the mass of orcs. "I led you into this." Alas, with a huge orcish prick in her mouth and between her boobs, Cait's in no shape to give you any kind of reply.] [party.has brint|Brint struggles mightily, but there're simply so many orcs that they easily overwhelm him. Sauntering forward, an amazoness lifts the flap of his loincloth and shakes her head in wonder at the sight, scratching her tusks. "Oh, my. What fun we're going to have with you; it's not often that we get a slave who's even bigger than our menfolk. Take him away, girls!" The last you ever see of Brint is of him being whisked away by four powerful orc amazons, one holding him down by each limb.] [party.has berwyn|Berwyn squeaks as one of the orc warriors grabs him by his hips and thighs, hoisting up the dogboy like a limp noodle. Unbidden, his tail wags back and forth, its speed increasing as coarse ham-hands shamelessly grope his plush butt through his clothing. "Hah, look at you! Soft and squishy all over — almost as good as the last fuckboy we had. You'll do just fine." With a mighty yank, thick fingers and yellowed nails expose Berwyn's voluptuous butt to the world. The poor dogboy's face has barely enough time to register shock before a girthy orc meatrod slams into his butthole. Worked up from the fight, the gargantuan orc fuckstick begins to savage his tender insides without a care, clearly intending to ruin him within and without. A pair of horned wolves adorn it, baring their fangs down at his challenger. "There's wisdom in recognizing your own foolishness." Arona scoffs, unimpressed. "The only fool I see here is you! You drag us halfway across the world because what? What are we doing here, Argoth?" "Waiting," he answers evenly. "Waiting for the greatest foe the world has ever seen. I will lead the Kervus to glory, sister, with or without you." Arona bristles, pushing Hretha away. "And I'll lead them home!" A few of the gathered warriors nod in agreement. Most, though, keep their silence. Argoth just sighs and closes his eyes, like he's dealing with a child. "We are raiders, Arona, descended from raiders as far back as the shaman's stories take us. But we can be more! There will be a battle here like there hasn't been since the Godswar, and you'd have us run from it... you're a coward, a shame upon my clan. If you cannot see that, then I have no choice but to remove you, sister." "Fucking try it. Get off that throne and grab your axe!" Arona howls, hefting up her hammer. Looks like things are about to get started. What do you do?
rows.translation: 酋长帐篷外的守卫们似乎根本不在乎你是否在那里。[pc.ra orc||多亏了你们的伪装，]但是他们的立场表明，无论你是谁，任何试图进入的尝试都会遭到他们的强烈反对。不过，这个障碍其实很容易被绕过：你[party.hasCompanions|示意[party.compNames]跟上你，然后 ]你退到一旁，绕着帐篷转了一圈。那些守卫似乎并不在意——毕竟，在他们的权力范围内，你又能做什么呢？因此，你很容易就找到一个没人注意的地方，在帐篷的帆布上划一个洞，然后溜了进去。 当你把头探出来的瞬间，就会感受到来自中央火坑散发出的强烈热浪。地面铺着用熊、狼以及其他野兽的毛皮制成的地毯，这些毛皮被剥下来后按照动物面朝内的方式排列着，最终形成了一条通向那座矗立在雕刻石基座上的巨大木制王座的通道。 坐在那王座上的，是一位体型庞大的兽人战士——他浑身都是沼泽绿色的肌肉，一头卷曲的黑发遍布全身。除了……之外他的头顶被剃得像阿罗娜一样光秃，只剩下鹰一般的轮廓。粗糙的皮肤上布满了旧伤痕和部落纹身，仅用最少的兽皮制成的缠腰布遮盖身体，除此之外什么也没有。一把青铜制的战斧放在他身旁，倚靠在石头上……还有六名兽人女战士懒洋洋地躺在他们首领的脚边，全都注视着站在王座前的那个人影。 阿罗娜已经到了，她双手叉腰，瞪着她的弟弟，手中的锤子也放在身侧。赫蕾莎站在这位性子急躁的战士身后，正以一种仪式性的动作在她的脸颊和脸上涂抹战涂。她已经练习过这些动作太多次了，因此她的失明并没有成为任何障碍。 现在改变主意还来得及，小妹妹。”酋长坐在宝座上低吼道，身体向后靠在雕刻精美的木架上。木架上装饰着一对角狼，它们露出獠牙，仿佛在瞪视着他的挑战者。“认识到自己的愚蠢才是真正的智慧。 阿罗娜嗤之以鼻，毫不为之所动：“在这里，唯一愚蠢的人就是你！你把我们拖到了半个地球之外，究竟是为了什么？我们在这里做什么，阿戈斯？” “等待，”他平静地回答，“等待这个世界上有史以来最强大的敌人。无论你是否跟随，我都会带领克尔维斯族走向荣耀。 阿罗娜怒不可遏，将赫蕾莎推到了一边：“那我就带他们回家去！” 在场的几位战士纷纷点头表示赞同。然而，大多数人依然保持沉默。阿戈斯只是叹了口气，闭上了眼睛，仿佛在对待一个孩子一样。我们是掠夺者，阿罗娜，我们的祖先从远古时代就是掠夺者，这一传统可以追溯到萨满们的传说之中。但我们可以做得更多！这一次将会有一场自‘神战’以来从未有过的战役，而你却想让我们逃避……你是个懦夫，是我们部落的耻辱。如果你看不到这一点，那么我别无选择，只能将你除名了，姐妹。 他妈的，试试看吧！从王座上下来，拿上你的斧头！”阿罗娜怒吼着，举起了她的锤子。 看来事情要开始了。你该怎么办？
rows.raw: " The guards outside the chieftain's pavillion don't seem to care if you're here or not[pc.ra orc||, thanks to your disguises,] but their crossed greataxes say that they'll object strongly to any attempt to enter no matter who you are. But that's easily circumvented: you [party.hasCompanions|motion to [party.compNames] to follow you as you ]move off to the side, circling the tent. The guards don't seem to care — what could you do, here in the seat of their power, after all? So you have no trouble finding a place out of sight to slit a hole through the pavillion's canvas and slip inside. The moment your head pokes through, you're assailed by intense warmth radiating from a central fire pit. The fur rugs cover the ground, stripped from bears and wolves and other beasts of the wild and arrayed with their faces inwards towards a great wood throne upon a dais of chiseled stone. Upon that throne sits a titan of an orcish warrior, a mountain of swamp-green muscle and curly black hair everywhere except the top of his head, which has been shaved down to a hawk like Arona's. His rough skin is a patchwork of old scars and tribal tattoos, covered in the barest amount of fur loincloth and nothing else. A bronze labrys sits beside him, leaning against the stone... along with a half-dozen orcish amazons lounging at their chieftain's feet, all watching the figure standing before the throne. Arona's here already, staring her brother down with hands on her hips and her hammer head-down beside her. Hretha is standing behind the impetuous warrior, anointing her cheeks and face with war paint in ritualistic motions. She's practiced these gestures so much that her blindness is no obstacle. "Still not too late to change your mind, little sister," the chieftain growls from his throne, leaning back against the carved wood. A pair of horned wolves adorn it, baring their fangs down at his challenger. "There's wisdom in recognizing your own foolishness." Arona scoffs, unimpressed. "The only fool I see here is you! You drag us halfway across the world because what? What are we doing here, Argoth?" "Waiting," he answers evenly. "Waiting for the greatest foe the world has ever seen. I will lead the Kervus to glory, sister, with or without you." Arona bristles, pushing Hretha away. "And I'll lead them home!" A few of the gathered warriors nod in agreement. Most, though, keep their silence. Argoth just sighs and closes his eyes, like he's dealing with a child. "We are raiders, Arona, descended from raiders as far back as the shaman's stories take us. But we can be more! There will be a battle here like there hasn't been since the Godswar, and you'd have us run from it... you're a coward, a shame upon my clan. If you cannot see that, then I have no choice but to remove you, sister." "Fucking try it. Get off that throne and grab your axe!" Arona howls, hefting up her hammer. Looks like things are about to get started. What do you do?"

rows.original: You remain in the shadows for now, content to watch events unfold. After all, Arona told you only to interfere if her brother tries some dirty trick. So you watch as Argoth slowly pushes himself to his feet and hefts up his axe, stepping down from the throne. "Very well, sister. If you refuse to back down..." He grits his teeth and assumes a fighting stance, both hands wrapped around the axe. It's almost a mirror of Arona's pose as she brings her maul to bear, grinding her heels into the rugs. The warriors around the tent step back, forming a semicircle of green bodies around the edge of the tent. Somehow, they don't notice you — or they don't care, too focused on the duel for dominance that's about to play out. Arona makes the first move, throwing herself headlong at her brother with a thunderous roar. Her hammer comes sweeping before her, cleaving through the air Argoth occupied a moment prior. Her brother steps back, letting Arona's momentum carry her forward and cracking the haft of his axe against her back. She grunts and stumbles, catching herself on his throne and swinging her hammer back around and letting its weight pull her back into the duel. Once again, Argoth evades the strike. He scowls, whirling his axe close enough to his sister to shear through the tip of her braid. "Control yourself, Arona!" he chides, forcing her back. "I expect better of you." "Fuck you!" his sister snarls back. This time, though, she adjusts her stance and gets her footing back before advancing. She comes more slowly this time, restraining her mighty hammer-blows so that when Argoth counters, she's able to pull back without being thrown around again. Argoth counters hard this time, using his greataxe like a cleaver with brutal chops and slashes that keep Arona backpedalling around the edge of the ring. She parries and dodges, but Argoth is larger and stronger, and pushes her back with every swing. A few dodges come too slow, and before long you see red rivers spilling down Arona's arms and chest from razor cuts. Finally, Arona catches Argoth's axeblade on the bronze head of her hammer, sliding back an inch with the force of impact before roaring and pushing back. Argoth's axe snaps, showering splinters, and his sister's hammer pushes through and into his chest. He grunts and stumbles back as Arona leaps at him, bringing the hammer down into his pectorals in a blow that would have crushed a human's bones. Instead, the mighty elder orc staggers and catches himself on the throne, coughing up a spat of blood onto the dais. "Good showing, little sister," he growls. "But this tribe needs leadership more than it needs raw strength. I can't let you take the tribe home... not yet. Boys!" Rather than rushing in to their chieftain's defense, the warriors surrounding the dueling siblings look amongst themselves. Even the amazons formerly sitting at the foot of the throne don't make a move. Arona grins, whirling her hammer to bear. "Looks like your viper-words haven't poisoned the tribe yet, big brother. Still got time to lose gracefully." "I don't lose, bitch," Argoth growls. Before Arona can stop him, the battered orc grabs a chain resting by the side of the throne and gives it a mighty yank. Arona's hammer slams down on it a second later, knocking it from Argoth's hand and pinning it to the stone... and then it goes taut, accompanied by a thunderous sound from behind the pavillion. Arona and the other warriors exchange worried glances in the moment before a huge hand tears its way in from the outdoors, soon accompanied by a massive gray-green arm covered in warts and boils. "Oh, I knew you wouldn't play fair!" Arona says, stepping backwards. "You're just gonna let your pet kill your own sister because you're a sore loser? Coward!" In the blink of an eye, she's gone, hurtling back with the force of a massive blow as the hill troll roars and stomps into the tent to defend its master. It's a huge misshapen thing, barely humanoid in its form and rippling with twisted hunch-backed muscle. One eye is much bigger than the other, [flags.ORC_QUEST_LODGE 1|but both swim in a drunken, unfocused haze. It seems like his minders have been incapacitated, leaving the troll violently ill — but still just as violent!|a black pit of boundless hate and rage.] "She's all yours, Benny," Argoth laughs hoarsely, coughing blood. "Get her!" Arona slowly picks herself up from among the warriors she bowled over, grabbing her hammer as she rises. "Okay, brother, you wanna cheat? Good. Show everyone what kinda man you are. [pc.name]! Let's go!" This thing's going to wreak havoc on the camp if you don't stop it!
rows.translation: 你暂时留在阴影中，满足于旁观事态发展。毕竟，阿罗娜只让你在她哥哥耍卑鄙手段时介入。 于是你看着阿戈斯缓缓撑起身体站立，提起斧子走下王座。“很好，妹妹。既然你拒绝退让……” 他咬紧牙关摆出战斗姿势，双手握住斧柄。阿罗娜举起巨锤，脚跟碾进地毯时，两人的姿势几乎如同镜像。帐篷周围的战士纷纷后退，在帐篷边缘围成一道绿色身体组成的半圆。不知为何，他们没有注意到你——或许只是根本不在乎；即将上演的支配权决斗吸引了他们全部注意。 阿罗娜抢先行动，发出雷鸣般的咆哮，迎头冲向哥哥。她的锤子横扫而过，劈开阿戈斯片刻前所在位置的空气。哥哥向后退去，任由阿罗娜的冲势带她向前，随即用斧柄重击她的后背。她闷哼一声踉跄几步，扶住他的王座稳住身体，再将锤子向后挥回，借助重量把自己拉回决斗。 阿戈斯再次躲过攻击。他皱起眉头，斧刃旋转着擦过妹妹，近得足以削断她辫子的末端。“控制好自己，阿罗娜！”他训斥着逼退她。“我对你的期待可不止这点。” “去你妈的！”妹妹咆哮着回敬。不过这一次，她在前进前调整姿势，重新站稳脚步。她放慢了速度，克制巨锤的强猛攻击，好让自己在阿戈斯反击时能够及时收势，不再被甩来甩去。阿戈斯这次反击得格外凶猛，将巨斧当成切肉刀，以残暴劈砍迫使阿罗娜沿着决斗圈边缘不断后退。她一边招架一边躲闪，可阿戈斯体型更大、力量更强，每次挥击都将她进一步逼退。几次闪躲慢了一拍；没过多久，你便看到剃刀般的伤口中涌出鲜红血流，沿阿罗娜的手臂和胸口淌落。 最终，阿罗娜用锤子的青铜锤头架住阿戈斯的斧刃；冲击力让她向后滑了一英寸，她随即咆哮着反推回去。阿戈斯的斧柄应声断裂，木屑四溅；妹妹的锤子冲破阻挡，撞上他的胸口。他闷哼着向后踉跄，阿罗娜则一跃而起，将锤子砸向他的胸肌——这一击足以粉碎人类的骨头。 然而，强壮的年长兽人只是摇晃几步，扶住王座稳住身体，向高台吐出一口鲜血。 “表现不错，小妹，”他低吼。“但这个部落需要的不是蛮力，而是领导。我不能让你带部落回家……现在还不能。小伙子们！” 围在决斗兄妹周围的战士没有冲上去保护酋长，反而面面相觑。就连先前坐在王座脚下的亚马逊战士也没有动作。 阿罗娜咧嘴一笑，再度抡起锤子。“看来你的毒蛇之语还没有毒害整个部落，大哥。你还有机会体面地认输。” “我从不认输，贱人，”阿戈斯低吼。阿罗娜尚未来得及阻止，伤痕累累的兽人便抓住王座旁的一条锁链，用力一扯。 一秒后，阿罗娜的锤子猛砸在锁链上，将它从阿戈斯手中击落并钉在石面……紧接着，锁链伴随帐篷后方传来的雷鸣声猛然绷紧。阿罗娜与其他战士不安地交换眼神；下一刻，一只巨手从外面撕开帐篷，紧随其后的是一条布满疣瘤和脓包的巨大灰绿色手臂。 “噢，我就知道你不会公平决斗！”阿罗娜一边后退，一边说道。“就因为输不起，你就打算让宠物杀死亲妹妹？懦夫！” 转瞬之间，她便消失在原地；山丘巨魔咆哮着踏进帐篷保护主人，沉重一击将她轰飞出去。那是一个巨大而畸形的怪物，形态勉强接近人类，扭曲驼背的肌肉不断起伏。一只眼睛远大于另一只；[flags.ORC_QUEST_LODGE 1|两只眼睛却都在醉酒般涣散的迷雾中游移。看来负责控制它的人已经失去行动能力，导致巨魔病得非常严重——但依旧同样暴力！|其中一只眼睛是充满无尽仇恨与怒火的漆黑深坑。] “她归你了，本尼，”阿戈斯咳着血，声音沙哑地笑道。“干掉她！” 阿罗娜从被自己撞倒的战士中缓缓起身，同时捡起锤子。“好啊，大哥，你想作弊？很好。让所有人看看你算个什么男人。[pc.name]！我们上！” 如果不阻止它，这东西会把整个营地砸个稀烂！

rows.original:
Good luck with all that, Arona. You withdraw as quick as you can, hearing curses and shouts of your name until you're back out of the pavillion and hauling ass for the exit. Before you're out of the camp, there's a crash from the chief's tent as it comes falling in on itself. Orcish warriors are running all over the place, to battle or into the hills to escape it. It's absolute chaos... and likely the dissolution of the Kervus tribe, now that it's leadership has been demolished. Whether Arona, Hretha, and Argoth survive or not doesn't matter.

            As you make it back onto the old road leading through the hills, you figure you can call Garth's orc problem sorted out for now. It'll be a long time before this tribe bothers Hawkethorne again, if it ever does.
rows.translation:
祝你好运，阿罗娜。你得尽快离开那里，因为你会听到人们的咒骂声以及呼喊你名字的声音，直到你离开那个帐篷，然后拼命往出口跑去。而在你离开营地之前，酋长的帐篷还会突然倒塌下来。兽人战士们四处奔逃，有的去参加战斗，有的则逃往山丘以躲避战火。整个场面一片混乱……对于已经失去领导力的凯尔维斯部落来说，这很可能意味着他们的覆灭。至于阿罗娜、赫蕾莎和阿戈斯能否存活下来，已经无关紧要了。

            当你重新回到那条穿过山丘的旧路上时，你心想，加斯的兽人问题应该暂时解决了。这个部落要再来找鹰棘镇的麻烦，恐怕还得等上很长时间——甚至可能永远不会再来了。

            "

rows.original: This looks like an orcish problem. Their chief's a coward, Arona's about to get pulped, and now there's a troll on the loose. Time to leave and call the orc problem resolved.
rows.translation: 这看起来像是兽人族面临的问题。他们的首领是个懦夫，阿罗娜快要被消灭了，现在又有一个巨魔在四处捣乱。是时候离开这里，宣布兽人族的危机已经解决了。
rows.raw: "This looks like an orcish problem. Their chief's a coward, Arona's about to get pulped, and now there's a troll on the loose. Time to leave and call the orc problem resolved."

rows.original: This is what Arona brought you here for, right: to watch just in case her brother does something fishy?
rows.translation: 这就是阿罗娜带你来这里的原因，对吧？就是为了监视，以防她的哥哥做出什么可疑的行为？
rows.raw: "This is what Arona brought you here for, right: to watch just in case her brother does something fishy?"

rows.original:
[party.CombatNames] rush out from the shadows, drawing your [pc.weapon] as you go. 

        Arona gasps. "[pc.name]! What the fuck-"
        
        She's cut off by the howl of Argoth's axe cutting through the air. In one motion he's grabbed it and spun it down towards you, driving you back from his throne. "To arms!" he bellows. "My sister means to assassinate me!"
        
        The gathered warriors roar in outrage, grabbing their weapons and lunging into the fray. It's going to be a hell of a fight!
rows.translation:
[party.CombatNames]从阴影中冲出来，一边跑一边拔出你的[pc.weapon]。

        阿罗娜倒吸了一口凉气。“[pc.name]！搞什么鬼——”
        
        她的话被阿戈斯挥斧划破空气的破空怒号打断了。他猛地抓起斧头，朝你的方向劈下，把你逼退，远离他的王座。“拿起武器！”他吼道，“我妹妹想要暗杀我！”
        
        聚集起来的战士们愤怒地咆哮着，抓起武器冲进了战团。这必将是一场恶战！

rows.translation: 嗯，这就是阿罗娜带你来这里的原因吧：为了扑上去打倒她哥哥，确保自己能够获胜？
rows.raw: "Well, this is what Arona brought you here for, right: to jump her brother and make sure she wins?"

rows.original:
You're fighting Chief Argoth and as many Kervus warriors as can cram their way into the field.

    Chief Argoth is a hulking mountain of muscle, with green skin covered in curly black hair and a latticework of old battle scars. Like his sister, his hair is shorn into a short hawk over his thick beard, though he lacks Arona's long braid. He wears little more than a hide loincloth around his waist, letting all within the tent gaze upon his rippling musculature. The bronze axe in his hand sings through the air with every swing, creating a howling gale around him as he charges into the fray.
    
    He's surrounded by a random pack of orcish fighters, all willing to defend their chieftain against this sudden ambush.
rows.translation:
你正在与阿戈斯酋长以及所有能够上战场的克尔维斯战士们交战。

    阿戈斯酋长犹如一座由肌肉构成的巨山，他的皮肤呈绿色，身上覆盖着卷曲的黑发，那些古老的战斗疤痕在皮肤上形成了复杂的图案。和他的姐姐一样，他的头发也被剪得短短的，只留下一撮覆盖在浓密胡须上的毛发，不过他没有阿罗娜那条长长的辫子。他腰间只围着一条兽皮缠腰布，这使得帐篷里的所有人都能看到他那结实有力的肌肉。他手中的青铜斧每一次挥动都会在空气中激荡出响亮的声响，当他冲入战场时，周围顿时掀起了一阵呼啸的风暴。
    
    他被一群随机出现的兽人战士包围了，这些战士们都决心保护他们的首领，共同抵御这场突如其来的伏击。

"
    You're fighting Chief Argoth and as many Kervus warriors as can cram their way into the field.

rows.original:
You're fighting Chief Argoth and his fearsome troll, Benny.

    Chief Argoth is a hulking mountain of muscle, with green skin covered in curly black hair and a latticework of old battle scars. Like his sister, his hair is shorn into a short hawk over his thick beard, though he lacks Arona's long braid. He wears little more than a hide loincloth around his waist, letting all within the tent gaze upon his rippling musculature. The bronze axe in his hand sings through the air with every swing, creating a howling gale around him as he charges into the fray.
    
    His troll is even more awesomely muscled, though much less handsome. It's a hideous thing covered in warts and boils, its gray-green skin stretched taut over a misshapen humanoid form. One eye, much larger than the other and set deep in Benny's bald head, seems to fixate on you as you enter the arena, filled with mindless, bestial rage. If this wretched creature's ever had a cogent thought in its mind, that time's long gone now. All that remains is the desire to batter your party into the ground.
rows.translation:
你正在与阿戈斯酋长以及他那可怕的巨魔本尼交战。

    阿戈斯酋长是一块由肌肉构成的庞然巨物，他的皮肤呈绿色，身上覆盖着卷曲的黑发，还有许多古老的战斗疤痕。与他的妹妹一样，他的头发也被剪得短短的，只留下一撮覆盖在浓密胡须上的毛发，不过他没有阿罗娜那条长长的辫子。他腰间仅缠着一条兽皮制成的缠腰布，这使得帐篷里的所有人都能看到他那结实有力的肌肉。他手中的青铜斧每一次挥动都会在空气中发出清脆的声音，当他冲入战斗现场时，这种声音仿佛会引发一阵狂风。
    
    他的巨型怪物体型更加魁梧，肌肉也更为发达，不过却远没有那么英俊。那是一只布满疣瘤和脓包的丑陋生物，灰绿色的皮肤紧绷在它那畸形的类人形态上。其中一只眼睛比另一只大得多，深陷在本尼光秃的头顶中，当你走进竞技场时，那双眼睛似乎会紧紧地盯着你，其中蕴含着一种毫无理智的、野性的愤怒。如果这个可恶的生物曾经有过任何清醒的念头，那么那种时刻早已一去不复返了。现在它剩下的唯一念头，就是把你们的队伍打得落花流水。

rows.original: As the last of Argoth's retainers fall, a thunderous crack of force echoes throughout the pavillion. Hretha steps up behind you, slamming her staff on the floor with enough channeled power to send the hair and loincloths of the orcs near her flying back. The warriors assembled around the tent that haven't yet jumped into the fray step back, making way for the blind priestess. "That is enough, Arona!" she says, scowling at the young amazon. "What is the meaning of this? You dare overthrow an honorable challenge with the help of outsiders? What has happened to you, my sister..." Arona sputters and looks desperately between you and her sister, struggling for words. "I... [pc.HeShe] wasn't... I told [pc.himHer] to stay back!" "And you think that excuses the chaos you've caused in camp? Surely you know, Arona, that a leader must take responsibility for her actions." Argoth pushes himself unsteadily back to his feet, black lips pulled back into a snarl. "That's right, sister. You violated the ancient traditions... you tried to ambush me." Arona lunges for him, held back only by a sudden dogpile of still-standing warriors. Thirty or so more orc warriors draw their axes at you, pushing you back to the edge of the tent at blade-point. No matter how well you kicked Argoth's ass, this many fighters at once... and all the ones in the growing crowd outside, jockeying for entrance... that's too much, even for you. You stow your weapon and back off. The orcish chieftain shrugs off the offered aid from some of his thanes and hefts up his own axe, pressing the blade up to Arona's throat. "I'd kill you for these violations... but you are my sister, Arona. There is no greater sin than kinslaying. I wonder if you'd have had the same restraint in your heart." He turns to Hretha and lays a hand on his sister's shoulder. "Let the tribe know: it is exile for my sister and her compatriots. Let them never set foot in Kervus land again." The priestess sighs, lowering her head. "Of course, brother. My chieftain." "You bastard!" Arona snarls. "You'd have done the same if my idiot backup hadn't ruined it." The elder orc needn't answer. He grunts with effort and lowers himself back onto the throne; the she-orcs that had been fawning over him rush over, kissing at his bruises and cuts as the warriors holding Arona back push her towards the entrance of the camp. So, too, are you pushed out at blade-point by the angry mob of fighters, forced to follow Arona and Hretha out of the pavillion. "YOU JACKASS," Arona howls as soon as you're outside. "What the fuck did I say!? Huh? AFTER he sprung his trap, not before!" "Peace, sister," Hretha sighs. "This [pc.ra orc|outsider|[pc.race]] is not of our tribe. It was not [pc.hisHer] place to know our customs... nor yours to challenge Argoth. He led us here for the glory of Kervus, not to slake your lust for battle and slaving. I tried so hard to raise you, but... no, this is the price you pay for your hot-headedness. I told you this day would come if you did not calm yourself." The amazon has not response to that, even as the camp gates are being thrown open. Hretha plants her staff at the threshold, waiting as the fighters shove you past. "At the very least... without you stoking the fires, our warriors may submit to Argoth and stop their raiding. Go back to your village, outsider, and tell them that. Consider it your victory takings for defeating Argoth in battle."
rows.translation: 当阿戈斯的最后一批仆从纷纷倒下时，一声惊天巨响骤然响起破解强烈的冲击波在馆内回荡。赫蕾莎走到你身后，将她的法杖重重砸在地面，释放出的能量足以让附近的兽人们的头发和腰布都被震得飞向后方。那些尚未加入战斗的战士们纷纷后退，为这位盲目的女祭司让出了道路。 够了，阿罗娜！”她皱着眉头对这位年轻的亚马逊女子说道，“这到底是什么意思？你竟敢借助外人的帮助来破坏一场光荣的挑战？你这是怎么了，我的妹妹……” 阿罗娜结结巴巴地说话，急切地在你和她妹妹之间来回看着，不知该说些什么好。我…… [pc.HeShe]不是这样的……我是这么说的。 [pc.himHer]你就想用这个理由来为自己在营地里造成的混乱开脱吗？阿罗娜，你肯定知道，一个领导者必须为自己的行为负责。” 阿戈斯摇摇晃晃地站了起来，黑色的嘴唇扭曲成一副愤怒的表情。“没错，姐姐。你违背了古老的传统…… 你试图设下埋伏我阿罗娜向他扑去，但被一群仍然站立着的战士挡住了去路。还有三十多名兽人战士拔出了他们的斧头，用刀刃将你逼向帐篷的边缘。无论你之前如何击败阿戈斯，面对这么多敌人同时进攻，你也无能为力了。还有外面那越来越多的人群，他们都争先恐后地想要进去……就连你来说，这也太过分了。把你的武器收起来，退回去吧。 那位兽人首领拒绝了他的一些手下提供的帮助，然后举起了自己的斧头，将斧刃抵在了阿罗娜的喉咙上。因为这些违法行为，我真想杀了你……但你是我的妹妹，阿罗娜。没有比杀害亲人更严重的罪行了。我在想，如果你处在我的位置，是否也能保持同样的克制你的心啊……” 他转向赫蕾莎，将手放在妹妹的肩上：“告诉部落吧——我的妹妹和她的同胞们将被流放。让他们永远不要再踏入克尔维斯的土地。” 女祭司叹了口气，低下了头。当然，兄弟。我的首领。” “你这个混蛋！”阿罗娜怒吼道，“要不是我那个愚蠢的替身搞砸了一切，你也会这么做的。” 那位年长的兽人根本不需要回答。他费力地哼了一声，重新坐回了王座上；那些一直对他阿谀奉承的雌性兽人们立刻围了上来，亲吻着他身上的淤伤和伤口，而那些牵制着阿罗娜的战士们则将她推向了营地的入口处。于是，你也同样被那些愤怒的战士们用刀尖逼迫着，不得不跟随阿罗娜和赫蕾莎离开那个亭子。 “你这个白痴！”你一走出亭子，阿罗娜就怒吼道，“我之前到底说了什么！？哼？之后他终于使出了他的手段，真是迟到了！” “冷静点，姐姐，”赫蕾莎叹息道，“这件事[pc.ra orc|局外人|[pc.race]]它不属于我们的族群。它本来就不是。 [pc.hisHer]这里本是用来了解我们风俗的地方……而不是让你来挑战阿戈斯的。他带领我们来到这里，是为了荣耀克尔维斯，而不是为了满足你对战斗与奴役的渴望。我曾经竭尽全力抚养你，但是……不，这就是你鲁莽行事所必须付出的代价。我就说过，如果你不冷静下来，这一天总会到来的。” 亚马逊人对这番话没有任何反应，而营地的大门也已经被强行打开了。赫蕾莎将她的法杖插在门槛上，静静地等待着那些战士把你推过去。至少……如果没有你不断煽动事端，我们的战士们或许早就向阿戈斯屈服，停止他们的袭击行为了。外乡人，你回去告诉你的族人吧。就把这当作你在战斗中击败阿戈斯的胜利成果吧。"

rows.original: The gates shut fast behind you, followed by the heavy thud of a bar being set into place. No doubt Hretha will be taking care of the hidden entrance you used the first time, too... you won't be going back into the orc camp now. Arona's hammer slips from her hands and she falls on her knees, all the strength slipping out of her with a long, heavy sigh. "Fuck. FUCK." You sit yourself down next to the big orc, surprised by her sudden, sullen silence. If there's one thing you've learned about Arona since you first traded blows, it's that she has no stomach for being quiet whether she's fighting or fucking, in victory or defeat. Before you can decide how to approach her after this, she sighs again and slaps her thighs, sitting up straight again. "Well fuck the Kervus and the longships they all sailed in on! Fuck 'em, I don't need 'em. I got all I need right here." She slaps the haft of her hammer, then the bronze face of her shield.[arona.fucked|.. and then finally grabs your thigh, squeezing hard.| After a moment's hesitation, she claps your shoulder too.] "Even if I'm pissed at you." Yeah, maybe you should have listened to instructions a little more closely. "So... what'll you do now?" "Fuck if I know," Arona says. Her hand tightens on you. "You got a tavern in that shitty little thorpe? Can't make important decisions sober. That's not the orcish way."
rows.translation: 大门在你身后迅速合拢，紧接着传来门闩落位的沉重砰响。毫无疑问，赫蕾莎也会处理你第一次进入时使用的秘密入口……现在你无法再返回兽人营地了。 阿罗娜的锤子从手中滑落；她跪倒在地，发出一声漫长沉重的叹息，仿佛全身力气都随之流失。“操。操！” 你在高大的兽人身旁坐下，对她突如其来的阴郁沉默颇感意外。自从第一次与阿罗娜交手以来，你至少明白了一件事：无论战斗还是做爱，无论胜利还是失败，她都忍受不了安静。你还没想好接下来该怎样面对她，她便再次叹气，拍打大腿，又挺直身子坐好。“去他妈的凯尔维斯，去他妈载他们来的每一艘长船！我不需要他们，我需要的全在这里。” 她先拍了拍锤柄，又拍了拍盾牌的青铜表面。[arona.fucked|……最后抓住你的大腿，用力捏紧。|迟疑片刻后，她也拍了拍你的肩膀。]“哪怕我还在生你的气。” 是啊，也许你当时应该更认真听从指示。“所以……你接下来怎么办？” “我他妈哪知道。”阿罗娜说着，抓住你的手又收紧了些。“你那个破村子里有酒馆吗？清醒时可不能做重要决定，那不符合兽人的作风。”

rows.original: You shake your head and tell her there's nowhere for her to put up her feet in Hawkethorne. She'd be better off moving on to greener pastures. The amazon side-eyes you for a long moment before she hauls herself up to her feet and grabs her hammer. "Guess that's the way it is. Might as well lose everything all at once. rows.original:
With a horrific howl of confusion and pain, the hill troll crumples face-first into the middle of the chieftain's tent. Argoth grunts from his position leaning back against the throne, his axe slipping from his fingers. When it tumbles, a final sign of submission from the beaten warrior, a gasp carries amongst what's left of the crowd.
    
    "You see that!?" Arona bellows, turning on them. "You see how this cowering little girl cheats? Your leader can't even fight his own battles... he has to rely on his monstrous fuckboy to fight me!"
    
    She steps on the troll's head and hefts her hammer high. "It's time for a real warrior to take charge, Kervus!"
    
    The warriors surrounding her howl in approval, raising axes and hammers to the heavens. Gerik barks heartily as well, dancing around his mistress's feet as the seeress steps forward. "I think you've made your point, Arona," Hretha says evenly, leaning on her sun-tipped staff. "As the middle child, I will gladly take the reins from Argoth."
    
    A hush falls over the crowd as the implication washes over them. And then Hretha smiles and opens her arms to her sister. "Then again... Lumia would not smile on my greed if I wanted to be chieftain and oracle both... so I suppose you'll have to do."
    
    The fighters laugh with her, and just like that, the tension bleeds from the pavillion. Arona drops her hammer by the wayside and steps down off the troll to take her sister in her arms, hugging her fiercely. "By rights," Hretha continues, smacking Arona's hand away from her furs, "You must decide what to do with Argoth. Not only have you defeated our brother, but you've utterly shamed him. To call on outsider aid in a duel and still lose is the lowest a man can sink to. Even a mindless beast has more honor."
    
    Arona smirks and turns back to the dais. She grabs her half-conscious brother and throws him from the throne, letting his body tumble down before seating herself upon the great horned artifice and sighing with contentment.

rows.original: As you approach the now familiar sight of the orcish camp in the foothills, you're met with an unfamiliar sight: that of a company of orc warriors coming up through the ravines and gullies that make up the foothills, a steady marching beat ringing out into the air. You tense for a second, then relax; you recognize the color and furs they're wearing as being that of the Kervus — this isn't some rival tribe looking to dislodge Arona's foothold in these hills. The orcs trundle up from the southeast, about a hundred in number in orderly ranks as they make a beeline for the warcamp; no-nonsense and reeking of barely disciplined brutality, you definitely don't want to get in the way of this column. Behind them, heavily laden carts and wagons pulled by mules and slaves alike bring up the rear, their contents covered in layers of oilcloth. Neither slave nor mule look happy about their predicament, but over the time you've spent with Arona, such appears to be the orcish way of life. As you watch, the column of orcs makes its way to the fore of the camp, and one of their number steps out to address the gate guards. The latter are as shocked as you were at first, instinctively reaching for their weapons — standards must have really slipped if those manning the gates were this oblivious — but soon relax when they recognize the colors of their tribe. Tension gives way to mirth as a shout rings out in the warcamp and the gates heave open; orcs from within the camp rush out to meet the column, laughing, hugging, guffawing, cheering. All semblance of discipline dissipates as the ranks break, orcs of all shapes and sizes reuniting after months. "We've been so bored, stuck here doing nothing. Thank the gods you're here to relieve us —" "You should've seen the fight when Argoth's little sister challenged him for the position of chieftain —" "Thank the Seven you've brought more beer, the stuff we have is starting to get all stale and flat —" "You should come and try the harpies they've got here, feathery cumrags with asses so big —" You're about to move on into the warcamp yourself when a heavy, callused hand lands on your shoulder. Turning, you look [pc.heightRange 72 84|straight into the eyes of|down at|up into the menacing gaze of] a stout orcish woman dressed in furs dyed in the colors of the Kervus tribe, plus a whole lot of leathers the others aren't wearing. Her skin's a lighter shade of green compared to, say, Arona, and a hint of brown in the mix results in a color somewhat reminiscent of swampwater. The fingers curled about your collarbone are firm but unyielding, with the implied threat of sharply applied pressure should you make any false moves. "[pc.ra orc|Hey, you. You're not of our tribe — what're you doing here?|You don't look like a slave, [pc.race]. You've got to be pretty brazen to be out in the open in front of an entire warcamp of orcs.]" [party.has arona |Arona snorts, stepping up from beside you. |Just then, Arona comes up to you, having just finished a cursory inspection of the laden carts. ] "It's fine, Ragnild. [pc.HeShe]'s a friend. If nothing else, [pc.heShe]'s finally helped me wrangle the truth out of Argoth as to why he had us waiting all this while in the hills doing nothing. Ragnild, [pc.name]. [pc.name], Ragnild. She's our blacksmith." Well met. Now, about that grip on your shoulder... "Well, if Arona says you're good, I guess you're all right, [pc.name]." A snort as Ragnild removes her hands from your shoulders and wrings them through her open-fingered gloves. "I prefer metallurgist, though." "Same difference. That's why no one likes you, Rags." Ragnild scowls and thumps her ample bosom with a fist. "You know exactly why no one likes me, Arona. Speaking of which, where's that brother of yours?" An enormous shit-eating grin crosses Arona's face. "He's been exiled. You're looking at the new chieftain now, Rags. I challenged him and he was dirty enough to try sending his bed-troll at me, but everything worked out in the end, thanks to [pc.name]." Scratching her chin, Ragnild studies you again, perhaps with a renewed interest... and perhaps even respect. [pc.dcb|Finally, you're getting some of the recognition you deserve around here.|Huh. You know the stereotypes about orcs, but guess stereotypes have to be seeded somewhere.|Hey, you know you're sexy, but you didn't know that you were that sexy.] "Huh. Pity it had to end this way, but I won't say that I'm not going to breathe a sigh of relief now that he's gone. You think his cronies are going to fall into line behind you quietly, or make a fuss?" Arona slaps a fist into a palm and grins. "Well, if they DO make trouble, I'll just beat them into line. Problem solved. Seriously, Rags, you think too much about things. Now that Argoth's been dealt with, you can spend time with people other than Hretha — if you could manage to talk less." A scowl. "Forget it. I'm going to get my cart sorted out. Here I am fresh from the islands, expecting to see Argoth and his goons sneering at me, and I find out you've whooped his ass and exiled him. Well, I'll have Pavo —"

rows.translation: 帕沃也不在了。他已经被送回了他应该待的地方——那些奴隶牢房里。 [flags.PAVO_SUCKED|他为了得到那种极致的性体验，背叛了我们。|他这次又失败了。]你只能没有他了。 啊……哦。 拉格斯，为什么这么愁眉苦脸的？我以为你不喜欢身边有奴隶呢。 只是……算了。谢谢您亲自来迎接我，首领。我先去把我的东西安顿好，然后就去喝一些赫蕾莎泡的茶，她的茶确实很好喝。 说着，你看到拉格妮尔德大步走向附近的一辆马车，车上装满了看起来像是金属制品的货物。那个女恶魔咬紧牙关，用脚后跟用力蹬地，然后通过强劲的手臂和腹部力量，车轮终于开始转动起来。 赶紧找一支该死的奴隶队来帮你处理那件事吧，拉格斯！真的！阿罗娜皱着眉头，最后又恶狠狠地瞥了拉格妮尔德一眼，然后才转向你。傻女人吧。不过不得不承认，她确实很擅长自己做的事情，否则早就因为她太让人恼火了而被我们赶走了。另外，她和赫蕾莎从小就一起长大。 她确实是个有点特别的人，这一点不可否认。 哈。阿罗娜摇了摇头，强挤出一丝欢快的笑容，那种刻意表现出来的情绪显然让人感到很不自然。我现在已经是首领了，救援物资刚刚从那些岛屿运过来，一切都在慢慢步入正轨。那些无聊透顶的孩子们至少可以回家到那些岛屿上，休息上几个月。我应该开心该死，还有那个女人…… 对于一个兽人来说，拉格妮尔德确实显得有些忧郁。 她确实懂得如何破坏美好的气氛，这一点毫无疑问。拜托， [pc.name] — 看来一切都已经准备妥当了。 [party.has arona|知道在我不在的时候，营地依然能够正常运转，我就不用像阿戈斯那样，每时每刻都得盯着它们了，这真是太好了。|我打算今晚准备一顿丰盛的晚餐，用来欢迎新成员的到来，同时也为老成员们送行。肯定会非常美味！]那我们走吧，站在那里干吗呢？ 你再仔细看看那些混杂在一起的兽人们，人群中已经开始出现一些嬉戏打闹的场景。没错，兽人就是这样的性格。至少，换一批守卫的话，他们应该就不会那么容易出去在边境地区惹是生非了……
rows.raw: " "Pavo's not around any more, either. He's been sent back to the slave pens where he belongs, considering how [flags.PAVO_SUCKED|he betrayed us for the high, high price of a good cocksucking.|he's failed for the last time.] You'll just have to make do without him." "Ah. Oh." "Why the long face, Rags? I thought you didn't like keeping slaves around." "It's just... never mind. Thanks for personally greeting me, chief. I'm going to get my things set up, then settle down for some of that tea Hretha's so good at." With that, you watch as Ragnild stomps over to a nearby cart, heavily laden with what looks like metalwork in it. The orcess grits her teeth as she digs her heels into the ground, and with a mighty flexing of arms and abs the wheels grind and start to turn. "Just get a damn slave team to help you with that thing, Rags! Really!" Scowling, Arona throws Ragnild one last ugly glance, then turns back to you. "Silly woman. Can't deny that she's good at what she does, though, else we'd have exiled her ages ago for being so damned frustrating. That, and she's been with Hretha since they were kids." She certainly seems like a piece of work, there's no denying it. "Hah." Shaking her head, Arona forces a cheery grin on her face, the emotional labor painfully obvious. "I'm chieftain now, the relief just arrived from the islands, and everything's falling into place. All the boys and girls bored stiff can at least go home to the islands and take a break for a couple months. I should be happy, damn it. And that woman..." Ragnild certainly looks melancholy for an orc. "She knows how to kill a good buzz, that's for sure. Come on, [pc.name] — looks like everything's in order. [party.has arona|It's good to know the camp can keep itself running while I'm away and I don't have to babysit them every waking moment like Argoth insisted on doing|I'm going to order a feast cooked up tonight, welcome the new arrivals and send off the old guard. It'll be pretty damned good]. Come on, then — no sense standing around." You take one more look at the mass of mingling orcs, small patches of playful roughhousing already beginning to erupt in the rabble. Yeah, orcs will be orcs all right. At the very least, a fresh change of the guard will mean that they won't be as tempted to go out and cause trouble in the Marches..."

rows.original:
The interior of the armorer's hut is brightly lit, both by [dayNight|light streaming in from a window|a couple of seal-oil lanterns hanging from the rafters] and the [dayNight|roaring fire|cooling embers] of the forge.

    With its previous occupant gone, the hut has taken on a more vibrant character. Gone are the plain spears, hammers and axes that lay against the walls; replacing them are armaments with a more personalised touch. A hide shield with an elaborately carved and painted face hangs above the doorway, its ferocious expression scrutinising the entirety of the main working area; several rune-etched, double-headed axeheads lie on a rack, waiting to be fitted onto hafts. Even the forge itself has changed, several additions and alterations in place to allow for better airflow and temperature control; anvil and quenching trough sit nearby within easy reach. A single verse of orcish script is carved into the stone, praising the light of Lumia and seeking her guidance in war.
    
    Pavo sought to be good enough. This is excellence and dedication.
    
    A small heap of looted weapons and armor lies near the entrance, plunder from the warband's recent exploits. All the pieces are far too small to be wielded in orcish hands or donned on orcish bodies; some have ears on their helmets or openings for tails. The few larger pieces that can be fitted to be useful to the Kervus will be, but more often than not these will be the fodder for the grist of Ragnild's forge, bronze melted down and reincarnated in a new form. Leather is stripped, hafts are repurposed or broken down for kindling if too far gone; Ragnild wastes nothing she's given.
    
    [dayNight
        |The orcess is working the forge as usual, the ring of heated metal sounding in the air as she beats a good temper into yet another edge. Her face is hidden behind the forge-mask she wears, but her entire demeanour and body language belies a furious, pinpoint focus on her work.
    
        |The orcess is nowhere to be seen, presumably either out at Hretha's for the evening or having retired to her personal chamber in the back of the hut. You'll have to check further in if you want to see if she's around.
    ]
rows.translation:
铸甲师的小屋里灯火通明，既有[dayNight|从窗户流泻而入的阳光|几盏悬挂在屋梁上的海豹油灯]，也有锻炉中[dayNight|熊熊燃烧的炉火|逐渐冷却的余烬]。

    前任主人离开后，小屋焕发出了更鲜明的个性。原本倚墙摆放的朴素长矛、锤子和斧头已不见踪影，取而代之的是更具个人特色的武备。门楣上挂着一面皮盾，盾面经过精雕细绘，那副凶猛的面孔俯瞰着整个主要工作区；架子上摆着数枚刻有符文的双刃斧头，等待装上长柄。就连锻炉本身也经过改造，增设了好几处结构，以便更好地控制气流与温度；铁砧和淬火槽就摆在伸手可及的位置。石墙上刻着一行兽人文字，赞颂卢米娅的光辉，祈求她在战争中赐予指引。
    
    帕沃只求做得足够好；这里体现的却是卓越与奉献。
    
    入口旁堆着一小堆劫来的武器和护甲，都是战帮最近出征的战利品。每件装备都太小，既不适合兽人的双手挥舞，也套不上兽人的身体；有些头盔开着容纳耳朵的孔，有些甲胄则留有让尾巴穿过的缺口。少数较大的部件可以改造成克尔维斯人能用的装备，自然会被留下；但更多时候，它们会成为拉格妮尔德锻炉里的原料，青铜熔化后以全新形态重生。皮革会被剥下，武器柄会被另作他用；若已破损得无法利用，就劈成引火柴。拉格妮尔德绝不浪费交到她手里的任何东西。
    
    [dayNight
        |女兽人像往常一样守着锻炉。她不断捶打又一件刃具，为其锻出良好的韧性，加热金属的敲击声回荡在空气中。她的脸藏在锻造面具后面，但整个人的姿态与动作无不显露出愤怒般炽烈而精准的专注。
    
        |不见女兽人的踪影；她大概去赫蕾莎那里度过今晚了，或是已经回到小屋后方自己的房间休息。若想知道她是否还在，你得继续往里面看看。
    ]
