rows.original: Entering the hut, you find that [ flags.PAVO_MET |things have changed considerably since you were last here. For one, Pavo is missing, presumably sent back to the slave pens if you remember Arona's words correctly. Secondly, the dark atmosphere the lizan preferred in the hut is gone, light [dayNight|shining in through a large open window|cast upon the hut's interior by a seal-oil lamp]. Thirdly, gone are Pavo's generic works, the plain, standardised armaments removed from the racks and walls and replaced with pieces possessed of a far more orcish character. |Ragnild's made herself at home. Firstly, there's a definite atmosphere to the hut, much like that of the chieftain's pavillion or Hretha's abode; it says something of the person dwelling within it. Secondly, there's plenty of light in a hut that clearly wasn't made for such — [dayNight|the window in the wall looks like someone installed it with a war hammer|the hook the seal-oil lamp's hanging from looks far too sturdy for a simple lamp]. Finally, the pieces on the racks and wall all have a very orcish character to them, one that you've become accustomed to with so long in Arona's company. ] The blacksmith herself is bent over the anvil with her back towards you, hammering a good temper into an orc-sized cleaver. Even with bronze, heating the blade evenly must've been a challenge... as you watch, she plunges the edge into a quenching trough, great clouds of steam rising into the air with an accompanying hiss. "Hello?" Ragnild pauses for a moment, and sets the sword blank down on a nearby bench. When she turns to face you, instead of the orcish face you were expecting, there's a heavy bronze mask shaped like a sabertooth cat in its place, fangs bared and looking as if it's ready to pounce any second. The suddenness of it all — before you know what you're doing, your instincts have already prodded your body into taking a step back. [pc.isDK|It's only when your mind catches up that you curse yourself for showing weakness, consciously or not.] [party.has arona |Arona laughs and claps you on the shoulder. "Don't worry, [pc.name]. The forge-mask gets most people the first time they see it — I know it did for me, and that's saying something. Still, it's prettier than her actual face on a bad day." Ragnild hooks a thumb under the mask's chin and pushes upwards, revealing a very orcish scowl adorning her face. "And what brings our great chieftain here? Surely not to follow in her brother's footsteps?" "Nah, nothing like that. I'm just showing [pc.name] around, that's all. Argoth was a bastard when it came to you, I'll agree, but I'll be damned if I'm going to give up on a little light-hearted teasing." "Hmph." |"Sorry about that." Ragnild's voice is slightly muffled under the bronze mask, but she hooks a thumb under its chin and pushes upwards, revealing a rather sheepish smile. There's a moment of awkward silence, and then she steps forward, reaching [pc.heightRange 60 68|out|up|down] to plant her powerful hands on your shoulders. "You all right there?" You were just taken by surprise, that's all. Nothing to worry about. "I forget you're [pc.ra orc|not of our tribe|not an orc]. The forge-mask... yeah, it does that to most people the first time they see it. My father's was that of a boar, and even more hideous and ferocious than mine. Said it reminded him of my mom on a bad day. "C'mon, laugh a little, okay? Show me you're all right?" [pc.isDK|Fine, fine, you'll humor her.|Sheesh, she's that worried about you, huh...?] There, one smile, coming right up. You're not sure if you can manage laughter, though... A chuckle. "Guess that'll have to do. Sorry about that, again." ] So, she seems to be quite busy, huh? "[dayNight|Damned if I am.|What gave it away? The fact that I'm still hammering away while every other lunk in the camp is asleep?] Pavo... look at the mess he's made of things. The lizard had plenty of skill, but that's where it ends. Not that I could've expected a slave to care any more than what would save him a beating, but even so, I'd have expected some pride in what he did. Now I'm the one left holding the bag, and Arona probably expects me to fix everything." She shakes her head, and sighs. [party.has arona |"To be fair, Rags, it's what's kept you around for this long. Argoth would have exiled you long ago if you weren't this damned useful to the Kervus." Arona jerks a thumb at the armaments strewn about the hut. "When it comes down to it, Hretha's soft spot for you wouldn't have outweighed the chieftain's word." "Yeah... can't deny that. And what does the new chieftain say about that?" "You're useful, Rags. Besides, if I exiled you, I wouldn't be able to tease your sorry ass every day, and that'd be a shame." "I don't know if that's better or worse than exile." Arona just snickers. ] So, you know she's a busy woman and all and thus you'll avoid wasting her time. What can you get done here? "Opening hours are from dawn to dusk. See me if you want to get outfitted — given how you're in Arona's good graces, I don't see a problem in letting you share in our stuff. You'll still have to pay, of course, I'm not letting you have it for free. "My mother taught me not to mix business and pleasure and I'm backlogged enough as it is fixing the mistakes Pavo made, so come along in the evenings if you want to be social." She doesn't join the others in the warrior's lodge? "Not for lack of wanting to. It's a long story[party.has arona| — one that Arona there's well acquainted with]. It's all right, I've grown to prefer tea with Hretha over the years, anyway." Tea — now that's not something commonly associated with orcs. "Surprised? Hretha's stuff is pretty amazing. I guess I'll just have to keep on surprising you then, [pc.name]. Well, if there's nothing else, I've got to get back to work. Never any shortage of that." With that, Ragnild pulls her forge-mask back down over her face and turns back to the anvil; it's not long before her muscle-bound arms are at work once more, the ringing of metal clear in the air. Seeing the conversation's at an end, you turn and step out of the hut. [party.has arona |"Nice woman, isn't she?" Arona says as you emerge into open air. "She's got heartlander orc blood in her, and it shows. Constantly worrying about this and that — that's what our mainlander cousins are known for. Worrying. Sure is a lot of fun to be around." By the sound of things, she gets along pretty well with Hretha. Arona dips her head and rubs her chin. "Of course they would. It's my sister's job as oracle to worry for the entire Kervus so we don't have to. Argoth's dislike for her wasn't all on him, either — people would like Rags more if she just wasn't such a stuck-up prick. Doesn't change anything, though. until she takes an actual apprentice, we're stuck with her. Won't drink. Won't fight. Doesn't like us keeping slaves, says it makes us weak. Bo-ring." Maybe she just needs someone to reach out to her. Ragnild clearly has different wants from the average orc, after all. "Yeah, and that someone isn't going to be me. I'd rather beat my head against a stone wall than try and sit through one of her conversations with Hretha." ] Well. While you certainly don't have the whole picture yet, you're beginning to get a feel for the situation between Ragnild and the rest of the Kervus. Not that you're about to step on Arona's toes... but you've already meddled so much in the tribe's affairs as an outsider. What's a little more?

[dayNight|从一扇大开的窗户中透了进来|被海豹油灯的光芒照亮的小屋内部]第三，帕沃那些普通的武器已经不见了——那些原本摆放在架子上或墙上的、样式单一、规格统一的武器，都被替换成了具有更加浓郁兽人特色的武器。 |拉格妮尔德让这个小屋变得充满了家的氛围。首先，这个小屋确实有一种独特的氛围，很像酋长的帐篷或赫蕾莎的住所；这种氛围在很大程度上反映了居住在其中的人的性格。其次，这个小屋虽然显然并不是为这种用途而建造的，但里面的光线却非常充足。 铁匠本人正背对着你，弯腰站在铁砧前，将一块青铜锻造成一把尺寸与兽人相当的砍刀。即便是青铜，要使刀刃均匀受热也必定是一项艰巨的任务……当你注视着她将刀刃浸入淬火槽中的时候，大量蒸汽伴随着嘶嘶声腾空而起。 喂？ 拉格妮尔德停顿了片刻，然后将那把剑随意地放在附近的长椅上。当她转过身来面对你时，你原本期待看到的却是兽人的面孔，然而代替它的却是一副形状像剑齿虎的重型青铜面具——那些锋利的獠牙仿佛随时都会扑上来攻击你。这一切发生得太突然了，还没等你反应过来，你的本能就已经促使你后退了一步。 [pc.isDK|直到你的思维真正跟上这种节奏时，你才会后悔自己表现出了软弱——无论你是有意还是无意。] [party.has arona |阿罗娜笑着拍了拍你的肩膀。别担心， [pc.name]第一次看到那个铁匠面具时，大多数人都会被它吸引——我知道我当时就是如此，而这已经说明了很多问题。不过，就算在她状态不好的时候，这个面具也比她真正的脸要好看一些。 拉格妮尔德用拇指勾住面具的下巴，用力向上拉，于是她那张脸上露出了典型的兽人般的阴沉表情。那么，是什么让我们伟大的女首领来到这里呢？难道是为了追随她兄弟的脚步吗？ 不，不是那样的。我只是在展示而已。 [pc.name]就这些吧。我承认，阿戈斯对你确实很刻薄，但我绝对不会放弃这种轻松幽默的调侃方式。 哼。 |对此我深感抱歉。拉格妮尔德的声音在青铜面具的遮掩下显得有些闷闷的，但她用拇指托住面具的下巴，轻轻一推，露出了一个略带羞涩的微笑。一阵尴尬的沉默之后，她向前迈了一步，伸出了手[pc.heightRange 60 68|出局|向上|向下]将她强有力的手放在你的肩膀上。你那边没事吧？ 你只是被吓了一跳而已，没什么好担心的。 我忘了你还在这里。 [pc.ra orc|与我们无关|不是兽人]那个铁匠面具……没错，大多数人在第一次看到它的时候都会有这样的反应。我父亲的那个面具是野猪的形象，比我的那个更加狰狞凶恶。他说，看到那个面具会让他想起我妈妈心情不好的时候。 来吧，笑一笑吧，好吗？让我看看你没事吧？ [pc.isDK|好吧好吧，你就迁就她吧。|哎呀，她居然这么担心你啊……？]看，那一个微笑，就这样出现了。不过，你还不确定自己是否真的能笑出来…… 一阵轻笑。看来也只能这样了。再次为这件事表示歉意。 ] 所以，她看起来挺忙的，是吧？ "[dayNight|我绝对不是这样的。|是什么暴露了我的行踪？难道就是因为我还在不停地忙碌，而营地里的其他人都已经睡着了吗？]帕沃……看看他把事情弄得一团糟。那条蜥蜴确实挺有本领的，但也就仅此而已了。我本来也没指望一个奴隶会对自己做的事情有多在意，只要能避免挨打就行，但即便如此，我还是希望他对自己所做的事情能感到一些自豪吧。现在看来我是最后还是得由我来解决问题，而阿罗娜大概也指望我来把一切都搞定吧。她摇了摇头，叹了口气。 [party.has arona |公平地说，拉格斯，正是这个原因让你能够在这里待这么久。如果你对凯尔维斯族没有这么大的用处，阿戈斯早就把你流放了。阿罗娜用拇指指了指小屋里散落的那些武器。归根结底，赫蕾莎对你的喜爱终究无法超越族长的话语权威。 是啊……确实不可否认。那么，新的首领对此是怎么说的呢？ 你还挺有用的，破布。再说，如果我把你流放了，就再也不能每天取笑你这个可怜的家伙了，那可太可惜了。 我不知道这样是比流放更好还是更糟。 阿罗娜只是轻声笑了起来。 ] 你知道，她是个非常忙碌的女性，所以你最好避免浪费她的时间。在这里，你能完成些什么呢？ 营业时间是从黎明到黄昏。如果你需要配备相关装备，可以来找我——既然你得到了阿罗娜的青睐，我觉得让你使用我们的东西并没有什么问题。当然，你还是需要支付费用，我可不会免费给你这些东西。 我母亲教导我不要把工作和生活混为一谈，而我现在已经忙得不可开交了，一直在弥补帕沃犯下的错误。所以，如果你想社交的话，晚些时候再来找我吧。 她没有和其他人一起加入战士会所吗？ 并不是因为不想这么做，事情的来龙去脉很复杂。[party.has arona| ——一个阿罗娜非常熟悉的人或事物]没关系，这些年来，我渐渐更喜欢喝加了赫蕾莎的茶了。 茶——这可绝对不是人们通常会与兽人联系在一起的东西。 感到惊讶吗？赫蕾莎的东西确实非常厉害。看来我得继续让你们感到惊讶才行了[pc.name]好吧，如果没有其他事情的话，我得回去工作了。这种事情对我来说从来都不缺。 说完这句话，拉格妮尔德又将她的铁匠面罩拉下来遮住脸，然后重新回到铁砧前。不久之后，她那肌肉结实的双臂又开始忙碌起来，金属碰撞发出的声响在空气中清晰地回荡着。看到谈话已经结束，你转身走出了小屋。 [party.has arona |真是个漂亮的女人，不是吗？当你走到户外时，阿罗娜说道。她身上流淌着腹地人兽人的血液，这一点显而易见。总是为这样那样的事情忧心忡忡——我们的那些大陆同胞就是以爱操心而闻名的。不过，跟他们在一起确实挺有趣的。 从种种情况来看，她和赫蕾莎相处得相当融洽。 阿罗娜低下头，揉了揉下巴。他们当然会这么想。作为先知，我妹妹的责任就是为整个凯尔维斯族着想，这样我们就不必操心这些事了。阿戈斯对她反感，并不完全是他的错——如果拉格斯不要那么傲慢无礼，人们会更喜欢她的。不过，这一切都不会有什么改变。在她真正收下一个学徒之前，我们还是得继续忍受她的存在。她既不喝酒，也不打架，还讨厌我们拥有奴隶，说这会让我们变得软弱无力。真是无聊至极。 也许她只是需要有人主动与她联系而已。毕竟，拉格妮尔德的愿望显然与普通的兽人不同。 没错，而那个人肯定不会是我。我宁愿撞墙也不愿陪她去听她和赫蕾莎的谈话。 ] 嗯，虽然你目前还没有掌握全部情况，但你已经开始了解拉格妮尔德与凯尔维斯部落其他成员之间的关系了。当然，你并不会因此得罪阿罗娜……但作为一个外人，你已经插手了部落太多事务。再多插手一点，又有什么关系呢？
rows.raw: " Entering the hut, you find that [ flags.PAVO_MET |things have changed considerably since you were last here. For one, Pavo is missing, presumably sent back to the slave pens if you remember Arona's words correctly. Secondly, the dark atmosphere the lizan preferred in the hut is gone, light [dayNight|shining in through a large open window|cast upon the hut's interior by a seal-oil lamp]. Thirdly, gone are Pavo's generic works, the plain, standardised armaments removed from the racks and walls and replaced with pieces possessed of a far more orcish character. |Ragnild's made herself at home. Firstly, there's a definite atmosphere to the hut, much like that of the chieftain's pavillion or Hretha's abode; it says something of the person dwelling within it. Secondly, there's plenty of light in a hut that clearly wasn't made for such — [dayNight|the window in the wall looks like someone installed it with a war hammer|the hook the seal-oil lamp's hanging from looks far too sturdy for a simple lamp]. Finally, the pieces on the racks and wall all have a very orcish character to them, one that you've become accustomed to with so long in Arona's company. ] The blacksmith herself is bent over the anvil with her back towards you, hammering a good temper into an orc-sized cleaver. Even with bronze, heating the blade evenly must've been a challenge... as you watch, she plunges the edge into a quenching trough, great clouds of steam rising into the air with an accompanying hiss. "Hello?" Ragnild pauses for a moment, and sets the sword blank down on a nearby bench. When she turns to face you, instead of the orcish face you were expecting, there's a heavy bronze mask shaped like a sabertooth cat in its place, fangs bared and looking as if it's ready to pounce any second. The suddenness of it all — before you know what you're doing, your instincts have already prodded your body into taking a step back. [pc.isDK|It's only when your mind catches up that you curse yourself for showing weakness, consciously or not.] [party.has arona |Arona laughs and claps you on the shoulder. "Don't worry, [pc.name]. The forge-mask gets most people the first time they see it — I know it did for me, and that's saying something. Still, it's prettier than her actual face on a bad day." Ragnild hooks a thumb under the mask's chin and pushes upwards, revealing a very orcish scowl adorning her face. "And what brings our great chieftain here? Surely not to follow in her brother's footsteps?" "Nah, nothing like that. I'm just showing [pc.name] around, that's all. Argoth was a bastard when it came to you, I'll agree, but I'll be damned if I'm going to give up on a little light-hearted teasing." "Hmph." |"Sorry about that." Ragnild's voice is slightly muffled under the bronze mask, but she hooks a thumb under its chin and pushes upwards, revealing a rather sheepish smile. There's a moment of awkward silence, and then she steps forward, reaching [pc.heightRange 60 68|out|up|down] to plant her powerful hands on your shoulders. "You all right there?" You were just taken by surprise, that's all. Nothing to worry about. "I forget you're [pc.ra orc|not of our tribe|not an orc]. The forge-mask... yeah, it does that to most people the first time they see it. My father's was that of a boar, and even more hideous and ferocious than mine. Said it reminded him of my mom on a bad day. "C'mon, laugh a little, okay? Show me you're all right?" [pc.isDK|Fine, fine, you'll humor her.|Sheesh, she's that worried about you, huh...?] There, one smile, coming right up. You're not sure if you can manage laughter, though... A chuckle. "Guess that'll have to do. Sorry about that, again." ] So, she seems to be quite busy, huh? "[dayNight|Damned if I am.|What gave it away? The fact that I'm still hammering away while every other lunk in the camp is asleep?] Pavo... look at the mess he's made of things. The lizard had plenty of skill, but that's where it ends. Not that I could've expected a slave to care any more than what would save him a beating, but even so, I'd have expected some pride in what he did. Now I'm the one left holding the bag, and Arona probably expects me to fix everything." She shakes her head, and sighs. [party.has arona |"To be fair, Rags, it's what's kept you around for this long. Argoth would have exiled you long ago if you weren't this damned useful to the Kervus." Arona jerks a thumb at the armaments strewn about the hut. "When it comes down to it, Hretha's soft spot for you wouldn't have outweighed the chieftain's word." "Yeah... can't deny that. And what does the new chieftain say about that?" "You're useful, Rags. Besides, if I exiled you, I wouldn't be able to tease your sorry ass every day, and that'd be a shame." "I don't know if that's better or worse than exile." Arona just snickers. ] So, you know she's a busy woman and all and thus you'll avoid wasting her time. What can you get done here? "Opening hours are from dawn to dusk. See me if you want to get outfitted — given how you're in Arona's good graces, I don't see a problem in letting you share in our stuff. You'll still have to pay, of course, I'm not letting you have it for free. "My mother taught me not to mix business and pleasure and I'm backlogged enough as it is fixing the mistakes Pavo made, so come along in the evenings if you want to be social." She doesn't join the others in the warrior's lodge? "Not for lack of wanting to. It's a long story[party.has arona| — one that Arona there's well acquainted with]. It's all right, I've grown to prefer tea with Hretha over the years, anyway." Tea — now that's not something commonly associated with orcs. "Surprised? Hretha's stuff is pretty amazing. I guess I'll just have to keep on surprising you then, [pc.name]. Well, if there's nothing else, I've got to get back to work. Never any shortage of that." With that, Ragnild pulls her forge-mask back down over her face and turns back to the anvil; it's not long before her muscle-bound arms are at work once more, the ringing of metal clear in the air. Seeing the conversation's at an end, you turn and step out of the hut. [party.has arona |"Nice woman, isn't she?" Arona says as you emerge into open air. "She's got heartlander orc blood in her, and it shows. Constantly worrying about this and that — that's what our mainlander cousins are known for. Worrying. Sure is a lot of fun to be around." By the sound of things, she gets along pretty well with Hretha. Arona dips her head and rubs her chin. "Of course they would. It's my sister's job as oracle to worry for the entire Kervus so we don't have to. Argoth's dislike for her wasn't all on him, either — people would like Rags more if she just wasn't such a stuck-up prick. Doesn't change anything, though. until she takes an actual apprentice, we're stuck with her. Won't drink. Won't fight. Doesn't like us keeping slaves, says it makes us weak. Bo-ring." Maybe she just needs someone to reach out to her. Ragnild clearly has different wants from the average orc, after all. "Yeah, and that someone isn't going to be me. I'd rather beat my head against a stone wall than try and sit through one of her conversations with Hretha." ] Well. While you certainly don't have the whole picture yet, you're beginning to get a feel for the situation between Ragnild and the rest of the Kervus. Not that you're about to step on Arona's toes... but you've already meddled so much in the tribe's affairs as an outsider. What's a little more?"

rows.original: [party.comp arona brint cait berwyn |[rand |As you make for the private chambers in the back of the hut, Arona steps away and towards the exit. "Uh, don't mind me. Go and drop in on Rags if you want, but I think I'm going to head to the lodge for some actual fun. Listening to her talk my ear off isn't how I want to spend my evening, thanks." |As you head for the back of the hut, Arona coughs not-quite-discreetly and half-turns, clearly intending to leave. "Yeah, burn your evening with Rags if you want, [pc.name], but that isn't my idea of fun. I'm going to get a couple of drinks down at the lodge — gods know I could use them." ] Before you can protest, Arona's already out the door, disappearing into the darkness of the warcamp. Well, if she doesn't want to stick around, you're not going to force her. | "Well, if you're going to have a little private time of your own, I can certainly leave you alone. The orcs are my kind of guys anyways when we're not fighting each other. I can see us getting along well. Call it a diplomatic mission as an unofficial representative of Khor'minos." Or in other words, he's going to the lodge and getting himself utterly smashed. "That's right." Would he want to come in with you? Even if things don't escalate, there's always the comforts of spending time with a large, stable woman. Brint laughs at that. "No thanks. That air she gives off... she's like some of the weird girls back home who'll only spread their legs for a single stud. Having me around would just kill your chances. That, and she reminds me a little too much of some girls I once knew. I'll pass, thanks." All right, if he says so. You watch as Brint clomps away into the camp, turning around a tent and vanishing from sight. | "All right then," Cait says with a wink. "You best get to it, [pc.name]. I'll be praying to Mallach for your success!" Wait, she isn't coming in with you? And what did she mean by praying for your success? "Ah, there's no need to be bashful about it. I'll be at the lodge spreading the good word should you need me, okay?" With that, Cait goes skipping off, tail and ass swishing about behind her. Really now, she knows what she's doing in a camp full of rutting orcs... and it'd totally be like the pink kitten to be looking forward to it. | "If you're going to be here awhile, mind if I have plans of my own?" Berwyn pipes up. Sure, if that's his thing. Where do you come calling when it's time to go? "Well, there's this nice shaman-type orc guy I came across some time ago while wandering the hills. Asked me if I wanted to share a smoke... I couldn't quite say yes back then, but he said if I ever ended up in the camp a cute boy like me with —" Ah, of course, say no more. You give Berwyn a pat on the butt and watch him scamper out of sight. How adorable. ] As you step towards the private chambers in rear, you pause. [rand |Unless you're sorely mistaken, you can hear singing coming from the back — and it's not the usual raunchy, bawdy, roaring orc singing that you've grown accustomed to hearing every time you pass by the warrior's lodge. Interesting. |There's definitely the sound of running water coming from the back... best not to question it too deeply. |There's a certain something or the other in the air, and it's not the soot of the forge nor the tang of metal. Smells almost like... perfume, or at least, what someone who'd never had any would imagine it'd smell like. ] Stepping up to the door to Ragnild's private quarters, you give it three solid knocks and are soon rewarded with the orc smith's face, all freshly cleaned up after a day at the forge. "Ah, [pc.name]. Nice of you to drop by — I was [rand|thinking of heading to Hretha's, but some oracle business came up and she had to say no|just about to start with dinner|just getting cleaned up| thinking of turning in early; good thing you caught me just in time]. It's nice to have some company on a cold night." If she doesn't mind you dropping in... "Oh no, not at all. Please, come on in.[party.has arona| Arona's not with you?" She said she had something else to do. "Figures. I don't need her to like me, I just need her to tolerate me and my unfun ways, which is more than what her brother gave me.] Do have a seat by the fire and make yourself comfortable." You do just that. Whether Rags shipped over the furred, leather-cushioned chair over from the islands or made it herself here, it's certainly more cozy than you'd have expected from orcs. Like it or not, Ragnild sure is an orc of many surprises. She herself pulls up a chair for herself across the wall and leans in, making herself all comfortable. "So, what's the occasion, [pc.name]?"
rows.translation: [party.comp arona brint cait berwyn |[rand |当你朝着小屋后面的私人房间走去时，阿罗娜却转身朝出口方向走去。呃，别管我。如果你想的话，去看看拉格斯吧，不过我想我还是去小屋里找点真正的乐趣。听她喋喋不休地说话，可不是我想要过的晚上，谢谢。 |当你走向小屋的后部时，阿罗娜轻咳了一声，然后半转身，显然是打算离开。没错，如果你想的话，大可以把晚上的时间都花在玩《拉格斯》上吧。 [pc.name]，但那并不是我心目中的乐趣所在。我打算去小屋喝上几杯酒——天知道我确实需要喝点东西。 ] 你还没来得及抗议，阿罗娜就已经出门了，消失在了军营的黑暗中。唉，如果她不想留在这里，你也强迫不了她。 | 嗯，如果你想有一些属于自己的私人时间，我当然可以不打扰你。反正那些兽人，在我们不互相争斗的时候，也是属于我的同类。我觉得我们相处得会很好的。就当这是我以科尔米诺斯的非官方代表身份执行的一项外交任务吧。 换句话说，他要去小屋里喝得烂醉如泥。 没错。 他会愿意和你一起进来吗？即使事情没有恶化，和一个成熟、稳定的女性在一起，总会有许多舒适的感觉吧。 布林特听到这话笑了起来。不用了，谢谢。她身上散发出的那种气质……她就像家乡那些只会为了某个帅哥才敞开怀抱的女孩。如果我出现在她身边，只会破坏你的机会。而且，她让我想起了一些我曾经认识的女孩。还是算了吧，谢谢。 好吧，如果他是这么说的的话。你就看着布林特摇摇晃晃地走进营地，然后绕过一个帐篷，从视线中消失了。 | 那好吧。凯特眨了眨眼说道。你最好赶紧动手吧。 [pc.name]我会为你的成功向玛拉赫祈祷的！ 等等，她不会和你一起进来吗？还有，她所说的“为你祈祷成功”是什么意思？ 啊，没什么好害羞的。如果你需要我的帮助，我会在小屋里帮忙宣传的，好吗？ 说完，凯特蹦蹦跳跳地跑开了，她的尾巴在身后摇来摇去。说真的，现在她知道自己在一个到处都是那些行为低俗的兽人的营地里该做什么了……而对于她来说，这一切简直就像是一只可爱的粉色小猫正在期待着一些有趣的事情发生一样。 | 如果你要在这里待一段时间，那我有没有自己的安排，你不会介意吧？贝尔温开口说道： “当然，如果那是他喜欢做的事情的话。那么，当该走的时候，你会去哪里呢？ 嗯，前段时间我在山间闲逛的时候，遇到一个很不错的、属于萨满类型的兽人。他问我是否想一起抽根烟……当时我没能立刻答应他，但他说，如果我哪天去了他们的营地，他会像对待我这样的可爱男孩一样…… 啊，当然，不用多说了。你轻轻拍拍贝尔温的屁股，然后看着它蹦蹦跳跳地跑出了视线范围。真是太可爱了。 ] 当你走向后面的私人房间时，你停了下来。 [rand |除非你完全弄错了，否则你应该能听到从后面传来的歌声——而且这绝对不是你每次经过战士小屋时都会听到的那种低俗、粗俗的兽人歌声。真是有趣。 |从后面确实传来了流水声……最好别深入去思考这个问题。 |空气中弥漫着某种特殊的气息，那既不是铁匠炉里冒出的烟尘，也不是金属散发出的刺鼻气味。这种味道几乎就像……香水，或者至少，是那些从未接触过香水的人所想象中的香水味道。 ] 你走到拉格妮尔德的私人居所门前，连续敲了三下门，不久之后，兽人铁匠那张刚在铁匠铺忙碌了一整天后洗得干干净净的脸出现了。 啊， [pc.name]你能来看我，真是太好了——我正打算[rand|本来打算去赫蕾莎家的，但突然有了一些神谕相关的事情需要处理，所以她只好取消了计划。|马上就要开始吃晚餐了。|刚刚被清理完毕| 正打算提前下班呢，还好你及时发现了我。]在寒冷的夜晚，有朋友陪伴在身边真是太好了。 如果她不介意你顺便拜访的话…… 哦不，绝对不是这样。请进吧。[party.has arona| 阿罗娜不在你身边吗？ 她说她还有其他事情要做。 果然如此。我并不需要她喜欢我，只需要她能容忍我以及我那些无趣的习惯罢了——这已经比她哥哥给我的还要多了。]请在火堆旁找个座位，好好休息吧。 你就这么做了。不管拉格斯是坐着那些毛皮覆盖、皮革坐垫的椅子从岛屿上过来的，还是自己一路走到了这里，她的居住环境确实比你想象中兽人应有的样子要舒适得多。不管你喜不喜欢，拉格妮尔德确实是个充满惊喜的兽人。她自己也在墙的对面拉了一把椅子坐下，然后靠过来，让自己坐得非常舒服。 那么，是什么事情让你们召集起来呢，[pc.name]？"

        向下望去，她那宽大的臀部与结实的大腿在她的身体上形成了鲜明的对比——由于她的身材极为魁梧，拉格妮尔德给人的感觉是，她的双腿甚至可以轻易地压碎一个人的头骨，而她自己却丝毫不会察觉。她的整个上半身都覆盖着一条长而厚实的皮围裙，而她的双手也戴着及肘长的厚皮手套，以此来保护自己免受铁匠炉火的热伤害。即便如此，她的上臂上还是留有一些烧伤的疤痕，这些疤痕都是她在跟随父亲学习这门手艺时，年轻时犯下的一些小错误留下的痕迹。厚底鞋能够保护她的双脚，避免它们在不经意间碰到地面上的尖锐物体而受伤。
        
        拉格妮尔德的作品中，最核心的部分是一具风格化的青铜面具，它的造型模仿了一只凶猛的剑齿虎——嘴巴大张，露出狰狞的笑容，眼睛则由深色玻璃制成。这具面具原本是为了在她工作时保护她免受熔炉散发的高温和强光的伤害，但制作过程中投入的精力和细节实在太多，以至于它看起来更像是一件仪式用品，而非实用工具。不过，以她的性格，如果这件东西没有任何实际用途，她是绝对不会在工作时穿戴它的。
        
        总的来说，拉格妮尔德是一个典型的、勤奋务实的兽人女性典范。她不像阿罗娜那样适合战场，也不像她的朋友赫蕾莎那样性感神秘。相反，她才是那个默默无闻却不可或缺的支柱，正是她维持着兽人社会的运转——尽管这个社会本身就已经岌岌可危了。

rows.original: [rand |How's things been doing now that Arona's in charge? "I wouldn't know personally, considering I just got here when she booted her brother out the gates, but judging by the way Argoth was when we were back on the islands, better. She knows how to stay out of Hretha's way and let her do her job instead of trying to have a finger in every pork pie." Oh, really? So it's Hretha who's the true power behind the throne? "Haha, oh yes. Old Hretha wants the tribe to think that she spends all day performing important divine rituals and stuff, praying for the gods' favor in battle and all that comes with being the oracle. What actually happens is that she spends a lot of time dealing with the minutia of actually running the tribe while her dumb bull of a brother, and now sister, goes around bashing people over the head for fun and profit. "Now, not to speak ill of our glorious chieftain, but do you really see Arona being the kind to be counting sacks of potatoes in the tents? Neither is Hretha, she makes Infrith do the counting and she does the tallying." Ragnild laughs at her own joke a little too cheerily. All right, you get the point. There's plenty to running a warcamp that neither the eldest or youngest of the Kervus siblings are interested in. "No, that's not right. Argoth's problem was that he did take an interest. It wouldn't have been so bad had he been competent at it, but he wasn't, and add that to his cronies pinching a little here and slipping a little there, it drove Hretha to her wits' end. If you want to make her job easier, best thing you can do for us is keep Arona away from the camp and focused on all kinds of glorious conquests as is befitting an orcish chieftain." Hah. That much you can do, at least. |How's she finding life in the Marches, as opposed to the islands? Rags chuckles, making a show of rubbing her forearms. "The air's a lot cooler and dryer, that's for one. It makes things a lot more comfortable for a sweaty woman at work, I can tell you as much. On the other hand, I'm starting to miss having shrimp and fish that aren't dried and salted. "Don't get me wrong, this is a nice place to visit and be on campaign in. Ask me to spend any more than a handful of years in this place, though, and I'd probably get homesick. Islander orcs are meant to live on islands and sail about in longships, not trudge about mountains like skulking mainlanders[pc.ra orc|, no offense]. Walking everywhere you go, lugging around carts instead of just unloading from the hold — it's an adventure for the younger ones, I'm sure, but the likes of me are too set in their ways for that." |What's her take on how's everyone getting along now? "You asking me?" Why, yes. She's the rare orc who has a good head on her shoulders. "You mean any head on her shoulders, ha. Not that that's necessarily a bad thing. Sometimes the world does need people who're willing to cut to the core of matters. I just wish it weren't always us. "Anyway, little Arona becoming chieftain's given everyone enough excitement to drive off that restlessness that was hanging about the camp like a cloud. Won't last forever, but an orc usually gets to see a change of chief only once in their lifetimes, so it stands to reason it'd be a bit of a buzz. While they're like this, they'll be content to eat and fuck and maybe beat up a few things, but I don't think they'll actually be ginning up to cause actual trouble like they were doing under Argoth." That's a good thing for everyone living in the Marches. "Say what you want about Hretha, she knows how to whip up the rabble into a frenzy. Looting and pillaging is fine and all, but fighting and fucking is what they're really after at heart. Old Hretha's got them running sorties into the forest these days; it helps that the monsters they've encountered are more than willing to fuck once beaten. Sometimes they bring back interesting stuff, but the most important thing is to keep them from getting bored." |How exactly does the camp get fed? With all these mouths living such vigorous lives, you'd expect a warcamp like this to eat a lot. An army moves on its stomach, after all. "Most of it's shipped in from the islands; the land in these hills is simply far too rocky and bare to be of much use when it comes to gleaning and foraging. Sure, some of the slaves have found rabbits and birds and the like, and the harpies leave their eggs all around, but it's not enough to feed all these mouths. Same thing with actually finding anything edible in that forest to the west — the spratlings running sorties wll sometimes bring back stuff, but it's far from sufficient. Besides, that kind of work is slave work; they can't be bothered to be thinking about food. All they have to do is show up at the lodge and stuff their faces; as far as they're concerned, slaves make it appear from thin air. When they want a worn axeblade reforged, they just chuck it over to me. Lumia's tits, some of them even think that I should be sharpening their knives when any idiot can work a whetstone by themselves!" To be fair, worrying about logistics isn't what they were brought here across the waves to do. "Yeah, you're right." Rags sighs and manages to look pouty. "Being that carefree isn't exactly a healthy mindset to cultivate, but point taken. I'm just overly touchy when it comes to some subjects, I guess." |So, how does she feel about this whole %"coming across to the mainland to fight a great evil" thing? Ragnild thinks a moment. "Before I landed with the longships, I couldn't help but be a bit skeptical. Sure, I've known Hretha since we were spratlings and she's never been outright wrong, but she's misinterpreted her visions quite badly at times. Now, being here and seeing with my own eyes what's been going on in the west... it's hard to deny the gravity of her words. And then of course there's you, who's actually seen this great evil Hretha's spoken of. "I think that for once in my life — and I'd wager a good chunk of the camp feels this way, too — I'm actually fighting for something bigger than just me or even the Kervus as a whole, and it makes me feel inspired. Even if it's just in some small way over the heat of the forge here, I feel like I'm doing something more than just live day to day. It's amazing." That's certainly a noble way to look at it. "Now don't get me wrong, I don't have any illusions. I was right by Hretha's side when she was memorising tales of the Godswar at her grandmother's feet and I know how horrible things got. But at the same time... without adversity to challenge it, you can't have nobility. There's meaning in doing things the hard way, but that doesn't change the face that it's hard. "I... in a way, I'm glad that I'm the one who's standing here now, because better it be me than my daughter. You understand where I'm coming from?" Yes... you think you do. ]

现在，我并不是要贬低我们那位光荣的领袖，但你们真认为阿罗娜会那种在帐篷里数土豆袋子的人吗？赫蕾莎也不是这样的，她因弗丽丝他负责计数，而她则负责核对数字。拉格妮尔德为自己的玩笑笑得有点太开心了。 好吧，你明白我的意思了。管理一个军营确实需要做很多事情，但凯尔维斯家的兄弟姐妹中，无论是老大还是老小，都没有人对这些事情感兴趣。 拉格轻笑了一声，然后故作夸张地揉了揉前臂。首先，这里的空气要凉爽得多，也干燥得多。对于像我这样在工作中会出汗的女性来说，这样的环境确实让生活更加舒适。不过，另一方面，我开始怀念那些没有经过腌制处理的虾和鱼了。 别误会，这里确实是个非常适合游览和开展活动的地方。但要是让我在这个地方待上几年以上，我恐怕会开始思乡的。岛民兽人本来就应该生活在岛上，驾驶长船在海上航行，而不是像那些躲在大陆上的家伙一样在山间跋涉。[pc.ra orc|没有冒犯的意思。]无论走到哪里，都得拖着那些购物车，而不仅仅是把东西从储物空间里取出来而已——对于那些年纪较小的孩子来说，这肯定是一场充满乐趣的冒险，但像我这样的老家伙，已经习惯了原来的生活方式，根本无法适应这种改变了。 |她对于大家现在的相处方式有什么看法呢？ 你是在问我吗？ 没错，她就是那种为数不多的头脑冷静的兽人。 你是说任何她有着清醒的头脑，哈。不过，这也不一定是件坏事。有时候，这样的头脑反而能让一个人更好地面对这个世界。我确实需要那些愿意直击问题核心的人。我只是希望，这些人不总是我们自己。 你想怎么评价赫蕾莎都行，但她确实懂得如何煽动那些暴民，让他们陷入疯狂。抢劫掠夺当然也不错，但他们真正想要的其实是战斗和性行为。这些天，老赫蕾莎总是带着他们进入森林；幸运的是，他们遇到的那些怪物在被击败后也非常愿意与他们发生性关系。有时候他们还会带回一些有趣的东西，但最重要的是，这样才能防止那些暴民感到无聊。 |这个营地究竟是如何获得食物的呢？考虑到有这么多人在这里生活，消耗量肯定很大。毕竟，军队就是靠粮食来维持行动的。 这些物资大部分都是从那些岛屿运过来的；这些山丘上的土地实在太崎岖且贫瘠了，根本无法用来种植作物或采集食物。当然，有些奴隶确实抓到了兔子和鸟之类的动物，那些鹰身女妖也会在周围留下它们的蛋，但这些远远不够养活所有人。同样，在西边的那片森林里也很难找到可食用的东西——那些负责搜寻的奴隶有时会带回一些东西，但远远不够需求。此外，这种搜寻工作本身也非常奴隶他们根本没心思去考虑食物问题；他们只需要出现在小屋里，然后大吃特吃就行了。在他们看来，奴隶似乎就是凭空变出食物的。当他们需要把磨钝的斧头重新磨利时，就直接把斧头扔给我。有些家伙甚至认为，我应该帮他们磨刀，可其实任何傻瓜都能自己用磨石把刀磨利啊！ 公平地说，他们远渡重洋来到这里，并不是为了操心这些后勤问题。 是的，你说得对。拉格叹了口气，还真摆出了一副生闷气的样子。成为那个无忧无虑的确不是一种值得培养的健康心态，不过你说的也有道理。我想，只是在某些话题上，我确实会变得过于敏感罢了。 |那么，她对于这种“前往大陆去对抗邪恶势力”的事情，究竟有什么感受呢？ 拉格妮尔德思考了一会儿。在乘坐那些长船登陆之前，我确实有些怀疑。当然，我们从小时候就认识赫蕾莎了，她也从不会表现得那么直率错误但她有时候会严重误解自己的幻象。现在，来到这里，亲眼看到西方发生的一切……确实很难否认她所说的话的分量。当然，还有你，你确实亲眼目睹了赫雷莎所提到的那种可怕的邪恶势力。 我想，在我这一生中，有那么一次——而且我敢打赌，营地里的很多人也有同感——我真正在为一些比我自己甚至整个凯尔维斯族更重要的东西而奋斗，这种感觉让我感到充满动力。即使只是在这样激烈的环境中，以这样的方式生活，我也觉得自己在做些有意义的事情，而不仅仅是在一天天混日子。这真是太棒了。 这种看法确实很高尚。 现在别误会，我没有任何幻想。当赫蕾莎在祖母面前背诵关于神战的故事时，我一直陪伴在她身边，我也知道那些事情究竟有多么可怕。但与此同时……如果没有逆境来考验一个人，就谈不上高尚。通过艰难的方式去完成某件事，其中确实蕴含着意义，但这并不会改变这件事本身的本质。困难。 我……从某种意义上来说，我很庆幸现在站在这里的是我，因为比起我的女儿，由我来面对这个局面反而更好。你明白我的意思吧？ 是的……你以为自己是这样想的。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |How's things been doing now that Arona's in charge? "I wouldn't know personally, considering I just got here when she booted her brother out the gates, but judging by the way Argoth was when we were back on the islands, better. She knows how to stay out of Hretha's way and let her do her job instead of trying to have a finger in every pork pie." Oh, really? So it's Hretha who's the true power behind the throne? "Haha, oh yes. Old Hretha wants the tribe to think that she spends all day performing important divine rituals and stuff, praying for the gods' favor in battle and all that comes with being the oracle. What actually happens is that she spends a lot of time dealing with the minutia of actually running the tribe while her dumb bull of a brother, and now sister, goes around bashing people over the head for fun and profit. "Now, not to speak ill of our glorious chieftain, but do you really see Arona being the kind to be counting sacks of potatoes in the tents? Neither is Hretha, she makes Infrith do the counting and she does the tallying." Ragnild laughs at her own joke a little too cheerily. All right, you get the point. There's plenty to running a warcamp that neither the eldest or youngest of the Kervus siblings are interested in. "No, that's not right. Argoth's problem was that he did take an interest. It wouldn't have been so bad had he been competent at it, but he wasn't, and add that to his cronies pinching a little here and slipping a little there, it drove Hretha to her wits' end. If you want to make her job easier, best thing you can do for us is keep Arona away from the camp and focused on all kinds of glorious conquests as is befitting an orcish chieftain." Hah. That much you can do, at least. |How's she finding life in the Marches, as opposed to the islands? Rags chuckles, making a show of rubbing her forearms. "The air's a lot cooler and dryer, that's for one. It makes things a lot more comfortable for a sweaty woman at work, I can tell you as much. On the other hand, I'm starting to miss having shrimp and fish that aren't dried and salted. "Don't get me wrong, this is a nice place to visit and be on campaign in. Ask me to spend any more than a handful of years in this place, though, and I'd probably get homesick. Islander orcs are meant to live on islands and sail about in longships, not trudge about mountains like skulking mainlanders[pc.ra orc|, no offense]. Walking everywhere you go, lugging around carts instead of just unloading from the hold — it's an adventure for the younger ones, I'm sure, but the likes of me are too set in their ways for that." |What's her take on how's everyone getting along now? "You asking me?" Why, yes. She's the rare orc who has a good head on her shoulders. "You mean any head on her shoulders, ha. Not that that's necessarily a bad thing. Sometimes the world does need people who're willing to cut to the core of matters. I just wish it weren't always us. "Anyway, little Arona becoming chieftain's given everyone enough excitement to drive off that restlessness that was hanging about the camp like a cloud. Won't last forever, but an orc usually gets to see a change of chief only once in their lifetimes, so it stands to reason it'd be a bit of a buzz. While they're like this, they'll be content to eat and fuck and maybe beat up a few things, but I don't think they'll actually be ginning up to cause actual trouble like they were doing under Argoth." That's a good thing for everyone living in the Marches. "Say what you want about Hretha, she knows how to whip up the rabble into a frenzy. Looting and pillaging is fine and all, but fighting and fucking is what they're really after at heart. Old Hretha's got them running sorties into the forest these days; it helps that the monsters they've encountered are more than willing to fuck once beaten. Sometimes they bring back interesting stuff, but the most important thing is to keep them from getting bored." |How exactly does the camp get fed? With all these mouths living such vigorous lives, you'd expect a warcamp like this to eat a lot. An army moves on its stomach, after all. "Most of it's shipped in from the islands; the land in these hills is simply far too rocky and bare to be of much use when it comes to gleaning and foraging. Sure, some of the slaves have found rabbits and birds and the like, and the harpies leave their eggs all around, but it's not enough to feed all these mouths. Same thing with actually finding anything edible in that forest to the west — the spratlings running sorties wll sometimes bring back stuff, but it's far from sufficient. Besides, that kind of work is slave work; they can't be bothered to be thinking about food. All they have to do is show up at the lodge and stuff their faces; as far as they're concerned, slaves make it appear from thin air. When they want a worn axeblade reforged, they just chuck it over to me. Lumia's tits, some of them even think that I should be sharpening their knives when any idiot can work a whetstone by themselves!" To be fair, worrying about logistics isn't what they were brought here across the waves to do. "Yeah, you're right." Rags sighs and manages to look pouty. "Being that carefree isn't exactly a healthy mindset to cultivate, but point taken. I'm just overly touchy when it comes to some subjects, I guess." |So, how does she feel about this whole %"coming across to the mainland to fight a great evil" thing? Ragnild thinks a moment. "Before I landed with the longships, I couldn't help but be a bit skeptical. Sure, I've known Hretha since we were spratlings and she's never been outright wrong, but she's misinterpreted her visions quite badly at times. Now, being here and seeing with my own eyes what's been going on in the west... it's hard to deny the gravity of her words. And then of course there's you, who's actually seen this great evil Hretha's spoken of. "I think that for once in my life — and I'd wager a good chunk of the camp feels this way, too — I'm actually fighting for something bigger than just me or even the Kervus as a whole, and it makes me feel inspired. Even if it's just in some small way over the heat of the forge here, I feel like I'm doing something more than just live day to day. It's amazing." That's certainly a noble way to look at it. "Now don't get me wrong, I don't have any illusions. I was right by Hretha's side when she was memorising tales of the Godswar at her grandmother's feet and I know how horrible things got. But at the same time... without adversity to challenge it, you can't have nobility. There's meaning in doing things the hard way, but that doesn't change the face that it's hard. "I... in a way, I'm glad that I'm the one who's standing here now, because better it be me than my daughter. You understand where I'm coming from?" Yes... you think you do. ]"

rows.original: Make small talk about daily life.
rows.translation: 聊聊日常生活中的琐事吧。

rows.original: [rand |"My forge-mask, you say? I'm pretty damn proud of it. It's supposed to be the greatest test of your skills, everything you've learned up to that point — and not just a challenge of technical skill. You can cast the best knives in the world, and it won't help you in making a forge-mask if you don't have a sense of beauty, of wonder." That's... selling it a little hard. "Oh, I damn well am. But think about it. Can you see the likes of Pavo casting anything like it? Or even bothering to in the first place? He's a slave, he wouldn't have bothered on such trivialities and focused on churning out enough numbers to keep Argoth happy. And even if Argoth had told him to cast one... he wouldn't have understood what goes into a forge-mask, why certain things are done in certain otherwise roundabout ways, and what it means to its wearer. "Best he'd have been able to do is copy one as best as he could, and call it a day knowing full well that no two forge-masks are supposed to be the same. Even then, it wouldn't have any soul to it. It's a fundamentally different way of seeing things, and it really shows in what you wind up creating." Hmm... there's a thread of thought there that should be explored further. "You should come hear some of the conversations I have with Hretha sometime. Maybe even join in. Not that I'm ribbing beating someone over the head — that's the best solution plenty of the time — but I think the tribe could benefit if more of them just sat down and listened to the seeress talk more than they do right now." |"I haven't had the chance to work with actual copper or tin ore in a good while now," Rags laments. "Sure, smelting isn't something that you ever forget how to do once you learn it, but at the same time one ought to keep in practice. That applies to practically everything you might ever learn." You don't know about that. For some reason, the various odds and ends, tricks and cantrips you've picked up in the course of this crazy journey... they're still pretty fresh in your mind. "If you're right, you're one lucky bastard. Chances are, though, that you're just thinking that way. No offense, of course, but as my dad said, you use it, or you lose it. Spend enough time lying around and your muscles go to shit. Maybe that's why you're just fine; it's not as if you've been faffing about all day and letting your skills go to seed, right?" Well, when she puts it that way, Kasyrra is still out there and presumably causing all sorts of trouble... "Yeah, it's just easy to let your enemies do the work for you, melt down the spoils the warriors bring in and rework those. Lumia's tits, I'll even admit it's the smart thing to do when you're hard-pressed for hands, time or resources. But when it gets down to it... ore might be heavy, ugly and there can be a lot of slag, but it's good to remember there's more than one way of doing things." |She get much respect in her position? Rags chuckles. "If not for it, Argoth would've booted me out a long time ago. I remember the day he took Pavo on one of his coastal raids — he was so happy, thinking he could finally be rid of me, a stupid bitch who kept on undermining his authority and ruffling his goons' feathers. Guess that didn't work out the way he imagined the way it would, eh?" No, you suppose not. "I like my job, [pc.name]; you could even say I was born to it. You get to use your head, you get to use your muscles, you get to see the things you've created, and folks have to acknowledge what you do no matter how they feel about you. It's very satisfying." Now that's something. Not many people can say that about what they do for a living. Even if they start out fine, familiarity breeds contempt and all that. "It's how you look at it. Everything... well, almost everything was worth it in the end. Not that I'm a woman for regrets to begin with." She thumps her chest and laughs. "And given the way things worked out in the end, I may not have come up top of the heap, but I damn well did well by myself anyway." |Make anything special of late? You've seen the work she can do, and to say that it's impressive is an understatement. "No. Now that we've actually got an idea of what we're going up against instead of just sitting around with our thumbs up our asses, Hretha's got me churning out everything from furs and studs to axeblades in short order. I still try to leave a special touch on everything that passes through my fire, but I can't deny that I'm spending a lot less time on each piece than I'd have otherwise liked." You've seen her recent wares, though. They're still good. "Good is for mass-cast trash that's finished in a couple hours. Good — good enough, that is. You've got to be better than good. An axe should be something your grandmother left you, and even though you've changed the blade and handle over and over again, yes, it is the same axe." Rags gives you a small, rueful smile. "Sorry for going off like that. It's... just important to me, you know? I feel like I'm cutting short not just the tribe, but myself as well for skiving like this." She's really hard on herself. "I have to be, who else would? What you do when you think no one's looking or will find out... that's when your decisions matter. And worse is... not really being able to do very much about it." ]
rows.translation: [rand |你说的那个锻造面具？我对此可是相当自豪的。它本应是你技能的最高考验，检验你迄今为止所学的一切——而不仅仅是对技术能力的测试。即使你能打造出世界上最精美的刀具，但如果缺乏对美的感知、缺乏那份敬畏之心，你也无法制作出那个锻造面具。 这有点…言过其实了。 哦，我当然是这么认为的。但你想想看，像帕沃这样的人，会花心思去制作这样的东西吗？甚至会首先考虑这个吗？他不过是个奴隶，根本不会把时间浪费在这种琐事上，他的目标只会是完成足够多的任务，让阿戈斯满意。就算阿戈斯命令他制作一个……他也不会明白一个锻造面具究竟需要哪些材料，为什么某些步骤要采取那些看似迂回的方式，以及它对佩戴者来说意味着什么。 他最多也就是尽力去复制其中一个，然后就此罢休，因为他心里很清楚，没有任何两个锻造面具应该是完全相同的。即便如此，那样做的结果也不会有任何不同。灵魂这就是关键所在。这是一种完全不同的看待事物的方式，而这种差异确实会体现在你最终创造出来的作品中。 嗯……其中有一个思路值得进一步探讨。 你应该找个时间来听听我与赫蕾莎的对话。或许还可以参与其中。我并不是在开玩笑，也不是在批评别人——很多时候，严厉责备确实是最好的解决办法——但我认为，如果部落里更多的人能坐下来，多听一听这位女先知的话，对他们来说肯定会有好处。 |已经有好一阵子没有机会真正接触铜矿或锡矿了。破布在哀叹。当然，一旦学会了炼铁技术，就永远不会忘记如何操作，但同时也需要不断练习。这一点其实适用于你所学的几乎所有技能。 你可能并不了解这一点。不知为何，在这段疯狂的旅程中，你所学到的那些五花八门的技巧和窍门……至今仍然清晰地记在你的脑海里。 如果你说的是对的，那你可真是个幸运的家伙。不过，很可能你只是这么认为而已。当然，没有冒犯的意思，但就像我爸爸说的：不使用它，就会失去它。如果整天无所事事，你的肌肉就会变得松弛无力。也许这就是你现在还能保持状态的原因吧——毕竟你并没有整天闲逛，让自己的技能逐渐退化，对吧？ 嗯，既然她这么说了，那么卡希拉应该还在外面，而且很可能会惹出各种麻烦来…… 没错，让敌人来替你完成这些工作确实很方便——他们可以拆解战士们带回的战利品，然后重新加工利用。说实话，当人手、时间或资源都十分紧张的时候，这样做确实也是明智的选择。但归根结底……矿石虽然可能很沉重、外观难看，而且其中还可能含有很多杂质，但我们必须记住：做事的方法其实并不只有一种。 |她在自己的职位上获得了很多尊重吗？ 拉格斯轻笑了一声。要不是因为这件事，阿戈斯早就把我赶走了。我还记得那天他带着帕沃去进行沿海袭击的时候——他当时高兴极了，以为终于可以摆脱我这个不断破坏他的权威、惹恼他那些手下的人了。不过，事情的发展显然并不像他想象的那样，对吧？ 不，你大概不会这么认为吧。 我喜欢我的工作， [pc.name]；你可以说，我生来就是为了做这个的。你需要动脑筋，需要运用体力，还需要看到自己创造的东西，而无论人们对你的看法如何，他们都不得不承认你的成就。这种感觉真的很令人满足。 这可真是了不起。很少有人能对自己的工作说出这样的评价。即使一开始一切都很顺利，但久而久之，熟悉也会带来轻视之类的情绪。 这取决于你如何看待它。一切……嗯，几乎最终，一切都是值得的。反正我本来就不是那种会后悔的人。她捶着胸膛大笑起来。考虑到最终的结果，我可能并没有取得最好的成绩，但至少我确实为自己争取到了不错的结果。 |最近有没有什么特别的事情发生呢？你们已经看到了她的能力，说她的表现令人印象深刻，其实还是轻描淡写了。 不。现在我们终于有了一个大致的想法什么我们不能只是无所事事地坐着，而必须采取行动。在赫蕾莎的督促下，我迅速开始制作各种物品，从毛皮和装饰钉到斧头刃，应有尽有。我仍然会尽力在每一件作品中融入自己的风格和心思，但不得不承认，我现在花费在每件作品上的时间确实比以前少了很多。 不过，你应该已经看过她最近推出的作品了。那些作品依然很不错。 好’这种评价，只适合那些几小时就能制作完成的廉价制品。‘好’——也就是还算不错而已。但你必须要做得比‘好’更好。一把斧头，应该是你祖母传给你的东西；即使你反复更换它的刀刃和把手，它依然是那把同样的斧头。拉格露出一个略带遗憾的微笑。很抱歉我刚才那样说话。你知道，这对我来说真的很重要。我觉得如果我这样逃避责任，不仅会伤害到整个部落，也会伤害到我自己。 她对自己实在太苛刻了。 我必须这么做，否则还有谁会去做呢？当你觉得没有人会在意，或者没有人会发现时，你所做的那些决定才真正重要起来。而更糟糕的是……你其实对此无能为力。 ]

"No. Now that we've actually got an idea of what we're going up against instead of just sitting around with our thumbs up our asses, Hretha's got me churning out everything from furs and studs to axeblades in short order. I still try to leave a special touch on everything that passes through my fire, but I can't deny that I'm spending a lot less time on each piece than I'd have otherwise liked." You've seen her recent wares, though. They're still good. "Good is for mass-cast trash that's finished in a couple hours. Good — good enough, that is. You've got to be better than good. An axe should be something your grandmother left you, and even though you've changed the blade and handle over and over again, yes, it is the same axe." Rags gives you a small, rueful smile. "Sorry for going off like that. It's... just important to me, you know? I feel like I'm cutting short not just the tribe, but myself as well for skiving like this." She's really hard on herself. "I have to be, who else would? What you do when you think no one's looking or will find out... that's when your decisions matter. And worse is... not really being able to do very much about it." ]"

rows.original: Ask her about herself and her role in the Kervus tribe.
rows.translation: 问问她关于她自己以及她在克尔维斯部落中所扮演的角色。
rows.raw: "Ask her about herself and her role in the Kervus tribe."

rows.original: [rags.numKids 1 |[rand |"I'll admit, I wonder how my parents are doing now that I've sent them the grandkids they want so much," Ragnild says with a wistful smile. "There's going to be a lot to say when I finally make it back home." Looks like some things never change across cultures. "Hah! Seriously, though. Every time Argoth left to go raiding or whatever, they'd always try to get me to have a fling here and there with some hopefully daring young orcish man who was either brave, foolhardy or stupid enough to not be bothered with the chieftain's unspoken word that I should be left untouched. 'Just once', they'd say. 'We'll set you up, and you won't even have to take care of the spratling yourself. We'll do it for you.' Well, guess it happened all right. Hope they're happy now." |"Now that I've had a kid — your kid, I'm really hoping whatever campaign Arona and Hretha have us on is going to wind up sooner rather than later. Given all the things my mother did for me when I was tiny, I can't honestly say that I'm a mother despite me having given birth. There's a difference between the two, and that's one of the things that she taught me." ... Ragnild looks at your musing, melancholic expression and gives you a rueful smile. "It's... it's just the way things are. She was a brown-skinned heartlander orc, and usually spratlings from those clans expect to call the women who gave birth to them 'mother.' Most of the Kervus... they say 'grandmother' in the same fashion, with the same meaning. It's one of the things that never quite sat right with me as a child, and I count myself lucky that as a sort of — well, she wasn't exactly a slave, but no one was expecting her to wield a weapon and go raiding with them. It made my upbringing different, and in a good way, even if it alienated me from most of the other children. I guess that's what I inherited from her, isn't it? I can't just drop a kid and then go back to fighting on the front lines as if nothing ever happened; I want to be with the spratling. And that's eating me up inside... "And that's why while I know I shouldn't be saying such things, I still hope that this great battle Hretha foresaw is going to happen before things stretch out too long, for everyone's sakes. Arona replacing her brother as chieftain may have bought some time, but the Kervus are going to eventually grow restless again." |"I wonder what my mother would say if she saw you, the father of my spratlings," Ragnild says with a small smile, looking you up and down. "I daresay she'd find you not bad, but then I'm not exactly impartial myself." You daresay that you're not bad and certainly able to measure up to whatever Rags' parents can throw at you. She laughs at that, a whole-hearted roar with her head thrown back; it takes several knee-slapping moments for Rags to finally calm down enough to speak again, wiping tears of mirth from her eyes. "Yes. Yes, I imagine you would. When this is all over... given how good you're in with Arona, I don't doubt that you'd have no problems coming up for a visit if you felt like it." Yeah, that makes sense. Whatever animosity they might have towards [pc.ra orc |orcs from other clans |non-orcs ] would probably be moot given how big of a part you played in installing the current chieftain. Who knows, you might even be regarded as some sort of hero! |"My mother was pretty young when she got picked up by the Kervus, so she's still got plenty of years ahead of her despite my age. Well, plenty of years by orc standards, anyway. At this rate, she'll probably end up living to see great-grandchildren!" Ha! "With the way Kervus live, even those who make it past their fighting years still have old scars and wounds hound them to their dying days. Back in the islands, a lot of Hretha's time was spent tending to those. Making it to that age is something even island orcs can respect, even for an outsider like her. She may not have joined them in any of their raids, but the instinct to respect the older members of the tribe is strong." |"If you think my cooking is good, just wait till you get to see what my mother's capable of whipping up. At the very least, we won't have to use seafood that's been dried and dragged in all the way from the coast, ha!" It just sounds like she's really enthusiastic about introducing you to her mother. "Don't get me wrong, it's not something that'll be happening anytime soon, not with how slowly the Kervus are moving despite Arona taking over as chieftain. But I'm sure she'll approve of the fact that at least I know who the father of my spratlings is as opposed to some encounter in the lodge that I don't even remember, which is how it happens most of the time." ] |[rand |So, she's spoken of having parents... "Yeah. They're still around, not dead or anything, but they're just old. Wouldn't make sense for any of them to come all the way across the sea set foot in a warcamp like this. Dad and mom are still back on the islands where they'll be safe, and after a whole damn lifetime of serving the tribe I think they've damn well earned what few years they've left. "It's odd, you know. Unless you've some special position like storyteller or oracle, islander orcs don't really know what to do with those of us who manage to live long enough to get old. Between all the fighting and drinking and stupidity, far too many of us manage to get ourselves killed before our bodies can start wearing out from overuse. I guess it balances out how quickly we tend to breed, eh?" That's a particularly somber way to look at it. "It's what it is. Neither dad nor mom are letting themselves go in their old age, though. Last I saw of them before I got on the longship, mom had convinced dad to try his hand at fish farming. Pen off little coves on the island with nets and the like and raise fish in them. Hope they'll be doing fine when I get back — even with us knowing why we're here now, it just makes me uneasy not knowing how long I'll have to be gone." |Does she have any siblings? "No, although it wasn't for lack of my parents trying," comes the reply. "See, in this part of the world in general, you've got the islander orcs, you've got mainlander orcs, and then you've got the heartlander orcs. My dad was the former, my mom was a war bride taken from the latter, and it's a bit harder for breedings to take between tribes with such great differences between them. Even so, they must've been really unlucky — I was the only kid they managed to have. Mom miscarried a few times despite the best efforts of Hretha's mother. It's kind of a sad story." It is. Was she ever lonely growing up? "Not as much as I could've been. Hretha's been very kind to me, even if her siblings were indifferent at best. Then there's Infrith... eh. That's all water under the bridge now. I lived through it, and it's only made me stronger. You need a good fire to cast bronze well, after all." |Hmm, you've noticed something... "Yes?" Most of the Kervus women you've seen have been fairly young warrioresses and amazons, so it stands to reason that they haven't had any chance to have children yet. Hretha's mentioned she's had some back on the islands... and well... "Yeah. Surprising for an orc woman my age, eh?" You hadn't quite expected her to be that forthright about it. A shrug. "It started when Argoth took a dislike to me more; that was more than ten years back now. Told the men to stay away from me — of course, not to my face, but Hretha's got really good hearing to make up for her eyes. We Kervus are a bunch of horny bastards, but the guys feared their young chieftain more than they wanted to fuck a young half-tribe woman. Didn't help that there were always plenty of willing women and slaves for any idiot to get his dick wet on. Why settle for a grumpy old bitch when you can have all kinds of tail across the board?" Now that Argoth's out and Arona's in, any thought of making up for lost time? Ragnild grins wolfishly. "Can't say it didn't pass my mind. I'm not getting any younger, after all. Old habits die hard, though; I'm not seeing most of Argoth's ex-goons lining up to bone me. Maybe there's a greenhorn or two who's curious about trying out an older, stronger woman... I certainly don't see Arona raising any objections." |Does she have any extended family? "You kidding me? Of course I do — some island orc tribes are nothing but one big extended family, and sometimes even the neighboring tribes to boot. You'd imagine that we'd all be inbred louts, but evidently enough people sail all over on longships and take war-brides from mainlander and heartlander clans that it doesn't matter in the long run. "But to answer your question... yeah. None of them are here in the camp, though, they're all back on the islands. And even if they were... I'm a bit of a pariah, so I wouldn't be expecting them to pop round for a visit in any case. "When push comes to shove, though, blood is thicker than water. It's probably thanks to them that I haven't actually been very much more than pushed for most of my life, although several people would've dearly loved to shove me." ] ]
rows.translation: [rags.numKids 1 |[rand |我得承认，现在我把他们梦寐以求的孙子孙女送给了他们，我真的很想知道他们现在过得怎么样。拉格妮尔德带着一丝怅惘的微笑说道。当我终于回到家时，有太多话想要说。 看来有些事情在不同的文化中是永远不会改变的。 哈！说真的，每次阿戈斯出去进行突袭或者别的什么行动时，他们总会试图让我和一些勇敢、鲁莽，或者蠢到根本不把首领‘不准我随便找对象’的禁令当回事的年轻兽人发生点什么。他们总是说：‘就这一次吧，我们会帮你安排一切，你甚至都不用亲自照顾那些孩子，我们会帮你处理的。’嗯，反正最后还是发生了。希望他们现在满意了吧。 |现在我有了孩子—— 你的孩子，我真心希望阿罗娜和赫蕾莎让我们参与的这个活动能尽快结束。想到我母亲在我小时候为我做过的那些事，说实话，尽管我生过孩子，但我并不能真正称自己为“母亲”。这两者之间是有区别的，而这也是她教给我的道理之一。 拉格妮尔德看着你那若有所思、充满忧郁的表情，露出了一丝遗憾的微笑。就是…事情本来就是这样的。她是一个皮肤黝黑的腹地人兽人，而那些部落里的孩子通常都会把生下他们的妇女称为‘母亲’。在克尔维斯部落，人们也会用同样的方式称呼她们为‘祖母’，意思也是一样的。这是我小时候就一直觉得不太对劲的事情之一。我觉得自己很幸运，因为——嗯，她其实算不上奴隶，但也没人期望她能拿起武器和他们一起去执行任务。这让我的成长经历与众不同，而且是以一种积极的方式，尽管这也让我与大多数其他孩子疏远了。我想，这大概就是我从她那里继承的东西吧？我不可能把孩子丢下，然后就回到前线继续战斗，装作什么都没发生过一样；我想要尽自己的一份责任。与一起那些小孩子……这真的让我心里很不好受…… 正因为如此，虽然我知道自己不应该说这些话，但我还是希望，为了大家的利益，赫蕾莎所预见的这场大战能够尽快发生。阿罗娜取代她哥哥成为首领或许为我们争取了一些时间，但凯尔维斯族人最终还是会再次变得不安分的。 |我想知道，如果我的母亲见到你——这些小生命的父亲，她会说什么呢。拉格妮尔德微微一笑，上下打量着你说道。我敢说，她应该会觉得你还不错，不过说实话，我自己也并不是完全客观的。 你大概觉得自己挺不错的，肯定有能力应对拉格的父母所提出的一切要求吧。 她听到这话后哈哈大笑，笑得把头都仰了回去；过了好一会儿，拉格才终于平静下来，能够再次说话了，同时还不停地用拳头拍着自己的膝盖，以缓解笑意。是的，我想你肯定会这么做的。等这一切都结束了……考虑到你和阿罗娜的关系那么好，我毫不怀疑如果你想去的話，去拜访她应该不会有任何问题。 嗯，这确实有道理。无论他们可能对什么怀有敌意[pc.ra orc |其他氏族的兽人 |非兽人 ]考虑到你在推动现任首领的上台过程中发挥了如此重要的作用，这个问题或许已经没有意义了。谁知道呢，你甚至可能会被视作某种英雄呢！ |我母亲被凯尔维斯族带走的时候还很年轻，所以尽管我年纪已经不小了，她面前仍然有很长的岁月可以享受。至少，按照兽人的标准来说是这样。照这个趋势发展，她说不定还能活到看到曾孙辈的时代呢！ 哈！ 以凯尔维斯族人的生活方式来看，即使那些度过了战斗年龄的人，也会带着那些旧伤痕度过余生。在那些岛屿上，赫蕾莎花费了大量时间照顾这些人。能够活到那样的年纪，即便是对像她这样的外来者，岛上的兽人也会心生敬意。虽然她可能从未参加过他们的任何袭击行动，但族人尊重年长成员的这种本能是根深蒂固的。 |如果你觉得我的厨艺已经不错了，那就等着看看我妈妈能做出什么吧。至少，我们不需要使用那些从海边运过来、经过晾晒处理的海鲜了，哈哈！ 听起来她真的很乐意带你去见她的母亲。 别误会，这种事短期内是不会发生的。毕竟，尽管阿罗娜已经成为了族长，但凯尔维斯一族的行动速度依然非常缓慢。不过我敢肯定，她一定会认可这一点：至少我知道自己孩子的父亲是谁，而不会像大多数情况下那样，是在部落里偶然遇到某个男人，却根本不记得他是谁。 ] |[rand |所以，她提到自己有父母…… 是啊，他们还在那儿，并没有死掉或怎么样，只是年纪大了而已。对他们中的任何人来说，大老远地跨海来到这样的战营里，实在没有意义。爸爸妈妈还在那些岛屿上，那里很安全。他们为部落服务了整整一生，我觉得他们完全应该享受剩下的这些岁月。 你知道，这挺奇怪的。除非你拥有像故事讲述者或先知那样的特殊地位，否则岛上的兽人真的不知道该如何对待那些活得足够久、直到衰老的我们。在不断的战斗、饮酒以及各种愚蠢的行为中，太多人会在他们的身体因过度使用而开始衰老之前就丧命了。我想，这大概也是为了平衡我们那种快速繁衍的习性吧，嗯？ 这种看待问题的方式未免过于悲观了。 事情就是这样的。不过，父母在晚年都依然不肯放松对自己要求。在我登上远航船之前，我最后一次见到他们时，妈妈已经说服爸爸尝试搞渔业。在岛上的小海湾里用网之类的工具围出区域，然后在那里养鱼。希望等我回来时，他们一切都会好起来——尽管我们现在都知道自己为什么来到这里，但不知道自己要离开多久，还是让我感到很不安。 |她有兄弟姐妹吗？ 不，并不是因为我的父母没有努力过。回复到来了。你看，在这个地区的各个部落中，有岛上的兽人、大陆上的兽人，还有那些居住在内陆的兽人。我父亲属于前者，而我母亲则是从后者那里被掳来的战争新娘。由于这些部落之间存在巨大的差异，不同部落之间的通婚其实相当困难。即便如此，他们还是运气极差——我是他们唯一的孩子。尽管赫蕾莎的母亲尽了最大努力，我母亲还是多次流产。这确实是一个令人伤感的故事。 确实如此。她在成长过程中，有没有感到过孤独呢？ 并没有达到我本可以成为的样子。赫蕾莎对我非常友善，尽管她的兄弟姐妹们至多也只是漠不关心而已。然后还有因弗里斯……唉，那些都已经成为过去了。我熬过了那些难关，而这些经历反而让我变得更坚强了。毕竟，只有用熊熊烈火才能将青铜铸得完美无缺。 |嗯，你注意到了某些事情…… 是吗？ 你见过的那些凯尔维斯女性，大多都是年纪较轻的战士和女勇士，因此她们自然还没有机会生孩子。赫蕾莎提到过，她在那些岛屿上生过孩子……嗯…… 是啊。对于一个和我同龄的兽人女性来说，这确实挺令人惊讶的，不是吗？ 你完全没有预料到她会如此直率地表达自己的想法。 耸了耸肩。这一切都始于阿戈斯开始越来越讨厌我，那已经是十多年前的事了。他命令手下们远离我——当然，他并没有当面这么说，但赫蕾莎的听力非常好，足以听明白他的意思。我们凯尔维斯族是一群好色的家伙，不过那些人害怕他们的年轻首领，远胜于他们想要和那个年轻的半部落女性发生关系的心情。更糟糕的是，总有大量愿意的女人和其他奴隶等着任何蠢货来满足他们的欲望。既然可以拥有各种各样的人，为什么还要满足于和一个脾气暴躁的老女人在一起呢？ 现在阿戈斯离开了，阿罗娜又回来了，有没有什么打算来弥补失去的时间呢？ 拉格妮尔德露出了狼一般的笑容。这个想法确实在我脑海中闪过。毕竟，我年纪也不小了。不过，老习惯很难改……我看阿戈斯那些以前的手下并没有排队来找我麻烦。也许会有那么一两个新手，对尝试和年纪更大、实力更强的女性相处感到好奇……反正，我可不觉得阿罗娜会反对。 |她还有其他亲戚吗？ 你在开玩笑吧？当然了——有些岛上的兽人部落确实没什么但是我们其实就像一个庞大的大家庭，有时候甚至还会包括邻近的部落。你可能会认为我们都会是近亲繁殖产生的怪人，但实际上，很多人会乘坐长船远行，从内陆部落中娶妻生子，因此从长远来看，这种近亲繁殖的现象其实并没有什么影响。 但为了回答你的问题……是的，他们所有人都不在营地里，他们都回到了岛上。而且就算他们在……我也算是个被排斥的人，所以他们也不会特意来看我的。 不过，到了紧要关头，血缘关系确实比任何东西都重要。或许正因为他们，我这辈子大部分时间都几乎没有真正遇到过什么严重的压力——尽管有很多人其实非常想给我施加压力。 ] ]

嗯，可以说既是也不是。一般来说，在这种时候，一位女战士会找些其他事情来做，以度过最后的几个月，但她也不会放弃训练。至于我，我的身体状况并没有让我成为负担，也没有妨碍我工作，所以我觉得没有理由放慢训练的速度。我知道，其他人，甚至像我母亲所在的部落里的人，可能会有不同的看法，但这就是我们真实的处境。 你并不是在质疑她的选择，但同时……你也很担心她。 一声叹息。我知道，我知道。这确实很奇怪，对吧？当我还是个小女孩的时候，我就常常幻想有这样一个人：他在让我怀孕之后，能真正关心我、悉心照料我；而如今，当这样的一个人真正坐在我面前时，我却[pc.himHer]也就是说，这样做也是可以的。 [pc.heShe]可以放松一点，不要过于担心。 经历会改变一个人；她已经不再是以前的那个女孩了，毕竟，那已经是二十年前的事了，不是吗？ 拉格妮尔德轻轻拍了拍自己那圆鼓鼓的肚子。成为母亲这一经历已经改变了我，而且还会继续改变我，这些变化是我根本无法预见的。这既让人感到害怕，同时又充满兴奋，我确信，没有其他的经历能够让我有这样的感受。 |哇，拉格现在已经发展得相当大了。她还要过多久才能生下孩子呢？ 赫蕾莎说这些事情还不确定，但应该不会太久了。有一半的时间，我真希望自己能赶紧把这件事搞定；而另一半时间，我又在想那些日子都去哪儿了，甚至不希望这一切这么快就结束。 听起来这就像是世界上任何一种事物一样——它既有优点也有缺点。你只需要顺其自然，随着事情的发展来应对即可。 我人生中的故事。拉格妮尔德懒洋洋地笑了笑，然后伸了个懒腰。顺其自然就好。赫蕾莎本来就应该是个先知，为这些事情烦恼实在没有必要。她这是别人的工作，不是我的，哈哈。 ] ]
rows.raw: " [rags.pregStage 1 2 3 |[rand |Now that she's got a little orc growing inside of her, how's she holding up? Feeling ill or anything? "I appreciate the concern, but there's no need to worry about me. Kervus women go on straight fighting and fucking without a care in the world and don't even notice anything until it becomes obvious." She points down at the gentle bump of her belly. "We've got strong bodies, and the warrioress who misses with her axe just because she feels ill all of a sudden for whatever reason is one who doesn't leave a bloodline." You see. She's no warrioress, but Rags' profession does keep her as fit as a fiddle and as powerful as any Kervus raider, even if she hasn't had the training to properly wield her prodigious strength. All right, if she says so, you'll take her word for it. "I'm not like some of those stuck-up idiots who hide wounds and the like — just so they can be sent out again on the next raid — they drop dead because their wound festered for not being properly treated. Hretha's fussing over me all the time, so I'm sure she'll spot anything wrong with me pretty quick." |"I guess my appetite is good, but then again all Kervus have good appetites. It's part of who we are — fight hard, feast hard, fuck hard. Never been better." She flashes you a tusky grin. "I don't know about you, but this is really agreeing with me so far." It's good — you'd hate to have to worry about here while you're out there. She waves off that comment. "Oh, pfff. This is probably one of the safest places in all the warcamp — the cooks probably have a harder time of it than me, ha! Don't worry your silly little head off over me, you go out there and do whatever needs to be done with Arona, okay? Keep her away from us and all." |Her baby bump isn't very big yet; hopefully it's not getting in her way. "Oh, trust me, the thing's going to be massive by the time I'm done with this. Women like Hretha and Infrith tend to be a little chubby around the middle, so they can hide it a bit longer without anyone really noticing, but these?" She jabs herself in the midriff with a laugh, her finger making but the barest of depressions. "It's already pretty obvious, and is going to be even more so down the line. Not like it's going to be getting in my way, anyway — if I can tote an anvil around from place to place, this isn't going to slow me down in the slightest. You just rest easy, okay?" |"Sometimes when I let my mind wander while working the forge, I realize that now more than ever, I've got something — no, someone — to keep myself together for. And that's more important than ever, and makes everything I've ever hoped to do just a bit more real. So... thanks, [pc.name]. I mean it." Looking at Rags, you know those words didn't come easily. "Odd, isn't it? How knowing you're going to be a mother changes your perspective on things quite a lot? I... it's just something to think about, and thinking is what a lot more Kervus could stand to do from time to time." ] |[rand |"I had to adjust my top this morning when I was getting dressed, and noticed some of the menfolk openly ogling my tits when I was at the forge.[party.has arona | | Arona, too, although she'd never admit it, ha. ] I guess being pregnant has its benefits, doesn't it?" Well, you have to admit that there's a certain something or the other about dark, full breasts that clearly look weighty for their size and jiggle all over the place with their milky load... Ragnild chuckles at that. "I'm not going to say that the extra attention is wholly unwelcome, but it does get distracting after a while. Well, I guess that's my problem and not theirs, huh? Maybe I should flaunt my tits in their faces while it lasts... and yours, too." |"Couldn't sleep last night at all; this little guy kept me awake by drumming on me from the inside. Wasn't but a week or two ago that he first started moving inside of me, and now he won't stop. Not that I'm complaining or anything — it just proves that he's a strong one — but well, it does make Hretha worry." Like mother, like kid. "Can't deny that. Strong of will and body, as it turns out. I just hope that the world he's going to be born into will be something worth living in, or as well as an islander orc can..." |"The weight's not a problem, but getting so big sometimes gets in my way. Not that I didn't prepare for it — Hretha went ahead and loosened a bunch of my clothes — but it's still something to get used to every time. Well, it's just another thing to take in stride. I've dealt with so much in my life, what's a little more?" She knows that you're here for her if she needs something. "Some of the younger girls think it a bit weird that I actually know who the father of my spratling is — most Kervus women don't settle down with a man until they're past their fighting, but not breeding prime. Happy, I've also spent so much of my life largely ignoring what most other members of my own tribe think. It shouldn't work that way, but some people are just destined to be thrown in the deep of things, aren't they?" |Gods. Even while pregnant, she looks really great. "I do, don't I? Hretha says the same thing as well. Keeping a strong body is one thing, but you've also got to have a good attitude towards things — that's a big part of it. If you want to look like a grumpy bitch all day like Arona does that's your choice, but when you actually want to be pleasant to other people a good smile and positive nature really go a long way to endearing you to others." That, and seeing her abs slowly disappear under her growing pregnant belly. Rags chuckles. "You like that so much, huh? Imagine how it must be from up here, then. It's crazy and wondrous at the same time, I tell you." ] |[rand |"Oof, I feel so full." She's such a strong girl, having a belly full of baby shouldn't be any kind of problem for her, eh? "Mmmnn. It's got nothing to do with the weight, it's simply the sensation of being so stuffed from within. And I didn't say it was all bad, either." Rags reaches over to smack you on the shoulder. "If anything, it makes me feel good in a calming sort of way, like the steady drum of rain on the roof, or that of the hammer ringing in the air. I could do this forever and not get bored, even if it does make me sleepy and let my mind wander." While on the job, that might be dangerous, but here and now when she's able to relax... "Yeah. It feels really good." Ragnild reaches down to poke her big, ripe belly, and is answered with a kick from within. "Guess the kid inside of me agrees, too." The both of you share a laugh at that. |Gods, she's so big. Rags looks like she swallowed a melon whole, and she's not done yet? "I'm fine; it's not as if I'm made out of glass or anything," Rag replies with a smile, patting her belly. "Hretha says the bigger the better — we don't need any sickly, scrawny spratlings who'll expire before the month is up. Life back on the islands is harsh, even if it's better than here in a warcamp, and we want the next generation of Kervus to have strong bodies. Getting a head start on that is what it's all about." Won't the birth be harder on her, though? "As much as I may disagree with a number of my tribe's practices, the Kervus have never shied away from hardship or even death if it's for a worthy cause. That's one of the things I want to preserve about them and fear they'll lose... and as such, I have to have a stake in my own words, don't I?" That's very true. You're just hoping that nothing happens to her. "[pc.ra orc |You're not from our tribe |You're not an orc ], so I wouldn't expect you to understand, not fully. But don't worry, Hretha will be right by my side if anything happens — you don't have to take all the responsibility on by yourself. That's you're taking responsibility for this situation in the first place is already something remarkable, by our standards..." |She's so big already, and yet she's so active. You take it this is normal for young Kervus women? "Well, yes and no. Generally at this point a warrioress would find something else to do for the last couple of months, but she wouldn't let herself fall out of training, either. On my part, my condition doesn't make me a liability or get in the way of my work, so I see no reason to slow down. I understand that some other peoples or even tribes like my mother's might think differently, but this is who we are." You're not questioning her choices, but at the same time... you're concerned for her. A sigh. "I know, I know. It's strange, isn't it? When I was little more than a girl I'd daydream of someone who'd give a bit more of a damn about me than would be expected after knocking me up, pamper me head and foot, and now that said person's sitting in front of me I'm telling [pc.himHer] that it's fine if [pc.heShe] can let go a little and not worry so much." Experiences change people; it's only expected that she isn't the same girl that she was, what, twenty years ago? Ragnild pats her big, swollen belly. "And being a mother's changed, and is still going to change, me in ways that I can't possibly foresee. It's scary and exciting at the same time, and I'm sure I wouldn't have it any other way." |Wow, Rag's gotten pretty huge at this point. How much longer is it going to be before she's going to have the kid? "Hretha says these things aren't certain, but it can't be too long now. Half the time I'm wishing that I could just pop the spratling and be done already, and the other half I'm wondering where all the time went and don't want it to be over so soon." Sounds like just about anything in the world — it has its good points and bad ones. You've just got to roll with it as things come. "Story of my life." Ragnild smiles and stretches lazily. "Just taking things as they come. Hretha's supposed to be an oracle, worrying about these things is her job, not mine, ha." ] ]"
