"Don't get me wrong. This stuff would fatten us right up if we just sat on our asses all day. Thank the Seven I wasn't here while Argoth had everyone just waiting around — just look at the weight some of the younger ones have put on. It's disgusting." ] Your appraisal of the meal over, the two of you fall silent as you apply yourselves to the food, and you soon find yourselves amongst the remains of the meal. Wow, that sure is a lot of dirty dishes for a meal without cutlery. Ragnild sighs in contentment and pats her belly. "Damn, that was great." Does she need help with the cleaning up? "What? No, you're my guest, and even orcs know how to treat guests right. I'll sort out this mess later, don't you fret about it. Right now, though, all I wanna do is to sit down here and think about how much better that tasted with you around." Oh hey, is she flattering you? "Sucking up? If I wasn't about to do that for Argoth, I'm not about to do it for you, friend. No, just stating what's obvious. Let's just enjoy this moment together, okay?" She took the words right out of your mouth. [rand |"Hope you aren't thinking of getting up to anything else after this," Rags mumbles. "Got a few other things I need to take care of tonight, and I've got to stay focused." Aw... The orcess snickers. "Well, if you want to try any funny business with a woman like me, it's best to do so before you feed her. You'd do well to keep that in mind for next time." Oh, you will. You will. |"It's nice to have someone at the table again," Ragnild says wistfully. "Never thought I'd miss having my folks at the table, but there it is. In between them going and you coming along, mealtimes were awfully empty." They must've been pretty lively affairs, then. "Oh, you bet. We had two big meals a day when I was a spratling — one to get the day started, and another to pay ourselves off for the hard work put in, as mom would say. I preferred dinner — breakfast was a bit too rushed for me, but dad always loved it. Me, the calm energy of everyone getting together after a day's work was the best. "No one talked shop at the dinner table. It was forbidden — if you didn't have a joke, a laugh, or an interesting story to tell, you sat down and shut up while someone else shared theirs. Worries and serious business were for the breakfast table. It wasn't always the end of work — dad would often keep the forge heated and anvil ringing deep into the night — but it was the end of the day." Yeah, you get what she's driving at. "Which is why I'm kinda glad you came along when you did, [pc.name]; you sure can liven up the atmosphere when you put your mind to it. Even if you don't, though, having someone else on the other end of the table is a nice thing in and of itself. At least I don't have to go over to Hretha's all the time any more just to have another face at the end of the dinner table." |So... no drink ever, not even at dinner? Ragnild gives you a small, rueful smile. "You one of those people who get really upset when they have to drink water? Water, that lowliest of drinks? Fit only for slaves and the youngest of children, spratlings who've been weaned but can't take watered-down ale yet?" Well... "Oh, Argoth didn't outright forbid me from getting booze. That would've tipped his hand; it would've been an outrage, even for the lowliest of orcs to be forbidden the simplest of life's pleasures. He just made it as difficult and annoying as he could and waited for me to give up, and it worked. I gave up, and people looked at me weird when didn't drink as much as they did, then stopped altogether. "He thought he was making my life miserable, and he was right. But I should thank him — I grew up with a clear head and a strong will for all his efforts, even if I did resent him until Hretha pointed out the truth of the matter. So no drink for me. You want to call it miserable, I call it disciplined." |"I wonder if anything's going to change now that Argoth's out and Arona's in," Ragnild muses, rubbing her chin. "Probably not. For all their differences they're — were — basically the same deep down inside, which probably explains how things came to this. Two people fighting for the same spot." What does she hope would have changed? A laugh, tinged with a bitter edge. "Oh, my dear [pc.name]. That's not a question fit for after-dinner talk. Would completely ruin the mood, you see. But with Arona going out and seeing more of the world — and the tribe with her, I suppose — I'm hoping that she'll be able to bring more of her experience to bear when this is all over and she settles into the duties of chieftain proper. Get some new perspectives and ideas on how things might be done. "But look at me prattling on. I'll just shut up now." ] A little while passes as the both of you bask in each others' presence, and then Rags stands and starts clearing away the dishes. "Thanks for coming over, [pc.name]. It's been a treat." Oh no, it's your pleasure to share a table with her. "Keep the people you give a shit about close, you hear? Hardest way to learn the value of something is to have it taken away from you. Hard to get it back after that, if ever." She sets down the stack of wooden plates, and walks you to the door. Before you leave, though, Rags turns to you and gives you a big, body-crushing bear hug, letting you feel the flex of her muscles before letting go and booting the door open. "I'll see you around. Don't be a stranger, okay?" [party.has arona | It doesn't take you long to find Arona and join back up with her — she's been having some fun of her own in the lodge, smelling of drink and several budding warriors seeking to curry favor with the new chieftain. Parting her from the carousel takes a little time and convincing, but you eventually manage to peel the half-drunk orcess away and back into the cool air of the orcish warcamp. "So? Have a good time with that sour old bitch? You should've come with me to the lodge instead, I tell you." What Arona probably meant to be a friendly nudge to your side ends up being a winding blow delivered via elbow. She chuckles, then slaps you on the back. "All right, let's be off." ]"

rows.original: [rand |Rags visibly perks up at your suggestion. "Oh?" You don't think it's a bad idea — more heads together would make for better conversation, wouldn't it? A smile. "Well, I can't say I'm not tempted. Just going back and forth between the two of us can get old after years of such, after all. Infrith is enthusiastic, but too inexperienced to be able to add much to the conversation, and Vaush is often just stoned out of his head whenever he shows up at Hretha's. "All right, let's go before I second-guess myself." |Rags considers your suggestion, a small, toothy grin spreading over her face. "Yeah, I can dig it. Hretha's just got in a bunch of local teas she wants to try out; she's got Infrith running around outside the camp doing lots of picking." Given how things are outside, isn't that dangerous? "She either sends Gerik with her or bullies Vaush into looking after the girl. She'll be fine. When you don't have your eyes, [pc.name], you really learn to use your nose and tongue well. No one can make a good herbal tea like Hretha — those things are simply to die for. "Yeah, let's be off. I can hardly wait." |"Oh, if that's what you want, I'm more than happy to go visiting with you," Rags replies with a smirk. "Been a while since I last saw Gerik. What a good boy." Good boy — a hulking mountain of muscle and fur, a very good boy, indeed. "I kind of liked animals when I was younger, but we couldn't have any around the house. Too many sharp edges around plus the forge, you see. Sure, everyone had a handful of chickens, but that doesn't really count. Even years later, I still can't have a pet around... on the other hand, Hretha's always had a guide beast with her ever since she was a girl. "Come on, then. Let's go see her." ] Without waiting for another word, Ragnild grabs you by the arm and throws open the door, dragging you out into the cool night air in her excitement. She doesn't stop her implacable stride until you're right in front of Hretha's, throwing the tent flaps in and shoving you in first. And what a sight greets you.
rows.translation: [rand |听到你的建议，拉格斯明显精神为之一振。哦？ 你并不认为这是个坏主意吧——大家齐心协力，讨论起来肯定会更有效果，不是吗？ 他露出了微笑。嗯，我得承认，这种诱惑确实存在。毕竟，多年以来，我们俩总是来回反复地讨论这些话题，早就让人感到厌倦了。因弗丽丝虽然热情高涨，但经验不足，实在无法为讨论带来太多有价值的意见；而沃什每次来到赫蕾莎那里时，往往都处于醉酒状态，根本无法参与讨论。 好吧，趁我还没改变主意，我们赶紧走吧。 |拉格考虑着你的建议，脸上露出了一个带着一丝狡黠的笑容。是啊，我挺感兴趣的。赫蕾莎刚买了一些当地的茶叶，想试试看；她还让因弗丽丝在营地外面到处采摘茶叶呢。 看外面的情况，这样不是很危险吗？ 她要么让格里克陪她一起去，要么逼迫沃什去照顾那个女孩。她不会有事的。当你暂时无法关注她的时候[pc.name]，你真的学会如何巧妙地运用自己的鼻子和舌头了。没有人能像赫蕾莎那样泡出美味的草药茶来——那些茶简直太美味了，让人无法抗拒。 好，我们出发吧。我等不及了。 |哦，如果那是你想要的，我非常乐意陪你去拜访。拉格带着一丝 smirk回答道。已经有好一阵子没有见到Geric了。他真是个好孩子。 好孩子——一只体型庞大、肌肉发达、浑身覆盖着毛发的动物，确实是个非常乖的好孩子。 我小时候还挺喜欢动物的，但我们家里根本不可能养宠物。家里到处都是锋利的边缘，再加上铁匠铺的环境，你也懂的。当然，大家都会养几只鸡，但那算不上真正的宠物。即使过了很多年，我现在仍然不能在家里养宠物……不过，赫蕾莎从小时候起就一直带着一只导引兽。 那好吧，我们一起去看看她吧。 ] 她没有多说一句话，就抓住你的手臂，猛地推开门，兴奋地把你拉到了凉爽的夜空中。直到你站在赫蕾莎的帐篷前，她才停下脚步，猛地拉上帐篷的门，然后把你推了进去。 而呈现在你眼前的景象，真是令人惊叹。

rows.original: Hretha's leaning over a small pot that's hanging over an equally diminutive fire, sniffing the steam that rises from the bubbling surface. Infrith reaches back and forth between the bronze vessel and several wooden boxes laid out on the ground, adding a pinch of this, a handful of that at Hretha's instruction. Rolling her shoulders and stretching, Ragnild pushes past you to the fore. "Oh my. Am I smelling what I'm smelling? Just so happens my joints are a little worse for the wear today." The seeress doesn't reply immediately, instead inhaling deeply of the pungent steam. "Infirth. Another pinch of dried mugwort. Notice the difference in the aroma?" As her apprentice hurries to obey, Hretha turns towards the both of you and beckons you over. "How nice of you to come, Rags. And just in time, too; you are smelling what you think you're smelling." "Lumia's tits, 'Retha. It's like you to know what I just need." "I'd be a terrible oracle if I didn't. Now, the tea's almost done. Why don't the both of you come sit by the fire?"
rows.translation: 赫蕾莎正俯身看着挂在那个同样小巧的火堆上方的小锅，闻着从锅底冒出来的蒸汽。因弗丽丝则在青铜锅和地上摆放的几个木箱之间来回取物，按照赫蕾莎的指示，加入这一撮、那一把的原料。 拉格妮尔德耸了耸肩，伸了伸腰，然后从你身边挤过去，走到了前面。哦天啊，我闻到的是真的吗？偏偏今天我的关节又变得有些不舒服了。 那位女先知并没有立即回答，而是深深地吸了一口那刺鼻的蒸汽。英弗斯。再尝一小口干艾叶吧。能感觉到香味上的不同吗？ 当她的学徒急忙遵命行事时，赫蕾莎转向你们两人，示意你们过来。你能来真是太好了，拉格斯。而且来得正是时候——你闻到的并不是自己以为的东西。 卢米娅的胸部啊，‘蕾莎。你就知道我到底需要什么。 如果我不这么做的话，我就真的算不上是个预言家了。好了，茶差不多泡好了，你们俩过来坐在火堆旁吧。

rows.original: The lean, dark shape of Gerik comes bounding up to you, snarling and slavering — until Ragnild grabs the wolfhound by the sides of his head and squeezes. "Who's a good puppy, then? Who's Hretha's obedient little boy?" The growl in Gerik's throat dies to a small whimper, and he starts shaking his head from side to side, clearly trying to squirm out of Rags' affectionate grip. You swear the wolfhound looks positively embarrassed to be seen in such a position, held in place by quite literally crushing adoration. "You're just too fluffy for your own good, you adorable little pet. I —" "All right, Rags, that's quite enough. I don't want you spoiling Gerik — you didn't slip him any treats, did you?" "Hah, no." Smiling, Ragnild lets go of the now-defeated Gerik, who trots back to his mistress with his tail between his legs. "But that's only because I couldn't get my hands on any on short notice." A sigh. "I know you like animals, Rags, but I'm the one who has to live with him. You did that to the other one when we were still girls, remember? I still —" "Oh, fine." Despite her words, Ragnild can't help but chuckle a little as she steps into the warmth of the tent and urges you forward. "Still, Gerik's such a good boy, I can't help myself."
rows.translation: 格里克那瘦削而黝黑的身影猛地朝你冲过来，同时发出低吼声，口中还流着口水——直到拉格妮尔德抓住这只狼犬的头部两侧，用力挤压起来。那么，谁才是乖狗狗呢？谁才是赫蕾莎那个听话的小男孩呢？ 格里克喉咙里的低吼渐渐变成了轻微的呜咽，他开始左右摇晃着头，显然是在试图摆脱拉格那充满爱意的怀抱。你发誓，那只狼犬看起来简直尴尬处于这样的境地，被人们近乎狂热的崇拜所支撑着。 你实在太可爱了，这种性格反而会给你带来一些麻烦呢，你这个讨人喜欢的小家伙……我—— 好了，拉格斯，够了。我可不想你把格里克宠坏——你没给他偷偷塞什么好东西吧？ 哈，才不会呢。拉格妮尔德微笑着放开了已经被击败的格里克，后者夹着尾巴摇摇摆摆地回到了它的女主人身边。但那只是因为我在短时间内找不到任何这样的东西。 一声叹息。我知道你喜欢动物，拉格斯，但最终还是得和我一起生活的人是我。我们还是女孩的时候，你对那只动物也做过同样的事，还记得吗？我到现在仍然…… 哦，好吧。尽管她这么说，但当拉格妮尔德走进帐篷里的温暖空间，催促你前进时，还是忍不住轻轻笑了起来。不过，格里克是个这么好的孩子，我实在忍不住啊。

rows.original: Passed out and snoring in one corner of Hretha's tent, Vaush lies in a big crumpled heap, stinking of warm smoke with a strong herbal tinge to it. A big ivory pipe lies next to his arms, thin wisps of grayish smoke curling from the bowl, and as you step in with Ragnild right behind you, Infrith gives the shaman a big kick in the butt. "Hey! You! Wake up, old man! Hretha's got company!" "Pffff. You said I could stay and smoke —" " — And that you had to get out if anyone arrived. Bad enough that the oracle lets you indulge in her quarters." "Can't be helped. 'Retha's the only one who knows to mix the correct proportions. If only she'd bother to teach me, I wouldn't have to drop by as often as I do." Still mumbling to himself, Vaush rubs his eyes, picks up his pipe, and attempts to stagger to his feet. Stoned out of his mind as he is, it takes the shaman several tries before he finally lets go of the tent pole and manages to remain upright; Infrith doesn't even so much as lift a finger to help him. "Go get cleaned up, will you?" "Fine, fine, whatever. Women, pfff." Vaush either doesn't notice you or Ragnild, or flat-out doesn't care as he stumbles past through the tent flap and out into the cold night, clutching his pipe to his chest like a treasure...
rows.translation: 在赫雷莎的帐篷里，沃什昏昏沉沉地躺在角落里，打着呼噜，整个人蜷缩成一团，身上散发着带着浓烈草药气味的温暖烟雾。他手臂旁边放着一根巨大的象牙烟管，烟斗里不断冒出灰白色的烟雾。当你和拉格妮尔德一起走进帐篷时，因弗丽丝一脚踢在了这个萨满的屁股上。 嘿！你！醒醒吧，老头！赫蕾莎有人来了！ 呼……你不是说我可以留下来抽烟吗…… 而且如果有人来了，你就必须立刻离开。更糟糕的是，那个女预言家还允许你进入她的房间。 也没办法啊。只有‘雷莎’知道如何按照正确的比例来调配这些材料。要是她能花点时间教我就好了，我就不用这么频繁地跑去了。瓦什仍在喃喃自语，他揉了揉眼睛，拿起烟斗，试图踉踉跄跄地站起身来。由于当时已经处于极度醉酒的状态，这位萨满试了好几次才终于松开帐篷的支柱，稳稳地站住了；而因弗丽丝甚至连一根手指都没伸出来帮他。 去洗个澡吧，好吗？ 好吧好吧，随你便。女人啊，真是无足轻重。沃什要么没有注意到你或拉格妮尔德，要么根本就毫不在意，他跌跌撞撞地穿过帐篷的门帘，走进了寒冷的夜色中，紧紧地将烟斗抱在胸前，就像抱着珍宝一样……

rows.original: Well, that's an invitation if you ever heard one. Still, Rags is the guest and you're the tag-along here, so you let her take her place by the fire first before settling down on a thick pelt yourself. The cozy fire, warm furs, and of course, the presence of a whole trio of thick-bodied orcish women only serves to make the scene ever more welcoming and genial — you'd wager even the most ruthless of orc chieftains would at least be mollified for a little by the sight. Infrith comes by and pours out little pewter cups of heated herbal brew, dark, heavy and pungent. Rags downs hers in one gulp, then holds her emptied cup out for more. Hretha chuckles, blowing on her own cup; the way she gets around so well, it's hard to believe the seeress is blind in the first place. "All right. To what do I owe the honor of having not just one, but the both of you here today?"
rows.translation: 嗯，这可真是个再好不过的邀请了。不过，拉格斯才是真正的客人，而你只是跟着她来的而已，所以你应该先让她坐在火堆旁，然后再自己找个柔软的毛皮坐下来。温暖的火堆、柔软的毛皮，再加上三位身材魁梧的兽人女性的陪伴，这一切让这个场景显得更加温馨舒适——你敢打赌，就算是最冷酷无情的兽人首领，看到这样的场景，至少也会暂时缓和一下自己的态度吧。 因弗丽丝走过来，倒出一些装在锡杯里的热草药茶，这种茶颜色深沉、味道浓烈且带有刺激性。赫蕾莎大口喝光了杯中的茶，然后把空杯子递出去，想要再喝一些。 赫雷莎轻笑着，用自己的杯子吹了吹热茶；看她这么熟练地使用各种工具，真让人难以相信这位女先知其实是个盲人。好吧，我究竟做了什么，才让你们两位今天都专程来到这里呢？
rows.raw: " Well, that's an invitation if you ever heard one. Still, Rags is the guest and you're the tag-along here, so you let her take her place by the fire first before settling down on a thick pelt yourself. The cozy fire, warm furs, and of course, the presence of a whole trio of thick-bodied orcish women only serves to make the scene ever more welcoming and genial — you'd wager even the most ruthless of orc chieftains would at least be mollified for a little by the sight. Infrith comes by and pours out little pewter cups of heated herbal brew, dark, heavy and pungent. Rags downs hers in one gulp, then holds her emptied cup out for more. Hretha chuckles, blowing on her own cup; the way she gets around so well, it's hard to believe the seeress is blind in the first place. "All right. To what do I owe the honor of having not just one, but the both of you here today?""

rows.translation: 只是顺便拜访一下而已

rows.original: You're just here to see how everyone's doing, and the more the merrier, right?
rows.translation: 你只是来看看大家的情况而已，人越多越好，对吧？
rows.raw: "You're just here to see how everyone's doing, and the more the merrier, right?"

rows.original: Have Hretha share in the fun. The more the merrier, right?
rows.translation: 让赫蕾莎也一起来享受这份乐趣吧。人多才热闹，不是吗？
rows.raw: "Have Hretha share in the fun. The more the merrier, right?"

rows.original: "Well, I'm here to see Gerik, if you don't mind." "Really, Rags. Oh well, I suppose it can't be helped. Come on, then." Hretha raises two fingers to her lips and whistles sharply. Gerik appears moments later, slinking on out from behind the tentpole and sniffing at his mistress. "Go on then, boy. Looks like auntie Rags wants to pamper you like the big lump of fur you are." The wolfhound doesn't hesitate. Still holding onto some of his bestial dignity, the mound of muscle and fur that is Gerik slinks up to Ragnild and curls up in her lap. Of course, he's much too large to fit comfortably, which means that plenty of him spills over the edges; that doesn't dissuade him in the least from making himself comfortable while Rags scratches at his ears and flank. "There's a good doggy," she coos. "Have you been giving your mistress much trouble?" Shaking her head slowly, Hretha sips at her tea. "Will you look at that, [pc.name]. That's what happens when an orc woman gets to her age without managing to have any children of her own — she goes a little crazy in the head and starts treating other peoples' pets as she would her own babies." "Mind your own business, 'Retha. I just like animals, that's all. [pc.name], why don't you try giving Gerik here a pat or two? I don't think he'd let you without me around to make him feel comfortable." [pc.ra lupine |You don't see how different it would be from petting yourself, to be fair. Gods, you wouldn't mind if she'd pet you the same way she's lavishing scritches upon Gerik here. "Oh, pfff. Wait your turn if you want it that badly, I'll get to you once I'm done with Gerik." Hretha just laughs. |Hmph. Well, it can't hurt. Reaching for the big fluffy canine in Ragnild's lap, you scratch Gerik behind the ears, eliciting a loud whuff of breath and frenzied wagging of his tail. For all of the wolfhound's ferocity, he sure can be endearing when he has the mind to be. "See? You're not so bad with animals, too." You don't know about that. Gerik looks like the sort who doesn't mind where pats are coming from, so long as they're forthcoming. As if agreeing with you, Gerik bows his massive head and folds his ears forward, clearly expecting you to lavish more attention upon him; you oblige, if only to see the overgrown wolfhound squirm at your touch. ] "Seriously, Rags," Hretha continues. "You're not getting any younger, you know. Put it off for too much longer, and you'll end up collecting all kinds of hounds in your dotage. I've seen it happen. You've seen it happen. Now that Argoth's gone and not around to keep the menfolk away, I'm sure it's just a matter of time before some young hopeful gets around to propositioning you. Of course, there's always taking the matter into your own hands instead of just waiting around..." A frustrated noise escapes Ragnild's lips. "'Retha, I appreciate you being honest, but in front of [pc.name]...?" "A little embarrassment might spur you into taking action. You and I know full well that you'd drag your feet and keep putting it off. As a seeress of Lumia... well, you know what I do. The Kervus need young blood — and you don't want to end up like your mother, do you? Endlessly gathering up all manner of hounds to replace the children she never had?" Hretha clucks her tongue. "Looking at you dote on Gerik like this, Rags... I'm telling you to watch yourself because we've been friends since we were spratlings. At least your mother didn't fail for lack of trying." "All right, all right, I get it, mom." Hretha chuckles and finishes her tea, allowing Infrith to refill her cup and yours, too. "I know I'll eventually have to do it, but at the same time I don't want to have a kid just for the sake of the tribe. That's how a lot of the amazons do it — just jump on someone's cock in the lodge and get shipped back home to the islands once they start showing. I — I want it to be more than that." Slowly, Hretha softens her gaze and shuffles over to Ragnild, stroking Gerik's fluffy tail as Rags pats his head. "Which is why you have even less time if you want to make things meaningful. Not just for whoever it is, but do you really want to run around after a kid ten years from now when you have even less energy to spare? I know what you want, Rags, we've spoken about it for years, but you always had the excuse of Argoth being on your back to put matters off. Now that he's finally gone, you can't find it in yourself to get started. I just don't want you to fall into a rut and get stuck there." Silence. Hretha pauses, considering her words; she looks at you a few times, considering something. "Gods, if things get bad enough I might even ask [pc.name] for help." What? "What?!" "Got your attention there, didn't I, Rags? Do get your act together, or else I might have to take more drastic action. And before you call me a meddlesome old scold, please be reminded that I'm the tribe's seeress. I'm supposed to be a meddlesome old scold, and proud of it." Twin pink patches stain Ragnild's swampy green cheeks and she mumbles something that's neither here nor there, but it's hard for her to do very much with an insistent Gerik in her lap. The petting and playing continues for a little while — Hretha shows you a couple of tricks the two of them taught Gerik when they were younger, and it's more than a little amusing to see such a menacing wolfhound acting in such a babyish manner.
rows.translation: 嗯，我是来见格里克的，如果您不介意的话。 真的吗，拉格斯。好吧，我想也没办法改变了。那我们走吧。赫蕾莎将两根手指放在嘴唇边，发出尖锐的口哨声。片刻之后，格里克从帐篷的支柱后面悄悄出现，然后嗅了嗅自己的女主人。那就去吧，孩子。看来拉格斯阿姨想好好宠溺你这个毛茸茸的小家伙呢。 那只狼犬没有丝毫犹豫。尽管还保留着一些野性的尊严，但那团由肌肉和毛发构成的庞大身躯还是悄悄地走到拉格妮尔德身边，在她的腿上蜷缩了下来。当然，它的体型实在太大，根本无法舒适地待在那里，因此它的身体有一部分还悬在了边缘之外；不过，这丝毫没有妨碍它尽情地享受这份舒适——而拉格妮尔德也在不停地挠它的耳朵和侧身。 有一只很乖的狗狗呢。她轻声细语地说话。你是不是给你的情妇带来了很多麻烦？ 赫蕾莎缓缓地摇了摇头，然后小口啜饮着她的茶。你看看那个， [pc.name]当一个兽人女性到了这个年纪却还没有自己的孩子时，就会发生这种事——她会有点精神失常，开始把别人的宠物当成自己的孩子来对待。 别多管闲事，‘雷莎。我只是喜欢动物而已，没别的。 [pc.name]，你为什么不去轻轻拍拍格里克呢？我觉得如果没有我在场让他感到安心，他是不会允许你这么做的。 [pc.ra lupine |说实话，你根本想象不到这和自慰会有多大的区别。天啊，要是她来帮你自慰，你应该也不会介意吧你就像她现在正温柔地抚摸着格里克一样。 哦，得了吧。如果你那么急的话，就等着轮到你的时候吧。等我处理完格里克的事情，再找你。 赫蕾莎只是笑了笑。 |哼，反正也没什么坏处。你伸手去摸拉格妮尔德怀中那只毛茸茸的大犬，轻轻挠了挠格里克的耳朵，结果它发出了一声响亮的呼噜声，同时疯狂地摇起了尾巴。尽管这只狼犬看起来很凶猛，但当它愿意表现温顺的时候，确实会显得非常可爱。 看吧？原来你和动物相处起来也挺在行的嘛。 你可能不知道这一点。格里克看起来是那种不在乎施舍者是谁的人，只要有人愿意给予他帮助就行。似乎在同意你的观点，格里克低下它那巨大的头，把耳朵向前贴紧，显然是在期待你能给予它更多的关注；你便满足了它的这个愿望，只不过当你触碰到这只体型庞大的狼犬时，它却显得很不自在，甚至有些扭动身体。 ] 说真的，拉格斯。赫蕾莎继续说道。你知道，人年纪是不会再变小的。如果再拖延太久，等到年老时，你就会发现自己需要照顾各种各样的宠物了。我亲眼见过这种情况发生的。你已经我早就预见会这样。现在阿戈斯不在了，也没有人再阻止那些男人接近你，我敢肯定，很快就会有一些年轻男子主动向你提出追求。当然，你也可以自己采取行动，而不是只是坐等事情发生…… 拉格妮尔德发出了一声沮丧的叹息。雷莎，我很感谢你的坦诚，但在大家面前，[pc.name]……？" 一点点尴尬或许会促使你采取行动。你我都很清楚，如果你继续拖延，事情永远也不会有进展。作为卢米娅的女预言家……嗯，你应该知道我的职责。凯尔维斯一族需要新鲜的血液——而你肯定不希望自己的结局像你的母亲那样，对吧？她一生都在收集各种各样的猎犬，来代替那些她从未拥有的孩子。赫蕾莎吐了吐舌头。看你这么宠爱格里克，拉格斯……我劝你还是收敛一点吧，毕竟我们从小时候就是朋友。至少你妈妈在养育你这方面可是没有半点疏忽的。 好吧，好吧，我明白了。妈妈。" 赫蕾莎轻笑着喝完了茶，然后让因弗丽丝再给她和你的杯子添满茶水。 我知道最终我还是要这么做，但同时我也不想只是为了部落的利益才生孩子。很多亚马逊女性都是这样做的——在部落里和某个男人发生关系，等孩子出生后就被送回家乡的岛屿上。但我……我希望我们的关系能超越这一点。 渐渐地，赫蕾莎放松了目光，走到拉格妮尔德身边，一边轻抚着格里克的蓬松尾巴，一边让拉格轻轻拍着它的头。这就是为什么你甚至较少如果你想让事情有意义，就必须抓紧时间。不仅仅是为了别人，也是为了你自己——十年后，当你剩下的精力更加有限时，你还真的想跑去追一个孩子吗？我知道你想要什么，拉格斯，我们多年来一直都在讨论这个问题，但你总是以阿戈斯的事情为借口，把事情推迟下去。现在他终于离开了，你却还是找不到开始行动的勇气。我只是不想看到你陷入困境，无法自拔。 沉默。赫蕾莎停顿了一下，仔细斟酌着自己要说的话；她多次注视着你，似乎在思考着什么。 天啊，如果情况真的变得太糟糕了，我甚至可能会考虑[pc.name]寻求帮助。 什么？ 什么？！ 我看你注意到了吧，拉格斯？最好赶紧振作起来，否则我可能不得不采取更严厉的措施。在你说我是个爱管闲事的老泼妇之前，请记住，我是部落的占卜女啊。所谓的就是一个爱管闲事的老脾气，而且还为此感到自豪呢。 两块粉红色的斑块点缀在拉格妮尔德那泛着沼泽绿色的脸颊上，她嘴里嘟囔着些含糊不清的话，但当杰里克紧紧地坐在她腿上时，她实在很难继续做其他事情。 这种抚摸和玩耍持续了一小会儿——赫蕾莎向你展示了她们俩在杰里克还小的时候教给他的一些把戏，看着这样一只看起来凶猛的狼犬做出如此幼稚的行为，实在让人觉得十分有趣。

rows.original: "I was thinking [pc.name] and I could read to you, if you like. Give Infrith a bit of a rest." "That sounds nice," Hretha replies with a careful nod. "I'd rather not pester Vaush to read to me any more than I absolutely need to. The man gets ideas easily. But what about you, [pc.name]? Any objections to reading to a poor blind woman like me?" Well, no. [pc.bg noblescion minstrel courtesan acolyte arcanist |Given who you were before all this started, it's not a big surprise you're literate |In spite of your upbringing, you somehow managed to pick up literacy along the way ], so there shouldn't be any problem with that. It's a little funny, though... "What is?" It's just that, well, island orcs aren't stereotypically very interested in the whole reading and writing thing, no offense. At least continental and heartlander orcs had the empire bother to try and civilize them... "None taken," Hretha replies with a short, barking laugh. "It's true, after all. Neither Argoth nor Arona saw the point in reading and writing; that was the seeress' job, after all. The fact that I was blind and couldn't very well do the job didn't occur to them in the least." Ragnild sighs. "When any of the spratlings sticks their head out of the lodge long enough to need something written or read, they just get a slave to do it. If that slave isn't literate, they just move down the line until they find one who is. Why bother to learn to do it yourself when you can have someone else do it for you?" "There you go again, Rags." "It's true, isn't it?" "Doesn't mean you have to keep on harping on about it. My mother taught Rags how to read so she'd be able to be my eyes when it came to these things, but one can't say that she hasn't benefited herself from the effort, either. Come on, then. There're a couple new volumes I had Vaush get from the horse-people down south a little while ago; I'd like to get started on those." It doesn't take long for the three of you to get comfortable a safe distance from the fire, huddled up on a particularly thick pelt. Infrith brings out the volumes Hretha requested: old, yellowed, peeling tomes — but Ragnild treats them reverently, handling them as if they were ingots of solid gold, or as if they might crumble to dust under her thick fingers. "Let's get started, then." As it turns out, the particular tome Hretha wanted was [rand|a treatise on the old Belharan Empire's conquests|the travel log of a merchant vessel|a rather raunchy romance, no doubt from one of the bigger cities like Tychris|an old, battered Lumian prayer-book|several minutiae on the lives of minor warrior-aristocrats in a far-off land|on several different ways of effectively preserving meats]. Seeing Hretha get all familiar and comfortable with Ragnild like this, the seeress' head on her childhood friend's shoulder, it's clear that they've been doing this a long, long time. Ragnild's husky voice rises and falls as she trails a finger along the pages — even Infrith's stopped in her work to pull up a stool behind the two and join in on the reading. "Hey, [pc.name]." The sudden silence bats at your mind. Huh? "Why don't you give it a go? My throat's getting a little dry." Ragnild smiles. "You can take over for this chapter, if you like." Aah, so that's what she's getting at. All right, then. You snuggle in a bit closer to the orc pile, take the volume from Rags, and start reading aloud. The pages are stained and a little torn, but the words are still legible and you settle in for a good while of reading. It's strange, having warm bodies pressed up against you like this, hearing your own voice ring out in the tent's confines. Almost like reading to a couple of little children... or overgrown children, if you think about it that way. Time ticks away slowly by the flickering fire, until you finally reach the end of the chapter and pass the book back to Ragnild. It's her turn again. "Hmm... it's much better to listen than to read..." Oh no, she isn't weaseling her way out of that one. She's going to sit here and read to Hretha as much as you are." "Oh, you —" Hretha cuts off the argument with a quiet chuckle, clapping her hands. "All right, break it off, you two. You really argue like a couple, you know that?" You do? "We do?" "There's no need to use that tone of voice with me, Rags, I can tell what you're trying to hide. Same goes for you, [pc.name]. Now pipe down and start reading already; while this is fun, I can easily get this sort of amusement without needing to borrow someone else's eyes." With Hretha taking charge of matters, the rest of the night goes by smoothly with the two of you taking turns reading to Hretha. Things get so cozy that even Gerik comes in and joins the pile, a furry, fluffy living rug stretched out over the three of you as time ticks by. Eventually, though, the fire begins to die down to but embers, and Rags shuts the tome with a soft thud before handing it back to Infrith. "Whew, my mouth's getting dry.
rows.translation: 我正在思考[pc.name]如果你们愿意的话，我也可以为大家朗读。让因弗丽丝稍微休息一下吧。 听起来不错。赫蕾莎谨慎地点了点头作为回应。除非真的有必要，否则我实在不想再麻烦沃什给我读书了。那家伙很容易产生一些奇怪的想法……不过你呢？ [pc.name]有人反对为我这样的盲人妇女朗读吗？ 嗯，不行。 [pc.bg noblescion minstrel courtesan acolyte arcanist |考虑到在这一切发生之前你是谁，你会识字也就不足为奇了。 |尽管你的成长环境并非如此，但你还是设法学会了读写能力。 ]所以应该不会有任何问题。不过，这有点有趣…… 什么？ 只是，嗯，岛上的兽人通常对阅读和写作这类事情并不感兴趣，无意冒犯。至少大陆上的兽人和心脏地带的兽人，还有帝国费心去尝试让他们文明化…… 没有抢到任何东西。赫蕾莎发出一声短促而刺耳的笑声作为回应。毕竟，这是事实。无论是阿戈斯还是阿罗娜，他们都认为阅读和写作并不是他们应该做的事情；毕竟，这些本来就是那位女先知的职责。而我因为失明而无法胜任这项工作，这一点他们根本就没有考虑到。 拉格妮尔德叹了口气。当那些幼崽中有任何一个把头伸出窝外足够长的时间，从而需要阅读或书写某些东西时，他们就会找个奴隶来代劳。如果那个奴隶不识字，他们就继续往下找，直到找到一个识字的奴隶。既然可以让别人来做这些事，为什么还要自己费心去学习呢？ 又来这一套了，拉格斯。 这是真的，对吧？ 但这并不意味着你就非得一直念叨这件事不可。我母亲教拉格斯阅读，就是为了让他在这些事情上能帮我出力，但也不能说她自己没有从中受益。好了，既然这样，我让沃什从南边的马人那里取来了几本新书，我想现在就开始研读它们了。 没过多久，你们三个人就在离火源一段安全距离的地方找了个地方坐下，围坐在一张特别厚实的毛皮上。因弗丽丝拿出了赫蕾莎要求的那些书卷：那些陈旧、发黄、书页已经开始脱落的典籍——但拉格妮尔德对待它们却极为谨慎，小心翼翼地捧着它们，就像捧着价值连城的黄金块一样，生怕自己的手指会把那些书页弄得粉碎。 那我们开始吧。 原来，赫蕾莎真正想要的那本典籍是[rand|一部关于古老贝拉兰帝国征服历史的专著|商船的航行日志|这是一段相当露骨的浪漫故事，无疑发生在像提克里斯这样的大城市里。|一本破旧不堪的卢米安祈祷书|关于遥远国度中那些地位较低的武士贵族们的日常生活中的种种琐事|通过多种不同的方法有效保存肉类]看到赫蕾莎与拉格妮尔德相处得如此融洽、如此自然，那位女先知将头靠在童年好友的肩上，显然她们已经这样做了很长时间。拉格妮尔德低沉而略带抑扬的声音随着手指在书页上移动而起伏着；就连因弗丽丝也暂停了自己的工作，搬来一张凳子坐在他们身后，一起参与这次阅读活动。 嘿，[pc.name]。" 突如其来的寂静在你脑海中回荡。哈？ 你为什么不试试看呢？我的喉咙有点干。拉格妮尔德笑了。如果你愿意的话，可以由你来负责这一章的内容。 啊，原来如此。那就是她到底想表达什么意思呢。好吧，那你就再往兽人堆旁边靠一点，拿上拉格斯给你的那本书，开始大声朗读吧。书页已经有些发黄了，也有些破损，但字迹还是能看清的，你可以好好地读上一会儿了。 真是奇怪，当温暖的身体这样紧贴着你，听到自己的声音在帐篷里回荡时，那种感觉简直就像在给几个小孩子读书……或者，换个角度想，也像是在给一些已经长大的孩子读书。在摇曳的火光中，时间缓缓流逝，直到你终于读完了这一章，然后将书还给了拉格妮尔德。 现在，轮到她了。 嗯……听比看要好多了…… 哦不，她并不是想找借口逃避这件事。她会坐在这里，像你一样给赫蕾莎读书的。 哦，你—— 赫蕾莎轻声笑了笑，拍手制止了这场争论。好了，你们俩别吵了。你们争论起来真的像一对夫妻一样，知道吗？ 你真的这么认为吗？ 我们真的要这么做吗？ 拉格斯，没必要用那种肌肉度和我说话，我看得出来你在试图隐瞒什么。你也是同样的道理。 [pc.name]现在安静下来，开始阅读吧；虽然这样很有趣，但我完全可以用自己的眼睛来获得这种乐趣，而不需要借助别人的眼睛。 在赫蕾莎负责处理各种事务后，接下来的夜晚进行得十分顺利——你们俩轮流给赫蕾莎读书。气氛变得如此温馨，就连格里克也加入了进来，你们三个人就像铺着一张柔软、蓬松的“活毯”，一起度过了那些时光。 然而，最终火堆里的火焰渐渐熄灭，只剩下余烬。拉格斯轻轻地把那本厚书合上，然后交还给了因弗丽丝。呼，我的嘴巴都快干掉啦。
rows.raw: " "I was thinking [pc.name] and I could read to you, if you like. Give Infrith a bit of a rest." "That sounds nice," Hretha replies with a careful nod. "I'd rather not pester Vaush to read to me any more than I absolutely need to. The man gets ideas easily. But what about you, [pc.name]? Any objections to reading to a poor blind woman like me?" Well, no. [pc.bg noblescion minstrel courtesan acolyte arcanist |Given who you were before all this started, it's not a big surprise you're literate |In spite of your upbringing, you somehow managed to pick up literacy along the way ], so there shouldn't be any problem with that. It's a little funny, though... "What is?" It's just that, well, island orcs aren't stereotypically very interested in the whole reading and writing thing, no offense. At least continental and heartlander orcs had the empire bother to try and civilize them... "None taken," Hretha replies with a short, barking laugh. "It's true, after all. Neither Argoth nor Arona saw the point in reading and writing; that was the seeress' job, after all. The fact that I was blind and couldn't very well do the job didn't occur to them in the least." Ragnild sighs. "When any of the spratlings sticks their head out of the lodge long enough to need something written or read, they just get a slave to do it. If that slave isn't literate, they just move down the line until they find one who is. Why bother to learn to do it yourself when you can have someone else do it for you?" "There you go again, Rags." "It's true, isn't it?" "Doesn't mean you have to keep on harping on about it. My mother taught Rags how to read so she'd be able to be my eyes when it came to these things, but one can't say that she hasn't benefited herself from the effort, either. Come on, then. There're a couple new volumes I had Vaush get from the horse-people down south a little while ago; I'd like to get started on those." It doesn't take long for the three of you to get comfortable a safe distance from the fire, huddled up on a particularly thick pelt. Infrith brings out the volumes Hretha requested: old, yellowed, peeling tomes — but Ragnild treats them reverently, handling them as if they were ingots of solid gold, or as if they might crumble to dust under her thick fingers. "Let's get started, then." As it turns out, the particular tome Hretha wanted was [rand|a treatise on the old Belharan Empire's conquests|the travel log of a merchant vessel|a rather raunchy romance, no doubt from one of the bigger cities like Tychris|an old, battered Lumian prayer-book|several minutiae on the lives of minor warrior-aristocrats in a far-off land|on several different ways of effectively preserving meats]. Seeing Hretha get all familiar and comfortable with Ragnild like this, the seeress' head on her childhood friend's shoulder, it's clear that they've been doing this a long, long time. Ragnild's husky voice rises and falls as she trails a finger along the pages — even Infrith's stopped in her work to pull up a stool behind the two and join in on the reading. "Hey, [pc.name]." The sudden silence bats at your mind. Huh? "Why don't you give it a go? My throat's getting a little dry." Ragnild smiles. "You can take over for this chapter, if you like." Aah, so that's what she's getting at. All right, then. You snuggle in a bit closer to the orc pile, take the volume from Rags, and start reading aloud. The pages are stained and a little torn, but the words are still legible and you settle in for a good while of reading. It's strange, having warm bodies pressed up against you like this, hearing your own voice ring out in the tent's confines. Almost like reading to a couple of little children... or overgrown children, if you think about it that way. Time ticks away slowly by the flickering fire, until you finally reach the end of the chapter and pass the book back to Ragnild. It's her turn again. "Hmm... it's much better to listen than to read..." Oh no, she isn't weaseling her way out of that one. She's going to sit here and read to Hretha as much as you are." "Oh, you —" Hretha cuts off the argument with a quiet chuckle, clapping her hands. "All right, break it off, you two. You really argue like a couple, you know that?" You do? "We do?" "There's no need to use that tone of voice with me, Rags, I can tell what you're trying to hide. Same goes for you, [pc.name]. Now pipe down and start reading already; while this is fun, I can easily get this sort of amusement without needing to borrow someone else's eyes." With Hretha taking charge of matters, the rest of the night goes by smoothly with the two of you taking turns reading to Hretha. Things get so cozy that even Gerik comes in and joins the pile, a furry, fluffy living rug stretched out over the three of you as time ticks by. Eventually, though, the fire begins to die down to but embers, and Rags shuts the tome with a soft thud before handing it back to Infrith. "Whew, my mouth's getting dry."

rows.original: "I think that'll be enough for today. It's getting late." "Pleasant as always," Hretha agrees. "And you, [pc.name]?" It was very nice spending time and taking things slow with the two of them. It's definitely a side of Hretha that she doesn't show often. "Most of the tribe thinks I'm either performing mystical rituals all day or getting myself off when no one's looking. Possibly both at the same time. But with Rags around... well, having someone around with her head set on the right way helps me keep my own. Good, genuine friends are hard to find." Ha... don't you know the truth of it. Gerik padding at her side, Hretha moves over to the tent flap and throws it open. "All right then, both of you. Lumia's blessings and sleep well. Don't be a stranger now." "Same to you, [pc.name]," Rags says, stifling a yawn. "You don't have to see me back or anything." As she wishes. After Ragnild and you part ways, you head off and [party.hasCompanions |head to collect [party.compNames]. Enough enjoyment — there's still work to be done... |consider your options. There's still work to be done... ]
rows.translation: 我想今天就到这里吧，已经很晚了。 一如既往，非常愉快。赫蕾莎表示同意。还有你，[pc.name]？" 和他们两个人一起慢慢享受时光，确实是一件非常愉快的事情。这绝对是赫蕾莎不常展现出来的一面。 部落里的大多数人都认为，我整天不是在举行一些神秘的仪式，就是在没人注意的时候自慰。或许两者同时进行吧……不过有拉格在身边……嗯，有一个头脑清醒的人在身边确实能帮助我保持理智。真正的好朋友可是很难找的。 哈……你难道不知道事情的真相吗？ 在格里克紧挨着她站着的时刻，赫蕾莎走到了帐篷的帘幕前，将它猛地拉开。那好吧，你们两个。愿卢米娅保佑你们，好好休息吧。从此以后，就别再当陌生人了。 你也是吧[pc.name]，”拉格斯压抑着哈欠说道。你不需要再来见我，也没什么必要。 随她的意愿吧。在拉格妮尔德和你分道扬镳之后，你就继续你的路吧[party.hasCompanions |前去领取[party.compNames]虽然玩得挺开心，但还有工作要去做呢…… |请仔细考虑你的选择。还有许多工作需要完成…… ]

rows.original: Something's off, though. As you're just about to turn and head off into the camp, you spy an irregular patch of shadow lurking by one of the nearby tents. Instinctively, your hand goes for your [pc.weapon], wondering if one of Argoth's goons still resents you for your hand in their last chieftain's downfall, but [silly|the clap of dummy thicc buttcheeks alerts you — and probably any guards to boot — to the truth of the situation|it holds up a hand, clearly waving you over]. As you step off to the side, the silhouette turns out to be Hretha, looking decidedly grumpy at your apprehension. She's wandered out on her own without even Gerik or Infrith, using her staff as a cane-cum-walking stick to get around in the darkness — not that darkness should bother the seeress in the least, what with being blind and all. "Calm [silly|your tits|yourself]," she whispers. "Is Rags gone?" Yeah, she's retired for the night. So, that's why she's skulking about in the shadows? Does she have something to say that Ragnild can't hear? "Mmm, it's not so much that she can't hear and more that I don't want her to hear me saying this. If she knew that I was meddling in her love life, I'd never hear the end of it from her." Oh. You fold your arms about your [pc.chest]. This is going to be good, isn't it? "Look... I haven't been the Kervus' oracle for most of my life without figuring out a thing or two. I don't need to use any kind of clairvoyance, I can hear it in your voices. Infrith and me aside, you're probably the only person who's given poor old Rags the time of your day outside of business, and it shows. I'm pretty sure she likes you." R-really now? "Oh yes." Hretha tucks her staff into the crook of her elbow and rubs her hands together. "The way it trembles when she's feeling something... I've known her since we were knee-high spratlings, [pc.name], there's no mistaking it. And as her concerned friend, I think I ought to give her a hand, especially since she's pushing thirty and hasn't touched a dick — or a muff besides her own, for that matter — in her life. You agree?" Um... "You do care about her, right? Or else you wouldn't visit her so often, yes?" Hretha leans in close, close enough that you can see her tusks in the dim light and smell her breath; even though she can't see, she damn well knows how to intimidate. Whether it works, though... "You wouldn't happen to be leading on poor Hretha's childhood friend and be merely toying with her feelings, would you?" No, you don't suppose so. "All right, then. I know you just left, but why don't you head on back to my tent? I'll explain everything there — don't feel like standing out in the chilly dark where the wind can get in your cracks. You can stay the night if you'd like."[party.som|| She clears her throat, cocking her head at [party.compNames]. "Both of you." | She clears her throat, cockin her head at [party.compNames] in turn. "All of you. Tent's big enough for plenty; I'll have Infrith get out the extra furs." ] With that, Hretha spins on her heels and strides off, clearly expecting you to follow her. You do so, wondering if this day is going to end already. [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |Cait skips alongside you, practically bouncing on her feet, and you can't help but wonder what's got the priestess in such a cheery mood. "Oh, she's just helping people find love and get together," comes the reply. "It's nice to have a kindred spirit every now and then, you know? Watching a matchmaker help people overcome their shyness and confess their love for each other... even if you're not involved, it's still great to see unfold before your eyes!" Yeah, when one of the people involved is you. Besides, shouldn't she be worried that a priestess of Lumia is muscling in on Mallach's turf? "Hey, so long as people are happy!" |Brint chuckles as he follows along — even with his considerable stride, the minotaur is forced to pick up his pace to keep up with Hretha. "Reminds me of how the womenfolk would catch out the young bulls who'd been rutting around back home. They sure knew how to be very persuasive when it came to these things, especially if the bull had knocked up the girl in the bargain. Guess it isn't too different with orcs, is it?" No, you suppose not. |Brienne chuckles as she follows along — even with her considerable stride, the cowgirl is forced to pick up her pace to keep up with Hretha. "Reminds me of how the womenfolk would catch out the young bulls who'd been rutting around back home. They sure knew how to be very persuasive when it came to these things, especially if the bull had knocked up the girl in the bargain. Guess it isn't too different with orcs, is it? I've got to get home myself sometime, try out how things are from the other side of the fence..." No, you suppose not. |As worked up as Hretha might be, and understandably so given that it's her best friend involved here, you nevertheless can't help but wonder if this couldn't wait for morning... ]
rows.translation: 不过，有些事情不对劲。就在你准备转身走向营地的时候，你注意到附近的一顶帐篷旁有一片不规则的阴影。出于本能，你的手立刻伸向了[pc.weapon]我在想，是否还有阿戈斯的某个手下，因为你在他们最后一位首领的倒台中起到了作用而仍在怨恨你[silly|那肥硕的臀部所发出的震动声，会让你——以及任何在场的守卫——立刻意识到事情的真相。|它伸出一只手，明显是在向你招手。]当你走到一旁时，那个身影竟是赫蕾莎——她因为你的打扰而显得格外恼怒。她甚至没有带着格里克或因弗丽丝，独自一人走了出来，用她的手杖既当作拐杖，也用来在暗影中行走。不过，对于这位失明的女先知来说，暗影根本不是什么障碍。 冷静下来。 [silly|你的胸部|你自己]，"她轻声说道。拉格斯走了吗？ 是啊，她今晚已经退休了。所以，她才躲在阴影里偷偷活动吗？难道她有些什么话，是拉格妮尔德听不见的？ 嗯，其实并不是说她不能我听说了更多我不愿意相信的事情想要真希望她现在能听到我说这些。如果她知道我干涉了她的感情生活，那我肯定会遭到她无休止的责备。 哦，你把双臂交叉在身前[pc.chest]这肯定会很有趣，对吧？ 听着……在我人生的大部分时间里，我虽然担任着克尔维斯的先知，但也学到了不少东西。我并不需要什么预知能力，我完全能够听到从你们的谈话中就能听出来。除了因弗丽丝和我，你们可能是唯一会在工作之余花时间陪可怜的老拉格斯的人，这一点很明显。我敢肯定，她喜欢你们。 真的吗？ 哦，是的。赫蕾莎将她的法杖夹在肘部，然后搓了搓双手。每当她有所感触时，她的身体就会不由自主地颤抖……我们从还是小孩子的时候就认识了，那时候我们还不高，就像那些小鲱鱼一样[pc.name]，毫无疑问，情况就是如此。作为她的好朋友，我认为我应该帮她一把，尤其是考虑到她都快三十岁了，这辈子却从来没和男人发生过关系——当然，除了她自己的手之外，也从来没有和其他女性有过任何亲密接触。你同意我的看法吗？ 嗯…… 你确实在乎她，对吧？否则你也不会这么频繁地去看她，不是吗？赫蕾莎凑得非常近，近到在昏暗的光线下你甚至能看到她的獠牙，也能闻到她的呼吸；虽然她看不见东西，但她确实很懂得如何让人感到恐惧。不过，这种方法是否真的有效……那就另当别论了。你该不会真的在和可怜的赫蕾莎的童年好友交往，而只是在玩弄她的感情吧？ 不，你绝对不会这么认为的。 好吧，那这样吧。我知道你刚离开，不过为什么不回到我的帐篷里来呢？我在那里会把一切都解释清楚——毕竟在寒冷的暗影中站着，让风吹进你的衣缝里，实在不太舒服。如果你愿意的话，也可以在我这里过夜。[party.som|| 她清了清嗓子，然后歪着头说道[party.compNames]。 你们两个。 | 她清了清嗓子，然后歪着头说道。 [party.compNames]反过来也是如此。你们所有人都可以进去。帐篷足够大，足够容纳所有人；我会让因弗丽丝去拿些多余的毛皮来。 ] 说完，赫蕾莎便转身大步离去，显然指望你会跟在她后面。你跟着她走了，心里却在想：这一天难道就要这样结束了吗？ [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |凯特蹦蹦跳跳地跟在你身边，你不禁好奇，究竟是什么让这位女祭司如此开心。 哦，她只是在帮助人们找到爱情并走到一起罢了。回复到来了。偶尔遇到一个志同道合的人，真的是件很愉快的事情，你知道吗？看着那些牵线人帮助人们克服害羞，让他们勇敢地表达自己的爱意……即使你自己并没有参与到其中，看着这一切在眼前发生，也是一种很美好的体验！ 是啊，当其中有一方参与其中的时候你此外，她难道不应该担心一位卢米娅的女祭司正在侵犯马拉赫的势力范围吗？ 嘿，只要大家开心就好！ |布林特边走边轻笑——尽管他自己步履矫健，但那个弥诺陶洛斯还是不得不加快速度才能跟上赫蕾莎。这让我想起那些女人是如何捉住那些在老家到处乱搞的年轻公牛的。在这类事情上，她们确实很会说服别人，尤其是当那头公牛还把某个女孩弄怀孕了的时候。我想，对于兽人来说，情况应该也差不多吧？ 不，你大概不会这么认为吧。 |布蕾妮轻笑着跟在后面——尽管她步子很大，但这位牛仔女孩还是不得不加快速度才能跟上赫蕾莎。这让我想起那些女人是如何捉住那些在乡下到处乱搞的年轻公牛的。在这类事情上，她们确实很会说服人，尤其是当那头公牛还把某个女孩弄怀孕了的时候。我想，对于兽人来说，情况应该也差不多吧？我也该回家试试看，看看从对方的角度来看，事情会是怎样的…… 不，你大概不会这么认为吧。 |尽管赫蕾莎如此激动，而且考虑到这件事涉及到她最好的朋友，她的反应也是可以理解的，但你还是不禁会想，这件事难道不能等到早上再处理吗…… ]
rows.raw: " Something's off, though. As you're just about to turn and head off into the camp, you spy an irregular patch of shadow lurking by one of the nearby tents. Instinctively, your hand goes for your [pc.weapon], wondering if one of Argoth's goons still resents you for your hand in their last chieftain's downfall, but [silly|the clap of dummy thicc buttcheeks alerts you — and probably any guards to boot — to the truth of the situation|it holds up a hand, clearly waving you over]. As you step off to the side, the silhouette turns out to be Hretha, looking decidedly grumpy at your apprehension. She's wandered out on her own without even Gerik or Infrith, using her staff as a cane-cum-walking stick to get around in the darkness — not that darkness should bother the seeress in the least, what with being blind and all. "Calm [silly|your tits|yourself]," she whispers. "Is Rags gone?" Yeah, she's retired for the night. So, that's why she's skulking about in the shadows? Does she have something to say that Ragnild can't hear? "Mmm, it's not so much that she can't hear and more that I don't want her to hear me saying this. If she knew that I was meddling in her love life, I'd never hear the end of it from her." Oh. You fold your arms about your [pc.chest]. This is going to be good, isn't it? "Look... I haven't been the Kervus' oracle for most of my life without figuring out a thing or two. I don't need to use any kind of clairvoyance, I can hear it in your voices. Infrith and me aside, you're probably the only person who's given poor old Rags the time of your day outside of business, and it shows. I'm pretty sure she likes you." R-really now? "Oh yes." Hretha tucks her staff into the crook of her elbow and rubs her hands together. "The way it trembles when she's feeling something... I've known her since we were knee-high spratlings, [pc.name], there's no mistaking it. And as her concerned friend, I think I ought to give her a hand, especially since she's pushing thirty and hasn't touched a dick — or a muff besides her own, for that matter — in her life. You agree?" Um... "You do care about her, right? Or else you wouldn't visit her so often, yes?" Hretha leans in close, close enough that you can see her tusks in the dim light and smell her breath; even though she can't see, she damn well knows how to intimidate. Whether it works, though... "You wouldn't happen to be leading on poor Hretha's childhood friend and be merely toying with her feelings, would you?" No, you don't suppose so. "All right, then. I know you just left, but why don't you head on back to my tent? I'll explain everything there — don't feel like standing out in the chilly dark where the wind can get in your cracks. You can stay the night if you'd like."[party.som|| She clears her throat, cocking her head at [party.compNames]. "Both of you." | She clears her throat, cockin her head at [party.compNames] in turn. "All of you. Tent's big enough for plenty; I'll have Infrith get out the extra furs." ] With that, Hretha spins on her heels and strides off, clearly expecting you to follow her. You do so, wondering if this day is going to end already. [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |Cait skips alongside you, practically bouncing on her feet, and you can't help but wonder what's got the priestess in such a cheery mood. "Oh, she's just helping people find love and get together," comes the reply. "It's nice to have a kindred spirit every now and then, you know? Watching a matchmaker help people overcome their shyness and confess their love for each other... even if you're not involved, it's still great to see unfold before your eyes!" Yeah, when one of the people involved is you. Besides, shouldn't she be worried that a priestess of Lumia is muscling in on Mallach's turf? "Hey, so long as people are happy!" |Brint chuckles as he follows along — even with his considerable stride, the minotaur is forced to pick up his pace to keep up with Hretha. "Reminds me of how the womenfolk would catch out the young bulls who'd been rutting around back home. They sure knew how to be very persuasive when it came to these things, especially if the bull had knocked up the girl in the bargain. Guess it isn't too different with orcs, is it?" No, you suppose not. |Brienne chuckles as she follows along — even with her considerable stride, the cowgirl is forced to pick up her pace to keep up with Hretha. "Reminds me of how the womenfolk would catch out the young bulls who'd been rutting around back home. They sure knew how to be very persuasive when it came to these things, especially if the bull had knocked up the girl in the bargain. Guess it isn't too different with orcs, is it? I've got to get home myself sometime, try out how things are from the other side of the fence..." No, you suppose not. |As worked up as Hretha might be, and understandably so given that it's her best friend involved here, you nevertheless can't help but wonder if this couldn't wait for morning... ]"

rows.original: By the time the [party.hasCompanions|lot|both] of you flump back into Hretha's tent, it's already getting pretty dark out; even the rowdiness of the lodge has largely died out as orcs either fall asleep at the table or stagger back to their bunks. Infrith is busy laying out heavy fur pallets, and Hretha gives her a nonchalant wave as she passes her by and sinks into the comfort of what used to be a mountain lion sprawled out on the floor. "Prepare a couple more if you would, girl. Night's looking to be cold and we have [party.hasCompanions|guests|a guest] over." As Infrith hurries off, Hretha lies back on her furs and tilts her head up to the ceiling, clearly contemplating her next words. When the seeress next speaks, there's a certain clarity to her speech that wasn't there moments before. You briefly wonder if there's some magic being worked here, but if there is you can't sense any. It's not as if Hretha's lacking in the art of charisma, after all. "[pc.name]. Ragnild, she's like family to me, in ways that Argoth and Arona never were. Maybe it's something in her mother's heartlander blood that makes her softer, the generations of captivity by Belhar that made them — ah, weak, as Arona might put it. Not that I'm speaking ill of my siblings, but Rags fulfilled a different need that I had but couldn't quite ask them to help with. If I hadn't had those talks with her about our mothers' feet as spratlings, then later as girls... well, I'd still be seeress of Lumia, but maybe a very different seeress. "So as you can see, she's very important to me. Argoth kept the menfolk away from her, and maybe it's for the best. Despite the tough exterior, [pc.name], Rags isn't a woman who's cut out for the way we usually go about these things. She's an orc with different needs." Different needs, she says. That's a very curious way to put it. At length, Infrith returns with several furs for [party.combatNames], and you make yoursel[party.hasCompanions|ves|f] comfortable while Hretha continues the tale. "A curious way, but a correct way to phrase it. She reads to me, [pc.name], and the poor thing doesn't think I notice her heart hammer when she just happens to pick up those trashy, tattered books we got from those merchant vessels years ago. Years ago, I tell you, and she still gets excited when she reads them to me. I know how her voice changes, her muscles tense when we get to the masquerade scene where the masked couples pair off in the ballroom and dance into the night." Hretha chuckles. "Oh, Rags... Lumia must have mixed up your soul with someone else's when your mother was pregnant. For someone like you to be born into an orc tribe, much less the Kervus..." You're beginning to see where this is going. Hretha nods and coughs. "I'm not going to ask you to marry her, that's not something the Kervus do, not at their age. Too many young get laid low in battle, you see, amongst other unfortunate events. Pairing up with someone you care about is something that happens when you start getting gray hairs and find that your body doesn't quite move as quickly as it used to; it's what you do when you want to find a nice little islet of your own and set up a fishery, raise the grandchildren your own kids send home. "At the same time, I know that poor old Rags has dreams, dreams that she'd be mocked by the rest of the tribe for if she were to ever let them be known. After all, the style amongst Kervus women is leathers, furs and bronze; whoever heard of an islander orc in a dress?" A dress... [pc.isBimbo|that sounds, like totally great! A big girl like Rags could really do with one! You nod and beam a big, bubbly smile, happy with the fact that you figured it out|Hretha's dropping a hint here, and you're not so dense that you can't pick it up]. All right, then, a dress it is. [ flags.NELIA_MET |Besides, if it's fancy frippery Hretha's talking about, you know just the person who could hook you up with some of that. While you don't know if Nelia has ever put together a dress for an orc before, you're fairly certain she wouldn't balk at trying. |Fancy frippery's in short supply this far away from any major city where such a luxury item might be available, but Hawkethorne's your best bet for trying to get your hands on anything like this in this neck of the Marches. You probably won't find a merchant with ready-made apparel, but a tailor or seamstress would be able to make one for you. ] "Poor Rags. Her heartlander mother filled her head with ideas, and she yearns for things that she's never seen, no matter how much she says otherwise. No Kervus would ever entertain such silly flights of fancy for a moment, but you're no Kervus... it sounds almost too good to be true, right? Now then, rest well, and I'll give you Rags' measurements in the morning." So just to get all this straight — she wants to play wingwoman and help you and Rags get together, because she thinks her friend likes you, and you like her in return. "That's right. You wouldn't be spending that much time with old Rags if you didn't care for her, would you?" And in order to do this, she wants you to go and get Rags a nice, girly dress, because that's what she secretly wants despite the entirety of Kervus society and custom being opposed to it. Hretha chuckles again. "Oh, my dear [pc.name], the dress is just the beginning. She wants so much more, so much more. All those silly little confessions whispered when she thought I was sleeping... being blind doesn't mean I'm deaf. But yes, go and get a dress for Rags — you'll do it if you care about her, right?"
rows.translation: 等到那个时候[party.hasCompanions|很多|两者都]当你跌跌撞撞地回到赫蕾莎的帐篷时，天已经差不多黑了；营地里原本的喧闹也几乎消失了，因为那些兽人要么在桌旁睡着了，要么摇摇晃晃地回到了自己的铺位上。因弗丽丝正在忙着铺上厚厚的毛皮垫子，而赫蕾莎在经过他身边时，只是随意地朝他挥了挥手，然后便躺在了原本是山狮躺着的那个地方，享受着那份舒适。 姑娘，如果你愿意的话，再准备几件吧。今晚看起来会很冷，我们需要的[party.hasCompanions|客人|一位客人]结束。 当因弗丽丝匆忙离开后，赫蕾莎仰躺在她的毛皮上，抬头望着天花板，显然在思考接下来该说些什么。当这位女先知再次开口时，她的话语中流露出一种前所未有的清晰与坚定。你不禁怀疑这里是否运用了某种魔法，但仔细观察却感觉不到任何异常。毕竟，赫蕾莎在魅力方面的表现也丝毫不逊色啊。 "[pc.name]拉格妮尔德，她对我来说就像家人一样，这种感情是阿戈斯和阿罗娜永远无法给予我的。也许是她母亲那种来自心脏之地的血统，让她显得更加温柔；而那些被贝尔哈尔囚禁的岁月，也让她们——用阿罗娜的话来说——变得脆弱了。并不是我想说我的兄弟姐妹有什么不好，但拉格斯满足了我某种他们可能无法帮助我满足的需求。要不是当初我们还是小孩子的时候，我曾和她聊过关于我们母亲们足部的事，那么后来当我们长大一些后，这些话题也就自然地被提了出来。嗯，我依然会是一名卢米娅的女预言家，但或许会是一个截然不同的预言家吧。 如你们所见，她对我来说非常重要。阿戈斯将那些男人都挡在了她的身外，或许这样反而更好。尽管她外表坚强[pc.name]，拉格斯并不是那种适合我们通常处理这类事情方式的女性。她是一名兽人，有着不同的需求。 不同的需求，”她说。这种表达方式确实很有趣。最终，因弗丽丝带着几张毛皮回来了[party.combatNames]然后，你就成就了自己。[party.hasCompanions|自己|f]在赫蕾莎继续讲述这个故事的时候，人们感到非常惬意。 一种奇怪的方法，但确实有效。正确可以这么说吧。她会给我读书听。 [pc.name]，那个可怜的女孩根本没意识到，每当她拿起那些多年前从商船上得到的破旧书籍时，我其实都能注意到她的心跳正在加速。真的是多年前的事了，可每当我听她给我读这些书时，她依然会显得非常兴奋。我清楚地记得，每当读到那些描述化装舞会场景的部分——那些戴着面具的情侣们在舞厅里成对跳舞，直到深夜——她的声音会发生变化，她的肌肉也会变得紧张起来。赫蕾莎轻声笑了起来。哦，拉格斯……在你母亲怀孕的时候，卢米娅肯定把你的灵魂和别人的搞混了。像你这样的人竟然会出生在一个兽人部落里，更别提还是凯尔维斯家族的了…… 你开始明白事情会朝着什么方向发展了。 赫蕾莎点了点头，然后轻咳了一声。我并不会向你提出娶她为妻，因为凯尔维斯族人在他们这个年纪是不会这么做的。你知道，太多年轻人会在战斗中丧生，还有其他许多不幸的事情也会发生。只有当头发开始变白，发现自己的身体不再像从前那样灵活时，才会考虑与自己关心的人结为伴侣；只有当想要拥有属于自己的小岛，建立自己的渔场，抚养那些自己的孩子送回来的孙子孙女时，才会考虑这样的选择。 同时，我也知道那个可怜的老拉格斯有着自己的梦想，那些梦想如果被部落里的其他人知道，她一定会遭到嘲笑。毕竟，在凯尔维斯族的女性中，流行的服饰风格是皮革、毛皮和青铜制品；谁会听说过有岛民兽人会穿裙子呢？ 一条裙子…… [pc.isBimbo|那听起来真是太棒了！像拉格斯这样的成熟女孩，确实需要这样一件东西！你点了点头，露出了灿烂的笑容，为自己想出了这个主意而感到非常高兴。|赫蕾莎在这里暗示了一些事情，你总不会蠢到完全听不懂吧？]好吧，那就选一条裙子吧。 [ flags.NELIA_MET |另外，如果赫蕾莎说的是那些花哨的装饰品，那你应该知道有谁能够帮你搞到这些东西。虽然你不知道内莉娅以前是否为兽人制作过裙子，但你可以肯定，她绝对不会拒绝尝试的。 |在远离任何大型城市的地方，这类奢华物品自然十分稀缺。不过，在这片边境地区，鹰棘镇是你找到这类东西的最佳去处。你可能找不到出售现成服装的商家，但裁缝或缝纫师应该能够为你制作所需的衣物。 ] 可怜的拉格斯。她那位来自心脏之地的母亲总在她脑海中灌输各种想法，因此她总是渴望那些她从未见过的东西，尽管她总声称自己并不这么想。不过，凯尔维斯绝不会浪费时间去考虑这种愚蠢的幻想……但你毕竟不是凯尔维斯……这一切听起来简直好得令人难以置信，对吧？现在，好好休息吧，明天早上我会把拉格斯的尺寸测量数据告诉你。 所以，先把事情弄清楚吧——她想扮演牵线搭桥的角色，帮你和拉格斯在一起，因为她觉得她的朋友喜欢你，而你也喜欢她。 没错。如果你不关心老拉格斯，就不会花这么多时间陪她吧？ 为了做到这一点，她希望你去为拉格斯买一条漂亮的女式裙子，因为尽管凯尔维斯社会的习俗和传统都反对这一点，但这其实是她内心真正的愿望。 赫蕾莎又笑了起来。哦，我的天啊[pc.name]，这条裙子仅仅是个开始。她想要的远不止这些，远远不止……那些她以为我在睡觉时偷偷说出的那些傻傻的表白……虽然我失明了，但并不意味着我也听不见。不过，去为拉格斯买一条裙子吧——如果你真的关心她，你肯定会的，对吧？
rows.raw: " By the time the [party.hasCompanions|lot|both] of you flump back into Hretha's tent, it's already getting pretty dark out; even the rowdiness of the lodge has largely died out as orcs either fall asleep at the table or stagger back to their bunks. Infrith is busy laying out heavy fur pallets, and Hretha gives her a nonchalant wave as she passes her by and sinks into the comfort of what used to be a mountain lion sprawled out on the floor. "Prepare a couple more if you would, girl. Night's looking to be cold and we have [party.hasCompanions|guests|a guest] over." As Infrith hurries off, Hretha lies back on her furs and tilts her head up to the ceiling, clearly contemplating her next words. When the seeress next speaks, there's a certain clarity to her speech that wasn't there moments before. You briefly wonder if there's some magic being worked here, but if there is you can't sense any. It's not as if Hretha's lacking in the art of charisma, after all. "[pc.name]. Ragnild, she's like family to me, in ways that Argoth and Arona never were. Maybe it's something in her mother's heartlander blood that makes her softer, the generations of captivity by Belhar that made them — ah, weak, as Arona might put it. Not that I'm speaking ill of my siblings, but Rags fulfilled a different need that I had but couldn't quite ask them to help with. If I hadn't had those talks with her about our mothers' feet as spratlings, then later as girls... well, I'd still be seeress of Lumia, but maybe a very different seeress. "So as you can see, she's very important to me. Argoth kept the menfolk away from her, and maybe it's for the best. Despite the tough exterior, [pc.name], Rags isn't a woman who's cut out for the way we usually go about these things. She's an orc with different needs." Different needs, she says. That's a very curious way to put it. At length, Infrith returns with several furs for [party.combatNames], and you make yoursel[party.hasCompanions|ves|f] comfortable while Hretha continues the tale. "A curious way, but a correct way to phrase it. She reads to me, [pc.name], and the poor thing doesn't think I notice her heart hammer when she just happens to pick up those trashy, tattered books we got from those merchant vessels years ago. Years ago, I tell you, and she still gets excited when she reads them to me. I know how her voice changes, her muscles tense when we get to the masquerade scene where the masked couples pair off in the ballroom and dance into the night." Hretha chuckles. "Oh, Rags... Lumia must have mixed up your soul with someone else's when your mother was pregnant. For someone like you to be born into an orc tribe, much less the Kervus..." You're beginning to see where this is going. Hretha nods and coughs. "I'm not going to ask you to marry her, that's not something the Kervus do, not at their age. Too many young get laid low in battle, you see, amongst other unfortunate events. Pairing up with someone you care about is something that happens when you start getting gray hairs and find that your body doesn't quite move as quickly as it used to; it's what you do when you want to find a nice little islet of your own and set up a fishery, raise the grandchildren your own kids send home. "At the same time, I know that poor old Rags has dreams, dreams that she'd be mocked by the rest of the tribe for if she were to ever let them be known. After all, the style amongst Kervus women is leathers, furs and bronze; whoever heard of an islander orc in a dress?" A dress... [pc.isBimbo|that sounds, like totally great! A big girl like Rags could really do with one! You nod and beam a big, bubbly smile, happy with the fact that you figured it out|Hretha's dropping a hint here, and you're not so dense that you can't pick it up]. All right, then, a dress it is. [ flags.NELIA_MET |Besides, if it's fancy frippery Hretha's talking about, you know just the person who could hook you up with some of that. While you don't know if Nelia has ever put together a dress for an orc before, you're fairly certain she wouldn't balk at trying. |Fancy frippery's in short supply this far away from any major city where such a luxury item might be available, but Hawkethorne's your best bet for trying to get your hands on anything like this in this neck of the Marches. You probably won't find a merchant with ready-made apparel, but a tailor or seamstress would be able to make one for you. ] "Poor Rags. Her heartlander mother filled her head with ideas, and she yearns for things that she's never seen, no matter how much she says otherwise. No Kervus would ever entertain such silly flights of fancy for a moment, but you're no Kervus... it sounds almost too good to be true, right? Now then, rest well, and I'll give you Rags' measurements in the morning." So just to get all this straight — she wants to play wingwoman and help you and Rags get together, because she thinks her friend likes you, and you like her in return. "That's right. You wouldn't be spending that much time with old Rags if you didn't care for her, would you?" And in order to do this, she wants you to go and get Rags a nice, girly dress, because that's what she secretly wants despite the entirety of Kervus society and custom being opposed to it. Hretha chuckles again. "Oh, my dear [pc.name], the dress is just the beginning. She wants so much more, so much more. All those silly little confessions whispered when she thought I was sleeping... being blind doesn't mean I'm deaf. But yes, go and get a dress for Rags — you'll do it if you care about her, right?" "

rows.original: She really is going to all these lengths to keep her hand in this hidden, isn't she? "I'm not denying it, [pc.name]. Usually amongst the Kervus, it's my job as oracle to pair up compatible couples when they start feeling the wind in their bones and it's time to settle down to a quieter life on the islands, supporting the young 'uns who're out raiding and having fun. I'd like to think I'm good at my job — haven't had a couple I put together break up on me yet. Most of them are pretty obvious when they get to that age... "Rags, though, she wants to experience romance, like the heartlanders were clumsily trying to learn from their imperial masters. She wouldn't want me to set her up like any other Kervus, she wants it to feel natural. If she knew I was conspiring with you like this to make her dreams real... you can tell a little white lie to make her happy, right?" [pc.isDK|Yeah, sure, you'd have no problems with that.|Hmm... while you're not entirely sure, if it's for Rags...] "Just think about it. Well then, it's gotten quite late. Stay the night in my tent, and I'll see you out on the morrow."
rows.translation: 她真是不惜费这么大劲来隐瞒自己的插手，对吧？ “我并不否认， [pc.name]。通常在克尔维斯族里，作为神谕者，我的职责就是在族人们开始觉得骨头里进了风、该在岛上安顿下来过更平静的日子、顺便照看那些在外劫掠玩乐的小辈时，为他们撮合合得来的伴侣。我觉得自己这份工作做得还不错——我撮合的情侣还没有一对散伙过。大多数人到了那个年纪，其实都挺明显的…… “不过拉格斯，她想要体验的是浪漫，就像内地人笨拙地试图从他们的帝国主子那里学来的那种。她不想让我像安排其他克尔维斯人那样安排她，她希望这一切感觉起来是自然的。如果她知道我正这样跟你合谋，想帮她实现梦想……为了让她开心，你可以撒个无伤大雅的小谎吧？” [pc.isDK|嗯，当然，你对此完全没问题。|嗯……虽然你还不太确定，但如果这是为了拉格斯的话……] “好好想想吧。不过，现在真的很晚了。今晚就在我的帐篷里过夜吧，明天早上我送你出去。”

rows.original: When you do awaken the next morning, Hretha's nowhere to be seen; Infrith provides you with a small basin of water to wash up in and helpfully informs you that the oracle's gone to see to several cases of stomachache by the lodge, probably some undercooked meat or something. The seeress' apprentice also rattles off several numbers, presumably Ragnild's measurements so you can get that dress made for her. That aside, you have free run of the camp... [party.has arona |Well, perhaps it's best if you ask Arona what she thinks of all this — for being chieftain of the Kervus, she's been more uncharacteristically silent throughout the previous night. This involves her people, after all. "I think it's a load of trash," comes the blunt and slightly disgruntled answer. "But at the same time, I'm not going to start seeing ghosts around every corner like my brother did. If it'll keep Rags happy and out of trouble, I'll let my sister get up to her mischief." That sounds fair. You don't know as much about Kervus politics as Arona would, so she's probably got a better handle on the situation than you do. "Regardless of what I think of her, Rags is excellent at what she does, and Hretha obviously loves her a lot as a friend. Her forge-skill's saved my life several times over now, which is more than what I can say for Pavo. Maybe it would be best for the Kervus if she actually had a spratling she could pass her talents on to before it's too late." Arona pauses several moments and thinks, clearly warming up to the idea. "That's right. As chieftain, I've got to see to the future of the tribe. Well, if that's what it takes. Presumably Hretha knows what she's doing..." Ever since she's become chieftain, Arona has mellowed out a little herself. Not that much, perhaps, but at least she's thinking more for the good of the clan than for herself these days. You can only wonder if she'll make for a great leader when this is all over... |[party.has cait |Well, then. As local priestess of love and amor, what does Cait think of all this? "It's really romantic, isn't it?" comes the chirpy reply, your pink kitten so excited that she can't help but keep swishing her tail about. "I wouldn't have imagined someone so... uh, idealistic could be found amongst orcs, of all peoples!" It certainly goes against the stereotypes, and you wouldn't know it just by looking at Ragnild. Gods, even now you're not completely sure if Hretha isn't just playing a big prank on you... Cait gives you a big, helpful smile. "What've you got to lose? Worst thing that happens is that you embarrass yourself a bit, then explain the situation and everything's good. Best thing that happens? You make Ragnild very happy and give her the companionship she's been wanting all this time. I don't even need to state that the answer is obvious, do I?" No. No, she doesn't. "Great, then there's no reason to hold back!" |Well, suppose it's time to get a move along, then. While there might have been more questions you'd had for Hretha, it sounds like the seeress might be busy for a little while now. What's the worst that could happen in getting old Rags a nice dress, anyway? Maybe you'd embarrass yourself for a minute or two before you explain it was all a prank on Hretha's part. The best thing that could happen? You make the orcess really, really happy. Hretha sounded really serious about this whole thing... that, and the risk compared to the reward makes it a no-brainer. Right? ] ] One way or the other, you ought to get a move on. If you're going to make it back to Hawkethorne in search of a seamstress, you've got a walk ahead of you.
rows.translation: 当你第二天早上真的醒来时，赫蕾莎已经不见了踪影；因弗丽丝给了你一小盆水让你洗漱，还热心地告诉你，那位女先知去处理营地里几起胃痛病例了，可能是有人吃了没煮熟的肉之类的东西。那位女先知的学徒还念出了一串数字，应该是拉格妮尔德提供的尺寸，这样你就可以为她制作那条裙子了。除此之外，你可以自由活动于整个营地之中…… [party.has arona |嗯，或许你最好去问问阿罗娜，她对此事有什么看法——作为克尔维斯部落的酋长，她在整个昨晚都异常地保持沉默。毕竟，这件事关系到她的族人。 我觉得这完全是一派胡言。随之而来的是一个直率而略带不满的回答。但同时，我并不会像我哥哥那样，觉得到处都有鬼魂出现。只要能让拉格斯开心，不惹上麻烦，我就让我的妹妹去闹她那些小把戏吧。 这听起来很合理。你对凯尔伏斯的政治局势的了解程度远不如阿罗娜，所以她很可能比你更清楚当前的形势。 无论我对她有什么看法，拉格斯在她所从事的领域确实非常出色，而赫蕾莎显然也非常喜欢她这个朋友。她的锻造技艺已经多次救了我的命，这一点，帕沃可就做不到。或许，对凯尔维斯家族来说，如果她能在为时已晚之前，找一个可以把自己所学传授给的人，那会是一件好事。阿罗娜停顿了片刻，仔细思考着，显然她正在逐渐接受这个想法。没错。作为族长，我有责任为部落的未来负责。如果必须这样做的话……想必赫蕾莎也明白自己在做什么…… 自从她成为首领以来，阿罗娜拥有她自己也变得成熟了一些。也许并没有变得太多，但至少这些天她考虑的更多是部落的利益，而不是自己的私利。人们不禁会想，等到这一切结束后，她是否会成为一名出色的领导者…… |[party.has cait |那么，作为爱情与情欲的本地化守护者，凯特对此有何看法呢？ 真是太浪漫了，不是吗？传来欢快地回应：“你的粉色小猫兴奋极了，根本忍不住不停地摇尾巴。我真没想到，在所有种族中，竟然会在兽人当中找到这样一个……呃，如此理想主义的人！ 这确实打破了那些刻板印象，单凭看拉格妮尔德的外表，你是根本无法猜到的。天啊，就连现在，你仍然不确定赫蕾莎是不是在故意捉弄你…… 凯特向你露出了一个热情而友好的微笑。你有什么可失去的呢？最坏的情况也不过是让自己有点难堪，然后解释一下情况，一切就会恢复正常。而最好的结果是什么呢？你会让拉格妮尔德非常开心，给她带来她一直以来渴望的陪伴。这个答案显然是一清二楚的，对吧？ 不，她并没有。 太好了，那就没有什么可以阻碍我们了！ |好吧，那看来是时候继续前进了。虽然你可能还有很多问题想问赫蕾莎，但听起来这位女先知现在可能有点忙吧。 毕竟，给那位年迈的拉格买一条漂亮的裙子，最坏的结果又能怎样呢？也许在你解释这一切都是赫蕾莎开的玩笑之前，你会尴尬上一两分钟。但最好的结果就是：你能让那个女妖真正地、彻底地开心起来。赫蕾莎对这件事可是非常认真的。…而且，考虑到风险与回报之间的比例，这个选择显然是不容置疑的，对吧？ ] ] 不管怎样，你都该赶快行动了。如果你打算回到鹰棘镇去寻找那位裁缝，那么你还有很长的路要走呢。

rows.original: Swallowing hard, you clear your throat and ask Nelia if she'd be willing to tailor a dress to certain specific requirements. Specifically, an orc. "Oh? And who might that be, [pc.ra orc |you?" You hurriedly explain that the dress isn't for you — |a friend of yours?" Indeed, ] it's for a friend of yours, a very good friend whom you'd like to help achieve her dreams. The words probably sound trite as they leave your lips, but Nelia simply smiles and holds your gaze. "Tell me, then. How do you envision this dress on your very special lady friend? Perhaps we can work together to come up with some inspiration... and you'll have to give me her measurements to work with, too. Why don't you sit down right here —" she pulls out a stool from her side of the stand " — and we can talk about it slowly? Looks like you want this to come out good, so there's no sense in rushing it." [party.hasCompanions|You dismiss [party.compNames] to have the run of the town market while you get all this sorted out|You run over what Infrith told you about Rags' measurements one last time in your head], then take a seat beside Nelia. Over the next couple of hours, an idea begins to take shape: something simple and inexpensive yet with elegance and charm, something figure-hugging yet not outright provocative, something clearly romantic and alluring yet without the direct, raw sexuality that most members of the Kervus tribe practically ooze. Nelia pauses the conversation every so often to think, scratching at the dirt with a small stick, then at last, clears her throat. "I'm seeing it, [pc.name]. I'm seeing what exactly it is you need for this very special someone of yours... yes, you want a sundress. A lovely light sundress with bared arms for your lovely lady, simple class and elegance in those swishing skirts and bright colors. From the sounds of it, she doesn't mind the cold that much, so putting it on for a few hours at a time to look her best shouldn't be any kind of problem for her. How's this look?" Yeah. As you gaze over the pattern Nelia's sketched into the dirt, you admit it's close to what would fit Ragnild best — looking stereotypically girly without being impractical or attempting to play the part of the temptress. Rags, a temptress... ha no, that wouldn't suit her at all. But this does. Nelia sure knows her stuff to be able to piece this much together from a simple chat with you. "Oh, it's nothing. Plenty of people come in to buy clothes as gifts, so I have to work with descriptions quite often. It's a matter of simple discernment to figure out the kind of person they're describing and match them to an outfit. It's an art you learn over the years in my trade, I'll say." An art that's served her well. Nelia nods and scuffs the dirt over with a foot, rubbing out her drawing. "Tell you what, [pc.name]. You've managed to capture my interest — it's not every day that someone comes up to me and asks for a pretty dress for an islander orc, of all people! They're usually about furs and leathers and studs, that kind of stuff." That's what you thought, too. "So tell you what," she continues. "I'll even throw in a set of lingerie for your lovely lady free of charge! I've always wanted to see if I could make a body shape like hers look good in skimpy clothing, design one that would —" You slowly lower your hands, and tell Nelia that you'll be quite content leaving the details to her and that you're confident Ragnild's fashionable future will be in good hands. Now then... what do you owe her? "Well... normally I'd ask for money, but since you're going out of town so often there's something else you can do for me instead. That'd be worth more than anything you could pay, to be honest." And that would be? "I need some winterstem. Most people smoke the stuff, but it's also a good dye fixer, and what with the recent troubles going out of town has been increasingly dangerous, even with the likes of you helping out. I'm good with a knitting needle, but not that good, so trying to pick some myself is out of the question, and prices on what little gets brought into town are getting higher every day. "So that's it, yeah. Get me enough winterstem to set me up for a little while, and I'll do your lady friend's sundress and throw in some lingerie to boot. How's that sound to you?" Sounds like a deal! The two of you shake on it, and Nelia waves you off. "Don't forget, then. Three stalks should be enough to last me a while!"
