rows.raw: " Swallowing hard, you clear your throat and ask Nelia if she'd be willing to tailor a dress to certain specific requirements. Specifically, an orc. "Oh? And who might that be, [pc.ra orc |you?" You hurriedly explain that the dress isn't for you — |a friend of yours?" Indeed, ] it's for a friend of yours, a very good friend whom you'd like to help achieve her dreams. The words probably sound trite as they leave your lips, but Nelia simply smiles and holds your gaze. "Tell me, then. How do you envision this dress on your very special lady friend? Perhaps we can work together to come up with some inspiration... and you'll have to give me her measurements to work with, too. Why don't you sit down right here —" she pulls out a stool from her side of the stand " — and we can talk about it slowly? Looks like you want this to come out good, so there's no sense in rushing it." [party.hasCompanions|You dismiss [party.compNames] to have the run of the town market while you get all this sorted out|You run over what Infrith told you about Rags' measurements one last time in your head], then take a seat beside Nelia. Over the next couple of hours, an idea begins to take shape: something simple and inexpensive yet with elegance and charm, something figure-hugging yet not outright provocative, something clearly romantic and alluring yet without the direct, raw sexuality that most members of the Kervus tribe practically ooze. Nelia pauses the conversation every so often to think, scratching at the dirt with a small stick, then at last, clears her throat. "I'm seeing it, [pc.name]. I'm seeing what exactly it is you need for this very special someone of yours... yes, you want a sundress. A lovely light sundress with bared arms for your lovely lady, simple class and elegance in those swishing skirts and bright colors. From the sounds of it, she doesn't mind the cold that much, so putting it on for a few hours at a time to look her best shouldn't be any kind of problem for her. How's this look?" Yeah. As you gaze over the pattern Nelia's sketched into the dirt, you admit it's close to what would fit Ragnild best — looking stereotypically girly without being impractical or attempting to play the part of the temptress. Rags, a temptress... ha no, that wouldn't suit her at all. But this does. Nelia sure knows her stuff to be able to piece this much together from a simple chat with you. "Oh, it's nothing. Plenty of people come in to buy clothes as gifts, so I have to work with descriptions quite often. It's a matter of simple discernment to figure out the kind of person they're describing and match them to an outfit. It's an art you learn over the years in my trade, I'll say." An art that's served her well. Nelia nods and scuffs the dirt over with a foot, rubbing out her drawing. "Tell you what, [pc.name]. You've managed to capture my interest — it's not every day that someone comes up to me and asks for a pretty dress for an islander orc, of all people! They're usually about furs and leathers and studs, that kind of stuff." That's what you thought, too. "So tell you what," she continues. "I'll even throw in a set of lingerie for your lovely lady free of charge! I've always wanted to see if I could make a body shape like hers look good in skimpy clothing, design one that would —" You slowly lower your hands, and tell Nelia that you'll be quite content leaving the details to her and that you're confident Ragnild's fashionable future will be in good hands. Now then... what do you owe her? "Well... normally I'd ask for money, but since you're going out of town so often there's something else you can do for me instead. That'd be worth more than anything you could pay, to be honest." And that would be? "I need some winterstem. Most people smoke the stuff, but it's also a good dye fixer, and what with the recent troubles going out of town has been increasingly dangerous, even with the likes of you helping out. I'm good with a knitting needle, but not that good, so trying to pick some myself is out of the question, and prices on what little gets brought into town are getting higher every day. "So that's it, yeah. Get me enough winterstem to set me up for a little while, and I'll do your lady friend's sundress and throw in some lingerie to boot. How's that sound to you?" Sounds like a deal! The two of you shake on it, and Nelia waves you off. "Don't forget, then. Three stalks should be enough to last me a while!" "

rows.original: You make sure that everything's in order, then pass the winterstem over to Nelia. She examines the wild herbs for several moments, then gives you a satisfied nod before bundling the lot up in a bit of wax paper and tucking it all under her stall's counter. "That'll do. I only need a bit each time I get the dyes out, but even just a little is enough to ensure the color doesn't fade or wash out for months or more. Hopefully that'll tide me over until all this dies down, or at least until I can get someone else to find me some more fresh winterstem at a decent price." Now, about those clothes... "Of course, of course. I've got them all right here. Hold your horses." Nelia hops off her stool and rummages amongst the racks in the back of her stall. "Ah, there. What do you think?" The dress she hands you is a balanced blend of elegant and cute, fine linen dyed with light blues and warm, sunny yellows. As promised, it's sleeveless — all the better with which to show off Rags' muscular arms when she does put it on — and held up by twin loops of fabric that're clearly meant to go over the shoulders. The skirts reach down to somewhere about mid-thigh, and Nelia's trimmed them all around with dainty white lace. Everything's been scaled up to orcish proportions, of course, but the cut of the dress is clearly meant to stick close to the body and accentuate one's natural figure. "Orc women are strong, thick girls," Nelia explains. "I tried to come at it from an angle of bringing out her natural femininity without clashing with her strength. Looks good, doesn't it?" [party.has arona |At the sight of the frilly dress, Arona snorts, clearly trying to hold in her laughter. She tries to hide the big, tusked smile on her lips behind a hand, then when that fails, roars in belly-shaking mirth. Several heads turn in the marketplace towards the Kervus chieftain, and quickly decide that it's not a situation they want any part of — an amused orc can just be as dangerous as an enraged one. Nelia, on her part, is not amused. Arona must be almost twice the goblin's height, but the latter isn't deterred as she folds her arms under her prodigious rack and glowers up at Arona. The orcess just keeps on laughing and laughing, so hard that tears are starting to form in her eyes. One bout of laughter provokes another; it's a surprise she isn't already on the floor with how heartily she's taking it all. "Please, Hretha, tell me you're joking, tell me that this is all one big prank. Please tell me you're not going to seriously ask one of the Kervus to wear this — this thing. It's so... so..." "Girly?" Nelia's lips set into a thin line. "No Kervus would wear this. It'd be a disgrace. This is the kind of stuff the stories say the Empire dressed brown-skinned heartlanders in to civilize them." Nelia doesn't budge from the spot despite Arona looming over her. "From what [pc.name] tells me, the lady in question is already a bit of a pariah as things stand. I don't see the problem. And as for those last words, for my trade as a seamstress... those're fighting words, girl." Arona's smile fades, and she glowers down at Nelia. For several seconds, the two women trade death glares, and you wonder if you're going to have to step in before the situation escalates. There's still the matter of the lingerie... "Right." Whirling around and cleanly turning her back on Arona, Nelia picks up a couple more pieces from the rack behind her and sets them on the counter. You look back at Arona, who's looking not so much aggravated but sullenly thoughtful. Wonder what passed between the two of them there, but either way it's a good thing Arona's not making a scene in the market... |[party.has etheryn |"Oooh, it's pretty," Ryn says with a soft sigh, running her fingers against the linen. "It's not too different from the clothes I'd 'borrow' when I snuck down into the town — simple enough that I wouldn't draw undue attention when in the streets, but fine enough that I wouldn't get into certain kinds of trouble." "Thank you." Nelia dips her head. "You're certainly a nice girl with good discernment." "And you're certainly an excellent seamstress." "Shucks, now you're making a mother like me blush. Come on, then, let me show you something else that'll take your breath away." She turns back towards the racks and returns with two more pieces, setting them on the counter before you. "Now these are some mighty fine girls, I'd say!" |Hmm... light blue and yellow certainly have that something or the other about them. While you're not entirely sure the colors go perfectly with Ragnild's shade of swampy green — they'd certainly work better with a lighter green or maybe even a gray-skinned orc — they wouldn't have the energy and vibrancy they do without their current colors. Well, as they say, the perfect is the enemy of the good, plus you'd have to see it on Rags herself to make a final decision about the thing. "Putting together an outfit meant as a gift is oftentimes a lot of guesswork," Nelia replies. "I'm glad this turned out as well as it did." Right. She's certainly a skilled seamstress. "Aww, now you're making me blush, sweetheart. Come on, let me show you something that'll really set your heart to racing." Swiveling her little body upon the high stool, Nelia rummages amongst the racks behind her, pulling out two pieces and plonking them on the counter with a big smile. "Feast your eyes on this, [pc.mf|boy|girl]!" ] ] Ooooh. They're racy, and they're lacy. Size aside, the pinkish-white two-piece lingerie Nelia's put together is absolutely adorable; you're not sure what the fabric she used here is, but it feels really smooth and good under your fingers. "You said your lady orc was a good girl, so I went with a design that would bring out that aspect of her while still keeping the fact that, well, she's an orc in mind." The two-piece is absolutely amazing. You're going to have a field day getting Rags to try on all of this. You really owe her big time, all this is great! Nelia mocks wiping the sweat from her brow and gives you a thumbs-up. "To be frank, [pc.name], I should be the one thanking you. I haven't felt this inspired in a long time — the closest thing I've done are a few pieces for the local lupine ladies, but while the differences in body shape between them and an orc are subtle, they're no less important for being so. I hope your lady friend likes all this!" Yeah, you do, too.

] 哦哦哦，这些内衣既性感又带有蕾丝装饰。先不说尺码的问题，内莉娅这套粉白色的两件套内衣真的可爱极了；虽然不清楚她用了什么材质，但触感确实真的握在手中时，手感顺滑且舒适。 你说你的兽人女仆是个好女孩，所以我就设计了一个既能突出这一特点，同时又能够体现她其实是个兽人这一事实的方案。 这套两件套真的太棒了！让你让拉格斯试穿这些衣服，肯定会玩得很开心。你真的欠她一个人情债——这些东西实在太好了！ 内莉娅一边笑着擦去额头上的汗水，一边朝你竖起了大拇指。坦白说， [pc.name]，其实应该是我来感谢你才对。我已经很久没有这种灵感和创作冲动了——之前为当地的一些女性顾客设计过一些作品，虽然她们与兽人的体型差异并不明显，但这些细节同样非常重要。希望你的女朋友会喜欢这些设计！ 是啊，你也是。
rows.raw: " You make sure that everything's in order, then pass the winterstem over to Nelia. She examines the wild herbs for several moments, then gives you a satisfied nod before bundling the lot up in a bit of wax paper and tucking it all under her stall's counter. "That'll do. I only need a bit each time I get the dyes out, but even just a little is enough to ensure the color doesn't fade or wash out for months or more. Hopefully that'll tide me over until all this dies down, or at least until I can get someone else to find me some more fresh winterstem at a decent price." Now, about those clothes... "Of course, of course. I've got them all right here. Hold your horses." Nelia hops off her stool and rummages amongst the racks in the back of her stall. "Ah, there. What do you think?" The dress she hands you is a balanced blend of elegant and cute, fine linen dyed with light blues and warm, sunny yellows. As promised, it's sleeveless — all the better with which to show off Rags' muscular arms when she does put it on — and held up by twin loops of fabric that're clearly meant to go over the shoulders. The skirts reach down to somewhere about mid-thigh, and Nelia's trimmed them all around with dainty white lace. Everything's been scaled up to orcish proportions, of course, but the cut of the dress is clearly meant to stick close to the body and accentuate one's natural figure. "Orc women are strong, thick girls," Nelia explains. "I tried to come at it from an angle of bringing out her natural femininity without clashing with her strength. Looks good, doesn't it?" [party.has arona |At the sight of the frilly dress, Arona snorts, clearly trying to hold in her laughter. She tries to hide the big, tusked smile on her lips behind a hand, then when that fails, roars in belly-shaking mirth. Several heads turn in the marketplace towards the Kervus chieftain, and quickly decide that it's not a situation they want any part of — an amused orc can just be as dangerous as an enraged one. Nelia, on her part, is not amused. Arona must be almost twice the goblin's height, but the latter isn't deterred as she folds her arms under her prodigious rack and glowers up at Arona. The orcess just keeps on laughing and laughing, so hard that tears are starting to form in her eyes. One bout of laughter provokes another; it's a surprise she isn't already on the floor with how heartily she's taking it all. "Please, Hretha, tell me you're joking, tell me that this is all one big prank. Please tell me you're not going to seriously ask one of the Kervus to wear this — this thing. It's so... so..." "Girly?" Nelia's lips set into a thin line. "No Kervus would wear this. It'd be a disgrace. This is the kind of stuff the stories say the Empire dressed brown-skinned heartlanders in to civilize them." Nelia doesn't budge from the spot despite Arona looming over her. "From what [pc.name] tells me, the lady in question is already a bit of a pariah as things stand. I don't see the problem. And as for those last words, for my trade as a seamstress... those're fighting words, girl." Arona's smile fades, and she glowers down at Nelia. For several seconds, the two women trade death glares, and you wonder if you're going to have to step in before the situation escalates. There's still the matter of the lingerie... "Right." Whirling around and cleanly turning her back on Arona, Nelia picks up a couple more pieces from the rack behind her and sets them on the counter. You look back at Arona, who's looking not so much aggravated but sullenly thoughtful. Wonder what passed between the two of them there, but either way it's a good thing Arona's not making a scene in the market... |[party.has etheryn |"Oooh, it's pretty," Ryn says with a soft sigh, running her fingers against the linen. "It's not too different from the clothes I'd 'borrow' when I snuck down into the town — simple enough that I wouldn't draw undue attention when in the streets, but fine enough that I wouldn't get into certain kinds of trouble." "Thank you." Nelia dips her head. "You're certainly a nice girl with good discernment." "And you're certainly an excellent seamstress." "Shucks, now you're making a mother like me blush. Come on, then, let me show you something else that'll take your breath away." She turns back towards the racks and returns with two more pieces, setting them on the counter before you. "Now these are some mighty fine girls, I'd say!" |Hmm... light blue and yellow certainly have that something or the other about them. While you're not entirely sure the colors go perfectly with Ragnild's shade of swampy green — they'd certainly work better with a lighter green or maybe even a gray-skinned orc — they wouldn't have the energy and vibrancy they do without their current colors. Well, as they say, the perfect is the enemy of the good, plus you'd have to see it on Rags herself to make a final decision about the thing. "Putting together an outfit meant as a gift is oftentimes a lot of guesswork," Nelia replies. "I'm glad this turned out as well as it did." Right. She's certainly a skilled seamstress. "Aww, now you're making me blush, sweetheart. Come on, let me show you something that'll really set your heart to racing." Swiveling her little body upon the high stool, Nelia rummages amongst the racks behind her, pulling out two pieces and plonking them on the counter with a big smile. "Feast your eyes on this, [pc.mf|boy|girl]!" ] ] Ooooh. They're racy, and they're lacy. Size aside, the pinkish-white two-piece lingerie Nelia's put together is absolutely adorable; you're not sure what the fabric she used here is, but it feels really smooth and good under your fingers. "You said your lady orc was a good girl, so I went with a design that would bring out that aspect of her while still keeping the fact that, well, she's an orc in mind." The two-piece is absolutely amazing. You're going to have a field day getting Rags to try on all of this. You really owe her big time, all this is great! Nelia mocks wiping the sweat from her brow and gives you a thumbs-up. "To be frank, [pc.name], I should be the one thanking you. I haven't felt this inspired in a long time — the closest thing I've done are a few pieces for the local lupine ladies, but while the differences in body shape between them and an orc are subtle, they're no less important for being so. I hope your lady friend likes all this!" Yeah, you do, too. "

rows.original: Hretha's face splits into a big, toothy grin as you helpfully inform her that the deed's done. Seeing the Kervus oracle in a truly mischievous mood isn't something that you experience very often, but it sure is intense; even Infrith takes an uncertain step away from her mistress, startled by the sudden change in her demeanour. "Oh, it's done? Thank you for playing along. I was half-worried you'd think I wasn't serious... right, never mind. Could I please have a feel?" Well, no reason to deny her it. You hand over the sundress and lingerie, and Hretha sits herself down on one of her furs, carefully poring over the garments with her fingers. She moves slowly, savouring each inch with her fingertips; it's like she's afraid of tearing the cloth by accident. "Feels fine, very fine indeed. Ah-ha. Simple, cheap materials, but whoever sewed this together pushed their potential to the limit. It'll certainly let the skin breathe... definitely not something I'd wear on a daily basis or at sea, but... ah, this is too good." When Hretha finally hands back the sundress and lingerie to you, the seeress is choking back sobs and sniffling a little. Her milky, dead eyes are still as dry as ever, but her body shivers a little as she composes herself. So, what now? "We give them to her, of course — or more correctly, you give them to her. Make it an occasion she won't forget... give her a reason to use those gifts, right?" Huh... you may have an idea or two. Hretha purrs like a cat that just got the cream. "Now you're getting into the spirit of things. I really just want Rags to be happy — without Argoth breathing down her neck all the time, we can help her finally make at least some of her dreams reality, can't we?" Know what? You've come all this way, why not go the extra mile and take Ragnild out for a date, just the two of you? You ought to be able to wander down from the foothills, stay over at the Frost Hound, and be back at the camp by morning. A nice, candlelit meal... doesn't that just sound amazingly romantic? [pc.bgMulti courtesan bard |It feels a little awkward, to have your skills and past as a courtesan come up like this, but at the same time, once a charmer, always a charmer, eh? If nothing else, you're intimately familiar with all the cheesy romantic dalliances Rags no doubt idealises and you're completely jaded of at this point. Although... given how this goes, you may become a little less so when you're through... |While the mean-spirited rumours about bards bedding everything with a pulse are just that, you have had to ply your charms at times in the past in order to get a meal and a warm bed. If it's a sappy, cheesy romance that Rags wants, she's going to get a pretty damn good sappy, cheesy romance, if but for a night. |You're not entirely sure how well you'd be at trying to create a sappy romantic dinner out of a trashy novel, but you're willing to put in your best effort into it for Rags' sake. In for a penny, in for a pound. ] "Lumia's tits," Hretha groans, grinning from ear to ear. "I wish I had the use of my eyes for just a minute so I can see old Rags' face when you give her these new threads and ask her out to dinner. [dayNight |I know she's not going to tear herself away from her work until evening, but part of me just wants to drag her away from that forge and force her to go out with you right now |I've got a good mind to head out right now and drag her over — it's not like she's doing anything except eating another meal all by herself and moping like a wet dog anyway ].[party.som|| Your friend can stay here with me until you get back, no worries about that. | Your friends can stay here with me until you get back, no worries about that. ] How's that sound to you?" [party.has arona |"I don't know about that, sister," Arona says. "I do have a chieftain's throne, and then there's the lodge —" Hretha waggles a finger. "Tch. No, you're going to stay here with your dearest sister, Arona. Being chieftain isn't all about knocking it loose and kicking it back; there's a lot of responsibility you've got to catch up on now that you're in your brother's position. With you being out with [pc.name] and [pc.hisHer] adventures all the time, I don't get many chances to sit you down and teach you the things you need to know to rule properly." Arona squints at her sister as if deciding whether to stare her down or not, then folds her arms. "Fiiiine." "That's my little sister." ] Well then. With that out of the way and everything ready, it certainly sounds like an adventure. [dayNight |"Great. We've still got some time to kill before evening, so why don't you spend it with blind old Hretha? I promise I'll make it worth your while." The seeress is good to her word. The next few hours until evening are filled with you reading to Hretha, her brewing up some kind of bitter tea for you — a delayed aphrodisiac, she says — and her feeling up the clothes you got for Rags and oohing and aahing over them. Before you know it, the daylight has started to lengthen and the air cool, the night of the Marches descending quickly over the land. ] "Well, I'm going to get old Rags," Gerik nipping at her heels, Hretha grabs her staff and pushes aside the tent flap, her hound at her side. Maybe it's just that she's standing up straight, because she's moving more animatedly, but the seeress looks five years younger than she did when you came in. "This is going to be fun." With that, you're left in the tent to sort out your thoughts. [pc.bgMulti courtesan bard |Even though this isn't your first time on this rodeo by far, you can't help but feel a little something or the other that niggles at the back of your mind. Maybe it's the lack of all the cynicism that would usually accompany the experience, but... you're actually looking forward to this. You must be, to have gone to all that trouble, right? |A little fancy crosses your mind, to serenade poor Ragnild when Hretha finally drags her over, but then again, maybe not. The new clothes and proposal of wining and dining are going to shock her, a full-on musical number would probably stop the blacksmith's stout heart. |Like it or not, you can't help but feel a little nervous as you pace around, waiting for Hretha to return. You've already come this far, there's no turning back now. An orc who has different wants... who knew things would end up like this, really? ]
rows.translation: 当你热心地告诉她这件事已经完成时，赫蕾莎的脸上露出了灿烂而露齿的笑容。见到克尔维斯神谕者处于如此调皮捣蛋的状态，其实并不是经常会发生的事，但这种场景确实非常引人注目；就连因弗丽丝也因为她态度的突然转变而有些惊慌，不由得退后了几步。 哦，已经完成了？谢谢你的配合。我还有点担心你会觉得我不是认真的……不过算了，可以让我看看吗？ 嗯，没有理由拒绝她。你把那条连衣裙和内衣递给她，赫蕾莎便坐在她的一张毛皮毯子上，仔细地用手指检查那些衣物。她动作很慢，仿佛生怕不小心弄破那些布料一样，每一寸都仔细地端详着。 感觉挺好的，真的很好。啊哈，这些材料虽然简单、便宜，但制作这个的人把他们的技艺发挥到了极致。这种衣服肯定能让皮肤透气……不过，我肯定不会每天穿它，也不会在海上穿它，不过……啊，这真的太棒了。 当赫蕾莎最终把那条连衣裙和内衣还给你时，那位女先知强忍着泪水，抽抽搭搭地说话。她那双毫无神采的、乳白色的眼睛依然干涸如初，但在努力平静下来的过程中，她的身体却在微微颤抖。 那么，接下来该怎么做呢？ 我们当然会把它们交给她——或者更准确地说，你把它们送给她。让这个时刻成为她永生难忘的经历……给她一个使用这些礼物的理由，对吧？ 哈……你或许能想出一些办法来。 赫蕾莎像一只刚得到奶油的小猫一样，发出满足的呼噜声。现在你终于理解我的意思了。我真心希望拉格斯能够开心起来——只要没有阿戈斯一直对她紧追不舍，我们就能帮助她终于实现至少一些将她梦中的现实变为现实，难道不行吗？ 你知道吗？你已经走了这么远的路，何不再进一步，带着拉格妮尔德出去约会呢？就你们两个人一起。你们可以从山脚下出发，去寒霜猎犬旅馆住一晚，然后早上再回到营地。享受一顿美妙的烛光晚餐……听起来是不是非常浪漫呢？ [pc.bgMulti courtesan bard |虽然自己的技能以及过去作为交际花的经历被这样提及，确实有点尴尬，但话说回来，一个魅惑者，永远都是魅惑者，对吧？至少，你对那些拉格们肯定会幻想的那些老套浪漫情节了如指掌，而此刻，你已经对此感到彻底厌倦了。不过……看看事情的发展趋势，等这一切结束后，你或许就不会那么厌烦了…… |虽然那些关于吟游诗人与所有有生命的东西都发生过关系的小道消息只不过是些无稽之谈，但你拥有在过去，有时候为了得到一顿饭和一张温暖的床，你就不得不施展你的魅力了。如果拉格斯想要的只是一段俗气又煽情的浪漫故事，那么就算只有一晚，她也会得到一段非常俗气又煽情的浪漫故事。 |你其实不太确定，自己能否把一部低俗的小说改编成一场浪漫的晚餐，但为了拉格的缘故，你还是愿意全力以赴。既然决定了，那就必须全力以赴。 ] 卢米娅的胸部赫蕾莎咧着嘴，发出一声呻吟。我真希望自己能暂时恢复视力，哪怕只有一分钟也好，这样就能看到当你把这些新线交给老拉格斯，然后邀请她共进晚餐时，她脸上的表情了。 [dayNight |我知道她要一直工作到晚上才会停下来，但我内心真的很想把她从那里拉出来，强迫她和你一起出去。就是现在 |我现在真的很想立刻去把她拉过来——反正她也没在做什么，只不过是独自吃着饭，然后像个湿淋淋的狗一样闷闷不乐罢了 ]。[party.som|| 你的朋友可以和我一起待在这里，直到你回来，这一点不用担心。 | 你的朋友们可以和我一起在这里等着你回来，不用担心这个问题。 ]你觉得这样怎么样？ [party.has arona |这个我就不清楚了，姐姐。阿罗娜说道。我确实有一张酋长宝座，另外还有那间小屋…… 赫蕾莎摇动了一下手指。啧，不行。你得留在这里，和你最亲爱的姐姐阿罗娜在一起。当首领并不只是意味着肆意狂欢、放纵自我，其中还有很多责任和义务需要承担。很多既然你现在处于你哥哥的位置上，你就必须承担起相应的责任来。既然你正在[pc.name]以及[pc.hisHer]我总是忙于各种冒险，几乎没有机会坐下来教你那些真正有助于你妥善管理事务的知识。 阿罗娜眯起眼睛看着她的妹妹，似乎在考虑是否要瞪回去，最终她交叉双臂站好了姿势。好吧。 那是我的妹妹。 ] 那么，既然一切都准备妥当了，这确实听起来像是一场冒险。 [dayNight |太好了。在晚上之前我们还有些时间可以消磨，不如你陪那位失明的老妇人赫蕾莎一起度过吧？我保证你会觉得这很值得的。 那位女先知确实守住了她的承诺。在接下来的几个小时里，她为你给赫蕾莎读书，为你泡制某种苦茶——她说这种茶具有延迟作用的催情效果——还会仔细检查你为拉格斯准备的衣物，不时发出赞叹之声。不知不觉间，白昼开始变长，空气也变得凉爽起来，三月的夜晚迅速降临到了这片土地上。 ] 好吧，我去把老拉格斯叫过来。格里克紧追在她的身后，赫蕾莎抓起手中的法杖，推开了帐篷的门帘，她的猎犬也跟在她的身旁。也许只是因为她站得笔直了，所以动作显得更加敏捷，但这位女先知看起来比你刚见到她时年轻了整整五岁。这肯定会有趣。" 就这样，你被留在帐篷里，让自己有时间整理思绪。 [pc.bgMulti courtesan bard |虽然这已经不是你第一次经历这种事了，但还是会有某些情绪在脑海中萦绕不去。也许是因为这次并没有通常会伴随这种经历而来的那种愤世嫉俗的情绪，但……你其实是在期待着这次经历。毕竟你付出了这么多努力，肯定也是期待着有所收获的，对吧？ |当赫蕾莎终于把拉格妮尔德带到面前时，你突然想到了一些花招，想用歌声来取悦她，但转念一想，也许也没必要。那些新衣服以及邀请她共进美食的提议本身就已经足以让她震惊了；而如果再加上一段完整的音乐表演，恐怕连这位铁匠结实的心也会被打动吧。 |不管你愿不愿意，当你焦急地来回走动，等待赫蕾莎回来时，难免会感到有些紧张。你已经走到这一步了，现在再也回不去了。一个有着不同想法的兽人……谁会想到事情会发展成这样呢？真的吗？ ]

The next few hours until evening are filled with you reading to Hretha, her brewing up some kind of bitter tea for you — a delayed aphrodisiac, she says — and her feeling up the clothes you got for Rags and oohing and aahing over them. Before you know it, the daylight has started to lengthen and the air cool, the night of the Marches descending quickly over the land. ] "Well, I'm going to get old Rags," Gerik nipping at her heels, Hretha grabs her staff and pushes aside the tent flap, her hound at her side. Maybe it's just that she's standing up straight, because she's moving more animatedly, but the seeress looks five years younger than she did when you came in. "This is going to be fun." With that, you're left in the tent to sort out your thoughts. [pc.bgMulti courtesan bard |Even though this isn't your first time on this rodeo by far, you can't help but feel a little something or the other that niggles at the back of your mind. Maybe it's the lack of all the cynicism that would usually accompany the experience, but... you're actually looking forward to this. You must be, to have gone to all that trouble, right? |A little fancy crosses your mind, to serenade poor Ragnild when Hretha finally drags her over, but then again, maybe not. The new clothes and proposal of wining and dining are going to shock her, a full-on musical number would probably stop the blacksmith's stout heart. |Like it or not, you can't help but feel a little nervous as you pace around, waiting for Hretha to return. You've already come this far, there's no turning back now. An orc who has different wants... who knew things would end up like this, really? ]"

rows.original: At length, you steadily become aware of voices fading in from outside — unmistakably Hretha and Ragnild, with the occasional bark from Gerik. "Seriously, I was going to have a quiet night, Hretha. What's all this about?" "If I told you, it wouldn't be a surprise, right?" "Yes, but —" "I promise you, Rags, you won't regret it." "You said that about the watermelons, too!" "That was twenty-five years ago!" The tent flap lets out a dramatic whoosh as it's slapped aside and in comes Hretha, dragging Ragnild by the arm. Being blind really doesn't hinder her in getting around when she's excited like this... "Hretha, I really don't —" Ragnild stops as she sees you waiting in the tent, package in hand. Her eyes widen a little, and you see her body tense just a little. It's quite obvious with how muscular she is, not that she was ever the kind to hide her feelings. "[pc.name]? What are you doing here?" Right. You have something for her. Smiling and putting on your best face, you step forward and present the neatly folded sundress to Rags, complete with the lingerie below. She's blase about it for all of two seconds until she realizes just what it is that you're giving her, upon which the orcess' usual shade of dirty green turns almost positively outright brown about her face and shoulders. "This is..." Grinning, Hretha comes up and plants a steadying hand on Rags' shoulder as she trembles. "I saw [pc.name] coming up to your place with this in [pc.hisHer] hands, so I couldn't help but get myself involved. These things have to be proper, don't they?" Indeed they do. Would such a pretty lady like her do you the honor of taking a good look at the clothes you had made for her? Rags doesn't say anything; she just stands there for several moments, clearly trying to process all this. Then, the orcess gently unfolds the sundress and shakes it out, the fine fabric juxtaposed against her thick sausage fingers as she looks it over from top to bottom. Once, twice, thrice she tilts her head, her eyes fixed wholly upon the bright colors as if mesmerised. "Ah... ah! This is..." Does she want to try it on? "T-try it on? Here? Now?" Ragnild bites her lip, little tusks poking at full, black flesh. "I, uh, well —" It'd be great, because you fully intend to take her down to Hawkethorne for dinner, and you'd like her to look her best while she's out on the town, right? The two of you can stay at the Frost Hound for the night, and she can be back in the camp by morning to be at her work. There's absolutely no reason why she can't go. "That's right," Hretha adds. "I know you've no excuses on hand, no reason to flake that I can't deal with or can't wait till morning, Rags. Go out of the camp and have some fun with [pc.name], you've earned it." "You!" Ragnild rounds on Hretha. "You set [pc.name] up to this, didn't you?" "Well, some of it. I was going to keep my involvement a secret up to the end, but... seeing you like this is worth you being mad at me." "I-I'm not mad, I'm just —" "I know exactly how you feel, dear. Now then —" Yes, now you'd like to see her in that dress. The lingerie can wait for later; you'll hold onto it for her in the meantime. Ragnild swallows hard, and you note that there're tears in her eyes. A small, warm smile spreads upon her face, and it only widens when Hretha gives her shoulder an encouraging shake. "O-of course. Hretha, would you please get Infrith to bring out the screen?"
rows.translation: 终于，你逐渐注意到外面有声音渐渐传来——那些声音无疑是赫蕾莎和拉格妮尔德的，偶尔还能听到格里克发出的吠声。 说真的，我本来想安静地度过这个夜晚的，赫蕾莎。到底发生了什么事？ 如果我告诉你这个消息，你应该也不会感到惊讶吧？ 是的，但是—— 我向你保证，拉格斯，你不会后悔的。 你对西瓜也是这么说的啊！ 那已经是二十五年前的事了！ 帐篷的门帘随着被猛地拉开而发出一声剧烈的声响，赫蕾莎拖着拉格妮尔德的手部走了进来。当她如此兴奋的时候，失明其实并不会妨碍她的行动…… 赫蕾莎，我真的不……当拉格妮尔德看到你手持包裹在帐篷里等候时，她停下了脚步。她的双眼微微一瞪，你可以看出她的身体微微绷紧了。考虑到她那结实的身材，这一点其实非常明显——毕竟她从来都不是那种会隐藏自己情绪的人。"[pc.name]你在这里做什么？ 对了，你有点东西要给她。你微笑着，露出最友好的表情，走上前去，将那条折叠得整整齐齐的连衣裙以及里面的内衣一起递给了拉格斯。她只是淡淡地看了两秒钟，就立刻明白了你送给她的究竟是什么东西——于是，这个女妖那惯常的脏绿色脸色立刻变成了近乎棕色的难看颜色。 这是…… 赫蕾莎微笑着走上前，将一只稳重的手放在正在颤抖的拉格斯的肩上。我看到了。 [pc.name]带着这个去你家吧。 [pc.hisHer]我当时就在现场，所以忍不住参与了进来。这些事情必须得有人去处理。合适的他们不是这样做的吗？ 确实如此。像她这样一位美丽的女士，会不会愿意赏光看看你为她制作的那些衣服呢？ 拉格什么也没说，只是站在那里好一会儿，显然在努力消化这一切。然后，那个女妖轻轻展开那条连衣裙，把它抖了抖，那细腻的布料与她那粗壮的手指形成了鲜明的对比，她从上到下仔细地打量着这条裙子。她一次、两次、三次地歪着头，目光完全被那些鲜艳的颜色吸引住了，仿佛被迷住了般。 啊……啊！这是…… 她想试穿一下吗？ 试一试？现在就试吗？拉格妮尔德咬住了嘴唇，那两颗小小的獠牙轻轻触碰着她那饱满、乌黑的嘴唇。我，呃，嗯—— 那当然很好，因为你本来就打算带她去鹰棘镇吃晚餐，而且你也希望她在城里的时候看起来最漂亮，对吧？你们俩可以在寒霜猎犬旅馆过夜，而她早上就可以回到营地继续工作。她完全没有理由不能去。 没错。赫蕾莎补充道。我知道你没有任何借口，也没有任何理由临阵退缩——毕竟这些事情我完全可以处理，或者也可以等到明天早上再做。拉格斯，走出营地去，好好玩一玩吧。 [pc.name]，你确实值得这个。 你！拉格妮尔德向赫蕾莎发起了攻击。你设置了[pc.name]到现在为止，你还不明白吗？ 嗯，算是吧。我本来打算把我的参与保密到最后，但是……看到你现在的样子，就算你生我的气也是值得的。 我、我并没有生气，只是…… 我完全理解你的感受，亲爱的。那么现在—— 是的，现在你肯定想看到她穿那条裙子吧。那些内衣可以等会儿再拿；你暂时先替她收好吧。” 拉格妮尔德艰难地咽了口唾沫，你可以看到她的眼里噙着泪水。然而，当赫蕾莎鼓励性地轻拍她的肩膀时，她脸上浮现出了一丝温暖而微小的笑容，那笑容逐渐变得更加灿烂。 当、当然可以。赫蕾莎，你能请因弗丽丝把屏幕拿出来吗？

rows.original: You wouldn't have expected an islander orc to be bashful about nakedness, but there you have it. Infrith brings out a screen of hides stretched over a frame, Ragnild ducks behind it, and the Kervus blacksmith reappears several moments later with the sundress stretched out over her muscular frame. There's no other way to describe it — there's enough give in the skirts and room to move around, but Nelia wasn't kidding when she said it was form-fitting. Out of her bulky fur and apron and in this cute yet stylish dress, the contours of Rags' body are as plain as if she'd donned one of Hretha's outfits, but with a lot less skin shown. "How's this? I... I've never worn one of these before, so I had to make a few guesses as to what went where." She looks simply stunning. "It's hard to believe that..." As if on cue, Infrith brings up a small hand mirror for Ragnild, who studies herself in it, angling the silvered surface in the light to get a good look at herself. Slowly, Rags grows increasingly melancholy, her expression softening as she examines herself further. Finally, she raises a hand to her mouth and hands the mirror back to Infrith. "I don't even recognize me at this point..." "Nonsense, you're still the same old Rags, just prettied up like you always dreamed of doing. You look great, dear." Rags sighs. "Hretha, you're blind." "Yes, but I ran my fingers all over that dress not too long ago. I know it looks good on you — don't contradict me, now." Now then, she's going to twirl for you. "T-twirl?" Yes. You'd love to examine a blushing beauty like her in that wonderful dress from all angles, and what better way to do that than twirling? "I-um, I —" She can turn around on the spot, right? That's what twirling is at its base. "Yes, but there's the whole, I don't know, thing where you make your hair and skirts billow out like they describe in the books and that supposedly makes you really attractive amongst humans and elves —" Ha ha, [pc.bg courtesan |you know exactly what she means; you've been on both giving and receiving ends of such flourishes in your past. Still, ]Rags is decidedly cute in a way when she's flustered like this, isn't she? Either way, one step at a time; she can at least have a go at twirling. "All right, then. Sheesh, Lumia's tits..." Taking a deep breath to steel herself, Ragnild does her best to pirouette on the spot. Her stout frame and large feet aren't exactly suited to the job, but she manages to turn about herself with surprising alacrity, her high ponytail trailing in the air behind her. Indeed, you get a lovely view of the orcess in her sundress from all angles, Hretha getting her own %"look" by patting down her friend as she comes to a breathless stop. Yes, yes, very fetching, very fetching indeed. Now then, there's the matter of wining and dining... "N-now?!" You thought you'd made that clear earlier on. What better way to show off her new threads than to go out on the town with them? "Yeah, I heard you say it just now, [pc.name], but I..." Ragnild deflates with a huge sigh, cupping her chin in her palms and giving you a dreamy, fanged smile. "Actually, know what? I'm not going to try resisting this any more. If I'd wanted to stop, I ought to have done this long ago... so let's keep going and see where this takes us. You want to take me out to the little village to the west, right?" It's got the only place that serves food for miles around. You don't think she wants to head in to the lodge, does she? Rags waves off that question with a snort. "Hah, no. While it might be fun to create an uproar, the warriors' lodge is about as far from romantic as one can get. Besides, this isn't just about me, is it? It's about you, too. So why don't we make this special for the two of us?" Of course, of course. [pc.heightRange 74 84|Grabbing hold of Rags by her waist and pulling her close|Leaning down as you grab Rags by the waist and pull her close|Tiptoeing and reaching up as you grab Rags by the waist and pull her close], you plant a quick smooch on the orcess' lips. To your surprise, she squirms and blushes even deeper before returning the gesture with a quick peck on your cheek. A bit of a shy kisser, perhaps, but you have no doubt she'll learn to be more passionate in time." "Good luck to the both of you!" Hretha calls out after the both of you as you leave her tent. "Have fun, and watch your step going down the hills in the darkness!" Rags just laughs. You link your arm in hers, feeling the reassuring squeeze of her muscles, and set off. Several orcs stare at the two of you as you make your way out of the camp, but none actually bother you — up until you reach the camp gates. As the gate comes into view, the orcish thane on duty rolls an eye up at you, then at Rags in her frilly, fetching and feminine sundress. First he looks various shades of dumbfounded, eyes wide and mouth open, then all his lackeys follow suit, frozen as they're trying to process what it is that they're seeing. At last, the entire gate guard breaks out into uproarious laughter, pointing and snorting at their blacksmith. "Rags! I know that Arona's ousted her brother, but even with Argoth exiled you think you an cut yourself loose like that? This is elf clothing, and the shame —" "Let me handle this, [pc.name]." Ragnild smiles sweetly and steps up to the thane, stopping a few paces before him and bobbing a curtsey — or at least, she tries to. If nothing else, she now has his whole and undivided attention. "Elf clothing, you say." "That's right, elf clothing, and why any self-respecting orc would be caught dead wearing —" The thane doesn't get to finish his sentence, because Ragnild's fist has already made solid contact with his jaw with a meaty smack. The impact lifts the thane a couple inches up into the air, his weapon falling sideways onto the grass, and he collapses backward onto the ground. Dazed but certainly in no less humorous a mood, he rubs his bruised chin and cranes his neck upward to look Rags in the eye and grin. "All right, all right, you've made your point. You're heading out so late?" "[pc.name] and I," Rags declares authoritatively, "are going on a date. We won't be back in camp until next morning, so you don't have to stay up for us." "Hey, it's no skin off my nose. Knock yourself out if you want to get all chummy with the village out west." "Hmph. Come on, [pc.name], let's go." Wow. Even in a pretty, frilly dress like this, guess Rags is still Rags... just because she has a softer side doesn't mean the hard side's vanished, either. Taking Rags' hand in yours, you lead her through the open gates and down into the foothills.
rows.translation: 你肯定不会想到，一个岛上的兽人竟然会因为裸露身体而感到害羞，但事实就是如此。因弗丽丝拿出一块覆盖在框架上的兽皮，拉格妮尔德躲到了它的后面，几分钟后，凯尔维斯铁匠又出现了，他将那条连衣裙披在了拉格妮尔德结实的身体上。没有其他方式可以形容它了——裙子的设计确实足够宽松，穿着也相当舒适，活动空间充足，但内莉娅说这条裙子非常贴身，这话一点不假。脱掉她那厚厚的毛皮和围裙，穿上这条既可爱又时尚的裙子，拉格斯的身体曲线显得格外清晰，简直就像她穿上了赫蕾莎的服装一样，只不过露出的皮肤面积要少得多。 这样怎么样？我……我以前从来没穿过这种东西，所以有些地方该放什么我也不知道，只能靠猜测来决定。 她看起来简直美得令人窒息。 真难以相信…… 仿佛是事先约定好的，因弗丽丝递给拉格妮尔德一面小手镜。拉格妮尔德仔细端详着自己的容貌，在光线的照射下调整镜面的角度，以便更清楚地看到自己。渐渐地，她的神情变得愈发忧郁，目光注视着自己的脸庞时，表情也变得更加柔和。最后，她将手放在嘴边，然后将镜子还给了因弗丽丝。 到现在，我甚至都认不出自己来了…… 别开玩笑了，你还是那个老拉格斯，只不过打扮得比你一直以来梦想中的样子还要漂亮而已。你看起来真的很棒，亲爱的。 拉格叹了口气。赫蕾莎，你盲的。" 是的，不过不久前我还用手指仔细摸过那条裙子呢。知道你穿这个真的很合适——现在可别反驳我哦。 那么，现在她要为你跳一段旋转舞了。 旋转？ 没错。你肯定很想从各个角度仔细欣赏她穿着那条漂亮裙子、面带红晕的美丽模样，而有什么比让她旋转起来更棒的方式呢？ 我、呃，我—— 她可以在原地转体，对吧？旋转的动作其实就是基于这个原理的。 是的，但是还有那个问题……就是如何让自己的头发和裙子像书里描述的那样飘扬起来。那个据说，这种特性会让你在人类和精灵中显得格外吸引人。 哈哈， [pc.bg courtesan |你完全明白她的意思；在过去，你既曾经给予过这样的关怀与帮助，也曾经接受过别人同样的举动。不过， ]当拉格这样慌乱的时候，她确实显得挺可爱的，不是吗？不管怎样，一步一个足印地来吧；至少她可以试着旋转一下看看。 好吧，那就这样吧。天啊，卢米娅的胸部…… 拉格妮尔德深吸一口气，强作镇定，尽力在原地完成一个旋转动作。她结实的身材和较大的脚掌其实并不太适合这项动作，但她还是以惊人的敏捷度完成了旋转，高高的马尾辫在身后飘动。确实，从各个角度来看，都能看到那位穿着连衣裙的女子那迷人的身姿。当赫蕾莎气喘吁吁地停下来时，她还轻轻拍了拍她的朋友，让自己也能欣赏到那“美貌”。 没错，确实非常迷人，真的非常迷人。那么，接下来就是请客吃饭的问题了…… 现在？！ 你本来以为自己之前已经说得很清楚了。还有什么比带着她的新发丝去城里逛逛更合适的方式来展示它们呢？ 是啊，我刚才确实听到你这么说了。 [pc.name]，但是，我……拉格妮尔德长叹一声，双手托着下巴，露出一个充满梦幻色彩、带着獠牙的微笑。其实，你知道吗？我不会再试图抗拒下去了。如果我真的想停下来，早就应该这么做了……所以，我们就继续吧，看看这条路会把我们引向哪里。你是想带我去西边的那个小村庄，对吧？ 这是方圆几英里范围内唯一一家提供食物的地方。你不会认为她想走进那间小屋吧？ 拉格嗤之以鼻，没有回答那个问题。哈，不是的。虽然惹点动静确实挺有趣的，但战士会所可远远称不上浪漫的地方。再说，这件事不仅仅关乎我，对吧？你也牵涉其中。那么，为什么不让这件事只属于我们两个人呢？ 当然，当然。 [pc.heightRange 74 84|她抓住拉格斯的腰，将她拉到自己身边。|你弯下身子，抓住拉格斯的腰，将她拉到自己身边。|你踮起脚尖，伸手抓住拉格的腰，将她拉到自己身边。]你轻轻在她的嘴唇上吻了一下。令你惊讶的是，她扭动着身体，脸红得更加厉害，然后也回吻了你一下，轻触了一下你的脸颊。或许这个吻有点害羞，但你毫不怀疑，随着时间的推移，她一定会学会更加热情地去表达自己的感情。 祝你们俩好运！当你们两人离开她的帐篷时，赫蕾莎叫住了你们。玩得开心点，不过在黑暗中下山坡的时候可得小心脚步！ 拉格只是笑了笑。你将手臂搭在她的肩上，感受到她肌肉带来的那种令人安心的触感，然后你们便一起出发了。当你们离开营地时，有几只兽人盯着你们看，但它们并没有真正来打扰你们——直到你们走到营地的大门前。当大门逐渐进入视线时，正在值班的兽人侍卫朝你瞥了一眼，然后又将目光转向穿着那条褶边繁复、极具女性魅力的连衣裙的拉格斯。起初，他露出了各种令人难以置信的表情，眼睛瞪得大大的，嘴巴也张得老大；随后，他的所有仆从也都纷纷效仿他的动作，呆立在原地，试图理解他们眼前所看到的一切究竟意味着什么。终于，所有的守门人都爆发出哄堂大笑，他们指指点点，嘲笑着他们的铁匠。 拉格斯！我知道阿罗娜把她的兄弟赶走了，但就算阿戈斯把你流放了，你也以为自己就能就这样摆脱束缚吗？这简直精灵衣物等等真丢脸。 —" 让我来处理这件事吧。 [pc.name]。"拉格妮尔德甜美地笑了笑，走上前去，停在领主面前几步远的地方，然后轻轻鞠了一躬——至少她是这么做的。尝试至少，现在她得到了他全部且专一的关注。你是说精灵服装啊。 没错，精灵服装……哪个有自尊的兽人会穿着这种东西出现在别人面前呢—— 那位领主还没来得及说完话，拉格妮尔德的拳头就已经狠狠地击中了他的下巴，发出“咚”的一声。这一击让他整个人被掀到了半空中，他的武器也掉在了草地上，随后他向后倒在地上。虽然有些头晕，但他的心情显然并没有因此而变差——他揉了揉受伤的下巴，然后仰起头，直视着拉格妮尔德的眼睛，露出了笑容。 好吧好吧，你把意思表达清楚了。这么晚还要出门吗？ "[pc.name]还有我，拉格斯以权威的口吻宣称：他们要去约会了。我们要到明天早上才会回到营地，所以你们不必为了等我们而熬夜。 嘿，这又不是跟我有什么关系。如果你想和西边的那个村子搞好关系，那就随你便吧。 哼，得了吧， [pc.name]，我们走吧。 哇，即使穿着这样一件漂亮、花边繁多的裙子，拉格斯依然还是拉格斯……她虽然有温柔的一面，但强硬的一面也并没有消失。你握住拉格斯的手部，带着她穿过敞开的大门，走向山脚下。
rows.raw: ' You wouldn't have expected an islander orc to be bashful about nakedness, but there you have it. Infrith brings out a screen of hides stretched over a frame, Ragnild ducks behind it, and the Kervus blacksmith reappears several moments later with the sundress stretched out over her muscular frame. There's no other way to describe it — there's enough give in the skirts and room to move around, but Nelia wasn't kidding when she said it was form-fitting. Out of her bulky fur and apron and in this cute yet stylish dress, the contours of Rags' body are as plain as if she'd donned one of Hretha's outfits, but with a lot less skin shown. "How's this? I... I've never worn one of these before, so I had to make a few guesses as to what went where." She looks simply stunning. "It's hard to believe that..." As if on cue, Infrith brings up a small hand mirror for Ragnild, who studies herself in it, angling the silvered surface in the light to get a good look at herself. Slowly, Rags grows increasingly melancholy, her expression softening as she examines herself further. Finally, she raises a hand to her mouth and hands the mirror back to Infrith. "I don't even recognize me at this point..." "Nonsense, you're still the same old Rags, just prettied up like you always dreamed of doing. You look great, dear." Rags sighs. "Hretha, you're blind." "Yes, but I ran my fingers all over that dress not too long ago. I know it looks good on you — don't contradict me, now." Now then, she's going to twirl for you. "T-twirl?" Yes. You'd love to examine a blushing beauty like her in that wonderful dress from all angles, and what better way to do that than twirling? "I-um, I —" She can turn around on the spot, right? That's what twirling is at its base. "Yes, but there's the whole, I don't know, thing where you make your hair and skirts billow out like they describe in the books and that supposedly makes you really attractive amongst humans and elves —" Ha ha, [pc.bg courtesan |you know exactly what she means; you've been on both giving and receiving ends of such flourishes in your past. Still, ]Rags is decidedly cute in a way when she's flustered like this, isn't she? Either way, one step at a time; she can at least have a go at twirling. "All right, then. Sheesh, Lumia's tits..." Taking a deep breath to steel herself, Ragnild does her best to pirouette on the spot. Her stout frame and large feet aren't exactly suited to the job, but she manages to turn about herself with surprising alacrity, her high ponytail trailing in the air behind her. Indeed, you get a lovely view of the orcess in her sundress from all angles, Hretha getting her own %"look" by patting down her friend as she comes to a breathless stop. Yes, yes, very fetching, very fetching indeed. Now then, there's the matter of wining and dining... "N-now?!" You thought you'd made that clear earlier on. What better way to show off her new threads than to go out on the town with them? "Yeah, I heard you say it just now, [pc.name], but I..." Ragnild deflates with a huge sigh, cupping her chin in her palms and giving you a dreamy, fanged smile. "Actually, know what? I'm not going to try resisting this any more. If I'd wanted to stop, I ought to have done this long ago... so let's keep going and see where this takes us. You want to take me out to the little village to the west, right?" It's got the only place that serves food for miles around. You don't think she wants to head in to the lodge, does she? Rags waves off that question with a snort. "Hah, no. While it might be fun to create an uproar, the warriors' lodge is about as far from romantic as one can get. Besides, this isn't just about me, is it? It's about you, too. So why don't we make this special for the two of us?" Of course, of course. [pc.heightRange 74 84|Grabbing hold of Rags by her waist and pulling her close|Leaning down as you grab Rags by the waist and pull her close|Tiptoeing and reaching up as you grab Rags by the waist and pull her close], you plant a quick smooch on the orcess' lips. To your surprise, she squirms and blushes even deeper before returning the gesture with a quick peck on your cheek. A bit of a shy kisser, perhaps, but you have no doubt she'll learn to be more passionate in time." "Good luck to the both of you!" Hretha calls out after the both of you as you leave her tent. "Have fun, and watch your step going down the hills in the darkness!" Rags just laughs. You link your arm in hers, feeling the reassuring squeeze of her muscles, and set off. Several orcs stare at the two of you as you make your way out of the camp, but none actually bother you — up until you reach the camp gates. As the gate comes into view, the orcish thane on duty rolls an eye up at you, then at Rags in her frilly, fetching and feminine sundress. First he looks various shades of dumbfounded, eyes wide and mouth open, then all his lackeys follow suit, frozen as they're trying to process what it is that they're seeing. At last, the entire gate guard breaks out into uproarious laughter, pointing and snorting at their blacksmith. "Rags! I know that Arona's ousted her brother, but even with Argoth exiled you think you an cut yourself loose like that? This is elf clothing, and the shame —" "Let me handle this, [pc.name]." Ragnild smiles sweetly and steps up to the thane, stopping a few paces before him and bobbing a curtsey — or at least, she tries to. If nothing else, she now has his whole and undivided attention. "Elf clothing, you say." "That's right, elf clothing, and why any self-respecting orc would be caught dead wearing —" The thane doesn't get to finish his sentence, because Ragnild's fist has already made solid contact with his jaw with a meaty smack. The impact lifts the thane a couple inches up into the air, his weapon falling sideways onto the grass, and he collapses backward onto the ground. Dazed but certainly in no less humorous a mood, he rubs his bruised chin and cranes his neck upward to look Rags in the eye and grin. "All right, all right, you've made your point. You're heading out so late?" "[pc.name] and I," Rags declares authoritatively, "are going on a date. We won't be back in camp until next morning, so you don't have to stay up for us." "Hey, it's no skin off my nose. Knock yourself out if you want to get all chummy with the village out west." "Hmph. Come on, [pc.name], let's go." Wow. Even in a pretty, frilly dress like this, guess Rags is still Rags... just because she has a softer side doesn't mean the hard side's vanished, either. Taking Rags' hand in yours, you lead her through the open gates and down into the foothills.'

rows.original: "Table for two?" Yes, please. For you, and for the orc lady at your side. Garth looks a little apprehensive, scratching his chin in confusion as his big, blue eyes dart between Ragnild and you. At last, he gives up trying to make sense of the situation and decides to go with the flow. "Sorry we don't have any booths or the like in those fancy establishments in the big cities. Good thing the common room's quite empty at this time of day — if you want privacy, I'll give you a corner table. You want candles with that, too?" If he doesn't mind. "I have a couple left over from the last batch Sanders ordered for the chapel. Might be a bit too holy for a little rend... renduz... meeting like this, but better than nothing. I'll have Gwyn bring them out." It's not the stuff of fairytales, but it's certainly far more than Ragnild's ever had in her life. The orcess is still in a mild state of shock ever since she stepped into the Frost Hound, not quite believing what's happening to her. It's endearing in a way, seeing how she's reacting to the new experience — you wonder if you'd have felt the same way if the roles were reversed and you were wearing Kervus furs, landing on her home islands for the first time. Heh. Well, it can't hurt to let her gape and gawk for a bit, can it? It's nice to see this other side of the no-nonsense orc smith for once. You reach the table, and pull out the chair for your date; poor Rags tries to gather her skirts to sit — she clearly has a theoretical idea of how it should be done, but the way she's fumbling with her orc-sized sundress shows the difference between theory and practice. It's just too adorable, her fingers grasping at Nelia's fine work before finally managing to smooth them out. "Hey, are you laughing?" A little bit. Rags looks like she's going to pout, then breaks into a tusky smile. "Yeah, I can see why. Oh look, and there come the candles." Indeed, there they come. Gwyn's coming up to your table, an old silvered candlestick in hand, the fat tallow candle atop it lit with a cheery little flame. She's even gone to the trouble of adding a little ribbon tied in a bow about her neck, a clear attempt to look the part of a fancy waitress — too bad her mother's penchant for uniforms still shines so much through her... "Oh, hey! Daddy said that the two of you were going to have a romantic dinner, and I tried dressing up and getting into the mood, and — oh! You look amazing, miss orc! That is a great dress! I'd like to wear something like that someday, but it looks like it'd be hard to get stains out of, so —" If she would take your order, please. "O-oh! Right, of course! You two need to have a great dinner date — what can I get you? I'll cook anything the two of you want!" You don't know about that. Perhaps she could surprise you — something romantic, perhaps? "I have just the idea! Why don't the two of you make chit-chat and eyes at each other while I whip it up?" With that, Gwyn scurries away, leaving the two of you to gaze deep into each others' eyes over the flickering light of a single scented candle. Hah, yeah... "Sprightly little girl, isn't she?" Rags says with a chuckle. Why, they don't have those out amongst the islander orcs? A sigh. "Not really... Hretha was a bit like that when she was a spratling of only five or six, I suppose. However, knowing that she was going to be oracle when she grew up soon sucked that attitude right out of her. There aren't many places where that kind of ditzy fascination with the world gets to last long — girl probably had a sheltered childhood." Thinking back on how Garth dotes on his daughter? Yeah... while Gwyn's no stranger to hard manual labor, her mind's been pretty sheltered considering the upbringing she's had. But enough about your waitress for tonight — how about turning the conversation to her? "Me?" Well, it's her big night out, after all, and you even got her a dress to go with it. Of course the conversation's going to be about her, right? Even in the dim candlelight, you can see Ragnild blush a little Hmm, well. Does she have any foods that she doesn't really like? "It doesn't really matter, does it? Out in the islands, food's hard enough to get — farming's hard on the rocky soil, and fishing has its own risks. Raiding, even more so. Hard work's gone into putting that food on the table, and I'm smart enough to eat it so long as it isn't going to poison me." You point out she's evading the question. Rags huffs. "So what if I am? It's not as if I'm going to be picky on a dinner date, am I?" There she goes again, not giving a direct answer. "... Fine, I don't like broccoli. It's hard, it's weird, and it tastes like crap no matter what you put on it or what you serve it with. Hey, if we get any would you be willing to take it off my hands?" Well... you'd have to think about that. "There you go, not giving me a direct answer." You laugh. To be honest, she doesn't need to worry. Gwyn did say that she was going to cook you a romantic meal, and broccoli doesn't make for a very romantic dish. Indeed, here she comes, returning with a big platter of cubed ham on lettuce leaves, and a basket of bread. Beaming, the nursery-matron-turned-waitress gives you a little bow, adds a jug of ale to the spread, and takes a step back with another bow. "W-well. I'll just leave the both of you to it, then!" And she does. You have to admit that Gwyn made a pretty good choice in the cubed ham — it's fancy enough to suit the occasion, but also familiar enough to the likes of Ragnild that she wouldn't be put off by it and filling by orc standards to match. She really is a little clever puppy... on her part, Rags is making an effort to not look like the savage barbarian of an orc that she is, toying around with the knife and fork meant for lupine hands — which, of course, means just a bit undersized for a big orc girl her size. She's really giving it her all in trying to be refined and elegant, and it's really funny in a heartwarming way. Ragnild stops, fork half-raised to her mouth. "You're not eating?" Oh, you were just thinking about how you got into this situation, and you're glad you did. Seeing her in a sundress, having the romantic meal that she always wanted, with someone she cares about... it feels really good to see her fulfilled like this, especially since she'd never be able to get away with something like this under Argoth's rule as chieftain. Arona's not too different from her brother, you suppose, but in the end she doesn't have it out for poor Rags. "I..." Rags looks down at the ham cube speared on her fork, sets it down, and swallows hard. "I think you usually say this at the end of the night and all — that's how it goes down in the books — but thanks for taking me out like this. It means a lot to me... although Hretha put you up to it, didn't she?" Yeah, she did, you're not going to lie about it. But that doesn't change the fact that you wanted to help her find some sort of peace with her wants, which the Kervus would — no mincing words about it — find deviant. Hretha just told you the best way to go about it. Ragnild pauses for a bit, the light of the scented candles flickering in her eyes. Then, she smiles and picks her fork back up. "Of course. Come on, [pc.name], the food's getting cold and it is very good. I'll feed you." She will? "Okay, just one bite." She raises her fork and reaches across the table. "Open wide, then." Sheesh... but at the same time, you have to admit the gesture's very endearing, and as you chew, the food is very good. The two of you finish the rest of your meal in silence as the scented candle slowly burns down — not that you don't have anything to say to each other, but what needs to be said can be easily and properly conveyed without needing to resort to words. Garth brings out a bucket of iced wine somewhere in the middle of the meal — he's changed into a very ill-fitting waistcoat and bowtie for the task — bows, and leaves. At length, the both of you finish up, wipe with napkins, and share a Look[silly| with a capital L] over the empty dishes and stub of candle that remains. "Thanks," Rags says, her eyes lowered and voice a little subdued. "Like I said, this... means a lot to me. It was fun." It's clear that it's taking a lot out of her to say those words, the likes of probably would certainly have no place if you were in her usual company. But that's all right. She doesn't need to thank you just yet — the night is still young, after all. "Upstairs, then?" Ah. You reach for Ragnild's massive ham-hand, calluses, burn scars and all, and take it in yours. The strength of her grip is plain even at a simple touch, and she allows you to help her out of her seat; Rags is still getting used to wearing a dress without tearing it up with her usual movements, and you give those thick fingers an encouraging squeeze. So long as that's what she wants... "Of course."
rows.translation: 两人桌吗？ 好的，请吧。这是为了你，也是为了你身旁的那个兽人女士。 加斯看起来有些困惑，他挠着下巴，那双蓝色的大眼睛在拉格妮尔德和你之间来回转动。最终，他放弃了试图理解这种状况的尝试，决定顺其自然吧。抱歉，在大城市里那些高档场所，我们并没有设置任何包间之类的设施。不过好在现在这个时间，公共休息室里没什么人……如果你想要私密空间，我可以给你安排一张角落桌。另外，你还需要蜡烛吗？ 如果他不介意的话。 上批桑德斯为小教堂准备的物品里还剩下一些。虽然用来举行这样的聚会可能有点过于正式了……但总比没有好。我会让格温把它们拿过来。 这虽然算不上童话故事中的情节，但无疑远远超出了拉格妮尔德一生中所拥有的一切。自从她走进霜犬酒馆号之后，这个女妖仍然处于一种轻微的震惊状态中，她几乎无法相信自己身上正在发生什么。从她对这种新体验的反应来看，这种情景还挺可爱的——你会不禁想，如果角色互换，你是穿上凯尔维斯毛皮，第一次降落在她的家乡岛屿上，会不会也有同样的感受呢？ 呵呵，让她瞪大眼睛、目瞪口呆一会儿，也没什么坏处吧？难得能看到这个严肃认真的兽人铁匠的另一面呢。 你走到桌子旁，为你的约会对象拉出椅子；可怜的拉格斯则试图整理她的裙摆以便坐下——她显然在理论上知道应该怎么做，但当她笨手笨脚地摆弄那条适合兽人穿的连衣裙时，理论与实践之间的差距就显而易见了。实在太可爱了，她的手指紧紧抓住奈莉亚精心制作的作品，最终还是成功地将它们抚平了。 嘿，你在笑吗？ 有点吧。 拉格看起来像是要撅起嘴来，但随后却露出了一个灿烂的笑容。是啊，我明白为什么了。哦，看，蜡烛来了。 果然，他们来了。格温正走向你们的桌子，手里拿着一支镀银的老烛台，烛台顶端的牛脂蜡烛正散发着欢快的火焰。她甚至还特意在脖子上系了一条打成蝴蝶结的丝带，显然是想努力呈现出一名优雅服务生的形象——可惜她母亲对制服的偏爱还是让她显得那么与众不同…… 哦，嘿！爸爸说你们俩要一起吃一顿浪漫的晚餐，我还特意打扮了一番，想要营造那种氛围呢——哦！你看起来真是太漂亮了，兽人小姐！那条裙子真是太棒了！我也想有一天能穿上这样的裙子，不过看起来那种裙子应该很难清洗掉污渍吧，所以…… 如果她愿意接受您的订单，那就请她吧。 哦哦！对，当然了！你们俩应该好好共进一顿晚餐——需要我准备些什么呢？只要你们想吃的，我什么都会做！ 你可能还不知道这件事。也许她能给你一个惊喜——比如一些浪漫的东西吧？ 我有个主意！你们俩就一边聊天、一边互相抛媚眼吧，我来负责准备这些东西。 说完，格温便匆匆离开了，留下你们俩在那一支散发着香气的蜡烛微光下，深深地对视着彼此的眼睛。哈，没错…… 那个活泼可爱的小女孩，对吧？拉格斯轻笑着说道： “哎呀，那些东西在岛民兽人中间应该也有吧？” “唉也不完全是……我想，当赫蕾莎还只有五六岁的时候，她也是这样的。不过，后来她知道自己长大后会成为先知，这种对世界的天真好奇心也就渐渐消失了。毕竟，很少有地方能让这种纯粹的探索欲持续太久——这个女孩大概度过了一个相对安逸、受保护的童年吧。 回想一下加斯是如何宠爱他女儿的？没错……虽然格温并不排斥体力劳动，但考虑到她的成长环境，她的思想其实一直比较保守、缺乏开阔的视野。不过，关于今晚这位女服务员的话题就说到这里吧——我们是不是应该把话题转向她呢？ 我？ 嗯，毕竟这是她的重要夜晚，而且你还专门为她准备了一条裙子。当然，谈话的内容肯定也会围绕她来展开，对吧？ 即使在昏暗的烛光下，你也能看到拉格妮尔德的脸微微红了。 嗯，那么……她有没有什么特别不喜欢吃的食物呢？ 其实也没什么关系吧？在那些岛屿上，食物本来就很难获得——在多岩石的土地上耕种非常困难，捕鱼也有很大的风险，而抢劫更是如此。人们付出了很多努力才把那些食物端上餐桌，只要这些食物不会让我中毒，我当然会吃下去。 你指出她在回避这个问题。 破布哼了一声。就算我是这样又怎样？我又不是在挑选晚餐约会对象，对吧？ 她又这样了，就是不直接回答问题。 ……好吧，我确实不喜欢西兰花。它太硬了，味道也很奇怪，不管你怎么烹饪或者搭配什么食材，它吃起来都很难吃。嘿，如果我们家里有西兰花，你愿意帮我把它处理掉吗？ 嗯……这个你得好好考虑一下。 看吧，你就是不肯直接回答我。 rows.raw: " "Table for two?" Yes, please. For you, and for the orc lady at your side. Garth looks a little apprehensive, scratching his chin in confusion as his big, blue eyes dart between Ragnild and you. At last, he gives up trying to make sense of the situation and decides to go with the flow. "Sorry we don't have any booths or the like in those fancy establishments in the big cities. Good thing the common room's quite empty at this time of day — if you want privacy, I'll give you a corner table. You want candles with that, too?" If he doesn't mind. "I have a couple left over from the last batch Sanders ordered for the chapel. Might be a bit too holy for a little rend... renduz... meeting like this, but better than nothing. I'll have Gwyn bring them out." It's not the stuff of fairytales, but it's certainly far more than Ragnild's ever had in her life. The orcess is still in a mild state of shock ever since she stepped into the Frost Hound, not quite believing what's happening to her. It's endearing in a way, seeing how she's reacting to the new experience — you wonder if you'd have felt the same way if the roles were reversed and you were wearing Kervus furs, landing on her home islands for the first time. Heh. Well, it can't hurt to let her gape and gawk for a bit, can it? It's nice to see this other side of the no-nonsense orc smith for once. You reach the table, and pull out the chair for your date; poor Rags tries to gather her skirts to sit — she clearly has a theoretical idea of how it should be done, but the way she's fumbling with her orc-sized sundress shows the difference between theory and practice. It's just too adorable, her fingers grasping at Nelia's fine work before finally managing to smooth them out. "Hey, are you laughing?" A little bit. Rags looks like she's going to pout, then breaks into a tusky smile. "Yeah, I can see why. Oh look, and there come the candles." Indeed, there they come. Gwyn's coming up to your table, an old silvered candlestick in hand, the fat tallow candle atop it lit with a cheery little flame. She's even gone to the trouble of adding a little ribbon tied in a bow about her neck, a clear attempt to look the part of a fancy waitress — too bad her mother's penchant for uniforms still shines so much through her... "Oh, hey! Daddy said that the two of you were going to have a romantic dinner, and I tried dressing up and getting into the mood, and — oh! You look amazing, miss orc! That is a great dress! I'd like to wear something like that someday, but it looks like it'd be hard to get stains out of, so —" If she would take your order, please. "O-oh! Right, of course! You two need to have a great dinner date — what can I get you? I'll cook anything the two of you want!" You don't know about that. Perhaps she could surprise you — something romantic, perhaps? "I have just the idea! Why don't the two of you make chit-chat and eyes at each other while I whip it up?" With that, Gwyn scurries away, leaving the two of you to gaze deep into each others' eyes over the flickering light of a single scented candle. Hah, yeah... "Sprightly little girl, isn't she?" Rags says with a chuckle. Why, they don't have those out amongst the islander orcs? A sigh. "Not really... Hretha was a bit like that when she was a spratling of only five or six, I suppose. However, knowing that she was going to be oracle when she grew up soon sucked that attitude right out of her. There aren't many places where that kind of ditzy fascination with the world gets to last long — girl probably had a sheltered childhood." Thinking back on how Garth dotes on his daughter? Yeah... while Gwyn's no stranger to hard manual labor, her mind's been pretty sheltered considering the upbringing she's had. But enough about your waitress for tonight — how about turning the conversation to her? "Me?" Well, it's her big night out, after all, and you even got her a dress to go with it. Of course the conversation's going to be about her, right? Even in the dim candlelight, you can see Ragnild blush a little Hmm, well. Does she have any foods that she doesn't really like? "It doesn't really matter, does it? Out in the islands, food's hard enough to get — farming's hard on the rocky soil, and fishing has its own risks. Raiding, even more so. Hard work's gone into putting that food on the table, and I'm smart enough to eat it so long as it isn't going to poison me." You point out she's evading the question. Rags huffs. "So what if I am? It's not as if I'm going to be picky on a dinner date, am I?" There she goes again, not giving a direct answer. "... Fine, I don't like broccoli. It's hard, it's weird, and it tastes like crap no matter what you put on it or what you serve it with. Hey, if we get any would you be willing to take it off my hands?" Well... you'd have to think about that. "There you go, not giving me a direct answer." You laugh. To be honest, she doesn't need to worry. Gwyn did say that she was going to cook you a romantic meal, and broccoli doesn't make for a very romantic dish. Indeed, here she comes, returning with a big platter of cubed ham on lettuce leaves, and a basket of bread. Beaming, the nursery-matron-turned-waitress gives you a little bow, adds a jug of ale to the spread, and takes a step back with another bow. "W-well. I'll just leave the both of you to it, then!" And she does. You have to admit that Gwyn made a pretty good choice in the cubed ham — it's fancy enough to suit the occasion, but also familiar enough to the likes of Ragnild that she wouldn't be put off by it and filling by orc standards to match. She really is a little clever puppy... on her part, Rags is making an effort to not look like the savage barbarian of an orc that she is, toying around with the knife and fork meant for lupine hands — which, of course, means just a bit undersized for a big orc girl her size. She's really giving it her all in trying to be refined and elegant, and it's really funny in a heartwarming way. Ragnild stops, fork half-raised to her mouth. "You're not eating?" Oh, you were just thinking about how you got into this situation, and you're glad you did. Seeing her in a sundress, having the romantic meal that she always wanted, with someone she cares about... it feels really good to see her fulfilled like this, especially since she'd never be able to get away with something like this under Argoth's rule as chieftain. Arona's not too different from her brother, you suppose, but in the end she doesn't have it out for poor Rags. "I..." Rags looks down at the ham cube speared on her fork, sets it down, and swallows hard. "I think you usually say this at the end of the night and all — that's how it goes down in the books — but thanks for taking me out like this. It means a lot to me... although Hretha put you up to it, didn't she?" Yeah, she did, you're not going to lie about it. But that doesn't change the fact that you wanted to help her find some sort of peace with her wants, which the Kervus would — no mincing words about it — find deviant. Hretha just told you the best way to go about it. Ragnild pauses for a bit, the light of the scented candles flickering in her eyes. Then, she smiles and picks her fork back up. "Of course. Come on, [pc.name], the food's getting cold and it is very good. I'll feed you." She will? "Okay, just one bite." She raises her fork and reaches across the table. "Open wide, then." Sheesh... but at the same time, you have to admit the gesture's very endearing, and as you chew, the food is very good. The two of you finish the rest of your meal in silence as the scented candle slowly burns down — not that you don't have anything to say to each other, but what needs to be said can be easily and properly conveyed without needing to resort to words. Garth brings out a bucket of iced wine somewhere in the middle of the meal — he's changed into a very ill-fitting waistcoat and bowtie for the task — bows, and leaves. At length, the both of you finish up, wipe with napkins, and share a Look[silly| with a capital L] over the empty dishes and stub of candle that remains. "Thanks," Rags says, her eyes lowered and voice a little subdued. "Like I said, this... means a lot to me. It was fun." It's clear that it's taking a lot out of her to say those words, the likes of probably would certainly have no place if you were in her usual company. But that's all right. She doesn't need to thank you just yet — the night is still young, after all. "Upstairs, then?" Ah. You reach for Ragnild's massive ham-hand, calluses, burn scars and all, and take it in yours. The strength of her grip is plain even at a simple touch, and she allows you to help her out of her seat; Rags is still getting used to wearing a dress without tearing it up with her usual movements, and you give those thick fingers an encouraging squeeze. So long as that's what she wants... "Of course.""

rows.original: "Huh, that's a broad bed." You eye the bed sitting in the room that Garth's let you have this night. It's certainly much stouter and sturdy-looking than the usual fare, resting on eight, maybe nine legs instead of the usual four and of good, solid wood. You don't know where the lacy duvets came from, but it's clear what he expects the two of you to get up to here. Giving you a small, weak grin, Ragnild leans against the doorway and pulls out the cord holding her high ponytail together, letting her dark hair spill down and out over her shoulders. "Heh... sorry, but I guess you've got to bear with me for a little bit. I'm not sure what to do from here..." Or maybe she does, and just needs the confidence to take the first step. "[pc.name]... I mean, darling, I know enough to understand that not everything I read in Hretha's books has to be real. You've gone out of your way and done your best for me. Now since I've taken so much, maybe it's time to give back a little? Let's end this night well, shall we?" Indeed. That could mean a number of things, though...
