拉格妮尔德确实守信用——在你从她身边经过进入后方后，才过了短短几分钟，她就跟了进来，摘下了手套和锻造面罩。那个兽人铁匠拉来一把椅子坐在你旁边，满意地叹了口气，然后舒舒服服地坐了下来。 怀孕之后，我确实会很容易感到疲劳，但这种疲劳是一种良性的疲劳。赫蕾莎说，在凯尔维斯人中，这种情况其实并不常见；我这种体质肯定是遗传自我妈妈的，毕竟她是个来自心脏之地的人。不过，你到底想说什么呢，[pc.name]？" ] ]
rows.raw: " [rags.numKids 1 |When you enter Rags' tent, the smith whirls on you again. You know that expression — [rags.pregStage 1 2 3 |it's the one she had when she announced that she was going to be bearing your issue the last time. Your eyes meet across the tent, and she gives you a nod. "Yeah, you guessed as much; I can tell what you're thinking, it's written all over your face. You went and knocked me up again, you blockhead." She's sure, isn't she? "Hretha, busybody that she is, went and made sure of it herself. Even if she didn't, I... I've gotten to know the signs by now. There's no doubt about it, yeah." |sternness mixed with a little bit of anxiety she's trying to hide but isn't doing exceedingly well at. She scowls at you for a second or two, and then her expression softens. "It's not that obvious yet, huh? The outfit hides it pretty well." Ragnild pats her leather-and-fur apron for emphasis. "Still, your kids grow really big and really fast; won't be long before I'm waddling around like Infrith on a bad day. It's been a while, hasn't it?" Yes, it has. "Well, there's no need to be a stranger. Come back every now and then, okay?" |and the enormously bloated belly snug under her leather apron tells the rest of the tale. "Yeah, you went ahead and knocked me up again, you blockhead. I know you're out there with Arona and all keeping her out of our hair, but I was really hoping you'd be able to come back and see me like this before I had the spratling. And you did. I don't say this often, but... thanks." ] It feels a little awkward and more than a little irresponsible, but this is the way the Kervus works; she's explained it to you before. This isn't the way Rags wants it, either, but such things don't change in a generation... "Oh, don't you worry your head off. Come here and give me a hug." Now that's something that'll make the both of you feel better. You step up to the forge and into Ragnild's waiting arms, and she [pc.heightRange 74 82 |pulls you into a big bear hug, her chin resting on your shoulder |pulls you into a big bear hug, her head fitting into the crook of your neck |pulls you up into a big bear hug, practically lifting you off the ground in the process ]. [rags.pregStage 1 2 3 |She squeezes you hard, perhaps a little more than necessary, but when she draws away she looks a little more reassured — and so are you |She squeezes you, but it's less hard and more warm, perhaps to assuage a vulnerability or chink in that emotional armors of hers. It certainly does help reassure you that she knows what she's doing and washes away your worries |It's a bit of a tight fit for her big, hard belly, but at least the comforting sensation through her furs and apron helps alleviate some of the worry ]. So... does the same thing happen as the last time? "Yeah. Once I give birth, the kid'll be shipped back to my parents on the next longboat. The old take care of the children, and the youth fight all day long." She sighs. "What a waste. Still... if they're with my mom and dad, then at least they might stand a chance to turn out differently, especially since they're half... well, you." Mm. "Well, that's still some ways off. In the meantime... what'd you come in here for to begin with, [pc.name]?" |You're just entering Ragnild's forge-tent when the smith herself whirls on you, practically throwing down her tongs with a most uncharacteristic excitement to her. [pc.heightRange 74 82 |She bears down on you like some kind of beast, intimidating |Despite the fact that you're quite a bit taller than her, the suddenness of Ragnild's approach and all the muscle she's packing is admittedly still intimidating |Given how she absolutely towers over you, it's hard not to feel at least a little intimidated by the suddenness of her approach ] despite the huge smile she's got plastered all over her dark lips. Despite the sweat from the forge that clings to her body, she wraps her arms about you and pulls you into a huge, bone-crushing hug that squeezes the air from your lungs. "Lumia's tits, [pc.name]. Am I glad to see you!" While it's written all over her face, you're glad to hear her say it. Now, what's the issue here? "The issue is that we're going to have issue!" What? "Oh, pfff. So much for using big words — we're going to have a kid, you blockhead!" You look at Ragnild's beaming face, then down at her [rags.pregStage 1 2 3 |tight, muscular belly, apparently not that much different from when the two of you were last together. Is... is she sure? "Hretha said it was a sure thing, and she's been helping to deliver spratlings since she was ten. If she says so, then there's no doubt about it." |slightly swollen belly. Now that you're able to take a closer look at it, you can definitely see her defined abs receding under the maternal curvature of her belly, starting to push out and away from her. It's not that prominent yet and easily disguisable should she have the mind to, but given how excited Ragnild's about the whole thing she's probably shown it off to everyone in camp who could care by now. |hugely swollen belly. Now that the shock of her sudden approach has worn off, you're able to take it in for what it is. Yeah, it's been a while since the last time the both of you were together... "Pfff, you idiot!" Ragnild scowls and punches your shoulder, and then her expression melts back into a smile — relieved this time. "I — I was worried that something might've happened to you out there. There'd better be a good excuse for you staying away from me for this long!" Right. You're sorry to have made her worry. Ragnild deflates a little, holding her big belly in her hands. "I've... I've been fine. Hretha's been taking care of me... at least you're here now, which is more than I can say for any of the chance encounters I might've had if things had been different when I was younger. If nothing else, I know who fathered this spratling on me, right?" ] Well, then. This is... what's going to happen now? "Nothing much, I guess," Ragnild admits. "The forge still needs fire, and the camp needs my work. These things happen in warcamps — when the girls wind up pregnant from who knows what where, they get rotated back out to the islands. I don't have that luxury." Oh no... "It's not a big deal. A warcamp isn't any place to raise a kid, though, so once they're born I'll have to trust any of the girls being rotated out to bring the spratling back to my parents. It's our way, [pc.name] — the Kervus have been doing this for generations. If this sort of thing didn't happen, we wouldn't be able to maintain our numbers given how so many of us die young." It's still... "...Not a great way to live. I know. We could be so much more." Awkward silence. So... "You just leave it to me," Ragnild says with a smile, trying to cheer up the conversation. "Before I left the islands, my old folks were urging me to take advantage of Argoth's absence to go make them some grandkids already — I'm sure that they'll be more than overjoyed to take on the task of raising a half-dozen spratlings who've been shipped home to them. There's nothing to be worried about — business as usual, yes? Hretha'll take good care of me while you're gone and all." She seems very blase about the whole issue, but apparently this is how [pc.ora orc |other orc tribes work |the Kervus as a tribe works ]. While you can tell that on some level Ragnild is struggling with this, that she can't quite fully accept it, the fact also remains that this is something she's come to expect and seen others do since she was a child, and that has an effect on people. Not fully certain about this whole thing, perhaps, but more than willing to take it in stride. "Well, that's that. Now then... [dayNight |you came to me for something, right? Business isn't going to stop just because I've got a kid inside of me." Yeah, about that... |I guess you're visiting at this hour for some personal time, aren't you?" She knows you pretty well, doesn't she? "Yeah, I was up late finishing up a couple of orders, but I was just about done anyway. Head in first, and I'll be with you after I've let the forge cool off a bit." Ragnild is good to her word — barely minutes have passed after you've pushed past her into the rear that she comes in after you, hanging up her gloves and forge-mask. Pulling up a chair to you, the orc smith slumps into it with a satisfied sigh and makes herself comfortable. "Being pregnant and all makes me tired easily, but in a good way. Hretha says it's not really common amongst the Kervus; I must've gotten it from my mom, heartlander that she was. Anyways, what did you have in mind, [pc.name]?" ] ]"

rows.original: As you step into the tent and see Ragnild working diligently away at the forge, one thing about her strikes you: her baby belly's gone. Where it was nice and round, her midriff's now much flatter now, perhaps with a bit of looseness still remaining akin to a deflated bladder but with how hard she's sweating at her work you've no doubt she'll be back in shape before too long. Looking up from her work, Ragnild notices you staring and greets you with a nod, waving you into the tent and setting down her work. "Yeah, it happened. Was going to, sooner or later." Was... was she okay? "Hretha was there, so of course it was okay. As smooth as it could be — she said it was a shame I waited so long to get started on churning out spratlings. I'm still standing here working the forge and anvil, aren't I?" That's true, yeah. The kid... "Sent back with one of the girls on the last longboat back to the islands. That one was sporting a pretty big belly, so she'll be an okay wet nurse for the trip back until the kid lands in my parents' hands." Rags' eyes meet yours, and her expression softens. "I know you'd have liked to meet and hold your kid at least, as much as I'd loved to have kept the spratling by my side, but let's face it — the warcamp's no place for a baby, I don't know when you'll be back next and the same goes for longships back to the islands. If something were to show up and attack the camp..." Yeah, you get it. It's what it is. "It's how the Kervus have lived for generations. Those young enough to breed do so on the move, those old enough to have ended up as veterans of all the raiding and fighting are surely wise enough to raise their grandchildren. It's... not ideal, but it's worked for the Kervus as a people." Just because things are okay doesn't mean things can't be better. Ragnild nods sadly. "But that's not a question we should be asking when there's still whatever Hretha's seen looming on the horizon to deal with. After that, though..." After that. Your orcish lover is silent for a moment, then shakes her head and shrugs. "[dayNight |Well, that's enough standing around and chit-chatting while I'm supposed to be on the job. Did you come for something, [pc.name]?" |Aah, screw it. I was wrapping up for the day, and you arriving just killed any mood I might've had to burn the midnight oil to get this next batch of picks done. Let's head in, shall we? I'll let the forge die down on its own." Of course. Taking Ragnild's hand in yours, you lead her through the dividing flap and into her private quarters, taking up a seat and letting her pull up a simple chair by your side. Ragnild graces you with a smile. "Feels homey and familiar, doesn't it?" It does. Now, to see just how you want to spend time with your orcish lover... ]
rows.translation: 当你走进帐篷，看到拉格妮尔德正在炉前认真地工作时，有那么一点立刻吸引了你的注意：她的孕肚不见了。原本圆润的腹部现在变得平坦了许多，虽然还带着一些松弛，但看她工作得如此卖力，毫无疑问，不久之后她就会恢复原来的身材了。 拉格妮尔德从工作中抬起头，注意到你在注视着她，便点了点头向你打招呼，然后邀请你进入帐篷，并放下了手中的工作。是啊，这件事确实发生了。迟早都会发生这样的事。 她……她没事吧？ 赫蕾莎也在场，所以当然一切都很顺利。她还说，真可惜我花了这么长时间才开始培育幼苗。现在我还在这里忙于锻造工作，不是吗？ 确实，没错。那个孩子…… 最后那艘长船把她们中的一个送回了岛屿。那个女孩肚子挺大的，所以在回程的路上，她可以暂时担任奶妈，直到孩子被送到我父母手里。拉格的目光与你相遇，她的表情变得柔和起来。我知道你肯定也很想见到自己的孩子，就像我也很希望把那个小家伙留在身边一样。但事实就是——军营根本不是照顾婴儿的地方。我不知道你什么时候才能回来，那些返回岛屿的长船也同样无法保证安全。如果有什么东西突然出现并袭击了营地的话…… 是的，你懂的。事情就是这样的。 几千年来，凯尔维斯族一直都是这样生活的。那些还具备生育能力的年轻成员会在迁徙的过程中繁衍后代；而那些经历了无数次袭击与战斗、已经成为族中老者的成员，自然也拥有足够的智慧来抚养他们的孙子孙女。这种生活方式……或许并不理想，但对整个凯尔维斯族来说，却一直是行之有效的。 仅仅因为现状还算不错，并不意味着情况不能变得更好。 拉格妮尔德黯然地点了点头。但在我们还有许多像赫蕾莎所提到的那些问题需要解决的时候，这个问题其实并不值得我们去探讨。不过，等那些问题都解决了之后…… 之后。 你的兽人恋人沉默了一会儿，然后摇了摇头，耸了耸肩。"[dayNight |好了，我本来应该在工作的，现在却在这里站着闲聊，实在浪费时间。你们来这里是有什么事吗，[pc.name]？" |啊，算了。我本来打算今天就结束工作了，可你的到来彻底破坏了我原本可以熬夜完成接下来这些工作的计划。我们进去吧，好吗？让我让铁匠铺里的火自然熄灭吧。 当然。你握住拉格妮尔德的手部，带着她穿过那道隔开的门帘，进入她的私人空间。你坐下来，让她在你身旁搬来一把简单的椅子坐下。 拉格妮尔德对你露出了微笑。让人感觉很温馨、很熟悉，不是吗？ 确实如此。那么，现在就让我们看看你究竟想如何与你的兽人恋人共度时光吧…… ]

rows.original: [rand |In a manner most incongruous with her beefy physique, Ragnild winces and looks a little sheepish, perhaps even vulnerable when you pop the question to her. Her cheeks coloring from their usual swamp-green to something more brownish in the orcish equivalent of a blush, she bites her lip and gives you a slow nod. "I'd like that, yes." You don't want to pressure her into anything she's not comfortable with. "Oh no, it's not that. It's just that... well, watching month after month, year after year of white week on end go by... oh, and of course, hearing Hretha's fuck-crazy screams from the other side of the longhouse... well, they give you certain expectations of how things are supposed to go. But then again, I was right. They can go that way, but don't have to... anyway, I'm spoiling the mood. What did you have in mind?" |Once the question leaves your lips, Rags' eyes dart to the side; she's very definitely avoiding your gaze. You lean in a little closer, asking if something's the problem. "No, no. I just, um, well —" she starts toying with one of her side braids — "I just need to gather myself for this. It's still taking some getting used to, being propositioned instead of being dragged off and fucked silly like most orcs are wont to do to each other." Well, you're [pc.ra orc |an orc |here ], and you're asking. "And I heard you the first time." She smiles, a little of her trepidation dissolving, and pokes you squarely on the nose with a thick sausage finger. "All right, I've collected myself and am all set. What're we doing tonight?" |A small tusky grin spreads across Rags' lips as you phrase the question, the orcess coyly reaching behind her head to fidget with her ponytail. "Well, when you put it that way instead of just grabbing me off to be smashed, I don't see why not. It's nice to be able to let my hair down with you instead of having to look tough for Arona and everyone else all the time..." She seems to be more... enthusiastic today. "Ha! That's one way to put it, I guess. The men were having white week recently, maybe that's the reason? Come on, then, when we've still got lots of fire in us. What were you thinking of getting up to?" ]
rows.translation: [rand |与她那结实的身材极不相称的是，当你向她提出这个请求时，拉格妮尔德皱起了眉，显得有些羞怯，甚至有些脆弱。她的脸颊从平常的沼泽绿变成了兽人式脸红时的那种棕褐色，她咬了咬嘴唇，缓缓地点了点头。 “我想要那样，没错。” 你并不想强迫她去做任何她会感到不自在的事。 “哦不，不是那样的。只是……嗯，看着月复一月、年复一年，一个又一个白色星期接连过去……哦，当然了，还能听到赫蕾莎从长屋另一头传来那种疯狂做爱的尖叫……嗯，这些都会让人对事情该有的走向产生某种预期。不过话说回来，我说得没错。事情可以那样发展，但并非必须如此……总之，我这是在破坏气氛。你原本打算怎么做？” |这个问题一出口，拉格斯的眼睛立刻瞥向一旁；她显然在刻意避开你的目光。你稍微凑近了一些，问她是不是出了什么问题。 “不，不。我只是，呃，嗯——”她开始摆弄自己的一侧发辫——“我只是需要先让自己定一定神。毕竟，被人主动提出这种要求，而不是像大多数兽人那样被拖走然后干到神魂颠倒，这种事还是需要些时间来适应。” 嗯，你[pc.ra orc |是一个兽人 |都到这儿了 ]，而你还在开口询问。 “而我第一次就已经听明白了。”她笑了，心中的紧张稍许消散，然后用一根厚实的、香肠般的手指戳在你的鼻子正中央。“好了，我已经定下神来，完全准备好了。今晚我们做点什么？” |当你这么问的时候，拉格斯的嘴唇上泛起一丝带着獠牙的浅笑，这个女兽人害羞地把手伸到脑后，摆弄着自己的马尾辫。“嗯，既然你是这么说，而不是直接把我拽走猛干一场，我没什么不行的。能和你在一起放松下来，而不用一直为了阿罗娜和其他人装出强硬的样子，这感觉真好……” 她今天似乎更加……热情。 “哈！这么说倒也可以。男人们最近刚过完白色星期，也许就是这个原因？来吧，趁我们身上还有的是欲火。你打算做点什么？” ]

rows.original: Rags is a big tough girl, but you know that she just wants some mushy romance and cuddling to get to that gooey core of hers.
rows.translation: 拉格斯是个坚强独立的女孩，但你知道，她其实只是渴望一些浪漫的情节和温暖的拥抱，这样才能触碰到她内心最柔软的部分。
rows.raw: "Rags is a big tough girl, but you know that she just wants some mushy romance and cuddling to get to that gooey core of hers."

rows.original: Ask Rags if she'd wear the dress you had made for her. She does look very fetching in it, after all.
rows.translation: 问问拉格斯是否愿意穿你为她制作的那条裙子。毕竟，她穿上它确实非常漂亮。
rows.raw: "Ask Rags if she'd wear the dress you had made for her. She does look very fetching in it, after all."

rows.original: With how pregnant Rags is, there's no way she's fitting into that lovely, slinky sundress. Maybe you could try asking again after she's had the baby.
rows.translation: 拉格斯现在怀孕这么厉害，她根本不可能穿得下那条漂亮又贴身的连衣裙。也许等她生完孩子后再问一次吧。
rows.raw: "With how pregnant Rags is, there's no way she's fitting into that lovely, slinky sundress. Maybe you could try asking again after she's had the baby."

rows.original: [pc.inRut|Being in rut as you are, you can't possibly be more prepared for this.|The only way you could be more vigorous about this is if you'd asked Hretha for a blessing beforehand.]
rows.translation: [pc.inRut|既然你正处在发情期，你的准备不可能比现在更充分了。|你唯一能比现在更猛的办法，就是事先向赫蕾莎求个祝福。]
rows.raw: "[pc.inRut|Being in rut as you are, you can't possibly be more prepared for this.|The only way you could be more vigorous about this is if you'd asked Hretha for a blessing beforehand.]"

rows.original: You probably should get the requisite tools to breed her with before trying it. Could lead to some embarrassing situations otherwise.
rows.translation: 在尝试之前，你最好先准备所需的工具，这样才能顺利地进行相关操作。否则，可能会遇到一些尴尬的情况。
rows.raw: "You probably should get the requisite tools to breed her with before trying it. Could lead to some embarrassing situations otherwise."

rows.original: Pay the best part of your orcish lover some particular loving attention.
rows.translation: 要特别关照你的兽人恋人，给予他/她更多的关爱。
rows.raw: "Pay the best part of your orcish lover some particular loving attention."

rows.original: Since her milk's come in, she wouldn't mind if you partake, would she?
rows.translation: 自从她开始产奶以来，她应该不会介意你喝一些吧？
rows.raw: "Since her milk's come in, she wouldn't mind if you partake, would she?"

rows.original: You come to the next morning atop Ragnild's sleeping furs, alone — your orcish lover must've gotten up at the crack of dawn to fire up the forge and get started on her work. Work waits for no one, after all... while it'd have been nice to wake up next to her, the harsh realities of life intrude upon your desires. Sighing, you pull on your [pc.armor] and other things, heading through the dividing fabric to find Rags exactly where you'd expect to find her. You watch quietly as she starts smelting down another bunch of bronze scrap, then she notices you and gives you a nod. "Sleep well?" Never better. There's a moment of understanding between the two of you, perhaps an aching longing that can never be sated, but Ragnild turns her gaze away before it can get too awkward. "Be careful out there, okay?[party.has arona | The chieftain's getting antsy, asking about when you're going to get the hell up so you lot can be off already. ]" You will. Sighing softly, you step out of the forge-tent and into the morning light.[party.hasCompanions| Time to gather [party.compNames] and be on your way...]
rows.translation: 第二天清晨，你独自一人躺在拉格妮尔德的睡毯上——你的兽人恋人肯定是在破晓时分就起床去生火、开始工作了。毕竟，工作是不会等待任何人的……虽然能和她一起醒来该有多好，但现实的残酷让这些美好的愿望无法实现。你叹了口气，穿上了衣服[pc.armor]还有其他一些东西，它们穿过那层分隔物，准确地出现在了你预期会找到拉格斯的那个地方。你静静地观察着她，看着她开始熔化另一堆青铜废料，然后她注意到了你，朝你点了点头。 睡得好吗？ 再好不过了。 你们两人之间有那么一刻，彼此心领神会，或许还有一种永远无法满足的深切渴望，但就在这种气氛变得过于尴尬之前，拉格妮尔德转开了视线。 在外面要小心点，好吗？[party.has arona | 首领已经变得不耐烦了，一直在问你们到底什么时候能动身，这样大家就能早点出发了。 ]" 你一定会做到的。轻轻叹了口气，你走出了铁匠帐篷，走进了晨光之中。[party.hasCompanions| 是时候集合了。 [party.compNames]然后就可以踏上你的旅程了……]

rows.original: You ask Rags if she just wants to cuddle up with you for a moment, feel each others' warmth — and if she's feeling up to it, perhaps do a bit more. If she isn't though, just cuddling and groping for a bit will be fine enough. The orcish smith laughs, clearly trying to sound boisterous, but she's less adept at disguising her emotions than she thinks. "Are you sure you didn't really mean to say 'I want to pin you down on the furs and rail you from behind', [pc.name]? That's what I usually get these days from the younger menfolk now that Argoth's out of the picture." No, no. You said what you just did — no mistakes about it, and besides, [pc.strengthRange 80 |while you might be able to pin her down with brute strength alone, it's just as likely that a big and hearty woman like her's bound to throw you off |it's not like you had any chance of pinning down a big and hearty girl like her anyways ]. Does she want to cuddle? Rags' smile fades a little, replaced by... the only real word to describe it, really, is longing. "Yes, [pc.name]. Yes, I'd like that very much." Well then, no sense in putting it off, then. [pc.strengthRange 80 |Sweeping Rags off her feet in the most romantic bridal carry you can muster, you heft |Taking Rags by the hand, you lead ] her past the tent's dividing flap and into the private section. Her sleeping furs are laid out all over one corner of the tent, and it's there that you [pc.strengthRange 80 |set her down gently, getting on your knees to do the job properly. Ragnild looks up at you, a silly grin on her tusky lips and a slight rust-brown blush in her cheeks as she clearly tries to find words for your gesture, but fails |set her down gently, leading her to the bedding's edge and giving her a small bow as she seats herself. Ragnild looks up at you sheepishly, but lowers her gaze again after a moment or two, clearly unsure how to proceed from here. This isn't how orcs stereotypically do it, after all ]. Smiling, you shush your orcish lover with a finger to her dark lips and start undressing her piece by piece — her furs and leathers aren't really that complicated and you could have them off in a flash, but that's not the point here. You drag out the disrobing for as long as you can, frequently letting your fingers wander over Ragnild's muddy green skin, teasing her with light touches and letting their tips trace along the contours of her muscular chest and arms. Slow and sensual, that's the thing — doing for her what no Kervus would ever even think of doing. There, there. Reaching up with one hand, you undo the strings that hold her high ponytail together and let her hair down, feeling it run through your fingers as it falls across her shoulders. She, too, finally takes up the initiative and starts working at your [pc.armor], too, trying to mimic your movements — she clearly has some idea of how to go about these things, given all the trashy romances Hretha's told you she reads, but is either shy or fumble-fingered when it comes to undressing another. Whatever, it's cute. You slow down your pace even more, letting her catch up; it's such a delight to be able to brush the backs of your fingers across her bare collarbone and the tops of her breasts. By the time she's finally done with you, you're gently holding Ragnild by her sides, running your thumbs along the firm edges of her [rags.pregStage 0 1 2 3 |firm, chiseled abs. They're so hard and defined under that deceptive outer layer of skin and just that tiniest bit of fat that they all but take your breath away as you marvel at their feel under your thumbs |abs. They're still plenty hard, but are slowly losing their definition as her womb pushes out against them. In a way, it's one of the most glorious things you've ever seen |belly, your thumbs tracing the edges of her midriff. Her womb is no less firm and powerful than her abs are — arguably more, and just as delightful to the touch |big, bulging belly, your thumbs tracing the curvature of her midriff as it juts away from her. It feels so warm and good, so hard and unyielding, that you can't help but sigh a little in glorious relief ]. Well, how does she feel? Ragnild hesitates, clearly wondering if this is some kind of set-up for a cheesy romantic scenario, then decides to throw caution to the wind and smiles. "Cold." You grin and give the orcess a great big hug, wrapping your arms about her[rags.pregStage 2 | and squeezing her big belly between the two of you ]. Well, that should take care of that. Not cold any more, is she? "Hah, no. Thanks." The two of you tumble together into the furs, kicking your clothes safely out of reach and fighting for the honor of initiating the kiss. [pc.heightRange 74 82 |You're both about the same height, so your bodies are a perfect fit for each other as you entwine yourselves in each others' embrace, arms and legs wrapping about warm bodies as you cozy up against each other. Rags' chest presses insistently against your [pc.chest], squeezable breastflesh remaining firm at first but turning pliant under the continued, insistent pressure of both your bodies. Her chin's at the perfect height for her to rest it against your shoulder, and she does that with several relieved mumbles, locking her fingers about your back |With you being significantly taller than Rags herself it, the choice of romantic cuddle is obvious. Arms and legs entwine about your bodies as you move to hold her close, chin positioned squarely atop her forehead. Rags' breath is warm against your [pc.chest] and neck, fingers firmly interlocked behind you as she nuzzles her face into your collarbone, little tusks prickling at your skin |The cuddle's a little awkward given how you're shorter than Rags and yet she wants to be the one embraced by you and not the other way around, but she curls up against your body, determined to make it work. Soon enough, the feeling of trepidation passes from you, replaced by one of genuine comfort as your orcish lover wraps her arms and legs about you, and you do the same. It's a little cramped for Rags, but she doesn't care in the slightest so long as it's truly for you. ]. Looks like she's settled down — you reach in and give Ragnild a small kiss, then reach for her head and scratch at her loosened hair. It's a bit rough and not exactly close to any statuesque beauty, but if it were that woman wouldn't be Rags any more. "Don't move," your orcish lover mumbles into your chest. "Let's just hold each other for a little while more, okay?" Your answer to that is to squeeze your hands behind her back, a motion that elicits a soft wiggle from Rags. Here on the ground atop her sleeping furs, [rags.pregStage 2 |with her baby belly snug against the two of you, you can't help but feel a warm goodness well up in the pit of your stomach. Your orcish lover may be living in a tent far away from home and sleeping on furs, but you're sure that here and now, she's far happier than any perfumed Jassiran lady with her trinkets and jewels. Would every Kervus be like her — content to snuggle after a hard day's work with a baby in her belly and a warm lover by her side — then perhaps the tribe could be less feared and yet keep their reputation for strength intact |with her pushing her face into your shoulder, you can't help but feel a great sensation of calm and peace descend upon you. Briefly, you wonder if this state of affairs could last forever — if the Kervus warcamp could just... remain as it is right now, frozen in time despite Arona's whole spiel about pushing things forward and getting off their butts. Maybe... maybe they could settle here instead of doing what they came to do and returning to the islands, and Ragnild could stay without needing to abandon her people if it ever came to that choice ]. But, like Ragnild's dreams for her people, you know that chances are that this could never come to pass on a sweeping scale like she hopes for. Still, here and now, between the two of you, perhaps it's better to let her — and you — dream, even if just for a night. "Hm?" Oh, nothing. You were just thinking. "Thinking." Ragnild's voice is quiet. "Yeah, I do that a lot, too, even when I don't want to. Hretha says it's because no one else does, so she and I have to do all the thinking for the whole of the tribe. Just lying here during the night, unable to sleep, thinking about [rags.pregStage 1 |what kind of future this little spratling's going to have." A good one, safe back in the islands. Ragnild sighs and pats her pregnant belly. "...Most other mothers would be content with that, that's certainly what the girls who get pregnant out here are satisfied with. Rotate out, squeeze out a brat and come back here on the next longship to fight and fuck for glory again. But... what happens after that?" |what's going to happen after all this. Arona said we were going to be out on the move again, but as far as people from around the camp have told me, so far things haven't been any different from when Argoth was chieftain. Not in any meaningful sense, anyway. And let's say this is all over... it'll be back to the islands with me, with all of us. I'll be smelting down old weapons and armor, fashioning things for the Kervus from the scraps and leavings of other peoples. It seems... all so futile to hope." ] It'll all work out. Ragnild opens her mouth as if intending to speak, then decides against it and wraps you in a great big crushing hug. Under the heat of her body, you can feel her powerful muscles shiver as she holds you tight, your orc lover reluctant to let go of you in the slightest. "Let me be close to you for a bit, please. You, your scent, your... what makes you you. I want it, [pc.name], I want it so much."

rows.original: At last, enough strength returns to your limbs for you to maneuver atop the furs and take Ragnild into your embrace. There's still a little instinctive shyness there, an automatic shrinking back at your touch, but the warmth of your bodies soon meet each other and she quickly wraps her arms about you, crushing you with a grip that's surprisingly strong for someone who was so recently worn out. "[pc.name]," she whispers breathlessly. You raise a hand and run it through her sweaty hair, taking a few strands between thumb and forefinger and rubbing them gently. Yes? "Thanks." She's more than welcome. Someone like her deserves happiness, and while the world is all too often of the mind that deserve's got nothing to do with it, that just means you've got to work to make it otherwise. Rags has no reply for that but to hold you even tighter, wrapping arms and legs about you as the two of you drift off atop the furs.

        |有一根横木从这一侧横跨过去，将营地与不速之客隔开了。但你也很清楚，外面驻扎着一支兽人战士小队：如果你打开门，你就可以随意进出……不过他们肯定会为了争夺这个入口与你交战。希望他们没有机会通知整个营地……
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    The main gates to the orcish camp are heavy wood, embossed with bronze bands to reinforce the northern wood. [
        flags.ORC_GATES_OPEN
        |The door has been thrown open, allowing you to come and go as you please. [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|A group of Kervus warriors are standing guard around the camp's only real entrance, axes and hammers ready to defend their stolen land.]
        |A bar has been run across it from this side, sealing the camp from uninvited guests. But you also know full well that a squad of orc warriors are stationed outside: if you open the door, it'll be easy to come and go as you please... but there's no way they won't fight you for the right. Hopefully they won't have a chance to alert the entire camp...
    ]"

rows.original: Throw open the doors to the orcish enclave. The guards outside will probably take exception to this idea, but it'll give you the freedom to come and go at-will.
rows.translation: 把兽人聚居地的门大敞开吧。外面的守卫们可能会反对这个主意，但这样你就可以自由地进出那里了。
rows.raw: "Throw open the doors to the orcish enclave. The guards outside will probably take exception to this idea, but it'll give you the freedom to come and go at-will."

rows.original:
A packed-dirt road leads north to south here, straight through the middle of the Kervus tribe's war-camp. Dozens of tents line the road, probably for the highest-rank warriors, with those belonging to thralls and junior warriors fanning out to the east and west.

    To the far north of the valley, you can see a huge four-posted pavillion tent. A pair of carved wooden wolves, each bearing racks of demonic horns, are sat at either side of the entrance flap. Alongside them are a pair of burly orcish warriors, each wearing heavy hides and wielding bronze great-axes.
    
    A path off to the east leads towards a large wooden-stake pen, [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|though its gates hang open.|full of huddling humanoid figures.] A much larger wood-and-stone hall sits between you and the pen, from which pours a thunderous din of voices — dozens of them. Plenty of orcs gathered thataway.
rows.translation:
一条被压实的土路从这里南北延伸，直接穿过克尔维斯部落的军营中央。道路两旁排列着数十顶帐篷，这些帐篷大概是为地位最高的战士们准备的，而那些属于奴隶和初级战士的帐篷则分布在道路的东侧和西侧。

    在山谷的最北端，你可以看到一座巨大的四柱帐篷。入口两侧各摆放着一对雕刻精美的木制狼像，这些狼像的头上都装饰着恶魔般的角。在它们旁边，还站着两名体格魁梧的兽人战士，他们身披厚重的皮甲，手中挥舞着青铜巨斧。
    
    一条向东延伸的小路通向一个用木桩围起来的大围场。 [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|尽管它的大门敞开着。|挤满了缩成一团的类人型身影。]在你和那个围场之间，坐落着一座规模更大的木石结构大厅，从那里传来了震耳欲聋的喧闹声——那是数十个人的声音。显然，有大量的兽人聚集在了那里。

"
    A packed-dirt road leads north to south here, straight through the middle of the Kervus tribe's war-camp. Dozens of tents line the road, probably for the highest-rank warriors, with those belonging to thralls and junior warriors fanning out to the east and west.

Alongside them are a pair of burly orcish warriors, each wearing heavy hides and wielding bronze great-axes.
    
    A path off to the east leads towards a large wooden-stake pen, [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|though its gates hang open.|full of huddling humanoid figures.] A much larger wood-and-stone hall sits between you and the pen, from which pours a thunderous din of voices — dozens of them. Plenty of orcs gathered thataway."

rows.original:
You're on an east-facing side path, off the main thoroughfare through the orcish camp. A large wooden-stake pen dominates the eastern side of the valley[
        flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED
        |. [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|The slave pens have largely been emptied out, but it seems there were plenty more of them in the camp than the ones you freed mid-quest. ]A small number of huddled figures are clustered inside; likely the most rebellious or misanthropic of the camp's thralls. [flags.PAVO_MET|You see Pavo the lizardman among them, grumpily huddled up in the cold. Guess Arona didn't appreciate how easily he rolled over for you.]
        |, [flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|though its gates hang open.|full of huddling humanoid figures.]
    ] 
    
    Directly to the north of you is a large wood-and-stone hall, [var0|from which pours a thunderous din of voices amidst gruff song and cheers. The orcish warriors are gathered inside, passing the time away while they wait for their leader's orders. A mere heavy curtain over the doorway separates you from the revelry within|once full of orcish warriors singing and drinking, you've since made sure they're no longer a threat].
rows.translation:
你此刻正走在一条朝东的小路上，这条小路偏离了穿过兽人营地的主干道。山谷的东侧有一处用木桩围起来的围场[
        flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED
        |。[flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|那些奴隶营里的大部分奴隶已经被释放了，不过看起来，这个营地里的奴隶数量其实比你在任务进行到中途时释放的那些要多得多。 ]里面聚集着少数蜷缩在一起的身影，他们很可能是这个营地里最为叛逆或最为厌恶人类的那些人。 [flags.PAVO_MET|你在他们中间看到了那个名叫帕沃的蜥蜴人，他正闷闷不乐地蜷缩在寒冷中。看来阿罗娜并不欣赏他如此轻易地就为你做出了让步。]
        |，[flags.ORC_SLAVES_FREED|尽管它的大门敞开着。|到处都是挤在一起的人形生物。]
    ] 
    
    就在你的正北方，有一座由木头和石头建造的大型大厅。 [var0|从那里传来了震耳欲聋的喧闹声，粗犷的歌声与欢呼声此起彼伏。那些兽人战士们聚集在室内，一边等待领袖的命令，一边消磨时间。只是一道厚重的帘子将你与室内的喧闹隔开了。|曾经这里充满了唱着歌、喝着酒的兽人战士，但后来你确保他们再也不会构成任何威胁了。]

rows.original: Given the situation you've precipitated in the lodge, going back in there seems unwise. It's a little too late to reconsider your actions, now — best to move on.
rows.translation: 鉴于你在小屋里引发的这场局面，再回到那里似乎并不明智。现在再重新考虑自己的行为已经有点太晚了——最好的办法就是继续前进。
rows.raw: "\n            Given the situation you've precipitated in the lodge, going back in there seems unwise. It's a little too late to reconsider your actions, now — best to move on."

rows.original:
The orcish warrior-lodge is a long wooden hall reinforced with stone pillars and adorned with pelts and furs around a single trestle table running through the middle. About two dozen orcish warriors, men and women, young and old, are cavorting in here. Mead and ale runs freely, alongside the barely-cooked meat of just about every animal in the March. 
    
    The youngest warriors in the tribe are busy serving their elders, rushing about with trays of food and drink from the camp cooks, while slaves and she-orcs too drunk to care about their appearance sit in laps and grind on the burliest warriors.
    
    [ylvid.atOrcCamp
        |The tribe's most famous warrior-skald, Ylvid, is sitting on the edge of the table with her drums in her lap, thumping away at them while she recounts [rand
            |tales of her ancestors' bravery in facing the Khor'minoan navy
            |the new chieftain's first kill on the hunt, a huge walrus scarred from decades of battles
            |the glory of the Kervus tribe won in Lumia's name against the nightmare beasts of long-distant wars
            |a bawdy song about an she-orc seducing an elven princess and fighting off her other suitors
            |the saga of a bumbling fool of an orc whose devotion to each of the Seven saves him from peril again and again
            |glorious tales of her patron, Thane Vulgra, in battling the greatest champions of Khor'minos — and fucking their wives afterwards
        ].
    ]
    
    A handful of orcs sit near the head of the table, thick-set and scarred — clearly veterans of many a campaign. Given the fine pelts and baubles that adorn their armor, their loud cavorting, and the fact that every orc in the room is paying them varying levels of silent obsequience, their status in the Kervus tribe is made clear to anyone who cares to look.
    
    [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED
        |
        |Didn't Arona say something about worrying that her brother wouldn't play fair? Here's your chance to do something about his lackeys in advance... if you choose to take it. No one's paid you any attention amidst the rowdy revelry, but you'll have to get closer to take any kind of action.
    ]
rows.translation:
兽人战士的聚会厅是一间长长的木制大厅，以石柱加固，四周装饰着毛皮和皮革，中间横着一张贯穿全场的支架长桌。约莫二十名兽人战士，男女老少，都在这儿欢闹作乐。蜂蜜酒和麦酒随意畅饮，还有边境地区几乎每种动物那半生不熟的肉。 
    
    部落里最年轻的战士们正忙着服侍长辈，端着营地厨子做好的食物和酒水来回奔走；而那些醉得顾不上自己形象的奴隶和雌性兽人，则坐在别人的腿上，在最为壮硕的战士身上磨蹭。
    
    [ylvid.atOrcCamp
        |部落里最著名的战士兼吟游诗人伊尔维德正坐在桌边，鼓搁在膝上，一边敲打，一边讲述着[rand
            |关于她的祖先们如何勇敢面对科尔米诺斯的海军的故事
            |新任首领在狩猎中取得的第一个猎物——一头因数十年厮杀而伤痕累累的巨大的海象
            |克尔维斯部落在卢米娅之名下，对抗遥远往昔战争中噩梦巨兽所赢得的荣耀
            |一首关于雌性兽人勾引一位精灵公主、并打退她其他追求者的淫荡歌谣
            |一个笨手笨脚的兽人傻瓜的传奇，他对七神中每一位的奉献一次又一次地让他脱离险境
            |关于她的庇护者领主沃尔格拉的辉煌传说：他与科尔米诺斯最强大的冠军们激战，事后还肏了他们的妻子
        ]。
    ]
    
    有几名兽人坐在桌首附近，体格厚实，满身伤疤——显然都是经历过许多场战役的老兵。从他们护甲上装饰的精美毛皮和饰物、他们高声的欢闹，以及屋里每个兽人对他们不同程度的默默恭顺来看，他们在克尔维斯部落中的地位，任何愿意留心的人都看得清楚。
    
    [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED
        |
        |阿罗娜不是说过，她担心她哥哥不会公平竞争吗？现在你有机会提前对付他的那些走狗……如果你愿意的话。在喧闹的狂欢中没人注意你，但你想采取任何行动，都得再靠近一些才行。
    ]

rows.translation: 加入这场狂欢吧。虽然这其中潜藏着风险，但不冒险就什么也得不到，不是吗？
rows.raw: "Approach the revelry. This carries its own risks, but nothing ventured, nothing gained, right?"

rows.original: You stand just before the flaps of a great pavillion tent, nestled into the far northern end of the orcish encampment. A pair of life-size wooden dire wolves flank the entrance, each bearing a rack of mighty demonic antlers atop its head. Each wolf has a particularly strapping orcish warrior standing in front of it, and as you approach, they [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|bow their heads in respect, standing aside to let you pass.|cross their bronze greataxes in front of the tent, barring your entrance. But they don't attack. Not yet, anyway...]
rows.translation: 你站在一座巨大帐篷的门前，这座帐篷坐落在兽人营地的最北端。入口两侧各有一只按实际大小制作的木制恐狼，每只狼的头顶上都装饰着一排巨大的恶魔角。在每只狼的前方，都站着一名体格魁梧的兽人战士。当你靠近时，他们[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED|低头表示敬意，侧身让你通过。|将青铜巨斧交叉横在帐篷前，拦住你的去路。但他们并没有发动攻击。至少现在还没有……]

But they don't attack. Not yet, anyway...]"

rows.original: This is where you're supposed to be... and there's no way the guards will just let you in, is there?
rows.translation: 这里本来就是你应该来的地方……不过守卫们肯定不会随便让你进来的，对吧？
rows.raw: "This is where you're supposed to be... and there's no way the guards will just let you in, is there?"

rows.original:
The interior of the warchief's pavilion is as opulent as nomadic warriors such as the Kervus tribe can make it. Thick rugs of furry hides cover up the grassy valley floor, all facing inwards towards a great wooden throne sat upon a rough-hewn stone dais. While nothing here can't be moved with some effort, the orcs have sure gone as all-out as they can.

    [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED
        |[party.has arona
            |Arona saunters over and crashes ass-first into her throne, kicking her legs up with a satisfied smile. "God damn, I never get tired of the view here," she murmurs. The growing bulge under her leathers just confirms the sentiment, especially as the she-orc's eyes drink you in from her dais. "Yeah... it's good to be queen."
        ]
        |The newly-minted Chief Arona lounges lazily upon her throne, one leg kicked up over an armrest. Her bulge is plainly visible for anybody to see, only accentuated by the pair of her sub-amazons pawing at her legs like the sex-candy they are now. 
    
        Arona gives you an upwards nod as you approach. "[pc.name]."
    ]

rows.translation: 你走近克尔维斯战营中央的战士大厅，震耳欲聋的战鼓与战士们的欢呼声迎面袭来。等你走到门前，鼓点已经加速到近乎狂热，与沉重的肉体撞击声交织在一起。里面传来一声巨响，更多男人随之喝彩。 一个光头兽人男子从门内翻滚着飞了出来，一头栽进泥地。厅内又爆发出更加喧闹的欢呼；鼓点也以最后一记胜利的重击戛然而止。 你绕过刚被扔出来的战士，走进大厅。 三十多名魁梧的绿色与灰色兽人战士围在中央一张支架长桌旁。桌面上站着[flags.LQ1_SONG |一道熟悉的身影，依旧曲线丰满，也依旧近乎赤裸——吟游诗人伊尔维德 |一名棕发兽人女子，身上除了一套带衬垫的链甲比基尼和一袭火红斗篷外几乎什么也没穿 ]，正拍打挂在肩头的战鼓。“我刚才怎么说的？”她朝聚集的战士们大喊。吟游诗人抖了抖自己修长而肌肉发达的腿。“只要能狠狠踢人屁股，我根本不需要双手！” 她原地旋身，[silly |在鼓上敲出一小节节拍 |优雅鞠躬，同时把斗篷扬到身前 ]，逗得观众们大为开心。其中一个兽人醉醺醺地把酒杯举向空中，高喊：“伊尔维德！” 他的同伴立即齐声响应。“伊尔维德！伊尔维德！伊尔维德！” 伊尔维德咧嘴一笑，从桌面一路走到长凳上，还径直踩过一个战士的脑袋。尽管周围震耳欲聋，那人仍醉得不省人事。她从他背上滑到地面时，他含糊地喷着口水；而她仍在鼓面上敲出轻快节拍。“好了！”她大喊道，声音强劲得几乎盖过同伴们醉醺醺的呼号。“除非还有谁想让我的脚塞进屁股，否则就继续喝酒！[party.has arona |新酋长亲自赏光到场了！可别让她看见你们冷落了她为大家搬出来的好酒！ |阿罗娜把好酒搬出来，可不是让我们坐在酒桶上发呆的！ ]” 她的话引来更多醉醺醺的欢呼。伊尔维德从一名战士手里接过酒杯，仰头一口灌完，任由一缕缕啤酒流过下巴，淌到几乎没有遮掩的双乳上。[party.has arona |她朝阿罗娜眨眨眼，摇摇晃晃地走到桌边一个空位坐下，享用起自己的酒。 ]
rows.raw: ' Approaching the warrior's lodge at the heart of the Kervus warcamp, you're assailed by the thundering sounds of drums and the roar of cheering warriors. A bald orc man comes sailing out of the door end over end, planting face-down in the dirt. There's more raucous cheering inside, and the drumbeat finally stops with a final triumphant strike. You step around the freshly-ejected warrior and enter the lodge. Three dozen brawny green and gray warriors are gathered around a central trestle table, atop which is standing [flags.LQ1_SONG |a familiar, and still both very curvy and very nearly naked, figure — Ylvid the skald |a brown-haired orc woman wearing very little besides a padded bikini of main links and a flame-red cape ], patting a wardrum hanging off her shoulder. "What did I tell you?" she shouts to the assembled fighters. The skald shakes out one of her long, thickly-muscled legs. "I don't need my hands when I can just kick ass!" She twirls on the spot and [silly |raps a bar on her drums |takes a bow, sweeping her cape around herself ], to the great amusement of her audience. One of them thrusts his tankard into the air drunkenly and shouts "Ylvid!" His fellows join in immediately. "Ylvid! Ylvid! Ylvid!" He sputters and drools as she slides down his back and onto the ground, still pattering at the face of her drum. "Alright!" she shouts, voice so powerful it just about drowns out the inebriated chanting of her comrades. "Unless anyone else wants my foot up their ass, let's get back to drinking! [party.has arona |Our new chieftain's graced us with her presence! Don't let her see you ignoring all that good ale she rolled out for you! |Arona didn't roll out the good stuff just so we could sit on it! ]" More drunken cheers greet her words, and Ylvid takes a mug from one of the warriors and knocks it back in one long go, letting streams of beer spill down her chin and onto her barely-covered tits. [party.has arona |She gives Arona a wink and sways her way over to an empty spot at the table to sit down and enjoy her drink. ] '

[livrea.met |You don't remember Livrea mentioning her, anyway. ] The skald nods. "Oh, yes. Our battle was glorious, legendary! We sang at each other until the sun fell behind the mountains and the foothills shook with the thunder of my drums! It was only stopped by the appearance of a fell dragon swooping out from the mountains, lured by the sweet songs the strawberry cow was playing her on harp. I wasn't going to let a creature like that slip away — the only thing a girl can ask for greater than defeating a rival is slaying a dragon!" "What happened?" "Ah! Livrea fled the scene, into the mountain tunnels, while I leapt on the dragon's head with my axe in hand and cleaved its skull down to the meat of its beastly brain. Look, a trophy of my kill!" Ylvid lifts up a massive tooth from a chain around her waist and holds it up to the firelight. "Big as a sword and thrice as hard. The only denser thing I've ever seen is Arona's skull!" [party.has arona |"Damn right. This bad girl can bounce a hammer blow!" Arona nods, rapping her knuckles on her head. |The orcs around her burst out laughing. ] "I think we all know who came out on top of that flyting! Livrea ran, and I slew a dragon! And now I'm here to tell the tale, and gulp down all Arona's ale!" Ylvid laughs, and gulps down another draught from her flagon. "So, that's what brought me here, and I'll be here until the new Chief finally breaks camp. I hear there's a great war brewing, and I'll be damned if I don't get to see it with my own eyes! In the meantime, though, I'll be here keeping morale up for the Chief!" Several orcs around her cheer. Hard to deny that she does have an effect on the camp's warriors. ] '

rows.original: Swap some words with the orcish skald.
rows.translation: 和这位兽人吟游诗人聊几句吧。
rows.raw: "Swap some words with the orcish skald."

rows.original: Get your hands all over this this big, curvy bard.
rows.translation: 好好享受这个身材丰满、曲线优美的吟游诗人吧。
rows.raw: "Get your hands all over this this big, curvy bard."

rows.original:
"Let's talk," you say, leaning against the lodge's big table.
    
    "Good. Play into my strengths!" Ylvid nods, and grabs a [ylvid.isPregnant
        |turkey leg
        |fresh drink
    ] from a passing slave. "I've got you right where I want you, [arona.isDom
        |pet
        |[pc.mf
            |handsome
            |beautiful
        ]
    ]."
    
    The skald cackles and [ylvid.isPregnant
        |rips a hunk out of that bird-meat with her tusks. Pregnancy certainly has given her an appetite, hasn't it?
        |knocks back half her beer in one mighty draught
    ]. "So, speak your mind! Just don't bitch if I do the same."

        |清凉饮料

rows.original: What's it like to be a skald in the lawless, barbarian islands?
rows.translation: 在那些荒芜无序、充满野蛮气息的岛屿上，担任一位吟游诗人究竟是一种怎样的体验呢？
rows.raw: "What's it like to be a skald in the lawless, barbarian islands?"

rows.original: Who's this Vulgra that she was mentioning earlier?
rows.translation: 她之前提到过的那个沃尔格拉到底是谁？
rows.raw: "Who's this Vulgra that she was mentioning earlier?"

rows.original: Most of the Kervus are at least nominally Lumian. How about Ylvid?
rows.translation: 大多数克尔维斯人至少在名义上属于卢米亚人。那么伊尔维德呢？
rows.raw: "Most of the Kervus are at least nominally Lumian. How about Ylvid?"

rows.original: What does Ylvid think about the tribe's new direction — and her potential part in growing it?
rows.translation: 伊尔维德对于部落的新发展方向有何看法？她又认为自己能够在其中发挥什么样的作用，为部落的发展做出贡献呢？
rows.raw: "What does Ylvid think about the tribe's new direction — and her potential part in growing it?"

rows.original: Talk to Ylvid about [ylvid.momPCAronaBoth|your children|her children with Arona|your children with her, and those Arona's fathered on the skald].
rows.translation: 与伊尔维德谈谈[ylvid.momPCAronaBoth|你的孩子们|她与阿罗娜的孩子|你和她所生的孩子，还有阿罗娜让那个吟游诗人生下的孩子]。
rows.raw: "Talk to Ylvid about [ylvid.momPCAronaBoth|your children|her children with Arona|your children with her, and those Arona's fathered on the skald]."

rows.original: Could Ylvid show Arona a thing or two about her skaldic fighting style?
rows.translation: 伊尔维德能否教阿罗娜几招吟游战士的战斗技巧？
rows.raw: "Could Ylvid show Arona a thing or two about her skaldic fighting style?"

rows.original: Arona needs to actually be around to benefit from teaching.
rows.translation: 阿罗娜必须在场才能接受教导。
rows.raw: "Arona needs to actually be around to benefit from teaching."

rows.original: You glance back at Arona. "You think you could teach [arona.isDom|my mistress|this big lug] something to help us in battle?" Ylvid laughs. "Her? I taught her just about everything she knows already! What more do you want from me, huh?" "Hey," Arona grunts. "I learned how to fight from my brother, not you. You and I've never really brawled except-" "In bed?" Ylvid leans forward, licking her tusk. "Where I taught you how to please a woman? You could still use a few lessons, girl." Arona snarls, and for a moment you think she's going to punch Ylvid — but she just yanks the bard's braid. "Bitch. I could take you in any battlefield." "Stupid kid!" Ylvid squirms free. "You think I don't have anything to teach you, huh?" "I think you're lucky the priests say beating up old women makes Lumia mad at you." Ylvid plants her hands on her hips. "Alright, that's it. You remember how to play the drums at least, pup?" "It's just banging on the top, how hard is it supposed to be?" Rolling her eyes, Ylvid turns to you, "She's playing dumber than she is, she's actually pretty damn good at it. Girl has a talent for pounding things, drums included. Can even sing, when she puts her mind to it." You watch as Arona's cheeks darken, just a little. This time she doesn't have a comeback. Ylvid grins at you. "Alright, I'll see what I can do. But we've gotta find you the right kit, big girl. You'll need your own drums, and a weapon you can wield in one hand, like my axe. And maybe something a little sexier to wear." Arona bristles, hefting her titanic chest up beneath her furred hides. "This is plenty sexy." "She does look good," you admit. "But she could look better," Ylvid insists. "You need something to accentuate those ham hocks, for starters." She slaps one of Arona's legs for emphasis. Before Arona can retaliate, Ylvid hooks a finger through the front of the brawler's bustier. "C'mon, ya lug, let's go bother Rags. I bet we can find some kit that'll fit you."
rows.translation: 你回头看向阿罗娜。“你能不能教[arona.isDom|我的女主人|这个大块头]一点战斗中能帮上我们的东西？” 伊尔维德笑了。“她？她会的东西差不多全是我教的！你还想从我这里要什么，嗯？” “喂，”阿罗娜哼道。“我打架是跟我哥学的，不是你。你和我从没真正较量过，除了——” “在床上？”伊尔维德向前倾身，舔了舔獠牙。“我在床上教你怎样取悦女人？姑娘，你还是需要再上几课。” 阿罗娜怒吼一声；有那么一刻，你以为她会一拳打向伊尔维德——可她只是猛地拽住吟游诗人的辫子。“贱人。无论在哪种战场，我都能打败你。” “蠢孩子！”伊尔维德挣脱出来。“你觉得我已经没什么能教你的了，嗯？” “我觉得你应该庆幸祭司们说殴打老妇人会惹卢米娅生气。” 伊尔维德双手叉腰。“好吧，够了。至少还记得怎么打鼓吧，小崽子？” “不就是敲鼓面吗，能有多难？” 伊尔维德翻着白眼转向你。“她只是在装得比实际更笨；其实她打得相当不错。这姑娘很有敲打东西的天赋，当然也包括鼓。她只要用点心，甚至还能唱歌。” 你看着阿罗娜的脸颊微微变暗。这一次，她没有还嘴。 伊尔维德朝你咧嘴一笑。“好吧，我看看能做些什么。不过，大姑娘，我们得先给你找到合适的装备。你需要自己的鼓，还要一把能单手使用的武器，就像我的斧子。或许还得换上一身更性感的衣服。” 阿罗娜恼火地挺起藏在毛皮衣物下的巨大胸脯。“这已经足够性感了。” “她确实很好看，”你承认道。 “但她可以变得更好看，”伊尔维德坚持道。“首先，你需要一些能凸显这双粗壮大腿的东西。”她拍了一下阿罗娜的腿，以示强调。 阿罗娜还没来得及反击，伊尔维德便把一根手指勾进斗士紧身上衣的前襟。“走吧，大块头，我们去烦烦拉格斯。我敢说我们能找到合你身的装备。”

rows.original: The opportunity to make Ragnild's life more miserable for a bit is enough to get Arona to follow Ylvid. You're not left alone for too terribly long, though: the girls return within the hour, with Ylvid looking as smug as [silly|a bug in a rug|can be]. Behind her marches Arona, still wearing those sexy hides of hers, but now with a long cloak draped around her shoulders and a pair of thigh-high boots that'd look right at home on Cait, complete with little heels that're making the amazon's steps unsteady as she follows [arona.ylvidFucked|her old flame|the bard] back to you. She's been afflicted with eyeliner and lipstick, a hint of rouge on her cheeks, a freshly done crown braid around her brows. "What'd I tell you?" Ylvid says proudly, slapping Arona's back. "Look at this big beauty. Ready to slay 'em and lay 'em. And we found this for her, too." Ylvid brandishes a hatchet, edged with silver and engraved with Sorran symbols. "Belonged to my old man. Almost forgot I still had it. I think he'd be tickled, knowing the chieftain of the tribe was using his axe." She hands it haft-first to Arona. Now you notice that the big beauty's carrying another lethal weapon under her left arm: a set of war drums, just like Ylvid's, on a sling over her shoulder. "Where'd those come from?" "My tent!" Arona laughs. "What, you think I just threw mine away? Ylvy woulda skinned me alive!" "You'd make a good set of drums, yourself," the older orc laughs. "So you can actually play those? Like Ylvid does?" you ask. There's a difference between just slapping away at an instrument and a bard's art, after all. Arona shrugs. "One way to find out. Just don't bitch if you don't end up liking my singing voice — you asked for this, remember that." You'll see how that pans out, you suppose. Arona can now equip the Storm Chanter set!
rows.translation: 能让拉格妮尔德再难受一阵的机会，足以说服阿罗娜跟随伊尔维德离开。不过，她们并没有把你独自留下太久：不到一个小时，姑娘们便回来了；伊尔维德看起来得意得[silly|像只钻进地毯的虫子|不得了]。阿罗娜跟在她身后，身上依然穿着那套性感毛皮，却多了一件披在肩上的长斗篷，还有一双长及大腿的高筒靴——配上小鞋跟，简直像是凯特会穿的款式；亚马逊战士跟着[arona.ylvidFucked|旧情人|吟游诗人]向你走来时，步伐也因此有些不稳。她还惨遭眼线和口红的荼毒，脸颊涂上了淡淡胭脂，眉前也重新编好一圈冠辫。 “我说什么来着？”伊尔维德骄傲地说道，同时拍了拍阿罗娜的后背。“看看这个大美人。准备好大杀四方，再把人统统睡一遍了。我们还给她找到了这个。” 伊尔维德挥舞着一把银刃短柄斧，上面刻有索兰符号。“这是我家老头子的。我差点忘了自己还留着它。要是知道部落酋长正在用他的斧子，他肯定会很高兴。” 她将斧柄朝前递给阿罗娜。直到这时，你才注意到大美人左臂下面还夹着另一件致命武器：一套与伊尔维德所用相同、以背带挂在肩上的战鼓。“那些是从哪儿来的？” “我的帐篷！”阿罗娜笑道。“怎么，你以为我直接把自己的鼓扔了？伊尔薇非活剥了我的皮不可！” “用你自己也能做出一套好鼓，”年长的兽人笑道。 “所以你真的会演奏？像伊尔维德那样？”你问道。毕竟，随便拍打乐器与吟游诗人的技艺之间存在差别。 阿罗娜耸耸肩。“试试就知道了。要是最后不喜欢我的歌声，别发牢骚——这是你自己要求的，记住。” 你想，之后自然会知道结果。 阿罗娜现在可以装备风暴咏唱者套装了！

rows.original: "So what's it like, being a skald in the islands?" "Fun!" Ylvid grins. "Wouldn't be doing it all these years if it wasn't. There's a hundred tribes living in the Sailgraves, some just a few mud huts huddled around a cave, and others have pocket empires like the Kervus; all of 'em love a good skald. Everyone fuckin' hates everyone else out there, beating each other over the head for whatever food and wealth they can steal, but one of the only things every tribe respects is a wandering skald. I can go anywhere and talk shit about anybody, and nobody lifts a hand to me. Striking a bard unprovoked gets you cursed by the gods, you know!" She laughs, and slaps the ass of a heavily-tattooed pexighast slave girl passing by. "We skalds, we collect the legends of not just our tribes but every tribe — and make a few of our own, if you've got balls as big as mine! We share those stories with the people we stay with, as thanks for their hospitality and in payment for the stories they share with us. Though every tribe has its own way of showing thanks for a well-sung saga." She leans in and gives [party.has arona |Arona's bulge a squeeze |you a toothy smirk ]. "There's nothing like the appreciation of a wide-eyed warrior-girl whose heart's been set ablaze by tales of heroics!" [party.has arona |Arona gasps, pawing off Ylvid's hand. "Hey, who can resist your charms when you're singing about her own ancestors, huh?" ] "Is it dangerous?" you ask. "Going around all by yourself?" Ylvid waves a hand. "I'm an orc, not some dainty elf princess! Things try and eat me all the time, but I'm good with my axe and spell-songs, and I've slain more than my share of beasts. The real threats are the kind on two legs, that are too addled or blackhearted to care whether you're a skald or a priest. Reavers hunt in packs, and even I can't overpower a half-dozen frothing berserkers at once. And I've made a few enemies over the years that're keen to hunt me down if they get the chance. Scorned men, a couple of shitbag skalds that can't hold a candle to my talents, a Velunite priest whose daughters all wanted me..." Ylvid puffs up her chest proudly. "You ain't anybody if you don't have enemies, and Sailgravers don't forget a face." She hefts her drum under an arm. "But as long as I have this and my axe, I'm not afraid of anything, or anyone!"
rows.translation: “那么，在这些岛屿上当一名吟游诗人，到底是什么感觉？” “有趣！”伊尔维德咧嘴一笑。“要是没意思，我也不会干这么多年了。帆葬海岸住着上百个部落，有些只是在洞穴周围挤着几间泥屋，有些则像克尔维斯那样拥有自己的小帝国；他们全都喜欢出色的吟游诗人。那地方人人都恨透了别人，为了能抢到的食物和财富互相砸脑袋，但所有部落都尊重的少数几件事之一，就是游荡的吟游诗人。我可以随便去哪儿、随便说谁的坏话，没人会动我一根手指。无缘无故殴打吟游诗人，可是会被神明诅咒的，你知道吧！” 她大笑起来，还拍了一个路过的、浑身刺青的佩克西加斯特奴隶女孩的屁股。“我们吟游诗人收集的不只是我们自己部落的传说，而是每个部落的——要是你有我这么大的卵蛋，还能自己编出一些来！我们会把这些故事讲给收留我们的人听，作为对他们好客的感谢，也作为他们与我们分享故事的报酬。不过每个部落表达对一首好歌谣的感谢的方式都各不相同。”她凑过身来，[party.has arona |捏了一把阿罗娜的胯下凸起 |朝你龇牙一笑 ]。“没有什么比得上一个被英雄事迹点燃了心火的、睁大眼睛的战士女孩所表达的欣赏了！” [party.has arona |阿罗娜倒吸一口气，一把拨开伊尔维德的手。“嘿，当你唱的是她自己祖先的故事时，谁能抵挡你的魅力呢，嗯？” ] “这样会很危险吗？”你问道。“一个人到处跑？” 伊尔维德摆了摆手。“我可是兽人，又不是什么娇弱的精灵公主！总有东西想吃掉我，但我的斧头和歌咒都很在行，我杀掉的野兽可比该我杀的多得多。真正的威胁是那些长着两条腿的家伙——他们糊涂到极点，或者黑心到根本不在乎你是吟游诗人还是祭司。掠夺者成群结队地狩猎，就算是我，也没法一次对付六个满嘴白沫的狂战士。这些年来我也结下了几个仇家，他们一有机会就急着追杀我。被我轻蔑过的男人，几个连给我提鞋都不配的混蛋吟游诗人，还有一个维伦信徒祭司——他的女儿们全都想要我……”伊尔维德得意地挺起胸膛。“没有敌人，你就什么都不是，而帆葬海岸人不会忘记任何一张脸。” 她把鼓夹到腋下。“但只要我有这个和我的斧头，我就什么都不怕，也不怕任何人！”
rows.raw: " "So what's it like, being a skald in the islands?" "Fun!" Ylvid grins. "Wouldn't be doing it all these years if it wasn't. There's a hundred tribes living in the Sailgraves, some just a few mud huts huddled around a cave, and others have pocket empires like the Kervus; all of 'em love a good skald. Everyone fuckin' hates everyone else out there, beating each other over the head for whatever food and wealth they can steal, but one of the only things every tribe respects is a wandering skald. I can go anywhere and talk shit about anybody, and nobody lifts a hand to me. Striking a bard unprovoked gets you cursed by the gods, you know!" She laughs, and slaps the ass of a heavily-tattooed pexighast slave girl passing by. "We skalds, we collect the legends of not just our tribes but every tribe — and make a few of our own, if you've got balls as big as mine! We share those stories with the people we stay with, as thanks for their hospitality and in payment for the stories they share with us. Though every tribe has its own way of showing thanks for a well-sung saga." She leans in and gives [party.has arona |Arona's bulge a squeeze |you a toothy smirk ]. "There's nothing like the appreciation of a wide-eyed warrior-girl whose heart's been set ablaze by tales of heroics!" [party.has arona |Arona gasps, pawing off Ylvid's hand. "Hey, who can resist your charms when you're singing about her own ancestors, huh?" ] "Is it dangerous?" you ask. "Going around all by yourself?" Ylvid waves a hand. "I'm an orc, not some dainty elf princess! Things try and eat me all the time, but I'm good with my axe and spell-songs, and I've slain more than my share of beasts. The real threats are the kind on two legs, that are too addled or blackhearted to care whether you're a skald or a priest. Reavers hunt in packs, and even I can't overpower a half-dozen frothing berserkers at once. And I've made a few enemies over the years that're keen to hunt me down if they get the chance. Scorned men, a couple of shitbag skalds that can't hold a candle to my talents, a Velunite priest whose daughters all wanted me..." Ylvid puffs up her chest proudly. "You ain't anybody if you don't have enemies, and Sailgravers don't forget a face." She hefts her drum under an arm. "But as long as I have this and my axe, I'm not afraid of anything, or anyone!" "

rows.original: "So, you and Arona..." [party.has arona |"Yeah!" Arona says, leaning over Ylvid. "Me and you, Ylvy." Ylvid snorts and [arona.bredYlvid |gives Arona a tusky kiss on the neck. |pushes the big girl off her. ] |Ylvid snorts. ] "Yeah, the girl and I go way back. Jarl Kervus himself used to be my biggest patron, paid me to sit around and entertain him and his retainers in their fort, back when Arona was just a babe in arms. Hah, I was just a teenager then, barely out from my mentor's wing, but he gave me a shot. It meant a lot to me. When he died, I stuck around the fort, helped out how I could. You've met the middle kid, Hretha, blinder than a bat? She kept biting slaves and scholars the family'd brought in to teach her, so Argoth put me to work teaching her our peoples' custom and history. Me and the shaman brought her up right. But then there's [party.has arona |this lump," she says, poking Arona's gut. |the new new Chief, Arona..." ] The skald shakes her head. "Arona's a wild child, always has been, but she's nothing if not the orcish ideal of a woman: huge, strong, and stubborn."[party.has arona | "Damn right!" Arona nods. " | Ylvid laughs. " ]But when I was done with Hretha, I was damn well a woman grown myself. I got stir-crazy, and left the island for a while, wandering through the Sailgraves. I fought and sung my way across the archipelago for years — a little aimless, sure, but having a great time! But ten years after I set out, [party.has arona |this brat |that damn girl ] tracked me down! She wanted me back in the tribe. Said it felt hollow without me." [party.has arona |[arona.bredYlvid |"Well it did!" Arona says. "I missed you, Ylvy. I think some part of me already knew I wanted to put a few whelps in you." "You didn't even have a dick back then! And let me tell my story." Ylvid snorts. |Arona frowns. "Did not." "Did too," Ylvid insists. ] ]"But I didn't want to go back. I was having too much fun fuckin' around on my own, seeing the islands however I wanted. But Arona... she doesn't know how to take 'no' for an answer! So she plants her hammer in the dirt and says I can leave with her or through her." Ylvid gives a dramatic sigh, [party.has arona |leaning into Arona's side and resting her head on a boob |but crosses her legs tightly ]. "Well, no orc backs down from a challenge, especially not a skald! So I said if she won, I'd come with her. But if I won, she'd have to give me something she could never get back. Her first time." [party.has arona |Arona's arm around Ylvid slips down and hefts up a hefty tit. Ylvid doesn't pull away this time. The skald just smirks |Ylvid just bites her lip ]. "We scuffled for the better part of an hour, before we both collapsed into each other. We couldn't decide who won. So... hell, why not split the difference? I broke in the Kervus's youngest firebrand, and she carried me back to the home island over her shoulder, and tossed me to her tattooist to make sure I was bearing the tribe's symbol on my flesh." She [ylvid.isPregnant |caresses her stomach |slaps her stomach ], just over the tattoo of a pair of horned wolves butting their racks together inked over her womb. "Worth it," Ylvid adds, rubbing a pair of fingers over the blue antlers. "Tribe'd fall apart without me around anyway! I'm surprised they didn't all drown while I was away, but I'm here for the long haul now.[arona.bredYlvid | Never thought I'd be mated to the chieftain, and definitely not Arona herself, but... even if I complain the bitch just ignores it." "I know you're not serious," Arona says, flexing her muscles around Ylvid's middle. "You've always been my favorite girl in the tribe, and you know it." Ylvid's cheeks darken, especially when the big amazon's hand strokes her [ylvid.belly]. "I know you love me, you oaf. And I know you love our babies. [arona.isLover |Just like I know you love [pc.name] here. ]You aren't subtle. So don't worry, I'll be here to take care of you, and our kids, and our tribe, as long as it takes to make your dream of a new age come true. ]"
rows.translation: “所以，你和阿罗娜……” [party.has arona |“没错！”阿罗娜说道，俯身凑向伊尔维德。“就是你和我，伊尔薇。” 伊尔维德哼了一声，[arona.bredYlvid |用带着獠牙的嘴在阿罗娜脖子上亲了一口。 |把那个大块头女孩从身上推开。 ] |伊尔维德哼了一声。 ] “是啊，我和那姑娘的交情可久了。克尔维斯领主本人曾是我最大的赞助人，他出钱让我坐在他们的堡垒里，逗他和他手下的随从开心，那时候阿罗娜还只是个襁褓里的婴儿。哈哈，我那时才十几岁，刚离开导师的羽翼，是他给了我机会。这对我意义重大。他死后，我就留在堡垒里，尽我所能帮忙。你见过中间那个孩子赫蕾莎吧？她瞎得像只蝙蝠。她老是咬家里请来教她的奴隶和学者，于是阿戈斯就让我去教她我们族人的习俗和历史。我和萨满一起把她带大。可后来还有[party.has arona |就是这个傻大个，”她说着，戳了戳阿罗娜的肚子。 |新上任的新酋长，阿罗娜……” ] 那位吟游诗人摇了摇头。“阿罗娜一直是个野性十足的孩子，向来如此，但她无疑是兽人对女性的理想典范：高大、强壮、固执。”[party.has arona | “说得对！”阿罗娜点点头。 “ | 伊尔维德笑了起来。“ ]但等我把赫蕾莎的事了结时，我自己也早就是个成年的女人了。我待得发疯，于是离开那座岛一阵子，在帆葬海岸四处游荡。多年来，我在群岛上一边打斗一边唱歌，一路走过——确实有点漫无目的，但过得痛快极了！可在我出发十年之后，[party.has arona |这个臭丫头 |那个该死的姑娘 ]找上了我！她想让我回部落。说没有我在，总觉得空落落的。” [party.has arona |[arona.bredYlvid |“本来就是！”阿罗娜说道。“我想你了，伊尔薇。我觉得我内心深处早就知道，我想往你肚子里塞几只崽子。” “那时候你连根鸡巴都还没有呢！还有，让我把故事讲完。”伊尔维德哼了一声。 |阿罗娜皱起眉头。“才没有。” “就是有，”伊尔维德坚持道。 ] ]“可我不想回去。我一个人到处鬼混、随心所欲地看那些岛屿，实在太快活了。可阿罗娜……她根本不懂什么叫‘不’！于是她把锤子往地上一插，说我要么跟她走，要么就从她身上过去。” 伊尔维德戏剧性地叹了口气，[party.has arona |侧身靠进阿罗娜怀里，把头枕在一只奶子上 |却把双腿紧紧交叉起来 ]。“哼，没有哪个兽人会从挑战面前退缩，吟游诗人更是如此！所以我说，要是她赢了，我就跟她走。但要是我赢了，她就得给我一样永远拿不回来的东西。她的第一次。” [party.has arona |阿罗娜搂着伊尔维德的手臂滑落下去，托起一只沉甸甸的奶子。这一次伊尔维德没有躲开。那位吟游诗人只是得意地一笑 |伊尔维德只是咬了咬嘴唇 ]。“我们扭打了大半个钟头，最后双双瘫进对方怀里。我们分不出谁赢了。所以……管他呢，干脆算打个平手？我驯服了克尔维斯家最年轻的小烈马，而她把我扛在肩上带回本岛，丢给她的纹身师，确保我身上带着部落的印记。”她[ylvid.isPregnant |抚摸着自己的肚子 |拍了拍自己的肚子 ]，就在她小腹上方那对犄角相抵的角狼纹身上。 “值得，”伊尔维德说着，用两根手指摩挲着那对蓝色的角。“反正没我在，部落早散架了！我真奇怪我不在的时候他们怎么没全淹死，不过现在我回来了，就长期待下去了。[arona.bredYlvid | 从没想过自己会跟酋长结为伴侣，更没想到会是阿罗娜本人，可是……就算我抱怨，那婊子也根本不理我。” “我知道你不是认真的，”阿罗娜说着，用肌肉环紧伊尔维德的腰腹。“你在部落里一直是我最喜欢的姑娘，你自己也清楚。” 伊尔维德的脸颊泛红，尤其是当那位高大的兽人亚马逊的手抚摸她[ylvid.belly]的时候。“我知道你爱我，你这个笨蛋。我也知道你很爱我们的孩子。[arona.isLover |就像我知道你也爱着这里的[pc.name]一样。 ]你一点也不含蓄。所以别担心，我会一直在这儿，照顾你、我们的孩子，还有我们的部落，直到你那个新时代的梦想成真。 ]”

rows.original: "So, who's Thane Vulgra, anyway?" you ask. Ylvid grins. "Only the greatest warrior in the Sailgraves! She's the raider-queen that sacked Khor'elthos; a beauty without compare, with biceps like treetrunks and thighs that can kill a man. By the power of her gods-forged axe, Seasplitter, she's carved a legend for herself that'll live throughout the ages across all the islands!" The skald sighs dreamily. "Vulgra's the most powerful thane in the Kervus tribe, and she's the one left behind to [orcs.areSettlers |safeguard our holdings and protect the ships coming out here with all our people |guard the home islands while the rest of the tribe's here following the Chief ]. More importantly, she's clearly the most intelligent of them all, since she's the one that's paying me to sit around and sing her praises, entertain her retainers, and teach her nieces and nephews." "Right," you laugh. "I can tell." Nodding, the skald takes a long chug of her drink. "Wouldn't have left her, and home, except I heard [var0 |Livrea was here |about that Livrea girl ]. I wasn't going to pass up a chance to test my skills against her! Now that I'm here, of course, Arona's [ylvid.isMom |gotten it in her head we all need to breed... and clearly I'm part of the plan." Some of the warriors catcall her, earning a venomous snarl. |not letting me get away again, so I'll just have to make sure the boys around here are well entertained!" She lifts her mug, to bellowing cheers from the lodge's warriors. ] To you, the skald adds more quietly, "Vulgra's my best friend. She's ferocious, but also generous and kind. She's got a real brain behind all that brawn; more than most of us Kervus. [party.has arona |Arona's lucky to have such a loyal and cunning supporter, huh? |She'd make a damn fine leader. Arona's lucky to have her at her back rather than vying for her spot. Lucky that Vulgra's got no nose for politicking, and just wants to keep her kin prosperous. ]" "Are we likely to ever see her out here?" Ylvid shakes her head. "Nah, not [orcs.areSettlers |for a while. She'll be the last to leave the old islands, if we ever do give them up completely. She's reliable, so she gets to be the rear guard. |likely. She's already been fighting off pexighast tribes left and right while our strength's tied up here. I hear it's been fierce! So I doubt we'll see her coming out here unless something incredible happens. ]"
rows.translation: “那么，沃尔格拉领主究竟是谁？”你问道。 伊尔维德咧嘴一笑。“当然是帆葬海岸最伟大的战士！她是洗劫科尔埃尔索斯的掠袭女王；美貌无与伦比，肱二头肌粗如树干，大腿能夹死男人。凭借神明锻造的战斧裂海者，她为自己刻下了一段传说，将在所有岛屿上世代流传！”吟游诗人如痴如醉地叹了口气。“沃尔格拉是克尔维斯部落最强大的领主，大家离开后，她负责[orcs.areSettlers |守护我们的领地，并保护载着所有族人前来这里的船只 |在其余族人来到这里追随酋长时，保卫故乡群岛 ]。更重要的是，她显然也是所有人里最聪明的；毕竟正是她付钱让我在这里闲坐着歌颂她、逗乐她的随从，再教导她的侄子侄女。” “当然，”你笑道。“我看得出来。” 吟游诗人点点头，仰头灌下一大口酒。“要不是听说[var0 |莉维娅在这里 |那个叫莉维娅的姑娘 ]，我才舍不得离开她和故乡。我绝不会错过和她比试本领的机会！当然，既然已经来了，阿罗娜又[ylvid.isMom |一门心思认定我们全都得生孩子……显然，我也是她计划的一部分。” 一些战士朝她吹起口哨，换来一声恶狠狠的咆哮。 |不肯再让我离开，那我只好确保这里的男孩们全都得到充分款待！” 她举起酒杯，大厅里的战士们顿时爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼。 ]她又压低声音对你补充道：“沃尔格拉是我最好的朋友。她凶猛，却也慷慨善良。那一身蛮力背后藏着真正的头脑，比我们大多数克尔维斯人都聪明。[party.has arona |阿罗娜能有这样忠诚又机敏的支持者，可真幸运，对吧？ |她会成为一位出色的领袖。阿罗娜很幸运，沃尔格拉愿意支持她，而不是争夺她的位置。也幸亏沃尔格拉不爱玩弄权术，只想让自己的亲族兴旺富足。 ]” “我们有可能在这里见到她吗？” 伊尔维德摇摇头。“不，[orcs.areSettlers |暂时不可能。即使我们最终彻底放弃旧群岛，她也会是最后一个离开的人。正因为她可靠，才被安排负责殿后。 |大概不会。我们的主力被牵制在这里时，她一直在家乡各处击退佩克西加斯特部落。听说战况十分激烈！所以除非发生什么惊天动地的大事，否则我不觉得她会来这里。 ]”
rows.raw: " "So, who's Thane Vulgra, anyway?" you ask. Ylvid grins. "Only the greatest warrior in the Sailgraves! She's the raider-queen that sacked Khor'elthos; a beauty without compare, with biceps like treetrunks and thighs that can kill a man. By the power of her gods-forged axe, Seasplitter, she's carved a legend for herself that'll live throughout the ages across all the islands!" The skald sighs dreamily. "Vulgra's the most powerful thane in the Kervus tribe, and she's the one left behind to [orcs.areSettlers |safeguard our holdings and protect the ships coming out here with all our people |guard the home islands while the rest of the tribe's here following the Chief ]. More importantly, she's clearly the most intelligent of them all, since she's the one that's paying me to sit around and sing her praises, entertain her retainers, and teach her nieces and nephews." "Right," you laugh. "I can tell." Nodding, the skald takes a long chug of her drink. "Wouldn't have left her, and home, except I heard [var0 |Livrea was here |about that Livrea girl ]. I wasn't going to pass up a chance to test my skills against her! Now that I'm here, of course, Arona's [ylvid.isMom |gotten it in her head we all need to breed... and clearly I'm part of the plan." Some of the warriors catcall her, earning a venomous snarl. |not letting me get away again, so I'll just have to make sure the boys around here are well entertained!" She lifts her mug, to bellowing cheers from the lodge's warriors. ] To you, the skald adds more quietly, "Vulgra's my best friend. She's ferocious, but also generous and kind. She's got a real brain behind all that brawn; more than most of us Kervus. [party.has arona |Arona's lucky to have such a loyal and cunning supporter, huh? |She'd make a damn fine leader. Arona's lucky to have her at her back rather than vying for her spot. Lucky that Vulgra's got no nose for politicking, and just wants to keep her kin prosperous. ]" "Are we likely to ever see her out here?" Ylvid shakes her head. "Nah, not [orcs.areSettlers |for a while. She'll be the last to leave the old islands, if we ever do give them up completely. She's reliable, so she gets to be the rear guard. |likely. She's already been fighting off pexighast tribes left and right while our strength's tied up here. I hear it's been fierce! So I doubt we'll see her coming out here unless something incredible happens. ]" "

rows.original: "Most of the Kervus seem to [pc.isBimbo |think Lumia's the best god! |hold Lumia in highest esteem among the Seven, ]" you say. "What about you?" "Hmm..." Ylvid taps her chin. "[ylvid.isMom |I've certainly come around on her. Hard to go wrong with the goddess of motherhood when you're a mom, isn't it? But |Nah. It's hard to go wrong with the goddess of big, round bellies and a warm hearth to come home to, but ] I'm more of a Sorra kinda girl. I travel a lot between the islands, and you're a fool if you don't appease the Stormsinger before a trip over the waters. Also, y'know, the singer part doesn't hurt! Mallach's the god of song and poetry, and he's great don't get me wrong, but the wildness of Sorra, the love of danger and adventure, that's what draws me to her. What's life without the spice?" You chuckle. "[ylvid.isMom |You really weren't drawn to motherhood, huh? |So not that drawn to motherhood, then? ]" Ylvid just snorts. "Not 'specially. We skalds take a hand in raising kids all the time; until I left to join the camp here, I was doin' it for Thane Vulgra back home. Teaching her nieces and nephews their history, the great sagas, how to play music, prayers for all the gods. Been doing it for families on and off since I was Arona's age. [ylvid.isMom |I used to think that was close enough to having kids, at least for me. But... maybe I was wrong about it. There's something different when they're your kids." Ylvid shakes her head and puts a hand on her [ylvid.belly]. "Being a mom really changes your perspective. I always thought that was a buncha romantic bullshit, but it's true! So yeah, I've been praying to Lumia a lot more than before. To Tira, too, to ask that my time to die be far off enough that I see these little shits grow up to be fierce warrior-skalds like me!" |I think that's close enough to havin' kids of my own for me. Skip the hard part of gettin' all heavy with 'em and pushing 'em out, changing them when they're tiny, all of that. I just get to mold 'em into fine young orcs when they're older!" Shaking her head, Ylvid thrusts out her hands in front of her stomach. "Hell, can you imagine it? Me, pregnant, waddling around with my gut out to here? I'd be a laughing stock!" The excited howls that erupt from the warriors all around her paint a different picture. Ylvid snarls at the boys — and a few amazons — cat-calling her. "Shut your face-holes! I don't want to hear you all yapping like a bunch of gnolls if it does ever happen, you hear?" "Anyway," she grunts. "Let's change the subject before any of the boys get ideas." ]
rows.translation: “大多数克尔维斯人似乎都[pc.isBimbo |觉得卢米娅是最棒的神！ |在七神之中最为尊崇卢米娅， ]”你说道。“你呢？” “嗯……”伊尔维德敲了敲下巴。“[ylvid.isMom |我当然已经逐渐开始信奉她了。当上母亲以后，选择母性女神总不会错，对吧？不过 |不算。谁会不喜欢大而圆的肚子，以及回家后温暖炉火的女神呢？不过 ]我更像是索拉的信徒。我经常往返于各个岛屿；出海前要是不安抚风暴歌者，那就是个傻瓜。况且，你也知道，歌者这个名号更是加分！马拉克是歌曲与诗歌之神，他确实很棒，别误会；但索拉的狂野、对危险与冒险的热爱，才是吸引我的地方。生活若没有一点刺激，还有什么意思？” 你轻笑起来。“[ylvid.isMom |你以前确实没被母亲这个身份吸引，对吧？ |所以你其实不太向往成为母亲？ ]” 伊尔维德只是哼了一声。“不怎么向往。我们这些吟游诗人一直都会参与照料孩子；离开家乡加入这个营地前，我就在替沃尔格拉领主做这些事。教她的侄子侄女学习历史、伟大传奇、演奏音乐以及向所有神明祈祷。我从阿罗娜这个年纪起，就时不时替不同家庭照顾孩子。[ylvid.isMom |我曾觉得，至少对我而言，这和拥有自己的孩子已经足够接近。但……也许我想错了。当他们是你自己的孩子时，感觉确实不一样。” 伊尔维德摇摇头，把一只手放在自己的[ylvid.belly]上。“成为母亲真的会改变你的看法。我以前一直觉得那套说辞尽是浪漫的胡扯，可它居然是真的！所以没错，我现在向卢米娅祈祷的次数比以前多得多。我也会向蒂拉祈祷，求她让我的死期来得足够晚，好让我亲眼看着这些小混蛋长成像我一样凶猛的战士吟游诗人！” |我觉得，这已经足够接近拥有自己的孩子了。可以跳过肚子变得沉重、把他们生出来、在他们还小的时候给他们换洗等等难熬的部分。等他们长大一些，我只管把他们塑造成优秀的年轻兽人！” 伊尔维德摇着头，把双手伸到肚子前方。“该死，你能想象吗？我怀着孕，挺着这么大的肚子蹒跚乱走？我肯定会沦为笑柄！” 四周战士们爆发出的兴奋嚎叫，却描绘出了截然不同的景象。 伊尔维德朝那些起哄的男孩——还有少数亚马逊——龇牙怒吼。“闭上你们的嘴洞！要是这事真的发生了，我可不想听见你们像一群豺狼人一样汪汪乱叫，听见没有？” “不管怎样，”她哼道。“趁男孩们还没冒出什么念头，换个话题吧。” ]
