rows.original: You lean against the side of the lodge and [ylvid.pregStage 2 |put a hand on the skald's growing tummy, right where her abs used to be. "How're you handling [arona.bredYlvid |being bred by Arona |having my baby in here ]?" Ylvid slaps your hand off, though she's got a faint grin beneath her tusks. "This is fucked up. I never thought I'd be a mother. This shit's supposed to happen to other, dumber girls in the tribe — and then I get to make fun of them!" "You didn't protest that hard when Hretha said you ought to have a kid, though." "I guess not," Ylvid says. She shrugs, and pats her belly. "Somehow I reckoned even if I stopped taking the tea, I'd get away unscathed. And then when the first morning sick hit me, it just felt... well, it was a shock!" "But?" "But now my whole life's about to change, and I don't have much say in it. The tribe's changing, too. More pregnant women, sure, but also more folk coming in from the islands now. Talk about farming, building houses. It's fucking weird. But... but I've never seen the Kervus this, I don't know, hopeful? Like we've suddenly got more going on than just seal-clubbing other tribes back home. Like instead of destroying, we're planning on creating. It's not orcy! I can't decide if I like it or hate it." You put your hand back on Ylvid's belly. This time she doesn't slap you. "And what about this?" "This? What, do you think I'm not gonna love my kids just because it wasn't my idea? Ha. This little shit's gonna be the greatest skald the Sailg— shit, the Frost Marches, has ever seen. I've trained apprentices before, this one I'm just gonna be raising from scratch. Fuck the chief and fuck Hretha, and fuck you too, I'm gonna be a great god-damn mom just to spite you all.[arona.bredYlvid | And I'm going to make that smug shit of a chieftain shower me in gifts for bearing her kid! I want the biggest fucking boat in the tribe — and I want her to captain it while I thunder the oar-drums! ]" You can't help but laugh. Now that's orcy alright. Even motherhood's a contest. |poke the Skald's muscular midriff. "Have you thought about the chieftain's new decree yet?" "What?" Ylvid snorts. "That we're supposed to all stop with the tea and start spreading our legs? Ha! I'm a skald, I don't back down from a challenge. Let [pc.isVirile |any land-born clod that wants to try do [pc.hisHer] best, I say! I'll take you on and show you what it means to try to breed an orc! |Arona come and show me her best. I'll break her fucking pelvis for her trouble if she wants to take a swing at breeding me! ]" You laugh at the older woman's boasting. "It's got to be a challenge with you, huh?" She sneers. "I don't want kids, but I'm loyal to my tribe. I won't refuse the chief's orders. But I'll damn well make [pc.isVirile |you |her ] work for it, if this is to be my fate." Ylvid puts her hands on her hips and throws back her head with a haughty laugh. While normally the skald's boasts and bragging gets the rest of the warriors in the lodge to cheer, this time there's a lot more leering at her half-bare body. If [pc.isVirile |you don't |Arona doesn't ] set about claiming this fierce prize, you're sure there's going to be a line of Kervus warriors eager to try their luck at planting their seed in her fertile fields. She knows it, too. Ylvid throws her mug at one of the most obvious of the leches, and [pc.isVirile |cuts you a glance. "I'd hope the [pc.raceCute] who [arona.isDom |caught our chieftain's eye |subdued our chieftain ] isn't wasting my time with these questions. A girl might get some ideas... if you're [pc.mf |man |woman ] enough. |shakes our her hair. "I only hope a worthy mate shows [pc.himHer]self! I don't mean to waste time with the likes of you! ]" [party.has arona |From across the lodge, Arona cups her package at Ylvid. The skald rolls her eyes. "Damn kid..." ] ]
rows.translation: 你靠在小屋的侧壁上， [ylvid.pregStage 2 |把手放在那位女歌手逐渐凸起的肚子上——也就是她曾经拥有紧实腹肌的地方，然后问道：“你是怎么应对这种变化的？ [arona.bredYlvid |由阿罗娜培育而来 |在这里生下我的孩子 ]尤尔维德一把拍开了你的手，不过她的獠牙后面其实藏着一丝微笑。“这太搞砸了……我从没想过自己会成为一名母亲。这种事情本来应该发生在部落里那些更傻的女孩身上——这样我就可以嘲笑她们了！ 不过，当赫蕾莎说你应该要个孩子的时候，你并没有那么强烈地反对啊。” “我想确实没有，”伊尔维德说。她耸了耸肩，然后轻拍着自己的肚子：“我当时觉得，就算不再喝那种茶了，也应该不会有什么坏处。结果到了第一天早上出现孕吐症状的时候，我真的觉得……哎，简直太意外了！ 但是？” “可是现在我的整个人生都要改变了，而我却几乎没有发言权。部落也在发生变化——怀孕的女性确实增多了，同时也有越来越多的人从那些岛屿上来到这里。大家开始讨论如何耕种、如何建造房屋…… 这他妈太奇怪了。但是……我从来没见过凯尔维斯族人表现出这种态度，我不知道，应该说是充满希望吧？就好像我们突然不再只是单纯地攻击其他部落了。我们不再只是破坏，而是开始计划去创造一些新的东西。这根本不是我喜欢的风格！我实在不知道自己是该喜欢它还是该讨厌它。 你再次将手放在伊尔维德的肚子上。这一次，她没有打你。“那这个呢？” “这个？你以为就因为这不是我的主意，我就不会爱我的孩子吗？哈，这个小家伙将来一定会成为赛尔格——该死，是整个霜冻之地有史以来最伟大的吟游诗人。我以前也教过学徒，但这个孩子，我打算从头开始培养他。去他的首领，去他的赫蕾莎，也去你的……我就为了让你们都难堪，也要成为一个出色的母亲。[arona.bredYlvid | 我就让那个自以为是的酋长因为让我生了她的孩子而送我一堆礼物吧！我想要部落里最大的船——而且我要让她来当船长，而我就负责敲鼓指挥划桨！ ]你忍不住笑了起来。现在那个真是太疯狂了……就连当母亲也成了一场竞赛。 |戳了戳那位吟游诗人的结实腹部，问道：“你考虑过首领的新法令了吗？” “什么？”伊尔维德哼了一声，“就是让我们所有人都别再喝茶了，而是去……做别的事情？哈！我可是吟游诗人，面对挑战我从不会退缩。 [pc.isVirile |任何想要尝试这么做的陆地生物[pc.hisHer]我说，这简直太棒了！我愿意接受你的挑战，让你亲眼看看尝试培育兽人到底意味着什么！ |阿罗娜，过来给我展示你的实力吧。如果她真想尝试和我交配，我就把她那该死的骨盆打断！ ]你们嘲笑那位年长女性的自夸：“肯定是要给你出个难题吧，对吧？” 她冷笑道：“我不想要孩子，但我对部落非常忠诚。我不会拒绝首领的命令。不过，我肯定会[pc.isVirile |你 |她 ]如果这就是我的命运，那就必须努力争取。” 伊尔维德双手叉腰，傲慢地仰头大笑。通常情况下，这位吟游诗人的夸夸其谈总会让营地里其他战士们发出欢呼声，但这一次，人们注视着她那半裸的身体的眼神中却充满了更多的淫邪意味。 [pc.isVirile |你不行。 |阿罗娜不会。 ]当你决定去争夺这个诱人的奖品时，肯定会有许多凯尔维斯战士争先恐后地想要试试自己的运气，将他们的“种子”播撒在她那肥沃的土地上。 她自己也明白这一点。于是，伊尔维德把她的杯子扔向了那些最明显的追求者中的一个[pc.isVirile |他瞥了你一眼，说道：“希望如此。 [pc.raceCute]谁[arona.isDom |引起了我们首领的注意 |使我们的首领屈服 ]问这些问题根本不会浪费我的时间。不过，如果是个女孩子的话，或许能得到一些灵感[pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]够了。 |她摇动着头发，说道：“我只希望能遇到一个值得托付终生的伴侣。 [pc.himHer]自己！我可不想把时间浪费在你们这种人身上！ ]" [party.has arona |在小屋的另一头，阿罗娜把她的包裹递给了伊尔维德。那位吟游诗人翻了个白眼：“该死的丫头…… ] ]

rows.original: [var0 |[arona.bredYlvid |"[pc.name]!" You've barely made it to the gates before [party.has arona |Arona goes running towards the camp. "I hear screaming from Hretha's tent! Come on!" |you're grabbed by Arona, dragged into a hug that threatens to crush your spine. "You're just in time! Ylvid's in labor!" ] You're pulled along into the camp, straight to the shaman's tent. A small crowd's gathered, including a number of other tribeswomen heavy with child or with newborns in arm, all following the same command that Ylvid did. You can hear howls of pain and effort echoing from inside, but Ylvid bars your entrance with a firm look. "Hretha has her. Don't worry, you two." "Worry? The fuck am I worried about?" Arona grunts. "Ylvid's gonna kick labor's ass." From inside, Hretha bellows "Push!" — and then you hear a scream that seems to shake the earth... followed by the wail of an infant. There's a collective sigh of relief from all those around you, Arona most of all. "It's a boy!" Infrith smiles and slaps the big amazon's bicep. "See, she's-" Another scream rips through the tent. "Fuck! Push again, damn it!" Hretha shouts. "There's another one!" Arona gasps. "T-twins!?" Another scream is followed by another, softer wail from inside. "A girl!" Arona cheers, sweeping you up into another hug. "Twins! A boy and a girl! Hahaha!" The big amazon turns, hefts Infrith up into a hug, and then sets the heavyset shamaness back down out her way so she can dip into the tent. There's a lot of angry orcish snarling and shouting in response to the invasion, but you suspect Arona doesn't care when her newborn children are just inside. Eventually it subsides into just the chieftain's jubilations — you imagine infants have been brought to breast, and the new mother's calmed herself down in Arona's arms. When Arona does finally come back out, it's with a weary, warm smile on her face. "Rjonar and Yngrith. That's going to be their names. Yngrith's going to have Hretha's gifts, looks like. Same foggy eyes. Big girl, too. And my son! Ah, he's got my eyes and Ylvy's hair. He's so handsome already!" You and the collected tribeswomen give the chief your congratulations, and several of the women dip inside to see the babies or give Ylvid their regards. You, though, are crushed into another great big hug. |"[pc.name]!" You've barely made it to the gates before you see Infrith come running, waving her arms. "It's Ylvid! The babies!" Well, shit, you got here just in time. You dart towards the shamans' tent[party.has arona | with Arona close behind |, and find Arona waiting outside for you ]. There's screaming inside, both Hretha's and Ylvid's, in a chaotic mix of orcish and Belharan curses. The big amazon clasps your shoulder before you step through the tentflap. Inside, Ylvid's sitting on a bloodied blanket, holding an infant to her breast with Hretha continues working between her legs. "Push!" the shaman commands. "Push, damn it!" Twins! Ylvid cuts you an absolutely furious look before squeezing her eyes closed and throwing all her strength into one last push. A few moments later, and Hretha's holding a second baby up, laughing as she washes it off in a basin of water close at hand. "Lucky you, [pc.name]. Ylvid wasn't as dried up as I feared after all." "Fuck you both!" the skald groans, accepting the second child. "Ah, a girl. One of each. A good omen, at least." "They're beautiful," you tell her, kneeling down beside where she lays and putting a hand on her sweat-soaked forehead. Ylvid tries to snort, but all the comes through is a weary sigh. "Yeah. We did good." She glances down at the babies now latched to either breast with a fond smile. "That fuckin' hurt, you know, you little rascals. You'd better grow up to be heroes for all that. Hmm. Rjonar and Yngrith, I think. I'll name them for the first Kervus." "Bad luck to name them early," Hretha says. "But good names anyway." Ylvid nods. "You're Lumian, they'll be find with you around. And with the mighty Champion watching over our tribe, too." "I'll keep them safe," you promise. Glancing at the pair, you give each infant's head a stroke. "Rjonar and Yngirth, huh? Gods, they're so big." "Yeah they are. Champions in the making, you ask me." You spend the next few hours getting to know Rjonar and Yngirth with their mother, before helping to wrap them both up and carry them to Ylvid's tent. You're just in time to see Arona dropping off a newly-built second crib to go with the one already prepared inside. She gives you a clap on the back, and introduces herself to the babies before letting Ylvid in to get them tucked in. "Congrats, you two," the chieftain says proudly. "The tribe's going to be so much stronger with those two around. I can feel it!" You can, too. ] |[var1 |Ylvid is waiting for you at the gates of the camp. Rjonar and Yngrith are trailing behind her, clutching at their mother's long cape... but your eyes are drawn from the young children to the bundle in Ylvid's arms. "Ylvid!" "Me," the skald laughs. "And our new sprat. A [rand |boy |girl ]. One more for my growing little horde." She smiles at you fondly, and her free hand pets Yngrith's messy brown hair. You take the opportunity to move in and get your arms around the newly postpartum mother, giving her and then your new child each a kiss. Ylvid clutches at your [pc.armor], keeping you from getting away from her lips for a few good, long moments. Orcs may not be the gentlest folk in Savarra, but for a few moments, Ylvid seems so needy, so vulnerable... it's impossible to stop kissing her. Rjonar giggles and blows a raspberry at you both, to his twin sister's great amusement. You finally pull yourself away to flick one of his tiny little tusks. "Let me get to know your new sibling!" The newborn just mewls and paws at Ylvid's chest. "Alright," the skald laughs, "seems to be meal-time, eh? I bet you two are hungry too, aren't you?" The twins babble, and Ylvid grins. "Good, then let's get you home. I'll see you at the lodge, [pc.mf |daddy |mommy ]. If you're lucky, I'll have leftovers for you, too." rows.raw: ' [var0 |[arona.bredYlvid |"[pc.name]!" You've barely made it to the gates before [party.has arona |Arona goes running towards the camp. "I hear screaming from Hretha's tent! Come on!" |you're grabbed by Arona, dragged into a hug that threatens to crush your spine. "You're just in time! Ylvid's in labor!" ] You're pulled along into the camp, straight to the shaman's tent. A small crowd's gathered, including a number of other tribeswomen heavy with child or with newborns in arm, all following the same command that Ylvid did. You can hear howls of pain and effort echoing from inside, but Ylvid bars your entrance with a firm look. "Hretha has her. Don't worry, you two." "Worry? The fuck am I worried about?" Arona grunts. "Ylvid's gonna kick labor's ass." From inside, Hretha bellows "Push!" — and then you hear a scream that seems to shake the earth... followed by the wail of an infant. There's a collective sigh of relief from all those around you, Arona most of all. "It's a boy!" Infrith smiles and slaps the big amazon's bicep. "See, she's-" Another scream rips through the tent. "Fuck! Push again, damn it!" Hretha shouts. "There's another one!" Arona gasps. "T-twins!?" Another scream is followed by another, softer wail from inside. "A girl!" Arona cheers, sweeping you up into another hug. "Twins! A boy and a girl! Hahaha!" The big amazon turns, hefts Infrith up into a hug, and then sets the heavyset shamaness back down out her way so she can dip into the tent. There's a lot of angry orcish snarling and shouting in response to the invasion, but you suspect Arona doesn't care when her newborn children are just inside. Eventually it subsides into just the chieftain's jubilations — you imagine infants have been brought to breast, and the new mother's calmed herself down in Arona's arms. When Arona does finally come back out, it's with a weary, warm smile on her face. "Rjonar and Yngrith. That's going to be their names. Yngrith's going to have Hretha's gifts, looks like. Same foggy eyes. Big girl, too. And my son! Ah, he's got my eyes and Ylvy's hair. He's so handsome already!" You and the collected tribeswomen give the chief your congratulations, and several of the women dip inside to see the babies or give Ylvid their regards. You, though, are crushed into another great big hug. |"[pc.name]!" You've barely made it to the gates before you see Infrith come running, waving her arms. "It's Ylvid! The babies!" Well, shit, you got here just in time. You dart towards the shamans' tent[party.has arona | with Arona close behind |, and find Arona waiting outside for you ]. There's screaming inside, both Hretha's and Ylvid's, in a chaotic mix of orcish and Belharan curses. The big amazon clasps your shoulder before you step through the tentflap. Inside, Ylvid's sitting on a bloodied blanket, holding an infant to her breast with Hretha continues working between her legs. "Push!" the shaman commands. "Push, damn it!" Twins! Ylvid cuts you an absolutely furious look before squeezing her eyes closed and throwing all her strength into one last push. A few moments later, and Hretha's holding a second baby up, laughing as she washes it off in a basin of water close at hand. "Lucky you, [pc.name]. Ylvid wasn't as dried up as I feared after all." "Fuck you both!" the skald groans, accepting the second child. "Ah, a girl. One of each. A good omen, at least." "They're beautiful," you tell her, kneeling down beside where she lays and putting a hand on her sweat-soaked forehead. Ylvid tries to snort, but all the comes through is a weary sigh. "Yeah. We did good." She glances down at the babies now latched to either breast with a fond smile. "That fuckin' hurt, you know, you little rascals. You'd better grow up to be heroes for all that. Hmm. Rjonar and Yngrith, I think. I'll name them for the first Kervus." "Bad luck to name them early," Hretha says. "But good names anyway." Ylvid nods. "You're Lumian, they'll be find with you around. And with the mighty Champion watching over our tribe, too." "I'll keep them safe," you promise. Glancing at the pair, you give each infant's head a stroke. "Rjonar and Yngirth, huh? Gods, they're so big." "Yeah they are. Champions in the making, you ask me." You spend the next few hours getting to know Rjonar and Yngirth with their mother, before helping to wrap them both up and carry them to Ylvid's tent. You're just in time to see Arona dropping off a newly-built second crib to go with the one already prepared inside. She gives you a clap on the back, and introduces herself to the babies before letting Ylvid in to get them tucked in. "Congrats, you two," the chieftain says proudly. "The tribe's going to be so much stronger with those two around. I can feel it!" You can, too. ] |[var1 |Ylvid is waiting for you at the gates of the camp. Rjonar and Yngrith are trailing behind her, clutching at their mother's long cape... but your eyes are drawn from the young children to the bundle in Ylvid's arms. "Ylvid!" "Me," the skald laughs. "And our new sprat. A [rand |boy |girl ]. One more for my growing little horde." She smiles at you fondly, and her free hand pets Yngrith's messy brown hair. You take the opportunity to move in and get your arms around the newly postpartum mother, giving her and then your new child each a kiss. Ylvid clutches at your [pc.armor], keeping you from getting away from her lips for a few good, long moments.
